        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_cron_access()\n RETURNS event_trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT\n    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev\n    JOIN pg_extension AS ext\n    ON ev.objid = ext.oid\n    WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_cron'\n  )\n  THEN\n    grant usage on schema cron to postgres with grant option;\n\n    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on tables to postgres with grant option;\n    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on functions to postgres with grant option;\n    alter default privileges in schema cron grant all on sequences to postgres with grant option;\n\n    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all\n        on sequences to postgres with grant option;\n    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all\n        on tables to postgres with grant option;\n    alter default privileges for user supabase_admin in schema cron grant all\n        on functions to postgres with grant option;\n\n    grant all privileges on all tables in schema cron to postgres with grant option;\n    revoke all on table cron.job from postgres;\n    grant select on table cron.job to postgres with grant option;\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "schema": "extensions",
        "identity": "grant_pg_graphql_access()",
        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_graphql_access()\n RETURNS event_trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\nbegin\n    if not exists (\n        select 1\n        from pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() ev\n        join pg_catalog.pg_extension e on ev.objid = e.oid\n        where e.extname = 'pg_graphql'\n    ) then\n        return;\n    end if;\n\n    drop function if exists graphql_public.graphql;\n    create or replace function graphql_public.graphql(\n        \"operationName\" text default null,\n        query text default null,\n        variables jsonb default null,\n        extensions jsonb default null\n    )\n        returns jsonb\n        language sql\n    as $$\n        select graphql.resolve(\n            query := query,\n            variables := coalesce(variables, '{}'),\n            \"operationName\" := \"operationName\",\n            extensions := extensions\n        );\n    $$;\n\n    -- Attach the wrapper to the extension so DROP EXTENSION cascades to it,\n    -- which in turn triggers set_graphql_placeholder to reinstall the \"not enabled\" stub.\n    alter extension pg_graphql add function graphql_public.graphql(text, text, jsonb, jsonb);\n\n    grant usage on schema graphql to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;\n    grant execute on function graphql.resolve to postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;\n    grant usage on schema graphql to postgres with grant option;\n    grant usage on schema graphql_public to postgres with grant option;\nend;\n$function$\n",

        "identity": "grant_pg_net_access()",
        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.grant_pg_net_access()\n RETURNS event_trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands() AS ev\n    JOIN pg_extension AS ext\n    ON ev.objid = ext.oid\n    WHERE ext.extname = 'pg_net'\n  )\n  THEN\n    GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA net TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;\n\n    ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER;\n    ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SECURITY DEFINER;\n\n    ALTER function net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net;\n    ALTER function net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) SET search_path = net;\n\n    REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC;\n    REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) FROM PUBLIC;\n\n    GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_get(url text, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;\n    GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb, params jsonb, headers jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer) TO supabase_functions_admin, postgres, anon, authenticated, service_role;\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "identity": "pgrst_ddl_watch()",
        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch()\n RETURNS event_trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  cmd record;\nBEGIN\n  FOR cmd IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()\n  LOOP\n    IF cmd.command_tag IN (\n      'CREATE SCHEMA', 'ALTER SCHEMA'\n    , 'CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO', 'ALTER TABLE'\n    , 'CREATE FOREIGN TABLE', 'ALTER FOREIGN TABLE'\n    , 'CREATE VIEW', 'ALTER VIEW'\n    , 'CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW', 'ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW'\n    , 'CREATE FUNCTION', 'ALTER FUNCTION'\n    , 'CREATE TRIGGER'\n    , 'CREATE TYPE', 'ALTER TYPE'\n    , 'CREATE RULE'\n    , 'COMMENT'\n    )\n    -- don't notify in case of CREATE TEMP table or other objects created on pg_temp\n    AND cmd.schema_name is distinct from 'pg_temp'\n    THEN\n      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\nEND; $function$\n",
        "configuration": null
      },

        "acl": [

        "schema": "extensions",
        "identity": "pgrst_drop_watch()",
        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_drop_watch()\n RETURNS event_trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  obj record;\nBEGIN\n  FOR obj IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects()\n  LOOP\n    IF obj.object_type IN (\n      'schema'\n    , 'table'\n    , 'foreign table'\n    , 'view'\n    , 'materialized view'\n    , 'function'\n    , 'trigger'\n    , 'type'\n    , 'rule'\n    )\n    AND obj.is_temporary IS false -- no pg_temp objects\n    THEN\n      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\nEND; $function$\n",
        "configuration": null
      },

        "acl": [
          "=X/supabase_admin",

        "owner": "supabase_admin",
        "schema": "extensions",
        "identity": "set_graphql_placeholder()",
        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.set_graphql_placeholder()\n RETURNS event_trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $function$\n    DECLARE\n    graphql_is_dropped bool;\n    BEGIN\n    graphql_is_dropped = (\n        SELECT ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public'\n        FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects() AS ev\n        WHERE ev.schema_name = 'graphql_public'\n    );\n\n    IF graphql_is_dropped\n    THEN\n        create or replace function graphql_public.graphql(\n            \"operationName\" text default null,\n            query text default null,\n            variables jsonb default null,\n            extensions jsonb default null\n        )\n            returns jsonb\n            language plpgsql\n        as $$\n            DECLARE\n                server_version float;\n            BEGIN\n                server_version = (SELECT (SPLIT_PART((select version()), ' ', 2))::float);\n\n                IF server_version >= 14 THEN\n                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(\n                            jsonb_build_object(\n                                'message', 'pg_graphql extension is not enabled.'\n                            )\n                        )\n                    );\n                ELSE\n                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(\n                            jsonb_build_object(\n                                'message', 'pg_graphql is only available on projects running Postgres 14 onwards.'\n                            )\n                        )\n                    );\n                END IF;\n            END;\n        $$;\n    END IF;\n\n    END;\n$function$\n",
        "configuration": null

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION net.http_post(url text, body jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, params jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, headers jsonb DEFAULT '{\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"}'::jsonb, timeout_milliseconds integer DEFAULT 5000)\n RETURNS bigint\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'net'\nAS $function$\ndeclare\n    request_id bigint;\n    params_array text[];\n    content_type text;\nbegin\n\n    -- Exctract the content_type from headers\n    select\n        header_value into content_type\n    from\n        jsonb_each_text(coalesce(headers, '{}'::jsonb)) r(header_name, header_value)\n    where\n        lower(header_name) = 'content-type'\n    limit\n        1;\n\n    -- If the user provided new headers and omitted the content type\n    -- add it back in automatically\n    if content_type is null then\n        select headers || '{\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\"}'::jsonb into headers;\n    end if;\n\n    -- Confirm that the content-type is set as \"application/json\"\n    if content_type <> 'application/json' then\n        raise exception 'Content-Type header must be \"application/json\"';\n    end if;\n\n    select\n        coalesce(array_agg(net._urlencode_string(key) || '=' || net._urlencode_string(value)), '{}')\n    into\n        params_array\n    from\n        jsonb_each_text(params);\n\n    -- Add to the request queue\n    insert into net.http_request_queue(method, url, headers, body, timeout_milliseconds)\n    values (\n        'POST',\n        net._encode_url_with_params_array(url, params_array),\n        headers,\n        convert_to(body::text, 'UTF8'),\n        timeout_milliseconds\n    )\n    returning id\n    into request_id;\n\n    perform net.wake();\n\n    return request_id;\nend\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._archive_supplier_receipt_impl(p_receipt_id uuid, p_is_archived boolean DEFAULT true)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\nBEGIN\n  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب تسجيل الدخول لأرشفة سند الاستلام.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.supplier_receipts\n  SET\n    is_archived = p_is_archived,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_receipt_id;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سند الاستلام غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    CASE WHEN p_is_archived\n      THEN 'ARCHIVE_SUPPLIER_RECEIPT'\n      ELSE 'RESTORE_SUPPLIER_RECEIPT'\n    END,\n    'supplier_receipts',\n    p_receipt_id,\n    jsonb_build_object('is_archived', p_is_archived)\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'is_archived', p_is_archived\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._build_business_summary_before133(p_summary_type text, p_period_start date, p_period_end date, p_generated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_facts JSONB;\n  v_timezone TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  -- The inner builder validates the period and the configured timezone.\n  v_result := public._build_business_summary_before_phase6(\n    p_summary_type, p_period_start, p_period_end, p_generated_at\n  );\n  SELECT business_timezone INTO STRICT v_timezone\n  FROM public.business_alert_settings WHERE id = true;\n  v_facts := public.phase6_financial_facts_internal(\n    NULL,\n    p_period_start::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE v_timezone,\n    (p_period_end + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE v_timezone,\n    v_timezone,\n    false\n  );\n  v_result := jsonb_set(v_result, '{sales}', (v_result->'sales') || (v_facts->'sales'));\n  v_result := jsonb_set(v_result, '{balances}', (v_result->'balances') || (v_facts->'balances'));\n  v_result := jsonb_set(v_result, '{expenses}', (v_result->'expenses') || (v_facts->'expenses'));\n  v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object(\n    'cashFlow', v_facts->'cashFlow',\n    'dailyBreakdown', v_facts->'dailyBreakdown'\n  );\n  IF jsonb_typeof(v_result) <> 'object'\n    OR octet_length(v_result::TEXT) > 32768\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Business summary payload is invalid or too large.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._build_business_summary_before_phase6(p_summary_type text, p_period_start date, p_period_end date, p_generated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_timezone TEXT;\n  v_period_start TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_period_end TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_summary_type NOT IN ('daily', 'weekly')\n    OR p_period_start IS NULL OR p_period_end IS NULL\n    OR p_generated_at IS NULL\n    OR (p_summary_type = 'daily' AND p_period_start <> p_period_end)\n    OR (p_summary_type = 'weekly' AND p_period_end <> p_period_start + 6)\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid Business summary period.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT business_timezone INTO STRICT v_timezone\n  FROM public.business_alert_settings WHERE id = true;\n  v_period_start := p_period_start::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE v_timezone;\n  v_period_end := (p_period_end + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE v_timezone;\n\n  WITH completion_events AS (\n    SELECT DISTINCT ON (osh.order_id)\n      osh.order_id,\n      osh.created_at AS completed_at\n    FROM public.order_status_history osh\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = osh.order_id\n    WHERE osh.new_status = 'completed'\n      AND osh.created_at >= v_period_start\n      AND osh.created_at < v_period_end\n    ORDER BY osh.order_id, osh.created_at\n  ),\n  completed_orders AS (\n    SELECT o.*, ce.completed_at\n    FROM completion_events ce\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = ce.order_id\n    WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'returned')\n  ),\n  item_basis AS (\n    SELECT\n      co.id AS order_id,\n      COALESCE(co.discount_in_minor_units, 0)::BIGINT AS order_discount,\n      oi.id AS order_item_id,\n      COALESCE(oi.line_total_in_minor_units, 0)::BIGINT AS line_total,\n      COALESCE(oi.cogs_in_minor_units, 0)::BIGINT AS cogs,\n      SUM(COALESCE(oi.line_total_in_minor_units, 0)) OVER (\n        PARTITION BY co.id\n      )::BIGINT AS lines_subtotal,\n      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n        PARTITION BY co.id ORDER BY oi.created_at NULLS LAST, oi.id\n      ) AS allocation_rank\n    FROM completed_orders co\n    JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = co.id\n  ),\n  base_allocations AS (\n    SELECT *,\n      CASE\n        WHEN order_discount > 0 AND lines_subtotal > 0\n          THEN (order_discount * line_total) / lines_subtotal\n        ELSE 0\n      END::BIGINT AS base_discount\n    FROM item_basis\n  ),\n  discounted_items AS (\n    SELECT *,\n      (\n        base_discount + CASE\n          WHEN allocation_rank <= (\n            order_discount - SUM(base_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id)\n          ) THEN 1 ELSE 0\n        END\n      )::BIGINT AS allocated_discount\n    FROM base_allocations\n  ),\n  sales AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS order_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS gross_sales,\n      COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units) FILTER (\n        WHERE payment_method IN ('cash', 'cash_on_delivery')\n      ), 0)::BIGINT AS cash_sales,\n      COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units) FILTER (\n        WHERE payment_method = 'cliq'\n      ), 0)::BIGINT AS cliq_sales,\n      COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units) FILTER (\n        WHERE payment_method = 'debt'\n      ), 0)::BIGINT AS credit_sales,\n      COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units) FILTER (\n        WHERE COALESCE(payment_method, 'unknown') NOT IN (\n          'cash', 'cash_on_delivery', 'cliq', 'debt'\n        )\n      ), 0)::BIGINT AS other_sales\n    FROM completed_orders\n  ),\n  item_totals AS (\n    SELECT\n      COALESCE(SUM(cogs), 0)::BIGINT AS cogs,\n      COALESCE(SUM(line_total - allocated_discount - cogs), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS gross_profit,\n      COALESCE(SUM(allocated_discount), 0)::BIGINT AS allocated_discounts\n    FROM discounted_items\n  ),\n  returns AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS return_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(sr.refund_amount_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS refunds,\n      COALESCE((\n        SELECT SUM(oi.cogs_in_minor_units)\n        FROM public.sales_returns restocked_return\n        JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = restocked_return.order_id\n        WHERE restocked_return.stock_disposition = 'restock'\n          AND restocked_return.created_at >= v_period_start\n          AND restocked_return.created_at < v_period_end\n      ), 0)::BIGINT AS recovered_cogs\n    FROM public.sales_returns sr\n    WHERE sr.created_at >= v_period_start AND sr.created_at < v_period_end\n  ),\n  expenses AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS expense_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS total_expenses,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER (\n        WHERE payment_method = 'cash'\n      ), 0)::BIGINT AS cash_expenses,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER (\n        WHERE payment_method = 'cliq'\n      ), 0)::BIGINT AS cliq_expenses\n    FROM public.operational_expenses\n    WHERE created_at >= v_period_start AND created_at < v_period_end\n      AND COALESCE(is_reversed, false) = false\n  ),\n  purchases AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS receipt_count,\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._calculate_guest_promotion(p_code text, p_items jsonb, p_customer_phone text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_code TEXT := UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(p_code), ''));\n  v_phone TEXT := CASE\n    WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(p_customer_phone), '') IS NULL THEN NULL\n    ELSE public.normalize_customer_phone(p_customer_phone)\n  END;\n  v_promotion public.promotion_codes%ROWTYPE;\n  v_item JSONB;\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_package_price BIGINT;\n  v_units_per_package INTEGER;\n  v_subtotal BIGINT := 0;\n  v_discount BIGINT := 0;\n  v_total_redemptions INTEGER := 0;\n  v_phone_redemptions INTEGER := 0;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_code IS NULL OR v_code !~ '^[A-Z0-9_-]{3,32}$' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'اكتب رمز خصم صحيحاً.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_items IS NULL\n    OR jsonb_typeof(p_items) <> 'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_items) > 50\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سلة الطلب غير صالحة لحساب الخصم.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) AS item(value)\n    GROUP BY item.value->>'product_id'\n    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تكرار المنتج نفسه داخل الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_item IN\n    SELECT item.value\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) AS item(value)\n    ORDER BY item.value->>'product_id'\n  LOOP\n    BEGIN\n      v_product_id := (v_item->>'product_id')::UUID;\n      v_quantity := (v_item->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n    EXCEPTION\n      WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات أحد طرود الطلب غير صحيحة.';\n    END;\n\n    IF v_product_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(v_quantity, 0) <= 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات أحد طرود الطلب غير صحيحة.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT\n      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      p.units_per_sale_unit\n    INTO v_package_price, v_units_per_package\n    FROM public.products AS p\n    WHERE p.id = v_product_id\n      AND p.is_active = true;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND\n      OR COALESCE(v_package_price, 0) <= 0\n      OR COALESCE(v_units_per_package, 0) <= 0\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'أحد منتجات السلة غير متاح للبيع.';\n    END IF;\n\n    v_subtotal := v_subtotal + (v_quantity * v_package_price);\n  END LOOP;\n\n  SELECT pc.*\n  INTO v_promotion\n  FROM public.promotion_codes AS pc\n  WHERE pc.code = v_code\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_promotion.is_active THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رمز الخصم غير صحيح أو غير فعال.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_promotion.starts_at IS NOT NULL\n    AND NOW() < v_promotion.starts_at\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رمز الخصم لم يبدأ بعد.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_promotion.expires_at IS NOT NULL\n    AND NOW() >= v_promotion.expires_at\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'انتهت صلاحية رمز الخصم.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_subtotal < v_promotion.minimum_subtotal_in_minor_units THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'الطلب لا يصل إلى الحد الأدنى المطلوب لهذا الخصم.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER\n  INTO v_total_redemptions\n  FROM public.promotion_redemptions AS pr\n  WHERE pr.promotion_code_id = v_promotion.id;\n\n  IF v_promotion.maximum_total_redemptions IS NOT NULL\n    AND v_total_redemptions >= v_promotion.maximum_total_redemptions\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تم استنفاد عدد استخدامات رمز الخصم.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_phone IS NOT NULL THEN\n    IF v_phone !~ '^07[789][0-9]{7}$' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الهاتف الأردني غير صحيح.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER\n    INTO v_phone_redemptions\n    FROM public.promotion_redemptions AS pr\n    WHERE pr.promotion_code_id = v_promotion.id\n      AND pr.customer_phone = v_phone;\n\n    IF v_phone_redemptions >=\n      v_promotion.maximum_redemptions_per_phone\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'تم استخدام رمز الخصم لهذا الرقم من قبل.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_promotion.discount_type = 'fixed' THEN\n    v_discount := LEAST(v_promotion.discount_value, v_subtotal);\n  ELSE\n    v_discount := FLOOR(\n      (v_subtotal::NUMERIC * v_promotion.discount_value::NUMERIC)\n      / 10000\n    )::BIGINT;\n\n    IF v_promotion.maximum_discount_in_minor_units IS NOT NULL THEN\n      v_discount := LEAST(\n        v_discount,\n        v_promotion.maximum_discount_in_minor_units\n      );\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_discount := LEAST(GREATEST(v_discount, 0), v_subtotal);\n  IF v_discount <= 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'قيمة الخصم المحسوبة غير صالحة لهذا الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'promotion_code_id', v_promotion.id,\n    'code', v_promotion.code,\n    'description', v_promotion.description_ar,\n    'subtotal', v_subtotal,\n    'discount', v_discount,\n    'total', v_subtotal - v_discount,\n    'message', 'تم تطبيق رمز الخصم بنجاح.'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._cancel_empty_cash_shift_before_return_events(p_shift_id uuid, p_reason text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_shift public.cash_shifts%ROWTYPE;\n  v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_reason), '');\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager'],\n    'إلغاء وردية فُتحت بالخطأ'\n  );\n\n  IF v_reason IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_reason) < 2 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'اكتب سبب إلغاء الوردية.';\n  END IF;\n  IF CHAR_LENGTH(v_reason) > 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سبب إلغاء الوردية أطول من المسموح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_shift\n  FROM public.cash_shifts\n  WHERE id = p_shift_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الوردية المحددة غير موجودة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_shift.status <> 'open' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يمكن إلغاء وردية مفتوحة فقط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.orders\n    WHERE cash_shift_id = p_shift_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.customer_payments\n    WHERE cash_shift_id = p_shift_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_payments\n    WHERE cash_shift_id = p_shift_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.operational_expenses\n    WHERE shift_id = p_shift_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_returns\n    WHERE cash_shift_id = p_shift_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'لا يمكن إلغاء الوردية لأنها تحتوي حركة مالية. صحح العملية ثم أغلق الوردية طبيعيًا.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.cash_shifts\n  SET\n    status = 'cancelled',\n    cancelled_by = v_user_id,\n    cancelled_at = NOW(),\n    cancellation_reason = v_reason,\n    expected_cash_in_minor_units = opening_cash_in_minor_units,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_shift_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'CANCEL_EMPTY_CASH_SHIFT',\n    'cash_shifts',\n    p_shift_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'shift_number', v_shift.shift_number,\n      'opening_cash_in_minor_units',\n        v_shift.opening_cash_in_minor_units,\n      'reason', v_reason,\n      'verified_empty', true\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN public.get_cash_shift_display_summary(p_shift_id)\n    || jsonb_build_object(\n      'success', true,\n      'message',\n        'تم إلغاء الوردية الفارغة وحفظ السبب في سجل التدقيق.'\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._cancel_order_impl_before_phase4_lock(p_order_id uuid, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_number TEXT;\n  v_warehouse_id UUID;\n  v_old_status TEXT;\n  v_item RECORD;\n  v_user_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := auth.uid();\n\n  -- Fetch order details\n  SELECT order_number, warehouse_id, status\n  INTO v_order_number, v_warehouse_id, v_old_status\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب المحدد غير موجود في قاعدة البيانات.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_old_status = 'completed' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إلغاء طلب مكتمل ومخصوم من المخزون بالفعل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_old_status = 'cancelled' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب ملغى بالفعل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Release reserved stock for each order item if warehouse_id is set\n  IF v_warehouse_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    FOR v_item IN\n      SELECT product_id, quantity\n      FROM public.order_items\n      WHERE order_id = p_order_id\n    LOOP\n      UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n      SET reserved_quantity = GREATEST(0, reserved_quantity - v_item.quantity),\n          updated_at = NOW()\n      WHERE warehouse_id = v_warehouse_id AND product_id = v_item.product_id;\n    END LOOP;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Update order status to cancelled\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET status = 'cancelled',\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_order_id;\n\n  -- Record status history\n  INSERT INTO public.order_status_history (\n    order_id,\n    old_status,\n    new_status,\n    changed_by,\n    notes\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_order_id,\n    v_old_status,\n    'cancelled',\n    v_user_id,\n    COALESCE(p_notes, 'إلغاء الطلب وتحرير الكمية المحجوزة بالمخزون')\n  );\n\n  -- Record audit log\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'cancel_order',\n    'orders',\n    p_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'order_number', v_order_number,\n      'old_status', v_old_status,\n      'new_status', 'cancelled'\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'order_id', p_order_id,\n    'order_number', v_order_number,\n    'status', 'cancelled',\n    'message', 'تم إلغاء الطلب وتحرير المخزون المحجوز بنجاح.'\n  );\n\nEXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'فشلت عملية إلغاء الطلب: %', SQLERRM;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

WHERE receipt.id = p_purchase_receipt_id\n      AND receipt.phase2_finalized_at IS NOT NULL\n  ) THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY(\n      SELECT DISTINCT         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._complete_order_impl_before_phase4_lock(p_order_id uuid, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_number TEXT;\n  v_warehouse_id UUID;\n  v_old_status TEXT;\n  v_item RECORD;\n  v_on_hand INT;\n  v_reserved INT;\n  v_new_on_hand INT;\n  v_new_reserved INT;\n  v_user_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := auth.uid();\n\n  -- Fetch order details with lock\n  SELECT order_number, warehouse_id, status\n  INTO v_order_number, v_warehouse_id, v_old_status\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب المحدد غير موجود في قاعدة البيانات.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_old_status = 'completed' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب مكتمل ومخصوم من المخزون بالفعل، ولا يمكن إكماله مرة أخرى.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_old_status = 'cancelled' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إكمال طلب ملغى.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_warehouse_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المستودع الخاص بالطلب غير محدد.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Process inventory deduction for each order item\n  FOR v_item IN\n    SELECT product_id, quantity\n    FROM public.order_items\n    WHERE order_id = p_order_id\n  LOOP\n    SELECT on_hand_quantity, reserved_quantity\n    INTO v_on_hand, v_reserved\n    FROM public.inventory_balances\n    WHERE warehouse_id = v_warehouse_id AND product_id = v_item.product_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'لم يتم العثور على رصيد المخزون للمنتج برقم (%) في المستودع.', v_item.product_id;\n    END IF;\n\n    v_new_on_hand := v_on_hand - v_item.quantity;\n    v_new_reserved := GREATEST(0, v_reserved - v_item.quantity);\n\n    IF v_new_on_hand < 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'الكمية الفعلية بالمخزون غير كافية لخصم الطلب. المتوفر الفعلي: %', v_on_hand;\n    END IF;\n\n    -- Update balance row\n    UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n    SET on_hand_quantity = v_new_on_hand,\n        reserved_quantity = v_new_reserved,\n        updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE warehouse_id = v_warehouse_id AND product_id = v_item.product_id;\n\n    -- Record sales deduction movement\n    INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements (\n      warehouse_id,\n      product_id,\n      movement_type,\n      quantity,\n      balance_before,\n      balance_after,\n      reference_type,\n      reference_id,\n      notes,\n      created_by\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_warehouse_id,\n      v_item.product_id,\n      'sales_deduction',\n      -v_item.quantity,\n      v_on_hand,\n      v_new_on_hand,\n      'order',\n      p_order_id,\n      'خصم مبيعات نهائي للطلب رقم ' || v_order_number,\n      v_user_id\n    );\n  END LOOP;\n\n  -- Update order status to completed and payment_status to paid\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET status = 'completed',\n      payment_status = 'paid',\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_order_id;\n\n  -- Record status history\n  INSERT INTO public.order_status_history (\n    order_id,\n    old_status,\n    new_status,\n    changed_by,\n    notes\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_order_id,\n    v_old_status,\n    'completed',\n    v_user_id,\n    COALESCE(p_notes, 'تسليم الطلب وإكمال الخصم النهائي من المخزون وتحصيل المبلغ')\n  );\n\n  -- Record audit log\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'complete_order',\n    'orders',\n    p_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'order_number', v_order_number,\n      'old_status', v_old_status,\n      'new_status', 'completed'\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'order_id', p_order_id,\n    'order_number', v_order_number,\n    'status', 'completed',\n    'message', 'تم إكمال الطلب وخصم الكميات من المخزون وتحديث الحسابات بنجاح.'\n  );\n\nEXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'فشلت عملية إكمال الطلب: %', SQLERRM;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_payment_method TEXT := v_payment_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'تسليم الطلب وتسجيل التحصيل والذمة'\n  );\n\n  IF v_payment_method = 'cash_on_delivery' THEN\n    v_payment_method := 'cash';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_payment_method NOT IN ('cash', 'cliq', 'debt') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'طريقة التحصيل يجب أن تكون كاش أو CliQ أو على الحساب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT *\n  INTO v_order\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_order.source = 'pos' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'طلبات البيع المباشر تُحصّل من شاشة نقطة البيع.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_order.status NOT IN ('ready', 'out_for_delivery') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا IF;\n\n  v_total := v_order.subtotal_in_minor_units\n    - v_order.discount_in_minor_units\n    + v_delivery_fee;\n  IF v_total < 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'إجمالي الطلب بعد الخصم والتوصيل غير صحيح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_collected := CASE\n    WHEN v_payment_method = 'debt' THEN 0\n    ELSE COALESCE(p_amount_collected_in_minor_units, v_total)\n  END;\n  IF v_collected < 0 OR v_collected > v_total THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المبلغ المقبوض يجب أن يكون بين صفر وإجمالي الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_collected = 0 THEN\n    v_payment_method := 'debt';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_payment_method = 'cliq'\n    AND v_collected > 0\n    AND NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), '') IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم مرجع CliQ مطلوب عند تسجيل التحويل.';\n  END IF;\n  IF CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(TRIM(p_reference_number), '')) > 120 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم مرجع الدفع أطول من الحد المسموح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_remaining := v_total - v_collected;\n  IF v_remaining > 0 AND v_order.customer_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب ربط الطلب بعميل مسجل قبل تسجيل ذمة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT id, shift_number\n  INTO v_shift_id, v_shift_number\n  FROM public.cash_shifts\n  WHERE branch_id = v_order.branch_id\n    AND status = 'open'\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF v_collected > 0 AND v_shift_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'افتح وردية الصندوق أولًا قبل تسجيل المبلغ المقبوض.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET\n    delivery_fee_in_minor_units = v_delivery_fee,\n    total_in_minor_units = v_total,\n    payment_method = CASE\n      WHEN v_remaining > 0 THEN 'debt'\n      WHEN v_payment_method = 'cash' THEN 'cash_on_delivery'\n      ELSE 'cliq'\n    END,\n    amount_paid_in_minor_units = 0,\n    payment_reference_number = CASE\n      WHEN v_payment_method = 'cliq' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), '')\n      ELSE NULL\n    END,\n    payment_confirmed_at = CASE WHEN v_collected > 0 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,\n    payment_confirmed_by = CASE WHEN v_collected > 0 THEN v_user_id ELSE NULL END,\n    cash_shift_id = v_shift_id,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_order_id;\n\n  v_result := public.complete_order(\n    p_order_id,\n    COALESCE(\n      NULLIF(TRIM(p_notes), ''),\n      CASE\n        WHEN v_remaining = 0 THEN 'تم التسليم وقبض كامل المبلغ'\n        WHEN v_collected = 0 THEN 'تم التسليم وكامل المبلغ على حساب العميل'\n        ELSE 'تم التسليم وتسجيل دفعة جزئية والباقي ذمة'\n      END\n    )\n  );\n\n  IF v_remaining > 0 AND v_collected > 0 THEN\n    v_payment_result := public.record_customer_order_payment(\n      p_order_id,\n      v_collected,\n      v_payment_method,\n      NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), ''),\n      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_notes), ''), 'دفعة مستلمة عند تسليم الطلب')\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'COMPLETE_WEBSITE_ORDER_WITH_SETTLEMENT',\n    'orders',\n    p_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'order_number', v_order.order_number,\n      'delivery_fee_in_minor_units', v_delivery_fee,\n jsonb_build_object(\n    'payment_method', CASE WHEN v_remaining > 0 THEN 'debt' ELSE v_payment_method END,\n    'payment_status', CASE\n      WHEN v_remaining = 0 THEN 'paid'\n      WHEN v_collected > 0 THEN 'partially_paid'\n      ELSE 'unpaid'\n    END,\n    'total_in_minor_units', v_total,\n    'amount_paid_in_minor_units', v_collected,\n    'remaining_in_minor_units', v_remaining,\n  END\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._confirm_order_impl(p_order_id uuid, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_number TEXT;\n  v_old_status TEXT;\n  v_user_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := auth.uid();\n\n  -- Fetch order details with row lock\n  SELECT order_number, status\n  INTO v_order_number, v_old_status\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب المحدد غير موجود في قاعدة البيانات.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_old_status = 'cancelled' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تأكيد طلب ملغى.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_old_status = 'completed' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب مكتمل بالفعل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Update order status to confirmed\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET status = 'confirmed',\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_order_id;\n\n  -- Record status transition\n  INSERT INTO public.order_status_history (\n    order_id,\n    old_status,\n    new_status,\n    changed_by,\n    notes\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_order_id,\n    v_old_status,\n    'confirmed',\n    v_user_id,\n    COALESCE(p_notes, 'تأكيد الطلب وبدء تحضيره (المخزون محجوز)')\n  );\n\n  -- Record audit log\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'confirm_order',\n    'orders',\n    p_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'order_number', v_order_number,\n      'old_status', v_old_status,\n      'new_status', 'confirmed'\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'order_id', p_order_id,\n    'order_number', v_order_number,\n    'status', 'confirmed',\n    'message', 'تم تأكيد الطلب بنجاح ويبقى المخزون محجوزاً.'\n  );\n\nEXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'فشلت عملية تأكيد الطلب: %', SQLERRM;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

       (v_item->>'units_per_package')::INTEGER,\n      sale_package_name_snapshot = v_item->>'package_name',\n      sale_package_price_in_minor_units =\n        (v_item->>'package_price')::BIGINT,\n );\n        END LOOP;\n        PERFORM public.finalize_order_parcel_instance_internal(\n          (v_instance->>'instance_id')::UUID\n        );\n      END LOOP;\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  -- Every balance was already checked and locked above.\n  FOR v_line IN\n    SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_final_lines)\n    ORDER BY (value->>'line_sequence')::INTEGER\n  LOOP\n    IF v_line->>'commercial_line_kind' <> 'configurable_parcel' THEN\n      v_movement_quantity := (v_line->>'base_quantity')::INTEGER;\n      SELECT on_hand_quantity INTO v_on_hand\n      FROM public.inventory_balances\n      WHERE warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n        AND product_id = (v_line->>'product_id')::UUID\n      FOR UPDATE;\n      v_balance_after := v_on_hand -         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._create_purchase_order_impl(p_supplier_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_expected_delivery_date timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_discount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_supplier_invoice_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_internal_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_items jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID;\n  v_po_id UUID;\n  v_po_number TEXT;\n  v_item JSONB;\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_ordered_qty INT;\n  v_unit_price BIGINT;\n  v_item_discount BIGINT;\n  v_line_total BIGINT;\n  v_subtotal BIGINT := 0;\n  v_total BIGINT := 0;\n  v_item_count INT := 0;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := auth.uid();\n\n  -- 1. Validate Supplier\n  IF p_supplier_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id = p_supplier_id AND is_active = true) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المورد المحدد غير موجود أو غير مفعل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- 2. Validate Items Array\n  IF p_items IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب إضافة منتج واحد على الأقل في أمر الشراء.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- 3. Calculate Subtotal & Validate Items\n  FOR v_item IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items)\n  LOOP\n    v_product_id := (v_item->>'product_id')::UUID;\n    v_ordered_qty := COALESCE((v_item->>'ordered_quantity')::INT, 0);\n    v_unit_price := COALESCE((v_item->>'purchase_price_in_minor_units')::BIGINT, 0);\n    v_item_discount := COALESCE((v_item->>'discount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT, 0);\n\n    IF v_product_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.products WHERE id = v_product_id AND is_active = true) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'أحد المنتجات المحددة غير موجود أو غير مفعل.';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_ordered_qty <= 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'الكمية المطلوبة لكل منتج يجب أن تكون أكبر من صفر.';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_unit_price < 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'سعر الشراء لا يمكن أن يكون بالسالب.';\n    END IF;\n\n    v_line_total := (v_ordered_qty * v_unit_price) - v_item_discount;\n    IF v_line_total < 0 THEN v_line_total := 0; END IF;\n\n    v_subtotal := v_subtotal + v_line_total;\n    v_item_count := v_item_count + 1;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  v_total := v_subtotal - COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0) + COALESCE(p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units, 0);\n  IF v_total < 0 THEN v_total := 0; END IF;\n\n  -- 4. Generate Unique PO Number: PO-2026-XXXX\n  v_po_number := 'PO-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY') || '-' || LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(1000 + RANDOM() * 9000) AS TEXT), 4, '0');\n  WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE purchase_order_number = v_po_number) LOOP\n    v_po_number := 'PO-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY') || '-' || LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(1000 + RANDOM() * 9000) AS TEXT), 4, '0');\n  END LOOP;\n\n  -- 5. Insert Purchase Order Header\n  INSERT INTO public.purchase_orders (\n    purchase_order_number,\n    supplier_id,\n    branch_id,\n    warehouse_id,\n    status,\n    order_date,\n    expected_delivery_date,\n    subtotal_in_minor_units,\n    discount_in_minor_units,\n    delivery_fee_in_minor_units,\n    total_in_minor_units,\n    amount_paid_in_minor_units,\n    supplier_invoice_number,\n    notes,\n    internal_notes,\n    created_by\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_po_number,\n    p_supplier_id,\n    p_branch_id,\n    p_warehouse_id,\n    'draft',\n    NOW(),\n    p_expected_delivery_date,\n    v_subtotal,\n    COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0),\n    COALESCE(p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units, 0),\n    v_total,\n    0,\n    p_supplier_invoice_number,\n    p_notes,\n    p_internal_notes,\n    v_user_id\n  )\n  RETURNING id INTO v_po_id;\n\n  -- 6. Insert Purchase Order Items\n  FOR v_item IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items)\n  LOOP\n    v_product_id := (v_item->>'product_id')::UUID;\n    v_ordered_qty := (v_item->>'ordered_quantity')::INT;\n    v_unit_price := (v_item->>'purchase_price_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;\n    v_item_discount := COALESCE((v_item->>'discount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT, 0);\n    v_line_total := (v_ordered_qty * v_unit_price) - v_item_discount;\n    IF v_line_total < 0 THEN v_line_total := 0; END IF;\n\n    INSERT INTO public.purchase_order_items (\n      purchase_order_id,\n      product_id,\n      ordered_quantity,\n      received_quantity,\n      purchase_price_in_minor_units,\n      discount_in_minor_units,\n      line_total_in_minor_units\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_po_id,\n      v_product_id,\n      v_ordered_qty,\n      0,\n      v_unit_price,\n      v_item_discount,\n      v_line_total\n    );\n  END LOOP;\n\n  -- 7. Audit Log\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'إنشاء أمر شراء',\n    'purchase_orders',\n    v_po_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'purchase_order_number', v_po_number,\n      'supplier_id', p_supplier_id,\n      'total_in_minor_units', v_total,\n      'items_count', v_item_count\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'purchase_order_id', v_po_id,\n    'purchase_order_number', v_po_number,\n    'total_in_minor_units', v_total,\n    'message', 'تم إنشاء أمر الشراء مسودة بنجاح'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._get_cash_shift_closing_report_before_return_events(p_shift_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_report JSONB;\n  v_shift public.cash_shifts%ROWTYPE;\n  v_summary JSONB;\n  v_reversed_receipt_count INTEGER := 0;\n  v_reversed_expense_count INTEGER := 0;\n  v_expense_breakdown JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_gross_sales BIGINT := 0;\n  v_total_refunds BIGINT := 0;\n  v_total_inflows BIGINT := 0;\n  v_total_outflows BIGINT := 0;\n  v_net_cliq BIGINT := 0;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'عرض تقرير إغلاق الوردية'\n  );\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_shift\n  FROM public.cash_shifts\n  WHERE id = p_shift_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الوردية المحددة غير موجودة.'; END IF;\n\n  v_report := public._get_cash_shift_closing_report_v1(p_shift_id);\n  IF v_shift.status <> 'open' THEN RETURN v_report; END IF;\n\n  v_summary := public.get_cash_shift_summary(p_shift_id);\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_reversed_receipt_count\n  FROM public.customer_payments cp\n  JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = cp.order_id\n  WHERE cp.cash_shift_id = p_shift_id\n    AND o.payment_method = 'debt'\n    AND cp.is_reversed = true;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_reversed_expense_count\n  FROM public.operational_expenses\n  WHERE shift_id = p_shift_id\n    AND is_reversed = true;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'category', category,\n      'count', item_count,\n      'amountInMinorUnits', amount_in_minor_units\n    ) ORDER BY amount_in_minor_units DESC, category\n  ), '[]'::JSONB)\n  INTO v_expense_breakdown\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      category,\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS item_count,\n      SUM(amount_in_minor_units)::BIGINT AS amount_in_minor_units\n    FROM public.operational_expenses\n    WHERE shift_id = p_shift_id\n      AND is_reversed = false\n    GROUP BY category\n  ) active_expense_groups;\n\n  v_gross_sales := COALESCE((v_report #>> '{sales,grossSalesInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT, 0);\n  v_total_refunds := COALESCE((v_report #>> '{sales,refundsInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT, 0);\n  v_total_inflows := v_gross_sales\n o.amount_paid_in_minor_units,\n          0\n        )), 0)::BIGINT AS current_balance_in_minor_units\n        FROM public.orders o\n        WHERE o.customer_id = c.id\n          AND o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')\n          AND o.amount_paid_in_minor_units < o.total_in_minor_units\n          AND (\n            COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos'\n            OR o.payment_method = 'debt'\n          )\n      ) receivable_stats ON true\n      WHERE c.is_deleted = false\n        AND (\n          v_search IS NULL\n          OR c.full_name ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(c.phone, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(c.email, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n        )\n        AND (\n          v_status = 'all'\n          OR (v_status = 'vip' AND c.is_vip = true)\n          OR (v_status = 'active' AND c.is_active = true AND c.is_blocked = false)\n          OR (v_status = 'inactive' AND c.is_active = false AND c.is_blocked = false)\n          OR (v_status = 'blocked' AND c.is_blocked = true)\n        )\n    ),\n    paged_customers AS (\n      SELECT *\n      FROM customer_directory\n      ORDER BY\n        CASE WHEN v_sort = 'highest_spending' THEN total_spending_in_minor_units END DESC,\n        CASE WHEN v_sort = 'most_orders' THEN total_orders_count END DESC,\n        CASE WHEN v_sort = 'latest' THEN created_at END DESC,\n        id DESC\n      OFFSET v_offset\n      LIMIT v_page_size\n    )\n    SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n      'customers', COALESCE(\n        (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(pc)) FROM paged_customers pc),\n        '[]'::JSONB\n      ),\n      'total_count', (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM customer_directory)\n    )\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._get_home_dashboard_before133()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_shared219 JSONB;\n  v_business_date DATE := (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE;\n  v_today_start TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_tomorrow_start TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_month_start TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_month JSONB;\n  v_week JSONB;\n  v_today JSONB;\n  v_today_sales BIGINT := 0;\n  v_today_completed_orders INTEGER := 0;\n  v_month_sales BIGINT := 0;\n  v_month_profit BIGINT := 0;\n  v_open_orders INTEGER := 0;\n  v_new_orders INTEGER := 0;\n  v_customer_receivables BIGINT := 0;\n  v_supplier_payables BIGINT := 0;\n  v_inventory_value BIGINT := 0;\n  v_active_products INTEGER := 0;\n  v_active_customers INTEGER := 0;\n  v_low_stock INTEGER := 0;\n  v_out_of_stock INTEGER := 0;\n  v_configuration_issues INTEGER := 0;\n  v_can_view_profit BOOLEAN := false;\n  v_latest_orders JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_stock_alerts JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_order_statuses JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_seven_day_sales JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY[\n      'owner',\n      'admin',\n      'manager',\n      'accountant',\n      'sales',\n      'warehouse_keeper',\n      'delivery_driver'\n    ],\n    'عرض الصفحة الرئيسية'\n  );\n\n  v_today_start :=\n    v_business_date::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n  v_tomorrow_start :=\n    (v_business_date + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n  v_month_start :=\n    date_trunc(\n      'month',\n      v_business_date::TIMESTAMP\n    ) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n\n  SELECT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.user_roles ur\n    JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id\n    WHERE ur.user_id = auth.uid()\n      AND r.code IN ('owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant')\n  )\n  INTO v_can_view_profit;\n\n  -- The131 equations are unchanged. Only the home reader skips periodic\n  -- evidence revalidation; reports and summaries remain strict.\n  BEGIN\n    IF v_today_start - INTERVAL '6 days' >= v_month_start THEN\n      v_month := public.phase6_financial_facts_internal(\n      NULL, v_month_start, v_tomorrow_start, 'Asia/Amman', false);\n    ELSE\n      v_shared219:=public.home219_shared_period_facts_internal(NULL,v_month_start,v_tomorrow_start,v_today_start - INTERVAL '6 days',v_tomorrow_start,'Asia/Amman');\n      v_month:=v_shared219->'month';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_today_start - INTERVAL '6 days' >= v_month_start THEN\n      -- Daily values are period-local by date. Reuse them only when the\n      -- complete seven-day interval is contained in the monthly interval.\n      SELECT jsonb_build_object('dailyBreakdown', jsonb_agg(day ORDER BY day->>'date'))\n      INTO v_week FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_month->'dailyBreakdown') day\n      WHERE (day->>'date')::DATE >= v_business_date - 6;\n    ELSE\n      -- Month boundary: never drop days from the previous month.\n      v_week:=v_shared219->'week';\n    END IF;\n  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n    -- Preserve the complete pre131 unavailable response, including its old\n    -- financial numbers. Expensive legacy calculations run ONLY on fallback.\n    RETURN public._get_home_dashboard_before_phase6()\n      || jsonb_build_object('financialFactsStatus', 'unavailable');\n  END;\n  SELECT day INTO v_today FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_week->'dailyBreakdown') day\n  WHERE (day->>'date')::DATE = v_business_date;\n  v_today_sales := COALESCE((v_today->>'grossSalesInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0);\n  v_today_completed_orders := COALESCE((v_today->>'completedOrderCount')::INTEGER, 0);\n  v_month_sales := (v_month #>> '{sales,grossSalesInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT;\n  v_month_profit := (v_month #>> '{sales,netProfitInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT;\n  v_customer_receivables := (v_month #>> '{balances,customerDueInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT;\n\n  SELECT\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (\n      WHERE status IN (\n        'new',\n        'confirmed',\n        'preparing',\n        'ready',\n        'out_for_delivery'\n      )\n    )::INTEGER,\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'new')::INTEGER\n  INTO\n    v_open_orders,\n    v_new_orders\n  FROM public.orders;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(s.current_balance_in_minor_units, 0)), 0)\n  INTO v_supplier_payables\n  FROM public.suppliers s\n  WHERE s.is_active = true;\n\n  SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(\n    ib.on_hand_quantity::NUMERIC\n      * COALESCE(p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact, p.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC)\n  ), 0), 0)::BIGINT\n  INTO v_inventory_value\n  FROM public.inventory_balances ib\n  JOIN public.products p ON p.id = ib.product_id\n  WHERE p.is_active = true;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER\n  INTO v_active_products\n  FROM public.products\n  WHERE is_active = true;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER\n  INTO v_active_customers\n  FROM public.customers\n  WHERE is_active = true\n    AND is_deleted = false;\n\n  WITH product_stock AS (\n    SELECT\n      p.id,\n      p.min_stock_level,\n      p.sale_unit_id,\n      p.units_per_sale_unit,\n      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(\n        SUM(ib.on_hand_quantity - ib.reserved_quantity),\n        0\n      )::INTEGER AS available_quantity\n    FROM public.products p\n    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances ib\n      ON ib.product_id = p.id\n    WHERE p.is_active = true\n    GROUP BY\n      p.id,\n      p.min_stock_level,\n      p.sale_unit_id,\n      p.units_per_sale_unit,\n      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units\n  )\n  SELECT\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (\n      WHERE sale_unit_id IS NOT NULL\n        AND units_per_sale_unit > 1\n        AND default_sale_price_in_minor_units > 0\n        AND available_quantity < units_per_sale_unit\n    )::INTEGER,\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (\n      WHERE sale_unit_id IS NOT NULL\n        AND units_per_sale_unit > 1\n        AND default_sale_price_in_minor_units > 0\n        AND available_quantity >= units_per_sale_unit\n        AND available_quantity <= GREATEST(\n          min_stock_level,\n          units_per_sale_unit\n        )\n    )::INTEGER,\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (\n v_configuration_issues\n  FROM product_stock;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(JSONB_AGG(order_row), '[]'::JSONB)\n  INTO v_latest_orders\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      o.id,\n      o.order_number AS \"orderNumber\",\n      COALESCE(c.full_name, 'زبون مباشر') AS \"customerName\",\n      o.status,\n      o.payment_status AS \"paymentStatus\",\n      o.total_in_minor_units AS \"totalInMinorUnits\",\n      o.source,\n      o.created_at AS \"createdAt\"\n    FROM public.orders o\n    LEFT JOIN public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id\n    ORDER BY o.created_at DESC\n    LIMIT 5\n  ) order_row;\n\n  WITH product_stock AS (\n    SELECT\n      p.id,\n      p.name_ar,\n      p.sku,\n      p.min_stock_level,\n      p.sale_unit_id,\n      p.units_per_sale_unit,\n      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(u.name_ar, 'طرد') AS sale_unit_name,\n      COALESCE(\n        SUM(ib.on_hand_quantity - ib.reserved_quantity),\n        0\n      )::INTEGER AS available_quantity\n    FROM public.products p\n    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances ib\n      ON ib.product_id = p.id\n    LEFT JOIN public.units u\n      ON u.id = p.sale_unit_id\n    WHERE p.is_active = true\n    GROUP BY\n      p.id,\n      p.name_ar,\n      p.sku,\n      p.min_stock_level,\n      p.sale_unit_id,\n      p.units_per_sale_unit,\n      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      u.name_ar\n  )\n  SELECT COALESCE(JSONB_AGG(stock_row), '[]'::JSONB)\n  INTO v_stock_alerts\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      ps.id,\n      ps.name_ar AS \"nameAr\",\n      ps.sku,\n      ps.available_quantity AS \"availableBaseUnits\",\n      ps.units_per_sale_unit AS \"unitsPerSaleUnit\",\n      ps.sale_unit_name AS \"saleUnitName\",\n      FLOOR(\n        ps.available_quantity::NUMERIC\n        / GREATEST(ps.units_per_sale_unit, 1)\n      )::INTEGER AS \"availableSalePackages\",\n      CASE\n        WHEN ps.sale_unit_id IS NULL\n          OR ps.units_per_sale_unit <= 1\n          OR ps.default_sale_price_in_minor_units <= 0\n          THEN 'configuration'\n        WHEN ps.available_quantity < ps.units_per_sale_unit\n          THEN 'out_of_stock'\n        ELSE 'low_stock'\n      END AS severity\n    FROM product_stock ps\n    WHERE\n      ps.sale_unit_id IS NULL\n      OR ps.units_per_sale_unit <= 1\n      OR ps.default_sale_price_in_minor_units <= 0\n      OR ps.available_quantity < ps.units_per_sale_unit\n      OR ps.available_quantity <= GREATEST(\n        ps.min_stock_level,\n        ps.units_per_sale_unit\n      )\n    ORDER BY\n      CASE\n        WHEN ps.sale_unit_id IS NULL\n          OR ps.units_per_sale_unit <= 1\n          OR ps.default_sale_price_in_minor_units <= 0\n          THEN 0\n        WHEN ps.available_quantity < ps.units_per_sale_unit\n          THEN 1\n        ELSE 2\n      END,\n      ps.available_quantity ASC,\n      ps.name_ar ASC\n    LIMIT 5\n  ) stock_row;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(JSONB_AGG(status_row), '[]'::JSONB)\n  INTO v_order_statuses\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      status,\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS count\n    FROM public.orders\n    WHERE status IN (\n      'new',\n      'confirmed',\n      'preparing',\n      'ready',\n      'out_for_delivery',\n      'completed'\n    )\n    GROUP BY status\n    ORDER BY CASE status\n      WHEN 'new' THEN 1\n      WHEN 'confirmed' THEN 2\n      WHEN 'preparing' THEN 3\n      WHEN 'ready' THEN 4\n      WHEN 'out_for_delivery' THEN 5\n      WHEN 'completed' THEN 6\n      ELSE 7\n    END\n  ) status_row;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(day || jsonb_build_object(\n    'salesInMinorUnits', day->'grossSalesInMinorUnits',\n    'dayLabel', to_char((day->>'date')::DATE, 'Dy')\n  ) ORDER BY day->>'date'), '[]'::JSONB)\n  INTO v_seven_day_sales FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_week->'dailyBreakdown') day;\n\n  RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'generatedAt', NOW(),\n    'financialFactsStatus', 'available',\n    'access', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'canViewProfit', v_can_view_profit\n    ),\n    'summary', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'todayCollections',v_today->'customerCollections',\n      'todayCashCollectedInMinorUnits', (v_today->>'cashCollectedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT,\n      'todayCliqCollectedInMinorUnits', (v_today->>'cliqCollectedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT,\n      'todaySalesInMinorUnits', v_today_sales,\n      'todayNetSalesInMinorUnits', COALESCE((v_today->>'netSalesInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0),\n      'todayCompletedOrders', v_today_completed_orders,\n      'monthSalesInMinorUnits', v_month_sales,\n      'monthNetSalesInMinorUnits', v_month #> '{sales,netSalesInMinorUnits}',\n      'monthProfitInMinorUnits',\n        CASE WHEN v_can_view_profit THEN v_month_profit ELSE NULL END,\n      'openOrdersCount', v_open_orders,\n      'newOrdersCount', v_new_orders,\n      'customerReceivablesInMinorUnits', v_customer_receivables,\n      'supplierPayablesInMinorUnits', v_supplier_payables,\n      'inventoryValueInMinorUnits', v_inventory_value,\n      'activeProductsCount', v_active_products,\n      'activeCustomersCount', v_active_customers,\n      'lowStockCount', v_low_stock,\n      'outOfStockCount', v_out_of_stock,\n      'configurationIssuesCount', v_configuration_issues\n    ),\n    'latestOrders', v_latest_orders,\n    'stockAlerts', v_stock_alerts,\n    'orderStatuses', v_order_statuses,\n    'sevenDaySales', v_seven_day_sales\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

The final remainder is assigned by a deterministic\n  -- line order, so allocated discounts always total the recorded discount.\n  WITH completion_events AS (\n    SELECT DISTINCT ON (osh.order_id)\n COALESCE(oi.sku_snapshot, '') AS sku,\n      public.phase35_report_package_count_internal(oi.id, oi.commercial_line_kind, oi.sale_package_quantity, oi.units_per_sale_package)::BIGINT AS SELECT\n      *,\n      (\n        base_discount + CASE\n          WHEN allocation_rank <= (\n            order_discount - SUM(base_discount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id)\n          ) THEN 1\n          ELSE 0\n        END\n      )::BIGINT AS allocated_discount\n    FROM base_allocations\n  ),\n  item_totals AS (\n    SELECT\n      COALESCE(SUM(line_total - allocated_discount - cogs), 0)::BIGINT\n ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_name), '[]'::JSONB)\n      AS payload\n    FROM (\n      SELECT\n        product_name,\n        sku,\n        SUM(package_quantity)::BIGINT AS package_count,\n        SUM(line_total - allocated_discount)::BIGINT AS revenue,\n        SUM(line_total - allocated_discount - cogs)::BIGINT AS profit,\n        jsonb_build_object(\n          'productName', product_name,\n Insert Receipt Item\n    INSERT INTO public.purchase_receipt_items (\n      purchase_receipt_id,\n      purchase_order_item_id,\n      product_id,\n      received_quantity,\n      unit_cost_in_minor_units\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_receipt_id,\n      v_po_item_id,\n      v_po_item.product_id,\n      v_recv_qty,\n      v_unit_cost\n    );\n\n    -- 2. Record Inventory Movement\n    INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements (\n      warehouse_id,\n      product_id,\n      movement_type,\n      quantity,\n      balance_before,\n      balance_after,\n      reference_type,\n      reference_id,\n      notes,\n      created_by\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_target_warehouse_id,\n      v_po_item.product_id,\n      'purchase_receipt',\n      v_recv_qty,\n      v_current_on_hand,\n      v_new_on_hand,\n      'purchase_receipt',\n      v_receipt_id,\n      'استلام مشتريات سند رقم ' || v_receipt_number || ' - طلب شراء ' || v_po.purchase_order_number,\n      v_user_id\n    );\n\n    -- 5.         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._reverse_cash_shift_with_operations_before_phase4_lock(p_shift_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_reason), '');\n  v_key TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_idempotency_key), '');\n  v_preview JSONB;\n  v_operation JSONB;\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_payment public.customer_payments%ROWTYPE;\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_expense public.operational_expenses%ROWTYPE;\n  v_new_paid BIGINT;\n  v_audit_id UUID;\n  v_primitive_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سبب عكس الوردية مطلوب ويجب أن يكون بين 3 و500 حرف.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_key IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'مفتاح منع التكرار لعكس الوردية غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '3s', true);\n  PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout', '30s', true);\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('cash-shift-full-reversal:' || p_shift_id::TEXT, 0));\n\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id=p_shift_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الوردية المحددة غير موجودة.'; END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing\n  FROM public.cash_shift_reversals\n  WHERE requested_by=v_user_id AND idempotency_key=v_key\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF v_existing.shift_id <> p_shift_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'مفتاح منع التكرار مستخدم لوردية أخرى.'; END IF;\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'idempotent',true,'reversalId',v_existing.id,'status',v_existing.status,'actualEffect',v_existing.actual_effect);\n  END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.cash_shift_reversals WHERE shift_id=p_shift_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'تم عكس هذه الوردية مسبقًا تحت المرجع %.', v_existing.id; END IF;\n\n  -- Canonical global lock order: shift, orders, customer payments, supplier\n  -- payments, expenses, returns, inventory balances, receipt/PO, suppliers.\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders WHERE cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.customer_payments WHERE cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.supplier_payments WHERE cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.operational_expenses WHERE shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.sales_returns WHERE cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM 1\n  FROM public.inventory_balances ib\n  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT o.warehouse_id, oi.product_id FROM public.orders o JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.id WHERE o.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id) keys\n    ON keys.warehouse_id=ib.warehouse_id AND keys.product_id=ib.product_id\n  ORDER BY ib.warehouse_id, ib.product_id FOR UPDATE OF ib;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.supplier_receipts sr JOIN public.supplier_payments sp ON sp.supplier_receipt_id=sr.id WHERE sp.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY sr.id FOR UPDATE OF sr;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.purchase_orders po JOIN public.supplier_payments sp ON sp.purchase_order_id=po.id WHERE sp.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY po.id FOR UPDATE OF po;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers s JOIN public.supplier_payments sp ON sp.supplier_id=s.id WHERE sp.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id ORDER BY s.id FOR UPDATE OF s;\n\n  v_preview := public._preview_cash_shift_full_reversal(p_shift_id);\n  IF COALESCE((v_preview->>'canExecute')::BOOLEAN, false) IS NOT TRUE THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عكس الوردية محجوب: %', COALESCE(v_preview->'operations','[]'::JSONB);\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.cash_shift_reversals(shift_id,requested_by,reason,idempotency_key,expected_effect)\n  VALUES(p_shift_id,v_user_id,v_reason,v_key,v_preview->'summary') RETURNING id INTO v_reversal_id;\n\n  FOR v_operation IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_preview->'operations') LOOP\n    v_primitive_id := NULL;\n    IF v_operation->>'status' = 'ALREADY_REVERSED' THEN\n      IF v_operation->>'operationType'='pos_sale' THEN SELECT id INTO v_primitive_id FROM public.pos_sale_reversals WHERE order_id=(v_operation->>'originalRecordId')::UUID;\n      ELSIF v_operation->>'operationType'='supplier_payment' THEN SELECT id INTO v_primitive_id FROM public.supplier_payment_reversals WHERE supplier_payment_id=(v_operation->>'originalRecordId')::UUID;\n      END IF;\n      INSERT INTO public.cash_shift_reversal_operations(reversal_id,shift_id,operation_type,original_record_id,status,primitive_reversal_reference,expected_effect,actual_effect)\n      VALUES(v_reversal_id,p_shift_id,v_operation->>'operationType',(v_operation->>'originalRecordId')::UUID,'already_reversed',v_primitive_id,v_operation->'expectedEffect',v_operation->'expectedEffect');\n      CONTINUE;\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_operation->>'operationType'='pos_sale' THEN\n      v_result := public.reverse_pos_sale((v_operation->>'originalRecordId')::UUID,v_reason,'shift:'||v_reversal_id::TEXT||':pos:'||(v_operation->>'originalRecordId'));\n      v_primitive_id := (v_result->>'reversal_id')::UUID;\n    ELSIF v_operation->>'operationType'='supplier_payment' THEN\n      v_result := public.reverse_supplier_payment((v_operation->>'originalRecordId')::UUID,v_reason,'shift:'||v_reversal_id::TEXT||':supplier:'||(v_operation->>'originalRecordId'));\n      v_primitive_id := (v_result->>'reversal_id')::UUID;\n    ELSIF v_operation->>'operationType'='customer_payment' THEN\n      SELECT * INTO v_payment FROM public.customer_payments WHERE id=(v_operation->>'originalRecordId')::UUID FOR UPDATE;\n      SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.orders WHERE id=v_payment.order_id FOR UPDATE;\n      IF NOT FOUND OR v_payment.is_reversed OR v_payment.cash_shift_id<>p_shift_id OR v_order.status<>'completed' OR v_order.source='pos' THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'سند القبض لم يعد قابلًا للعكس ضمن الوردية.';\n      END IF;\n      v_new_paid := GREATEST(v_order.amount_paid_in_minor_units-v_payment.amount_in_minor_units,0);\n      UPDATE public.orders SET amount_paid_in_minor_units=v_new_paid,payment_status=CASE WHEN v_new_paid=0 THEN 'unpaid' ELSE 'partially_paid' END,updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=v_order.id;\n      UPDATE public.customer_payments SET is_reversed=true,reversed_at=NOW(),reversed_by=v_user_id,reversal_reason=v_reason WHERE id=v_payment.id;\n      INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id,action,entity_name,entity_id,details) VALUES(v_user_id,'REVERSE_CUSTOMER_PAYMENT_FOR_SHIFT','customer_payments',v_payment.id,jsonb_build_object('shift_id',p_shift_id,'reversal_id',v_reversal_id,'reason',v_reason)) RETURNING id INTO v_audit_id;\n      v_primitive_id := v_audit_id;\n    ELSIF v_operation->>'operationType'='operational_expense' THEN\n      SELECT * INTO v_expense FROM public.operational_expenses WHERE id=(v_operation->>'originalRecordId')::UUID FOR UPDATE;\n      IF NOT FOUND OR v_expense.is_reversed OR v_expense.shift_id<>p_shift_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'المصروف لم يعد قابلًا للعكس ضمن الوردية.'; END IF;\n      UPDATE public.operational_expenses SET is_reversed=true,reversed_at=NOW(),reversed_by=v_user_id,reversal_reason=v_reason WHERE id=v_expense.id;\n      INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id,action,entity_name,entity_id,details) VALUES(v_user_id,'REVERSE_OPERATIONAL_EXPENSE_FOR_SHIFT','operational_expenses',v_expense.id,jsonb_build_object('shift_id',p_shift_id,'reversal_id',v_reversal_id,'reason',v_reason)) RETURNING id INTO v_audit_id;\n      v_primitive_id := v_audit_id;\n    ELSE\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'نوع عملية غير مدعوم في تنفيذ عكس الوردية.';\n    END IF;\n\n    INSERT INTO public.cash_shift_reversal_operations(reversal_id,shift_id,operation_type,original_record_id,status,primitive_reversal_reference,expected_effect,actual_effect)\n    VALUES(v_reversal_id,p_shift_id,v_operation->>'operationType',(v_operation->>'originalRecordId')::UUID,'reversed',v_primitive_id,v_operation->'expectedEffect',v_operation->'expectedEffect');\n  END LOOP;\n\n  UPDATE public.cash_shifts SET status='reversed',closed_by=NULL,closed_at=NULL,actual_cash_in_minor_units=NULL,cash_discrepancy_in_minor_units=NULL,discrepancy_reason=NULL,reversed_by=v_user_id,reversed_at=NOW(),reversal_reason=v_reason,reversal_id=v_reversal_id,updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=p_shift_id;\n  UPDATE public.cash_shift_reversals SET status='completed',actual_effect=v_preview->'summary',completed_at=NOW() WHERE id=v_reversal_id;\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id,action,entity_name,entity_id,details) VALUES(v_user_id,'REVERSE_CASH_SHIFT_WITH_OPERATIONS','cash_shifts',p_shift_id,jsonb_build_object('reversal_id',v_reversal_id,'reason',v_reason,'effect',v_preview->'summary','operations',v_preview->'operations'));\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'idempotent',false,'reversalId',v_reversal_id,'shiftId',p_shift_id,'actualEffect',v_preview->'summary','operations',v_preview->'operations','message','تم عكس جميع عمليات الوردية ضمن معاملة واحدة وحفظ سجل المراجعة.');\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._reverse_customer_order_payment_before_phase4_lock(p_payment_id uuid, p_reason text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_payment public.customer_payments%ROWTYPE;\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_shift public.cash_shifts%ROWTYPE;\n  v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_reason), '');\n  v_new_paid BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'عكس سند قبض عميل'\n  );\n  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب تسجيل الدخول لعكس سند القبض.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_reason IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_reason) > 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سبب عكس سند القبض مطلوب ولا يتجاوز 500 حرف.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_payment\n  FROM public.customer_payments\n  WHERE id = p_payment_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'سند القبض غير موجود.'; END IF;\n  IF v_payment.is_reversed THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تم عكس سند القبض مسبقاً.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_order\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = v_payment.order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_order.status <> 'completed' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن عكس الدفعة إلا لطلب مكتمل قائم.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_payment.cash_shift_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    SELECT * INTO v_shift\n    FROM public.cash_shifts\n    WHERE id = v_payment.cash_shift_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n    IF NOT FOUND OR v_shift.status <> 'open' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن عكس سند قبض مرتبط بوردية مغلقة؛ سجّل تسوية تدقيقية جديدة بدلاً من ذلك.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_new_paid := GREATEST(\n    v_order.amount_paid_in_minor_units - v_payment.amount_in_minor_units,\n    0\n  );\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET\n    amount_paid_in_minor_units = v_new_paid,\n    payment_status = CASE WHEN v_new_paid = 0 THEN 'unpaid' ELSE 'partially_paid' END,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = v_order.id;\n\n  UPDATE public.customer_payments\n  SET\n    is_reversed = true,\n    reversed_at = NOW(),\n    reversed_by = v_user_id,\n    reversal_reason = v_reason\n  WHERE id = v_payment.id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)\n  VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'REVERSE_CUSTOMER_PAYMENT',\n    'customer_payments',\n    v_payment.id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'payment_number', v_payment.payment_number,\n      'order_id', v_order.id,\n      'original_amount_in_minor_units', v_payment.amount_in_minor_units,\n      'payment_method', v_payment.payment_method,\n      'reason', v_reason,\n      'remaining_in_minor_units', v_order.total_in_minor_units - v_new_paid\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'payment_id', v_payment.id,\n    'order_id', v_order.id,\n    'remaining_in_minor_units', v_order.total_in_minor_units - v_new_paid,\n    'message', 'تم عكس سند القبض وحفظ أثره التدقيقي وتحديث ذمة العميل.'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._reverse_operational_expense_before_phase4_lock(p_expense_id uuid, p_reason text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_expense public.operational_expenses%ROWTYPE;\n  v_shift public.cash_shifts%ROWTYPE;\n  v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_reason), '');\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'عكس مصروف تشغيلي'\n  );\n  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'يجب تسجيل الدخول لعكس المصروف.'; END IF;\n  IF v_reason IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_reason) > 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سبب عكس المصروف مطلوب ولا يتجاوز 500 حرف.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_expense\n  FROM public.operational_expenses\n  WHERE id = p_expense_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'المصروف غير موجود.'; END IF;\n  IF v_expense.is_reversed THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'تم عكس هذا المصروف مسبقاً.'; END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_shift\n  FROM public.cash_shifts\n  WHERE id = v_expense.shift_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_shift.status <> 'open' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن عكس مصروف مرتبط بوردية مغلقة؛ سجّل تسوية تدقيقية جديدة بدلاً من ذلك.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.operational_expenses\n  SET\n    is_reversed = true,\n    reversed_at = NOW(),\n    reversed_by = v_user_id,\n    reversal_reason = v_reason\n  WHERE id = v_expense.id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)\n  VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'REVERSE_OPERATIONAL_EXPENSE',\n    'operational_expenses',\n    v_expense.id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'expense_number', v_expense.expense_number,\n      'shift_id', v_expense.shift_id,\n      'original_amount_in_minor_units', v_expense.amount_in_minor_units,\n      'payment_method', v_expense.payment_method,\n      'reason', v_reason\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'expense_id', v_expense.id,\n    'shift', public.get_cash_shift_summary(v_expense.shift_id),\n    'message', 'تم عكس المصروف مع الاحتفاظ بسجل المراجعة.'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",
