BIGINT;v_stored BIGINT;v_result JSONB;v_claim RECORD;\n  v_po public.purchase_orders%ROWTYPE;v_paid NUMERIC;v_receipts NUMERIC;v_legacy NUMERIC;v_cap NUMERIC;v_available BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT balance INTO v_balance FROM public.phase133_supplier_balance_evidence_internal() WHERE supplier_id=p_supplier_id;\n  SELECT current_balance_in_minor_units INTO v_stored FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=p_supplier_id;\n  IF v_balance IS NULL OR v_balance IS DISTINCT FROM v_stored THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CHEQUE_SUPPLIER_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: رصيد المورد لا يطابق دليل133.';\n  END IF;\n  IF COALESCE(p_amount,0)<=0 OR p_amount>v_balance THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CHEQUE_EXCEEDS_SUPPLIER_BALANCE: مبلغ الشيك أكبر من ذمة المورد؛ لا سلفة مورد.';\n  END IF;\n  v_available:=v_balance;\n  IF p_opening_only THEN\n    IF p_claim_id IS NOT NULL OR p_purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'سداد الرصيد السابق لا يخصص لأمر شراء أو قيد آخر.';END IF;\n    v_available:=public.go_live_supplier_opening_payable_internal(p_supplier_id);\n    IF p_amount>v_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'GO_LIVE_SUPPLIER_PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_OPENING: مبلغ الشيك أكبر من المتبقي من الرصيد السابق.';END IF;\n  END IF;\n  IF p_purchase_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    IF p_claim_id IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'اختر أمر شراء أو قيد شيك، لا كليهما.';END IF;\n    SELECT * INTO v_po FROM public.purchase_orders WHERE id=p_purchase_order_id AND supplier_id=p_supplier_id;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'أمر الشراء لا يتبع المورد المحدد.';END IF;\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units),0) INTO v_paid FROM public.supplier_payments\n      WHERE purchase_order_id=p_purchase_order_id AND NOT is_reversed;\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(supplier_invoice_payable_total_snapshot_in_minor_units::NUMERIC),0) INTO v_receipts\n      FROM public.purchase_receipts WHERE purchase_order_id=p_purchase_order_id AND status='completed' AND phase2_finalized_at IS NOT NULL;\n    SELECT COALESCE((SELECT payable::NUMERIC FROM public.phase133_legacy_po_payables_internal()\n      WHERE purchase_order_id=p_purchase_order_id),0) INTO v_legacy;\n    v_cap:=GREATEST(v_po.total_in_minor_units::NUMERIC,v_receipts+v_legacy);\n    IF v_paid+p_amount>v_cap THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_PO_PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_PAYABLE: مبلغ الشيك أكبر من المتبقي لأمر الشراء.',\n        DETAIL=jsonb_build_object('payable',v_cap,'paid',v_paid,'maxAllowed',GREATEST(v_cap-v_paid,0))::TEXT;\n    END IF;\n    -- Preserve the selected PO, including its existing133 cap. Finalized receipt\n    -- dates are proven; the planned/unreceived residual has NO invented date.\n    WITH principals AS (\n      SELECT r.id,r.received_at debt_at,r.supplier_invoice_payable_total_snapshot_in_minor_units::NUMERIC principal\n      FROM public.purchase_receipts r WHERE r.purchase_order_id=p_purchase_order_id\n        AND r.status='completed' AND r.phase2_finalized_at IS NOT NULL\n        AND r.supplier_invoice_payable_total_snapshot_in_minor_units>0\n      UNION ALL SELECT v_po.id,CASE WHEN v_cap-v_receipts=v_legacy THEN v_po.received_at END,v_cap-v_receipts\n        WHERE v_cap>v_receipts\n    ), remaining AS (\n      SELECT *,GREATEST(principal-GREATEST(v_paid-COALESCE(SUM(principal) OVER(\n        ORDER BY debt_at NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0),0),0) outstanding\n      FROM principals\n    ), planned AS (\n      SELECT *,GREATEST(LEAST(outstanding,p_amount-COALESCE(SUM(outstanding) OVER(\n        ORDER BY debt_at NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0)),0)::BIGINT allocation\n      FROM remaining\n    ) SELECT jsonb_build_object('balanceInMinorUnits',v_balance,'allocatedInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(allocation),0),\n      'parts',COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind','supplier_balance','id',id,'originalDebtAt',debt_at,\n        'allocateInMinorUnits',allocation) ORDER BY debt_at NULLS FIRST,id) FILTER(WHERE allocation>0),'[]'::JSONB)) INTO v_result FROM planned;\n    IF (v_result->>'allocatedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT<>p_amount THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CHEQUE_SUPPLIER_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH';END IF;\n    RETURN v_result;\n  END IF;\n  IF p_claim_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    SELECT * INTO v_claim FROM public.cheque_supplier_claim_positions_internal(p_supplier_id) WHERE id=p_claim_id;\n    IF NOT FOUND OR p_amount>v_claim.outstanding THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CHEQUE_CLAIM_PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_DUE: قيد المورد غير مطابق أو المبلغ أكبر من المتبقي.';END IF;\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('balanceInMinorUnits',v_balance,'allocatedInMinorUnits',p_amount,'parts',\n      jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('kind','compensation','id',v_claim.id,'originalDebtAt',v_claim.occurred_at,'allocateInMinorUnits',p_amount)));\n  END IF;\n  WITH principals AS (\n    SELECT 'supplier_balance'::TEXT kind,r.id,r.received_at debt_at,r.total_in_minor_units::BIGINT principal\n    FROM public.supplier_receipts r WHERE r.supplier_id=p_supplier_id AND r.status='completed' AND r.total_in_minor_units>0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'supplier_balance',r.id,r.received_at,r.supplier_invoice_payable_total_snapshot_in_minor_units\n    FROM public.purchase_receipts r JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON po.id=r.purchase_order_id\n    WHERE po.supplier_id=p_supplier_id AND r.status='completed' AND r.phase2_finalized_at IS NOT NULL\n      AND r.supplier_invoice_payable_total_snapshot_in_minor_units>0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'supplier_balance',l.purchase_order_id,po.received_at,l.payable\n    FROM public.phase133_legacy_po_payables_internal()l JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON po.id=l.purchase_order_id\n    WHERE l.supplier_id=p_supplier_id AND l.payable>0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'opening',b.id,b.original_balance_date::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman',b.amount_in_minor_units\n    FROM public.supplier_opening_balances b WHERE b.supplier_id=p_supplier_id AND NOT b.is_reversed AND b.direction='payable'\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'compensation',c.id,c.occurred_at,c.outstanding\n    FROM public.cheque_supplier_claim_positions_internal(p_supplier_id)c WHERE c.outstanding>0\n  ), ordered AS (\n    SELECT p.*,SUM(principal) OVER()-v_available coverage,\n      COALESCE(SUM(principal) OVER(ORDER BY debt_at NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0) prior\n    FROM principals p WHERE NOT p_opening_only OR p.kind='opening'\n  ), remaining AS (\n    SELECT *,GREATEST(principal-GREATEST(coverage-prior,0),0)::BIGINT outstanding FROM ordered\n  ), planned AS (\n    SELECT *,GREATEST(LEAST(outstanding,p_amount-COALESCE(SUM(outstanding) OVER(\n      ORDER BY debt_at NULLS FIRST,id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING),0)),0)::BIGINT allocation\n    FROM remaining\n  )\n  SELECT jsonb_build_object('balanceInMinorUnits',v_balance,'allocatedInMinorUnits',COALESCE(SUM(allocation),0),\n    'parts',COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind',kind,'id',id,'originalDebtAt',debt_at,\n      'allocateInMinorUnits',allocation) ORDER BY debt_at NULLS FIRST,id) FILTER(WHERE allocation>0),'[]'::JSONB))\n  INTO v_result FROM planned;\n  IF (v_result->>'allocatedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT<>p_amount THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CHEQUE_SUPPLIER_ALLOCATION_MISMATCH: لا تخصيص بلا أصل مثبت.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cleanup_guest_order_gateway_requests(p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 500)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_deleted_count INTEGER := 0;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_batch_size IS NULL OR p_batch_size NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cleanup batch size must be between 1 and 500.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Keep the cleanup short and defer contested rows to the next run. The\n  -- cutoff is deliberately beyond both every rate-limit window (15 minutes)\n  -- and the browser's 24-hour pending idempotency-key lifetime.\n  PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '2s', true);\n  PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout', '5s', true);\n\n  WITH stale_rows AS (\n    SELECT ctid\n    FROM public.guest_order_gateway_requests\n    WHERE created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours'\n    ORDER BY created_at, id\n    LIMIT p_batch_size\n    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED\n  ), deleted_rows AS (\n    DELETE FROM public.guest_order_gateway_requests AS request\n    USING stale_rows\n    WHERE request.ctid = stale_rows.ctid\n    RETURNING 1\n  )\n  SELECT count(*)::INTEGER INTO v_deleted_count\n  FROM deleted_rows;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'deleted_count', v_deleted_count,\n    'retention_hours', 48\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.close_cash_shift(p_shift_id uuid, p_actual_cash_in_minor_units bigint, p_discrepancy_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_snapshot JSONB;\n  v_section JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  v_result := public._close_cash_shift_before_closing_report_snapshot(\n    p_shift_id,\n    p_actual_cash_in_minor_units,\n    p_discrepancy_reason\n  );\n  -- The internal close function has already frozen the canonical monetary\n  -- columns. Capture the same report consumers see, inside this transaction.\n  v_snapshot := public._get_cash_shift_closing_report_before_snapshot(p_shift_id)\n    || jsonb_build_object(\n      'snapshotStatus', 'immutable',\n      'snapshotVersion', 1\n    );\n  IF COALESCE(v_snapshot->>'success', 'false') <> 'true' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تعذر إنشاء لقطة تقرير الإغلاق؛ تم إلغاء إغلاق الوردية بأمان.';\n  END IF;\n  v_section := public.owner_withdrawal_closing_section_internal(p_shift_id);\n  IF jsonb_array_length(v_section->'items') > 0 THEN\n    v_section := v_section || jsonb_build_object('netMovementAfterWithdrawalsInMinorUnits',\n      (v_snapshot #>> '{reconciliation,netMovementInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT\n        - (v_section->>'netInMinorUnits')::BIGINT);\n    v_snapshot := v_snapshot || jsonb_build_object('ownerWithdrawals', v_section);\n  END IF;\n  v_section:=public.cheque_shift_settlement_section_internal(p_shift_id);\n  IF jsonb_array_length(v_section->'items')>0 THEN\n    v_snapshot:=v_snapshot||jsonb_build_object('chequeCompensationSettlements',v_section);\n  END IF;\n  UPDATE public.cash_shifts\n  SET closing_report_snapshot = v_snapshot,\n      closing_report_snapshotted_at = NOW(),\n      closing_report_snapshot_version = 1,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_shift_id\n    AND status = 'closed'\n    AND closing_report_snapshot IS NULL;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تعذر تثبيت لقطة تقرير الإغلاق؛ تم إلغاء العملية بأمان.';\n  END IF;\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details\n  ) VALUES (\n    auth.uid(),\n    'CAPTURE_CASH_SHIFT_CLOSING_REPORT_SNAPSHOT',\n    'cash_shifts',\n    p_shift_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'snapshot_version', 1,\n      'snapshot_bytes', octet_length(v_snapshot::TEXT),\n      'captured_at', NOW()\n    )\n  );\n  RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object(\n    'closingReportSnapshotCaptured', true\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_owner_telegram_delivery_v1(p_run_id uuid, p_event_id uuid, p_success boolean, p_error text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.owner_telegram_dispatch_settings\n    WHERE id AND enabled AND run_id=p_run_id AND lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_TELEGRAM_LEASE_LOST'; END IF;\n  IF p_success IS NULL OR p_error IS NOT NULL AND p_error NOT IN\n    ('OWNER_TELEGRAM_DELIVERY_FAILED','OWNER_BUSINESS_EVENT_NOT_ALLOWED') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_TELEGRAM_COMPLETION_CODE_REQUIRED';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.automation_event_deliveries\n    WHERE event_id=p_event_id AND channel='telegram' AND status='processing'\n      AND lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_TELEGRAM_EVENT_LEASE_LOST'; END IF;\n  RETURN public.owner217_complete_delivery_internal(p_event_id,'telegram',p_success,\n    CASE WHEN p_success THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(p_error,'OWNER_TELEGRAM_DELIVERY_FAILED') END);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_website_order_with_payment(p_order_id uuid, p_payment_method text, p_reference_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_order RECORD;\n  v_payment_method TEXT := LOWER(NULLIF(TRIM(p_payment_method), ''));\n  v_shift_id UUID;\n  v_shift_number TEXT;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'تأكيد قبض وتسليم طلب الموقع'\n  );\n\n  IF v_payment_method = 'cash_on_delivery' THEN\n    v_payment_method := 'cash';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_payment_method NOT IN ('cash', 'cliq') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'طريقة التحصيل يجب أن تكون كاش أو CliQ.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_payment_method = 'cliq'\n    AND NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), '') IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم مرجع عملية CliQ مطلوب قبل تأكيد القبض.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(TRIM(p_reference_number), '')) > 120 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم مرجع الدفع أطول من الحد المسموح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT\n    id,\n    order_number,\n    branch_id,\n    source,\n    status,\n    payment_method,\n    total_in_minor_units\n  INTO v_order\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_order.source = 'pos' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'طلبات البيع المباشر تُحصّل من شاشة نقطة البيع.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_order.status NOT IN ('ready', 'out_for_delivery') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'لا يمكن تأكيد قبض الطلب في حالته الحالية (%).',\n      v_order.status;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_order.branch_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تحصيل الطلب دون فرع محدد.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Serialize collection with shift closing. Either this collection belongs to\n  -- the current shift, or the operator must open a new shift after closing.\n  SELECT id, shift_number\n  INTO v_shift_id, v_shift_number\n  FROM public.cash_shifts\n  WHERE branch_id = v_order.branch_id\n    AND status = 'open'\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'افتح وردية الصندوق أولاً قبل تأكيد قبض وتسليم الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET\n    payment_method = CASE\n      WHEN v_payment_method = 'cash' THEN 'cash_on_delivery'\n      ELSE 'cliq'\n    END,\n    payment_reference_number = CASE\n      WHEN v_payment_method = 'cliq'\n        THEN NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), '')\n      ELSE NULL\n    END,\n    payment_confirmed_at = NOW(),\n    payment_confirmed_by = v_user_id,\n    cash_shift_id = v_shift_id,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_order_id;\n\n  -- Reuse the canonical inventory/status implementation. Any failure rolls\n  -- back the collection and shift link in this same transaction.\n  v_result := public.complete_order(\n    p_order_id,\n    COALESCE(\n      NULLIF(TRIM(p_notes), ''),\n      CASE\n        WHEN v_payment_method = 'cliq'\n          THEN 'تم التسليم وتأكيد استلام تحويل CliQ'\n        ELSE 'تم التسليم وتأكيد استلام الكاش'\n      END\n    )\n  );\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'CONFIRM_WEBSITE_ORDER_PAYMENT',\n    'orders',\n    p_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'order_number', v_order.order_number,\n      'payment_method', v_payment_method,\n      'payment_reference_number',\n        CASE WHEN v_payment_method = 'cliq'\n          THEN NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), '') ELSE NULL END,\n      'amount_in_minor_units', v_order.total_in_minor_units,\n      'cash_shift_id', v_shift_id,\n      'cash_shift_number', v_shift_number\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN v_result || jsonb_build_object(\n    'payment_method',\n      CASE WHEN v_payment_method = 'cash'\n        THEN 'cash_on_delivery' ELSE 'cliq' END,\n    'payment_status', 'paid',\n    'payment_reference_number',\n      CASE WHEN v_payment_method = 'cliq'\n        THEN NULLIF(TRIM(p_reference_number), '') ELSE NULL END,\n    'cash_shift_id', v_shift_id,\n    'cash_shift_number', v_shift_number,\n    'message', 'تم تأكيد القبض والتسليم وخصم المخزون وربط العملية بالوردية.'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_direct_supplier_receipt_v2(p_supplier_id uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_supplier_invoice_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_supplier_invoice_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_received_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_header_discount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_supplier_freight_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_legacy_tax_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_amount_paid_at_receipt_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_payment_method text DEFAULT 'cash'::text, p_payment_reference text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_internal_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_lines jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_key TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), '');\n  v_invoice_number TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_supplier_invoice_number), '');\n  v_normalized_invoice TEXT := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_supplier_invoice_number), ''));\n  v_payment_method TEXT := LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_payment_method), ''), 'cash'));\n  v_payment_reference TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_payment_reference), '');\n  v_canonical_lines JSONB;\n  v_canonical_request JSONB;\n  v_fingerprint TEXT;\n  v_legacy_key UUID;\n  v_existing_operation public.business_operations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_operation_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_receipt_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_receipt_number TEXT;\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_line_weights JSONB;\n  v_header_allocations JSONB;\n  v_freight_allocations JSONB;\n  v_component_weights JSONB;\n  v_component_merchandise_allocations JSONB;\n  v_component_final_allocations JSONB;\n  v_inventory_components JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_wac_results JSONB;\n  v_line JSONB;\n  v_component JSONB;\n  v_line_id UUID;\n  v_item_id UUID;\n  v_line_sequence INTEGER := 0;\n  v_line_kind TEXT;\n  v_client_line_id UUID;\n  v_commercial_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_units_per_parcel INTEGER;\n  v_base_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_gross BIGINT;\n  v_line_discount BIGINT;\n  v_line_net BIGINT;\n  v_line_header_discount BIGINT;\n  v_line_freight BIGINT;\n  v_line_acquisition BIGINT;\n  v_component_merchandise BIGINT;\n  v_component_acquisition BIGINT;\n  v_merchandise_gross NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_line_discount_total NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_line_net_total NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_acquisition_total NUMERIC;\n  v_invoice_payable NUMERIC;\n  v_outstanding NUMERIC;\n  v_product public.products%ROWTYPE;\n  v_purchase_unit_name TEXT;\n  v_base_unit_name TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'warehouse_keeper'],\n    'استلام بضاعة الموردين - نموذج الطرود'\n  );\n\n  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE2_AUTH_REQUIRED: يجب تسجيل الدخول.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_key IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 255 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID: مفتاح منع التكرار غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n  v_legacy_key := public.phase2_try_parse_uuid_internal(v_key);\n  IF v_legacy_key IS NOT NULL THEN\n    v_key := v_legacy_key::TEXT;\n  END IF;\n  IF p_header_discount_in_minor_units < 0\n    OR p_supplier_freight_in_minor_units < 0\n    OR p_legacy_tax_in_minor_units < 0\n    OR p_amount_paid_at_receipt_in_minor_units < 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_FINANCIAL_VALUE_INVALID: القيم المالية لا يمكن أن تكون سالبة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_payment_method NOT IN ('cash', 'cliq', 'bank_transfer', 'deferred') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_PAYMENT_METHOD_INVALID: طريقة الدفع غير مدعومة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_payment_method = 'deferred'\n    AND p_amount_paid_at_receipt_in_minor_units > 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_deferred_payment_zero_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_DEFERRED_PAYMENT_INVALID: الاستلام الآجل لا يقبل دفعة فورية.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_payment_method IN ('cliq', 'bank_transfer')\n    AND p_amount_paid_at_receipt_in_minor_units > 0\n    AND v_payment_reference IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_payment_reference_required_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_PAYMENT_REFERENCE_REQUIRED: مرجع الدفعة الإلكترونية مطلوب.';\n  END IF;\n  v_canonical_lines := public.phase2_canonicalize_receipt_lines_internal(p_lines);\n\n  v_canonical_request := jsonb_build_object(\n    'contract_version', 2,\n    'operation_type', 'supplier_receipt_v2',\n    'supplier_id', LOWER(p_supplier_id::TEXT),\n    'warehouse_id', LOWER(p_warehouse_id::TEXT),\n    'branch_id', CASE WHEN p_branch_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE LOWER(p_branch_id::TEXT) END,\n    'supplier_invoice_number', v_normalized_invoice,\n    'supplier_invoice_date', p_supplier_invoice_date,\n    'received_at', CASE WHEN p_received_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(p_received_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD\"T\"HH24:MI:SS.US\"Z\"') END,\n    'header_discount_in_minor_units', p_header_discount_in_minor_units,\n    'supplier_freight_in_minor_units', p_supplier_freight_in_minor_units,\n    'legacy_tax_in_minor_units', p_legacy_tax_in_minor_units,\n    'amount_paid_at_receipt_in_minor_units', p_amount_paid_at_receipt_in_minor_units,\n    'payment_method', v_payment_method,\n    'payment_reference', v_payment_reference,\n    'notes', NULLIF(BTRIM(p_notes), ''),\n    'internal_notes', NULLIF(BTRIM(p_internal_notes), ''),\n    'lines', v_canonical_lines\n  );\n  v_fingerprint := public.phase2_request_fingerprint_internal(v_canonical_request);\n\n  -- Legacy and V2 direct receipts share one normalized key lock. A historical\n  -- legacy UUID has no trustworthy Phase-2 fingerprint, so V2 fails closed.\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'supplier_receipt:' || v_key,\n    0\n  ));\n\n  IF v_legacy_key IS NOT NULL THEN\n    IF EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.supplier_receipts receipt\n      WHERE receipt.idempotency_key = v_legacy_key\n    ) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'LEGACY_IDEMPOTENCY_IDENTITY_UNPROVEN: لا يمكن إثبات تطابق العملية التاريخية.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.business_operations operation\n    WHERE operation.operation_type = 'supplier_receipt_v2'\n      AND operation.idempotency_key = v_key\n      AND operation.initiated_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_user_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: مفتاح الاستلام غير متاح لهذا المستخدم.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing_operation\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.operation_type = 'supplier_receipt_v2'\n    AND operation.initiated_by = v_user_id\n    AND operation.idempotency_key = v_key;\n\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF v_existing_operation.request_fingerprint IS NULL\n      OR v_existing_operation.result_snapshot IS NULL\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'LEGACY_IDEMPOTENCY_IDENTITY_UNPROVEN: لا يمكن إثبات تطابق العملية التاريخية.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_existing_operation.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM v_fingerprint THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: استُخدم المفتاح نفسه لطلب مختلف.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN v_existing_operation.result_snapshot;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.suppliers supplier\n    WHERE supplier.id = p_supplier_id AND supplier.is_active\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE2_SUPPLIER_INVALID: المورد غير موجود أو غير نشط.';\n  END IF;\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.warehouses warehouse\n    WHERE warehouse.id = p_warehouse_id AND warehouse.is_active\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE2_WAREHOUSE_INVALID: المستودع غير موجود أو غير نشط.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_branch_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.branches branch\n    WHERE branch.id = p_branch_id AND branch.is_active\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE2_BRANCH_INVALID: الفرع غير موجود أو غير نشط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_payment_shift_internal(\n    p_branch_id, v_payment_method, p_amount_paid_at_receipt_in_minor_units\n  );\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY(\n    SELECT DISTINCT (component->>'product_id')::UUID\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_canonical_lines) line\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(line->'components') component\n    ORDER BY (component->>'product_id')::UUID\n  ));\n  PERFORM public.phase2_validate_receipt_lines_internal(v_canonical_lines);\n\n  SELECT\n    COALESCE(SUM((line->>'gross_amount_in_minor_units')::NUMERIC), 0),\n    COALESCE(SUM((line->>'line_discount_in_minor_units')::NUMERIC), 0)\n  INTO v_merchandise_gross, v_line_discount_total\n  FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_canonical_lines) line;\n  v_line_net_total := v_merchandise_gross - v_line_discount_total;\n\n  IF v_merchandise_gross > 9223372036854775807::NUMERIC\n    OR v_line_discount_total > 9223372036854775807::NUMERIC\n    OR v_line_net_total > 9223372036854775807::NUMERIC\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22003',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_MONEY_OVERFLOW: إجمالي الفاتورة يتجاوز الحد المدعوم.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_header_discount_in_minor_units > v_line_net_total THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_header_discount_total_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_HEADER_DISCOUNT_EXCEEDS_NET: خصم رأس الفاتورة يتجاوز صافي البضاعة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_line_net_total = 0\n    AND (p_header_discount_in_minor_units > 0 OR p_supplier_freight_in_minor_units > 0)\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_zero_allocation_basis_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_ZERO_ALLOCATION_BASIS: لا يمكن توزيع خصم أو شحن على أساس صفري.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_acquisition_total := v_line_net_total\n    - p_header_discount_in_minor_units::NUMERIC\n    + p_supplier_freight_in_minor_units::NUMERIC;\n  v_invoice_payable := v_acquisition_total + p_legacy_tax_in_minor_units::NUMERIC;\n  IF v_acquisition_total > 9223372036854775807::NUMERIC\n    OR v_invoice_payable > 9223372036854775807::NUMERIC\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22003',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_MONEY_OVERFLOW: تكلفة الاستحواذ أو إجمالي الفاتورة يتجاوز الحد المدعوم.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_amount_paid_at_receipt_in_minor_units::NUMERIC > v_invoice_payable THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_payment_upper_bound_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_PAYABLE: الدفعة تتجاوز إجمالي فاتورة المورد.';\n  END IF;\n  v_outstanding := v_invoice_payable - p_amount_paid_at_receipt_in_minor_units::NUMERIC;\n\n  IF v_normalized_invoice IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n      'supplier_invoice:' || p_supplier_id::TEXT || ':' || v_normalized_invoice,\n      0\n    ));\n    IF EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_financial_invoice_identities identity\n      WHERE identity.supplier_id = p_supplier_id\n        AND identity.normalized_invoice_number = v_normalized_invoice\n        AND identity.is_active\n    ) OR EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_receipts receipt\n      WHERE receipt.supplier_id = p_supplier_id\n        AND LOWER(BTRIM(receipt.supplier_invoice_number)) = v_normalized_invoice\n        AND receipt.status <> 'cancelled'\n    ) OR EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_receipts receipt\n      WHERE receipt.supplier_id = p_supplier_id\n        AND LOWER(BTRIM(receipt.supplier_invoice_number)) = v_normalized_invoice\n        AND receipt.status <> 'cancelled'\n    ) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23505',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'uq_supplier_financial_invoice_active',\n        MESSAGE = 'DUPLICATE_SUPPLIER_INVOICE: رقم فاتورة المورد مستخدم في سند مالي نشط.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_receipt_number := 'GRN-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY') || '-'\n    || LPAD(NEXTVAL('public.supplier_receipt_seq')::TEXT, 6, '0');\n  v_result := jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'idempotent', false,\n    'operation_id', v_operation_id,\n    'receipt_id', v_receipt_id,\n    'receipt_number', v_receipt_number,\n    'inventory_acquisition_cost_in_minor_units', v_acquisition_total::BIGINT,\n    'supplier_invoice_payable_total_in_minor_units', v_invoice_payable::BIGINT,\n    'supplier_outstanding_balance_effect_in_minor_units', v_outstanding::BIGINT\n  );\n\n  INSERT INTO public.business_operations (\n    id, operation_type, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint,\n    initiated_by, result_snapshot, completed_at\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_operation_id, 'supplier_receipt_v2', v_key, v_fingerprint,\n    v_user_id, v_result, NOW()\n  );\n\n  INSERT INTO public.supplier_receipts (\n    id, receipt_number, supplier_id, warehouse_id, branch_id,\n    supplier_invoice_number, supplier_invoice_date, received_at, received_by,\n    subtotal_in_minor_units, discount_in_minor_units,\n    delivery_fee_in_minor_units, tax_in_minor_units, total_in_minor_units,\n    amount_paid_in_minor_units, amount_due_in_minor_units, payment_status,\n    payment_method, payment_reference, notes, internal_notes, status,\n    idempotency_key, operation_id, phase2_finalized_at,\n    merchandise_gross_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n    line_discount_total_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n    header_discount_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n    supplier_freight_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n    legacy_tax_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n    inventory_acquisition_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n    supplier_invoice_payable_total_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n    amount_paid_at_receipt_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n    supplier_outstanding_balance_effect_snapshot_in_minor_units\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_receipt_id, v_receipt_number, p_supplier_id, p_warehouse_id, p_branch_id,\n    v_invoice_number, p_supplier_invoice_date, COALESCE(p_received_at, NOW()), v_user_id,\n    v_line_net_total::BIGINT, p_header_discount_in_minor_units,\n    p_supplier_freight_in_minor_units, p_legacy_tax_in_minor_units,\n    v_invoice_payable::BIGINT, p_amount_paid_at_receipt_in_minor_units,\n    v_outstanding::BIGINT,\n    CASE WHEN v_outstanding = 0 THEN 'paid'\n      WHEN p_amount_paid_at_receipt_in_minor_units > 0 THEN 'partially_paid'\n      ELSE 'unpaid' END,\n    v_payment_method, v_payment_reference,\n    NULLIF(BTRIM(p_notes), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(p_internal_notes), ''),\n    'completed', NULL, v_operation_id, NOW(),\n    v_merchandise_gross::BIGINT, v_line_discount_total::BIGINT,\n    p_header_discount_in_minor_units, p_supplier_freight_in_minor_units,\n    p_legacy_tax_in_minor_units, v_acquisition_total::BIGINT,\n    v_invoice_payable::BIGINT, p_amount_paid_at_receipt_in_minor_units,\n    v_outstanding::BIGINT\n  );\n\n  IF v_normalized_invoice IS NOT NULL THEN\n    INSERT INTO public.supplier_financial_invoice_identities (\n      supplier_id, normalized_invoice_number, operation_id, supplier_receipt_id\n    ) VALUES (\n      p_supplier_id, v_normalized_invoice, v_operation_id, v_receipt_id\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(\n    'key', line->>'client_line_id',\n    'weight', (\n      (line->>'gross_amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT\n      - (line->>'line_discount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT\n    )\n  )) INTO v_line_weights\n  FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_canonical_lines) line;\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(allocation_key, allocated_amount), '{}'::JSONB)\n  INTO v_header_allocations\n  FROM public.phase2_allocate_largest_remainder_internal(\n    p_header_discount_in_minor_units, v_line_weights\n  );\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(allocation_key, allocated_amount), '{}'::JSONB)\n  INTO v_freight_allocations\n  FROM public.phase2_allocate_largest_remainder_internal(\n    p_supplier_freight_in_minor_units, v_line_weights\n  );\n\n  FOR v_line IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_canonical_lines)\n  LOOP\n    v_line_sequence := v_line_sequence + 1;\n    v_line_id := gen_random_uuid();\n    v_client_line_id := (v_line->>'client_line_id')::UUID;\n    v_line_kind := v_line->>'line_kind';\n    v_commercial_quantity := (v_line->>'commercial_quantity')::INTEGER;\n    v_units_per_parcel := NULLIF(v_line->>'units_per_parcel', '')::INTEGER;\n    v_gross := (v_line->>'gross_amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;\n    v_line_discount := (v_line->>'line_discount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;\n    v_line_net := v_gross - v_line_discount;\n    v_line_header_discount := COALESCE(\n      (v_header_allocations->>v_client_line_id::TEXT)::BIGINT, 0\n    );\n    v_line_freight := COALESCE(\n      (v_freight_allocations->>v_client_line_id::TEXT)::BIGINT, 0\n    );\n    v_line_acquisition := v_line_net - v_line_header_discount + v_line_freight;\n\n    INSERT INTO public.supplier_receipt_commercial_lines (\n      id, supplier_receipt_id, operation_id, line_sequence,\n      commercial_line_kind, family_product_id, parcel_configuration_id,\n      configuration_revision, commercial_quantity, units_per_parcel_snapshot,\n      base_unit_name_snapshot, parcel_unit_name_snapshot,\n      gross_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units, discount_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n      line_total_snapshot_in_minor_units, client_line_id,\n      received_parcel_quantity, received_base_unit_quantity,\n      allocated_header_discount_in_minor_units,\n      allocated_supplier_freight_in_minor_units,\n      final_acquisition_amount_in_minor_units, finalized_at\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_line_id, v_receipt_id, v_operation_id, v_line_sequence,\n      v_line_kind,\n      NULLIF(v_line->>'family_product_id', '')::UUID,\n      NULLIF(v_line->>'parcel_configuration_id', '')::UUID,\n      NULLIF(v_line->>'configuration_revision', '')::INTEGER,\n      v_commercial_quantity, v_units_per_parcel,\n      v_line->>'base_unit_name', NULLIF(v_line->>'parcel_unit_name', ''),\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.delete_draft_purchase_order(p_purchase_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_purchase_order_number TEXT;\n  v_status TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager'],\n    'حذف أوامر الشراء'\n  );\n\n  SELECT purchase_order_number, status\n  INTO v_purchase_order_number, v_status\n  FROM public.purchase_orders\n  WHERE id = p_purchase_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'أمر الشراء المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_status <> 'draft' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'يمكن حذف أمر الشراء عندما تكون حالته مسودة فقط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  DELETE FROM public.purchase_orders\n  WHERE id = p_purchase_order_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'DELETE_DRAFT_PURCHASE_ORDER',\n    'purchase_orders',\n    p_purchase_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'purchase_order_number', v_purchase_order_number\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'purchase_order_id', p_purchase_order_id,\n    'purchase_order_number', v_purchase_order_number\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.endorse_customer_cheque_v1(p_cheque_id uuid, p_supplier_id uuid, p_expected_version integer, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_c public.deferred_cheques%ROWTYPE;v_plan JSONB;v_request JSONB;v_replay JSONB;v_payment UUID;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','manager'],'تجيير شيك لمورد');\n  v_request:=jsonb_build_object('action','endorse','cheque',p_cheque_id,'supplier',p_supplier_id,'version',p_expected_version);\n  v_replay:=public.cheque_replay_internal(p_idempotency_key,v_request);IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_replay;END IF;\n  -- Supplier before cheque; no order/payment/shift locks are discovered later.\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=p_supplier_id AND is_active FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'المورد غير موجود أو غير نشط.';END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_c FROM public.deferred_cheques WHERE id=p_cheque_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF v_c.version IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_version OR v_c.direction<>'incoming' OR v_c.status<>'pending' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CHEQUE_INVALID_TRANSITION: التجيير لوارد قيد الانتظار فقط؛ حدّث التفاصيل.';\n  END IF;\n  v_plan:=public.cheque_supplier_plan_internal(p_supplier_id,v_c.amount_in_minor_units);\n  INSERT INTO public.cheque_party_keys(party_kind,party_id,bank_key,cheque_number,cheque_id)\n  VALUES('supplier',p_supplier_id,v_c.bank_key,v_c.cheque_number,v_c.id);\n  v_payment:=public.cheque_pay_supplier_internal(v_c.id,p_supplier_id,v_plan);\n  UPDATE public.deferred_cheques SET status='endorsed',endorsed_supplier_id=p_supplier_id,supplier_payment_id=v_payment,\n    version=version+1,changed_by=auth.uid(),changed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=v_c.id;\n  RETURN public.cheque_finish_event_internal(v_c.id,'endorsed',v_c.status,NULL,p_idempotency_key,v_request);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_product_flavor_inheritance()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_master public.products%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.flavor_master_product_id IS NULL THEN\n    IF NEW.is_flavor_master AND NEW.flavor_name_ar IS NOT NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'المنتج الأساسي لا يحمل اسم نكهة.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.flavor_master_product_id = NEW.id THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن ربط المنتج بنفسه كمنتج أساسي.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_master\n  FROM public.products\n  WHERE id = NEW.flavor_master_product_id;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المنتج الأساسي للنكهة غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_master.flavor_master_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إنشاء نكهة داخل نكهة أخرى.';\n  END IF;\n\n  NEW.flavor_name_ar := BTRIM(NEW.flavor_name_ar);\n  NEW.is_flavor_master := false;\n  NEW.category_id := v_master.category_id;\n  NEW.brand_id := v_master.brand_id;\n  NEW.unit_id := v_master.unit_id;\n  NEW.purchase_unit_id := v_master.purchase_unit_id;\n  NEW.units_per_purchase_unit := v_master.units_per_purchase_unit;\n  NEW.default_purchase_price_in_minor_units :=\n    v_master.default_purchase_price_in_minor_units;\n  NEW.sale_unit_id := v_master.sale_unit_id;\n  NEW.units_per_sale_unit := v_master.units_per_sale_unit;\n  NEW.parcel_only := v_master.parcel_only;\n  NEW.default_sale_price_in_minor_units :=\n    v_master.default_sale_price_in_minor_units;\n  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN\n    NEW.cost_price_in_minor_units := v_master.cost_price_in_minor_units;\n  END IF;\n  NEW.sale_price_in_minor_units := v_master.sale_price_in_minor_units;\n  NEW.wholesale_price_in_minor_units :=\n    v_master.wholesale_price_in_minor_units;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_product_identifier_integrity()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_sku TEXT := UPPER(BTRIM(NEW.sku));\n  v_barcode TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(NEW.barcode), '');\n  v_barcode_normalized TEXT;\n  v_lock_key TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_sku IS NULL OR v_sku = '' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'رمز الصنف SKU مطلوب.',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'products_sku_canonical_check';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF COALESCE(NEW.is_flavor_master, false) AND v_barcode IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'المنتج الأساسي للنكهات للتجميع فقط ولا يحمل باركود بيع.',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'products_flavor_master_no_barcode_check';\n  END IF;\n\n  NEW.sku := v_sku;\n  NEW.barcode := v_barcode;\n  v_barcode_normalized := LOWER(v_barcode);\n\n  -- Serialize every normalized identifier before checking the shared SKU /\n  -- barcode namespace. Sorted acquisition prevents inverse-pair deadlocks.\n  FOR v_lock_key IN\n    SELECT DISTINCT identifier\n    FROM (\n      VALUES (LOWER(v_sku)), (v_barcode_normalized)\n    ) AS identifiers(identifier)\n    WHERE identifier IS NOT NULL\n    ORDER BY identifier\n  LOOP\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(\n      hashtextextended('product_identifier:' || v_lock_key, 0)\n    );\n  END LOOP;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.products product\n    WHERE product.id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id\n      AND UPPER(BTRIM(product.sku)) = v_sku\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23505',\n      MESSAGE = 'رمز الصنف SKU مستخدم بالفعل لمنتج آخر.',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'products_sku_normalized_key';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_barcode_normalized IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.products product\n    WHERE product.id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id\n      AND LOWER(BTRIM(product.barcode)) = v_barcode_normalized\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23505',\n      MESSAGE = 'الباركود مستخدم بالفعل لمنتج آخر.',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'products_barcode_normalized_key';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.products product\n    WHERE product.id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id\n      AND NULLIF(BTRIM(product.barcode), '') IS NOT NULL\n      AND LOWER(BTRIM(product.barcode)) = LOWER(v_sku)\n  ) OR (\n    v_barcode_normalized IS NOT NULL\n    AND EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.products product\n      WHERE product.id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id\n        AND LOWER(BTRIM(product.sku)) = v_barcode_normalized\n    )\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23505',\n      MESSAGE = 'لا يمكن استخدام نفس الرقم كـSKU لمنتج وباركود لمنتج آخر.',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'product_identifier_cross_collision';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_automation_event(p_event_key text, p_event_type text, p_entity_id uuid, p_payload jsonb)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_event_id UUID;v_event_key TEXT:=NULLIF(TRIM(p_event_key),'');v_payload JSONB:=COALESCE(p_payload,'{}'::JSONB);\nBEGIN\n  IF v_event_key IS NULL OR length(v_event_key)>300 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid automation event key.';END IF;\n  IF p_event_type NOT IN('new_order','low_stock','out_of_stock','shift_closed','order_unprocessed','order_near_expiry','order_expired',\n    'shift_close_reminder','shift_close_overdue','purchase_order_overdue','expense_daily_threshold','business_alert_recovery',\n    'business_daily_summary','business_weekly_summary','business_integrity_warning','cheque_due','cheque_returned') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid automation event type.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_entity_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Automation event entity is required.';END IF;\n  IF jsonb_typeof(v_payload)<>'object' OR octet_length(v_payload::TEXT)>32768 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid automation event payload.';END IF;\n  INSERT INTO public.automation_events(event_key,event_type,entity_id,payload) VALUES(v_event_key,p_event_type,p_entity_id,v_payload)\n  ON CONFLICT(event_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id INTO v_event_id;\n  IF v_event_id IS NULL THEN SELECT id INTO v_event_id FROM public.automation_events WHERE event_key=v_event_key;END IF;\n  RETURN v_event_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_business_summary(p_summary_type text, p_period_start date, p_period_end date, p_scheduled_for timestamp with time zone, p_generated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_run_id UUID;\n  v_event_id UUID;\n  v_event_key TEXT;\n  v_event_type TEXT;\n  v_payload JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_summary_type NOT IN ('daily', 'weekly') OR p_scheduled_for IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid Business summary enqueue request.';\n  END IF;\n  v_event_key := 'business_summary:' || p_summary_type || ':'\n    || p_period_start::TEXT || ':' || p_period_end::TEXT;\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_event_key, 0));\n\n  SELECT id, event_id INTO v_run_id, v_event_id\n  FROM public.business_summary_runs\n  WHERE summary_type = p_summary_type\n    AND period_start = p_period_start AND period_end = p_period_end;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n      'success', true, 'created', false,\n      'runId', v_run_id, 'eventId', v_event_id\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  v_run_id := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_payload := public.build_business_summary(\n    p_summary_type, p_period_start, p_period_end, p_generated_at\n  );\n  v_event_type := CASE p_summary_type\n    WHEN 'daily' THEN 'business_daily_summary'\n    ELSE 'business_weekly_summary'\n  END;\n  v_event_id := public.enqueue_automation_event(\n    v_event_key, v_event_type, v_run_id, v_payload\n  );\n\n  INSERT INTO public.business_summary_runs(\n    id, summary_type, period_start, period_end, scheduled_for,\n    run_status, event_id, generated_at\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_run_id, p_summary_type, p_period_start, p_period_end,\n    p_scheduled_for, 'queued', v_event_id, p_generated_at\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true, 'created', true,\n    'runId', v_run_id, 'eventId', v_event_id\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_closed_shift_automation_event()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_difference BIGINT := COALESCE(NEW.cash_discrepancy_in_minor_units, 0);\nBEGIN\n  IF OLD.status = 'open' AND NEW.status = 'closed' THEN\n    PERFORM public.enqueue_automation_event(\n      'shift_closed:' || NEW.id::TEXT,\n      'shift_closed',\n      NEW.id,\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'shiftId', NEW.id,\n        'shiftNumber', NEW.shift_number,\n        'expectedCashInMinorUnits', NEW.expected_cash_in_minor_units,\n        'actualCashInMinorUnits', NEW.actual_cash_in_minor_units,\n        'cashDiscrepancyInMinorUnits', v_difference,\n        'cashDiscrepancyAbsoluteInMinorUnits', ABS(v_difference),\n        'cashDiscrepancyDetected', v_difference <> 0,\n        'cashDiscrepancyDirection', CASE\n          WHEN v_difference > 0 THEN 'surplus'\n          WHEN v_difference < 0 THEN 'shortage'\n          ELSE 'balanced'\n        END,\n        -- Preserve the legacy payload field for deployed consumers while\n        -- changing its meaning to the approved any-non-zero rule.\n        'cashDiscrepancyThresholdInMinorUnits', NULL,\n        'cashDiscrepancyThresholdExceeded', v_difference <> 0,\n        'closedAt', NEW.closed_at\n      )\n    );\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_expired_order_business_alert()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_enabled BOOLEAN;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT order_expired_enabled INTO v_enabled\n  FROM public.business_alert_settings\n  WHERE id = true;\n\n  IF COALESCE(v_enabled, false)\n    AND NEW.source = 'website'\n    AND NEW.status = 'expired'\n    AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'expired'\n  THEN\n    PERFORM public.enqueue_automation_event(\n      'order_expired:' || NEW.id::TEXT,\n      'order_expired',\n      NEW.id,\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'orderId', NEW.id,\n        'orderNumber', NEW.order_number,\n        'expiredAt', NEW.expired_at,\n        'reason', NEW.expired_reason,\n        'source', NEW.source\n      )\n    );\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_order_automation_event()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.source <> 'website'\n    OR NEW.status <> 'new'\n    OR NEW.delivery_zone IS NULL\n    OR (TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND OLD.delivery_zone IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.delivery_zone)\n  THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.enqueue_automation_event(\n    'new_order:' || NEW.id::TEXT,\n    'new_order',\n    NEW.id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'orderId', NEW.id,\n      'orderNumber', NEW.order_number,\n      'deliveryZone', NEW.delivery_zone,\n      'deliveryFeeInMinorUnits', NEW.delivery_fee_in_minor_units,\n      'totalInMinorUnits', NEW.total_in_minor_units,\n      'paymentMethod', NEW.payment_method,\n      'source', NEW.source,\n      'createdAt', NEW.created_at\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_order_push_webhook(p_payload jsonb)\n RETURNS bigint\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'vault', 'net', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_secret TEXT;\n  v_url TEXT;\n  v_request_id BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT decrypted_secret\n  INTO v_secret\n  FROM vault.decrypted_secrets\n  WHERE name = 'order_push_webhook_secret'\n  ORDER BY created_at DESC\n  LIMIT 1;\n\n  IF NULLIF(v_secret, '') IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سر إشعارات الطلبات غير مهيأ.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT decrypted_secret\n  INTO v_url\n  FROM vault.decrypted_secrets\n  WHERE name = 'order_push_webhook_url'\n  ORDER BY created_at DESC\n  LIMIT 1;\n\n  IF NULLIF(TRIM(v_url), '') IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رابط إشعارات الطلبات غير مهيأ.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT net.http_post(\n    url := v_url,\n    body := p_payload,\n    headers := jsonb_build_object(\n      'Content-Type', 'application/json',\n      'x-order-push-secret', v_secret\n    ),\n    timeout_milliseconds := 5000\n  )\n  INTO v_request_id;\n\n  RETURN v_request_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

No secret is provisioned by migration.\n  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM vault.decrypted_secrets WHERE name='owner_telegram_dispatch_url')<>1\n    OR (SELECT count(*) FROM vault.decrypted_secrets WHERE name='owner_telegram_dispatch_secret')<>1 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_TELEGRAM_VAULT_SETTINGS_REQUIRED';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT decrypted_secret INTO v_url FROM vault.decrypted_secrets WHERE name='owner_telegram_dispatch_url';\n  SELECT decrypted_secret INTO v_secret FROM vault.decrypted_secrets WHERE name='owner_telegram_dispatch_secret';\n  IF v_url IS DISTINCT FROM 'https://kzevmysfydaslxcerogt.supabase.co/functions/v1/owner-telegram-dispatch'\n    OR length(coalesce(v_secret,''))<32 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_TELEGRAM_VAULT_SETTINGS_INVALID'; END IF;\n  SELECT net.http_post(url:=v_url,body:='{\"mode\":\"dispatch\"}'::jsonb,\n    headers:=jsonb_build_object('Content-Type','application/json','x-owner-telegram-secret',v_secret),\n    timeout_milliseconds:=5000) INTO v_request;\n  RETURN v_request;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_stock_automation_event()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_product_name TEXT;\n  v_warehouse_name TEXT;\n  v_should_enqueue BOOLEAN := false;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.status = 'active' THEN\n    v_should_enqueue := TG_OP = 'INSERT'\n      OR OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'active'\n      OR OLD.severity IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.severity;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NOT v_should_enqueue THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT p.name_ar INTO v_product_name\n  FROM public.products p\n  WHERE p.id = NEW.product_id;\n\n  SELECT w.name_ar INTO v_warehouse_name\n  FROM public.warehouses w\n  WHERE w.id = NEW.warehouse_id;\n\n  PERFORM public.enqueue_automation_event(\n    'stock_alert:' || NEW.id::TEXT || ':' || NEW.severity || ':'\n      || floor(extract(epoch FROM NEW.last_updated_at))::BIGINT::TEXT,\n    CASE\n      WHEN NEW.severity = 'out_of_stock' THEN 'out_of_stock'\n      ELSE 'low_stock'\n    END,\n    NEW.id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'stockAlertId', NEW.id,\n      'productId', NEW.product_id,\n      'productName', COALESCE(v_product_name, 'صنف'),\n      'warehouseId', NEW.warehouse_id,\n      'warehouseName', COALESCE(v_warehouse_name, 'المستودع'),\n      'availableQuantity', NEW.available_quantity,\n      'thresholdQuantity', NEW.threshold_quantity,\n      'severity', NEW.severity,\n      'updatedAt', NEW.last_updated_at\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.execute_aftercare_supplier_v1(p_action text, p_idempotency_key text, p_payload jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE actor UUID; k TEXT:=btrim(p_idempotency_key); reason TEXT; allowed TEXT[];\n request JSONB; financial JSONB; financial_replay JSONB; fingerprint TEXT; existing public.business_operations%ROWTYPE;\n op UUID:=gen_random_uuid(); original UUID; order_id UUID; supplier UUID; source_kind TEXT; source_id UUID;\n source JSONB; preview JSONB; blocked TEXT; issued JSONB; row RECORD; case_id UUID; case_ids UUID[]:='{}'::UUID[];\n manifest JSONB; result JSONB; at TIMESTAMPTZ; quantity INTEGER; cost NUMERIC(24,6); unit_name TEXT;\nBEGIN\n actor:=public.sr208_assert_role_internal('customer_return');\n IF p_action NOT IN ('replacement_supplier','reclassify_replacement','reclassify_return') OR p_action IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_ACTION_INVALID'; END IF;\n IF k IS NULL OR length(k) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_KEY_INVALID'; END IF;\n IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_INVALID'; END IF;\n reason:=NULLIF(btrim(p_payload->>'reason'),'');\n IF reason IS NULL OR length(reason) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_REASON_INVALID'; END IF;\n allowed:=CASE WHEN p_action='replacement_supplier' THEN ARRAY['orderId','items','reason','notes','supplierId']\n  ELSE ARRAY['sourceId','supplierId','reason','previewFingerprint'] END;\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_payload) x WHERE NOT x=ANY(allowed)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_FIELD_INVALID'; END IF;\n supplier:=(p_payload->>'supplierId')::UUID;\n IF supplier IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n IF p_action='replacement_supplier' THEN\n  order_id:=(p_payload->>'orderId')::UUID;\n  financial:=public.phase43_canonicalize_replacement_request_internal(order_id,p_payload->'items',reason,p_payload->>'notes');\n  financial_replay:=public.phase43_resolve_replacement_replay_internal(public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(k),\n   public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal('erp_user',actor,NULL,NULL),public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(financial));\n  request:=jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'financialRequest',financial,'supplierId',supplier);\n ELSE\n  source_kind:=CASE WHEN p_action='reclassify_replacement' THEN 'replacement' ELSE 'return' END;\n  source_id:=(p_payload->>'sourceId')::UUID;\n  IF source_id IS NULL OR p_payload->>'previewFingerprint' IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE211_PREVIEW_REQUIRED'; END IF;\n  request:=jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'sourceId',source_id,'supplierId',supplier,'reason',reason,'previewFingerprint',p_payload->>'previewFingerprint');\n END IF;\n fingerprint:=encode(extensions.digest(request::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex');\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('supplier-replacement208|'||actor::TEXT||'|'||k,0));\n SELECT * INTO existing FROM public.business_operations WHERE operation_type='supplier_replacement208' AND initiated_by=actor AND idempotency_key=k;\n IF FOUND THEN\n  IF existing.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM fingerprint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'; END IF;\n  PERFORM public.sr208_assert_operation_internal(existing.id);\n  IF p_action='replacement_supplier' AND(financial_replay->>'decision' IS DISTINCT FROM 'REPLAY'\n   OR financial_replay->>'operation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM existing.result_snapshot->>'replacementOperationId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE211_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;\n  SELECT array_agg(x::UUID ORDER BY x::UUID) INTO case_ids FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(existing.result_snapshot->'caseIds') x;\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'contractVersion',208,'action',p_action,'idempotencyKey',k,'operationId',existing.id,'idempotent',true,\n   'cases',(SELECT jsonb_agg(public.sr208_case_dto_internal(id,true) ORDER BY id) FROM unnest(case_ids) id));\n END IF;\n IF p_action='replacement_supplier' AND financial_replay->>'decision'='REPLAY' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE211_STANDALONE_IDENTITY'; END IF;\n IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=supplier AND is_active) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n IF p_action='replacement_supplier' THEN\n  issued:=public.settle_sales_replacement_v1(order_id,k,p_payload->'items',reason,p_payload->>'notes');\n  original:=(issued->>'operationId')::UUID;\n  IF original IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE211_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;\n ELSE\n  source:=public.sr211_source_internal(source_kind,source_id);\n  order_id:=(source->>'orderId')::UUID;\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_customer_order_context_internal(order_id,false,false);\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY[(source->>'productId')::UUID]);\n  preview:=public.preview_aftercare_supplier_v1(source_kind,source_id,supplier);\n  IF preview->>'previewFingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM p_payload->>'previewFingerprint' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE211_PREVIEW_CHANGED'; END IF;\n  blocked:=preview->>'blockedReason';IF blocked IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '%',blocked; END IF;\n  original:=(source->>'operationId')::UUID;\n END IF;\n -- Canonical issuer owns inventory locks first; never block on a supplier\n -- already held by receipt cancellation in the opposite hierarchy.\n BEGIN\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=supplier AND is_active FOR SHARE NOWAIT;\n EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_PARENT_BUSY_RETRY'; END;\n IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n FOR row IN SELECT 'replacement'::TEXT kind,f.replacement_item_id id FROM public.phase43_replacement_inventory_effects f\n  WHERE p_action='replacement_supplier' AND f.operation_id=original\n  UNION ALL SELECT source_kind,source_id WHERE p_action<>'replacement_supplier'\n  ORDER BY 1,2\n LOOP\n  source:=public.sr211_source_internal(row.kind,row.id);\n  blocked:=public.sr211_blocked_internal(row.kind,row.id);IF blocked IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION '%',blocked; END IF;\n  quantity:=(source->>'quantity')::INTEGER;cost:=(source->>'unitCost')::NUMERIC;at:=clock_timestamp();\n  SELECT COALESCE(u.name_ar,'باكيت') INTO unit_name FROM public.products p LEFT JOIN public.units u ON u.id=p.unit_id WHERE p.id=(source->>'productId')::UUID;\n  INSERT INTO public.supplier_replacement_cases(operation_id,supplier_id,product_id,warehouse_id,branch_id,origin,damage_event_id,\n   quantity,commercial_quantity,units_per_commercial_unit,unit_name,base_unit_name,unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact,occurred_at,created_by)\n  VALUES(op,supplier,(source->>'productId')::UUID,(source->>'warehouseId')::UUID,(source->>'branchId')::UUID,\n   CASE WHEN row.kind='replacement' THEN 'customer_replacement' ELSE 'customer_return' END,CASE WHEN row.kind='return' THEN row.id END,\n   quantity,quantity,1,unit_name,unit_name,cost,at,actor) RETURNING id INTO case_id;\n  INSERT INTO public.aftercare_supplier_links(case_id,replacement_item_id,damage_event_id,original_operation_id,source_fingerprint)\n   VALUES(case_id,CASE WHEN row.kind='replacement' THEN row.id END,CASE WHEN row.kind='return' THEN row.id END,\n    (source->>'operationId')::UUID,encode(extensions.digest(source::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'));\n  PERFORM public.sr208_append_event_internal(op,case_id,'send',quantity,quantity,-round(quantity*cost)::BIGINT,0,reason,at);\n  case_ids:=array_append(case_ids,case_id);\n END LOOP;\n IF cardinality(case_ids)=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE211_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;\n manifest:=public.sr208_operation_manifest_internal(op);\n result:=jsonb_build_object('evidenceFingerprint',encode(extensions.digest(manifest::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'),\n  'aftercare211Fingerprint',encode(extensions.digest(public.sr211_links_manifest_internal(op)::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'),\n  'caseIds',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'id' ORDER BY x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'cases') x),\n  'eventIds',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'id' ORDER BY x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'events') x));\n -- The shared envelope contains commitments/IDs only. Replacement COGS stays\n -- in its existing protected issuance evidence, never copied into this tail.\n IF p_action='replacement_supplier' THEN result:=result||jsonb_build_object('replacementOperationId',original,\n  'replacementResultFingerprint',encode(extensions.digest(issued::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex')); END IF;\n INSERT INTO public.business_operations(id,operation_type,idempotency_key,request_fingerprint,request_identity_version,request_identity_snapshot,initiated_by,result_snapshot,completed_at)\n VALUES(op,'supplier_replacement208',k,fingerprint,208,request,actor,result,clock_timestamp());\n PERFORM public.sr208_assert_operation_internal(op);\n INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id,action,entity_name,entity_id,details)\n VALUES(actor,'AFTERCARE_SUPPLIER_DISPOSITION','business_operations',op,jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'order_id',order_id,'case_ids',case_ids));\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'contractVersion',208,'action',p_action,'idempotencyKey',k,'operationId',op,'idempotent',false,\n  'cases',(SELECT jsonb_agg(public.sr208_case_dto_internal(id,true) ORDER BY id) FROM unnest(case_ids) id));\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.execute_document_correction_once(p_action text, p_record_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text, p_preview_fingerprint text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  actor UUID; k TEXT:=NULLIF(btrim(p_idempotency_key),''); reason TEXT:=NULLIF(btrim(p_reason),'');\n  request_hash TEXT; existing public.business_operations%ROWTYPE; preview JSONB; result JSONB;\n  o public.orders%ROWTYPE; cp public.customer_payments%ROWTYPE; locked_cp public.customer_payments%ROWTYPE;\n  shift_id UUID; product_ids UUID[];\nBEGIN\n  actor:=public.correction207_assert_role_internal(p_action);\n  PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout','3s',true);\n  PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout','30s',true);\n  IF p_record_id IS NULL OR reason IS NULL OR char_length(reason) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_REASON_INVALID: اكتب سبباً من3 إلى500 حرف.'; END IF;\n  IF k IS NULL OR char_length(k) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_KEY_INVALID'; END IF;\n  IF p_preview_fingerprint IS NULL OR p_preview_fingerprint!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_PREVIEW_REQUIRED'; END IF;\n  request_hash:=encode(extensions.digest(jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'recordId',p_record_id,'reason',reason,'preview',p_preview_fingerprint)::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex');\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('document-correction207-key:'||actor::TEXT||':'||k,0));\n  SELECT * INTO existing FROM public.business_operations WHERE operation_type='document_correction207' AND initiated_by=actor AND idempotency_key=k;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF existing.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM request_hash THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'; END IF;\n    RETURN existing.result_snapshot||jsonb_build_object('idempotent',true);\n  END IF;\n  -- Acquire the canonical writer's lock hierarchy BEFORE comparing displayed\n  -- facts. Its own relationship validation/locks and all triggers still run.\n  IF p_action='pos_sale' THEN\n    SELECT * INTO o FROM public.orders WHERE id=p_record_id;shift_id:=o.cash_shift_id;\n    IF shift_id IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('cash-shift-full-reversal:'||shift_id::TEXT,0)); END IF;\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('pos-sale-reversal:'||p_record_id::TEXT,0));\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id=shift_id FOR UPDATE;\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders WHERE id=p_record_id FOR UPDATE;\n    SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT product_id ORDER BY product_id) INTO product_ids FROM public.phase3_pos_reversal_inventory_rows_internal(p_record_id);\n    IF cardinality(product_ids)>0 THEN PERFORM public.phase3_lock_inventory_products_internal(product_ids); END IF;\n  ELSIF p_action='customer_payment' THEN\n    SELECT * INTO cp FROM public.customer_payments WHERE id=p_record_id;\n    IF cp.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('phase4-order|'||cp.order_id::TEXT,0)); END IF;\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id=cp.cash_shift_id FOR UPDATE;\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders WHERE id=cp.order_id FOR UPDATE;\n    SELECT * INTO locked_cp FROM public.customer_payments WHERE id=p_record_id FOR UPDATE;\n    IF locked_cp.order_id IS DISTINCT FROM cp.order_id OR locked_cp.cash_shift_id IS DISTINCT FROM cp.cash_shift_id THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='PHASE4_LOCK_PLAN_CHANGED_RETRY: Customer Payment relationship changed.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF p_action='supplier_payment' THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase4_lock_supplier_context_internal(NULL,NULL,p_record_id);\n  ELSE\n    PERFORM public.phase4_lock_supplier_context_internal(NULL,p_record_id,NULL);\n  END IF;\n  preview:=public.get_document_correction_preview(p_action,p_record_id);\n  IF preview->>'fingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM p_preview_fingerprint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_PREVIEW_STALE: تغير المستند؛ راجع المعاينة الجديدة وأكد مجدداً.'; END IF;\n  IF NOT (preview->>'eligible')::BOOLEAN THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'CORRECTION_BLOCKED: %',preview->>'blockedReason'; END IF;\n  CASE p_action\n    WHEN 'pos_sale' THEN result:=public.reverse_pos_sale(p_record_id,reason,k);\n    WHEN 'customer_payment' THEN result:=public.reverse_customer_order_payment(p_record_id,reason);\n    WHEN 'supplier_payment' THEN result:=public.reverse_supplier_payment(p_record_id,reason,k);\n    WHEN 'purchase_receipt' THEN result:=public.cancel_purchase_receipt_v2(p_record_id,reason);\n  END CASE;\n  result:=jsonb_build_object('success',true,'contractVersion',207,'action',p_action,'recordId',p_record_id,\n    'idempotent',false,'preview',preview,'writerResult',result);\n  INSERT INTO public.business_operations(operation_type,initiated_by,idempotency_key,request_fingerprint,result_snapshot,completed_at)\n  VALUES('document_correction207',actor,k,request_hash,result,NOW());\n  RETURN result;\nEND; $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.execute_supplier_replacement_v1(p_action text, p_payload jsonb, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n PERFORM public.sr208_assert_role_internal(p_action);\n IF p_action='reverse' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier215_credits WHERE event_id=(p_payload->>'eventId')::UUID)\n THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_USE_CREDIT_REVERSAL'; END IF;\n RETURN public.tb215_supplier_writer_before215_internal(p_action,p_payload,p_idempotency_key);\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.expire_stale_new_website_orders(p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 100)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order RECORD;\n  v_item RECORD;\n  v_expired_count INTEGER := 0;\n  v_failed_count INTEGER := 0;\n  v_attempted_count INTEGER := 0;\n  v_candidate_limit INTEGER;\n  v_scan_exhausted BOOLEAN := false;\n  v_expired_order_ids UUID[] := ARRAY[]::UUID[];\n  v_failed_order_ids UUID[] := ARRAY[]::UUID[];\n  v_reason CONSTANT TEXT := 'انتهت مهلة حجز طلب الموقع (5 ساعات) قبل قبول الطلب.';\nBEGIN\n  IF p_batch_size IS NULL OR p_batch_size NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'دفعة إنهاء صلاحية الطلبات يجب أن تكون بين 1 و100.';\n  END IF;\n  -- p_batch_size is a success target.  Candidate attempts are independently\n  -- bounded so poison rows cannot consume the success quota or cause a hot loop.\n  v_candidate_limit := LEAST(1000, GREATEST(p_batch_size * 10, p_batch_size + 25));\n  PERFORM SET_CONFIG('lock_timeout', '3s', true);\n  PERFORM SET_CONFIG('statement_timeout', '25s', true);\n\n  FOR v_order IN\n    SELECT customer_order.id, customer_order.order_number,\n      customer_order.warehouse_id,\n      operation.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1' AS is_v2\n    FROM public.orders customer_order\n    LEFT JOIN public.business_operations operation\n      ON operation.id = customer_order.operation_id\n    WHERE customer_order.source = 'website'\n      AND customer_order.status = 'new'\n      AND customer_order.reservation_expires_at IS NOT NULL\n      AND customer_order.reservation_expires_at <= NOW()\n      AND customer_order.reservation_released_at IS NULL\n    ORDER BY customer_order.reservation_expires_at, customer_order.id\n    LIMIT v_candidate_limit\n    FOR UPDATE OF customer_order SKIP LOCKED\n  LOOP\n    v_attempted_count := v_attempted_count + 1;\n    BEGIN\n      IF v_order.is_v2 THEN\n        PERFORM public.phase3_expire_customer_order_v2_internal(v_order.id);\n      ELSE\n        IF v_order.warehouse_id IS NULL THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب (%) لا يملك مستودعًا صالحًا لتحرير الحجز.',\n            v_order.order_number;\n        END IF;\n        FOR v_item IN\n          SELECT item.product_id, SUM(item.quantity)::INTEGER quantity\n          FROM public.order_items item WHERE item.order_id = v_order.id\n          GROUP BY item.product_id ORDER BY item.product_id\n        LOOP\n          UPDATE public.inventory_balances balance\n          SET reserved_quantity = balance.reserved_quantity - v_item.quantity,\n            updated_at = NOW()\n          WHERE balance.warehouse_id = v_order.warehouse_id\n            AND balance.product_id = v_item.product_id\n            AND balance.reserved_quantity >= v_item.quantity;\n          IF NOT FOUND THEN\n            RAISE EXCEPTION\n              'تعذر تحرير حجز الطلب (%): رصيد الحجز للصنف (%) غير متطابق.',\n              v_order.order_number, v_item.product_id;\n          END IF;\n        END LOOP;\n        UPDATE public.orders SET status = 'expired', expired_at = NOW(),\n          expired_reason = v_reason, reservation_released_at = NOW(),\n          updated_at = NOW()\n        WHERE id = v_order.id AND source = 'website' AND status = 'new'\n          AND reservation_expires_at <= NOW()\n          AND reservation_released_at IS NULL;\n        IF NOT FOUND THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION\n            'تغيرت حالة الطلب (%) أثناء إنهاء الصلاحية؛ تم إلغاء العملية بأمان.',\n            v_order.order_number;\n        END IF;\n        INSERT INTO public.order_status_history(\n          order_id, old_status, new_status, changed_by, notes\n        ) VALUES (v_order.id, 'new', 'expired', NULL, v_reason);\n        INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)\n        VALUES (NULL, 'EXPIRE_STALE_NEW_WEBSITE_ORDER', 'orders', v_order.id,\n          JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('order_number', v_order.order_number,\n            'source', 'website', 'reason', v_reason, 'actor', 'system'));\n      END IF;\n      v_expired_count := v_expired_count + 1;\n      v_expired_order_ids := ARRAY_APPEND(v_expired_order_ids, v_order.id);\n    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n      -- A poison row is isolated by this subtransaction. The scheduler can\n      -- continue releasing unrelated eligible orders and reports the exact\n      -- opaque IDs that require operational review.\n      v_failed_count := v_failed_count + 1;\n      v_failed_order_ids := ARRAY_APPEND(v_failed_order_ids, v_order.id);\n      INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(\n        user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details\n      ) VALUES (\n        NULL,\n        'EXPIRE_STALE_WEBSITE_ORDER_FAILED',\n        'orders',\n        v_order.id,\n        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n          'order_number', v_order.order_number,\n          'source', 'website',\n          'actor', 'system',\n          'sqlstate', SQLSTATE,\n          'error', LEFT(SQLERRM, 500)\n        )\n      );\n    END;\n    EXIT WHEN v_expired_count >= p_batch_size;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  IF v_attempted_count >= v_candidate_limit\n    AND v_expired_count < p_batch_size\n  THEN\n    SELECT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.orders customer_order\n      WHERE customer_order.source = 'website'\n        AND customer_order.status = 'new'\n        AND customer_order.reservation_expires_at IS NOT NULL\n        AND customer_order.reservation_expires_at <= NOW()\n        AND customer_order.reservation_released_at IS NULL\n        AND NOT (customer_order.id = ANY(v_failed_order_ids))\n    ) INTO v_scan_exhausted;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'success', v_failed_count = 0,\n    'attempted_count', v_attempted_count,\n    'expired_count', v_expired_count,\n    'expired_order_ids', v_expired_order_ids,\n    'failed_count', v_failed_count,\n    'failed_order_ids', v_failed_order_ids,\n    'scan_exhausted', v_scan_exhausted\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.extract_google_maps_coordinates(p_google_maps_url text)\n RETURNS double precision[]\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_url TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_google_maps_url), '');\n  v_match TEXT[];\n  v_latitude DOUBLE PRECISION;\n  v_longitude DOUBLE PRECISION;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_url IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN NULL;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_match := REGEXP_MATCH(\n    v_url,\n    '[?&](?:q|query)=(-?[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)(?:,|%2c)(-?[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)',\n    'i'\n  );\n\n  IF v_match IS NULL THEN\n    v_match := REGEXP_MATCH(\n      v_url,\n      '/@(-?[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?),(-?[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?)(?:,|/|$)',\n      'i'\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_match IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN NULL;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_latitude := v_match[1]::DOUBLE PRECISION;\n  v_longitude := v_match[2]::DOUBLE PRECISION;\n\n  IF v_latitude NOT BETWEEN -90 AND 90\n    OR v_longitude NOT BETWEEN -180 AND 180\n  THEN\n    RETURN NULL;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN ARRAY[v_latitude, v_longitude];\nEXCEPTION\n  WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN\n    RETURN NULL;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finalize_guest_order_gateway(p_idempotency_key uuid, p_outcome text, p_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\n SET lock_timeout TO '3s'\n SET statement_timeout TO '5s'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_request public.guest_order_gateway_requests%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_outcome NOT IN ('succeeded', 'order_rejected', 'gateway_error') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid gateway outcome.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_request\n  FROM public.guest_order_gateway_requests\n  WHERE idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_request.decision <> 'allowed' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Gateway authorization was not found.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_request.outcome = 'succeeded' THEN\n    IF p_outcome <> 'succeeded'\n      OR v_request.order_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_order_id\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Gateway request is already finalized.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.guest_order_gateway_requests\n  SET outcome = p_outcome,\n      order_id = CASE WHEN p_outcome = 'succeeded' THEN p_order_id ELSE NULL END,\n      finalized_at = NOW()\n  WHERE idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key;\nEND;\n$function$\n",
