        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finalize_order_parcel_instance_internal(p_parcel_instance_id uuid)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_item_id UUID;\n  v_locked_order_item_id UUID;\n  v_line_kind TEXT;\n  v_family_product_id UUID;\n  v_configuration_id UUID;\n  v_configuration_revision INTEGER;\n  v_expected INTEGER;\n  v_actual BIGINT;\n  v_invalid_components BIGINT;\n  v_finalized_at TIMESTAMPTZ;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT instance.order_item_id\n  INTO v_order_item_id\n  FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n  WHERE instance.id = p_parcel_instance_id;\n\n  IF v_order_item_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = 'P0002',\n      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND: تعذر العثور على الطرد المطلوب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Global hierarchy: Order Item -> Parcel Instance -> configuration/products.\n  SELECT item.commercial_line_kind\n  INTO v_line_kind\n  FROM public.order_items item\n  WHERE item.id = v_order_item_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_line_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'configurable_parcel' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'order_parcel_instances_order_item_kind_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'Parcel finalization requires an explicit configurable Parcel Order Item.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT\n    instance.order_item_id,\n    instance.family_product_id,\n    instance.parcel_configuration_id,\n    instance.configuration_revision,\n    instance.units_per_parcel_snapshot,\n    instance.finalized_at\n  INTO\n    v_locked_order_item_id,\n    v_family_product_id,\n    v_configuration_id,\n    v_configuration_revision,\n    v_expected,\n    v_finalized_at\n  FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n  WHERE instance.id = p_parcel_instance_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF v_locked_order_item_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order_item_id THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '40001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_ORDER_ITEM_CHANGED_DURING_FINALIZATION: أعد المحاولة من معاملة جديدة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_ALREADY_FINALIZED: الطرد مكتمل مسبقًا.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM 1\n  FROM public.product_parcel_configurations configuration\n  WHERE configuration.id = v_configuration_id\n    AND configuration.family_product_id = v_family_product_id\n    AND configuration.configuration_revision = v_configuration_revision\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'order_parcel_instance_configuration_snapshot_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'Parcel configuration/family/revision is not valid at finalization.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Stable product ordering prevents two mixed Parcels from taking product\n  -- locks in opposite orders. FOR SHARE freezes family membership until commit.\n  PERFORM 1\n  FROM public.products product\n  WHERE product.id = v_family_product_id\n    OR product.id IN (\n      SELECT component.product_id\n      FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n      WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = p_parcel_instance_id\n    )\n  ORDER BY product.id\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  SELECT\n    COALESCE(SUM(component.base_quantity), 0),\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (\n      WHERE product.id IS NULL\n        OR product.is_flavor_master\n        OR COALESCE(product.flavor_master_product_id, product.id)\n          IS DISTINCT FROM v_family_product_id\n    )\n  INTO v_actual, v_invalid_components\n  FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n  LEFT JOIN public.products product ON product.id = component.product_id\n  WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = p_parcel_instance_id;\n\n  IF v_actual IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected::BIGINT THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'order_parcel_composition_total_check',\n      MESSAGE = FORMAT(\n        'Parcel composition total (%s) must equal its pack-size snapshot (%s).',\n        v_actual,\n        v_expected\n      );\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_invalid_components <> 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'order_parcel_component_family_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'Every Parcel component must belong to its immutable Family snapshot.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM SET_CONFIG(\n    'nawasrah.parcel_finalization_id',\n    p_parcel_instance_id::TEXT,\n    true\n  );\n\n  UPDATE public.order_parcel_instances\n  SET finalized_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_parcel_instance_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_go_live_setup_v1(p_confirmation text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_state public.go_live_setup_state%ROWTYPE;\n  v_main_branch UUID;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'إنهاء بداية التشغيل');\n  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_state FROM public.go_live_setup_state WHERE id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF v_state.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'idempotentReplay', true,\n      'finishedAt', v_state.finished_at, 'finishedBy', v_state.finished_by);\n  END IF;\n  IF BTRIM(COALESCE(p_confirmation, '')) <> 'إنهاء بداية التشغيل' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: اكتب عبارة التأكيد \"إنهاء بداية التشغيل\" حرفياً.';\n  END IF;\n  v_main_branch := public.go_live_main_branch_internal();\n  IF v_main_branch IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_MAIN_BRANCH_REQUIRED: اختر الفرع الرئيسي الذي تُنسب إليه الديون الافتتاحية قبل الإنهاء.';\n  END IF;\n  UPDATE public.go_live_setup_state\n  SET finished_at = NOW(), finished_by = v_user_id, main_branch_id = v_main_branch\n  WHERE id RETURNING * INTO v_state;\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)\n  VALUES (v_user_id, 'GO_LIVE_SETUP_FINISHED', 'go_live_setup_state', NULL,\n    jsonb_build_object('finished_at', v_state.finished_at, 'main_branch_id', v_state.main_branch_id,\n      'status', public.go_live_setup_counts_internal()));\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'idempotentReplay', false,\n    'finishedAt', v_state.finished_at, 'finishedBy', v_state.finished_by);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_active_order_push_targets(p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)\n RETURNS TABLE(subscription_id uuid, user_id uuid, endpoint text, p256dh text, auth_key text)\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT DISTINCT\n    subscription.id,\n    subscription.user_id,\n    subscription.endpoint,\n    subscription.p256dh,\n    subscription.auth_key\n  FROM public.push_subscriptions AS subscription\n  JOIN public.profiles AS profile\n    ON profile.id = subscription.user_id\n  JOIN public.user_roles AS user_role\n    ON user_role.user_id = profile.id\n  JOIN public.roles AS role\n    ON role.id = user_role.role_id\n  WHERE subscription.is_active = true\n    AND profile.is_active = true\n    AND role.code = ANY (ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'orders']::TEXT[])\n    AND (p_user_id IS NULL OR subscription.user_id = p_user_id);\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_ai_inventory_snapshot()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_items JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'قراءة مخزون وأسعار مساعد الإدارة الذكي'\n  );\n\n  WITH product_stock AS (\n    SELECT\n      p.name_ar,\n      p.sku,\n      COALESCE(u.name_ar, 'طرد') AS sale_unit_name,\n      GREATEST(p.units_per_sale_unit, 1)::INTEGER AS units_per_sale_unit,\n      GREATEST(COALESCE(p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units, 0), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(SUM(ib.available_quantity), 0)::INTEGER AS available_base_units\n    FROM public.products p\n    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances ib\n      ON ib.product_id = p.id\n    LEFT JOIN public.units u\n      ON u.id = p.sale_unit_id\n    WHERE p.is_active = true\n    GROUP BY\n      p.id,\n      p.name_ar,\n      p.sku,\n      u.name_ar,\n      p.units_per_sale_unit,\n      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units\n  )\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    JSONB_AGG(\n      JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n        'productName', name_ar,\n        'sku', sku,\n        'saleUnitName', sale_unit_name,\n        'unitsPerSaleUnit', units_per_sale_unit,\n        'salePriceInMinorUnits', sale_price_in_minor_units,\n        'availableBaseUnits', available_base_units,\n        'availableSalePackages', FLOOR(\n          available_base_units::NUMERIC / units_per_sale_unit\n        )::INTEGER\n      )\n      ORDER BY name_ar ASC, sku ASC\n    ),\n    '[]'::JSONB\n  )\n  INTO v_items\n  FROM product_stock;\n\n  RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'generatedAt', NOW(),\n    'items', v_items\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_ai_monthly_report()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_business_date DATE := (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE;\n  v_date_from DATE;\n  v_date_to DATE;\n  v_report JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'قراءة التقرير الشهري لمساعد الإدارة الذكي'\n  );\n\n  v_date_from := date_trunc('month', v_business_date)::DATE;\n  v_date_to := (v_date_from + INTERVAL '1 month - 1 day')::DATE;\n\n  WITH branch_reports AS (\n    SELECT\n      b.id,\n      b.name_ar,\n      public.get_operational_business_report(\n        b.id,\n        v_date_from,\n        v_date_to\n      ) AS report\n    FROM public.branches b\n    WHERE b.is_active = true\n  ),\n  totals AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS branch_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'orderCount')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS order_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'grossSalesInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS gross_sales,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'netSalesInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS net_sales,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'grossProfitInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS gross_profit,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'netProfitInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS net_profit,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'collectedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS collected,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'sales'->>'outstandingInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS period_outstanding,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'expenses'->>'count')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS expense_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'expenses'->>'totalInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS expenses_total,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'purchases'->>'receiptCount')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS purchase_receipt_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'purchases'->>'totalInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS purchases_total,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'balances'->>'customerDueInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS customer_due,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'balances'->>'supplierDueInMinorUnits')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS supplier_due,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'inventory'->>'stockedProducts')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS stocked_products,\n      COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE((report->'inventory'->>'lowStockProducts')::BIGINT, 0)), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS low_stock_products\n    FROM branch_reports\n  ),\n  branch_payload AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(\n      JSONB_AGG(\n        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('name', name_ar)\n        ORDER BY name_ar ASC\n      ),\n      '[]'::JSONB\n    ) AS payload\n    FROM branch_reports\n  )\n  SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'success', true,\n    'generatedAt', NOW(),\n    'period', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'dateFrom', v_date_from,\n      'dateTo', v_date_to,\n      'label', TO_CHAR(v_date_from, 'YYYY-MM')\n    ),\n    'branches', branch_payload.payload,\n    'sales', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'orderCount', totals.order_count,\n      'grossSalesInMinorUnits', totals.gross_sales,\n      'netSalesInMinorUnits', totals.net_sales,\n      'grossProfitInMinorUnits', totals.gross_profit,\n      'netProfitInMinorUnits', totals.net_profit,\n      'collectedInMinorUnits', totals.collected,\n      'outstandingInMinorUnits', totals.period_outstanding\n    ),\n    'expenses', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'count', totals.expense_count,\n      'totalInMinorUnits', totals.expenses_total\n    ),\n    'purchases', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'receiptCount', totals.purchase_receipt_count,\n      'totalInMinorUnits', totals.purchases_total\n    ),\n    'balances', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'customerDueInMinorUnits', totals.customer_due,\n      'supplierDueInMinorUnits', totals.supplier_due\n    ),\n    'inventory', JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'stockedProducts', totals.stocked_products,\n      'lowStockProducts', totals.low_stock_products\n    ),\n    'branchCount', totals.branch_count\n  )\n  INTO v_report\n  FROM totals\n  CROSS JOIN branch_payload;\n\n  RETURN v_report;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_inventory_product_page(p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 24, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_category_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_status text DEFAULT 'all'::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_page INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page, 1);\n  v_page_size INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page_size, 24);\n  v_search TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_search), '');\n  v_status TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_status), ''), 'all');\n  v_offset INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY[\n      'owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant', 'cashier', 'sales',\n      'warehouse_keeper', 'orders', 'delivery_driver', 'view_only'\n    ],\n    'عرض صفحة المخزون الإداري'\n  );\n\n  IF v_page < 1 OR v_page > 100000 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الصفحة غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_page_size < 1 OR v_page_size > 100 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حجم الصفحة يجب أن يكون بين 1 و100.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_search IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_search) > 100 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عبارة البحث طويلة جدًا.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_status NOT IN ('all', 'available', 'low_stock', 'out_of_stock', 'near_expiry', 'damaged', 'stagnant') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'فلتر حالة المخزون غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_offset := (v_page - 1) * v_page_size;\n\n  RETURN (\n    WITH stock_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT\n        product.id AS product_id,\n        COALESCE(SUM(ib.on_hand_quantity) FILTER (\n          WHERE (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR ib.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)\n            AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n        ), 0)::INTEGER AS on_hand_quantity,\n        COALESCE(SUM(ib.reserved_quantity) FILTER (\n          WHERE (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR ib.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)\n            AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n        ), 0)::INTEGER AS reserved_quantity,\n        COALESCE(SUM(ib.available_quantity) FILTER (\n          WHERE (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR ib.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)\n            AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n        ), 0)::INTEGER AS available_quantity,\n        CASE WHEN p_warehouse_id IS NOT NULL THEN p_warehouse_id\n          WHEN COUNT(ib.warehouse_id) FILTER (\n            WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id\n          ) = 1 THEN MIN(ib.warehouse_id::TEXT) FILTER (\n            WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id\n          )::UUID\n        END AS warehouse_id\n      FROM public.products product\n      LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances ib ON ib.product_id = product.id\n      LEFT JOIN public.warehouses warehouse ON warehouse.id = ib.warehouse_id\n      WHERE product.is_flavor_master = false\n      GROUP BY product.id\n    ),\n    inventory_catalog AS MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT\n        product.*,\n        stock.on_hand_quantity,\n        stock.reserved_quantity,\n        stock.available_quantity,\n        stock.warehouse_id,\n        EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM public.inventory_movements movement\n          JOIN public.warehouses movement_warehouse ON movement_warehouse.id = movement.warehouse_id\n          WHERE movement.product_id = product.id\n            AND movement.movement_type = 'sales_deduction'\n            AND (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR movement.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)\n            AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR movement_warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n        ) AS has_sales\n      FROM public.products product\n      JOIN stock_by_product stock ON stock.product_id = product.id\n      WHERE product.is_flavor_master = false\n    ),\n    filtered_catalog AS NOT MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT product.*\n      FROM inventory_catalog product\n      WHERE (p_category_id IS NULL OR product.category_id = p_category_id)\n        AND (\n          v_search IS NULL\n          OR product.name_ar ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR product.sku ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(product.barcode, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n        )\n        AND (\n          v_status = 'all'\n          OR (v_status = 'available' AND product.available_quantity > 0)\n          OR (v_status = 'low_stock' AND product.available_quantity > 0\n              AND product.available_quantity <= product.min_stock_level)\n          OR (v_status = 'out_of_stock' AND product.available_quantity <= 0)\n          OR (v_status = 'stagnant' AND product.has_sales = false\n              AND product.on_hand_quantity > 0)\n          -- Product-level expiry/damage state is not stored in the canonical\n          -- products table, so these legacy UI filters intentionally match no rows.\n          OR (v_status IN ('near_expiry', 'damaged') AND false)\n        )\n    ),\n    paged_catalog AS MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT product.*\n      FROM filtered_catalog product\n      ORDER BY product.name_ar, product.id\n      OFFSET v_offset\n      LIMIT v_page_size\n    ),\n    detailed_page AS (\n      SELECT\n        product.id,\n        product.sku,\n        product.barcode,\n        product.name_ar,\n        product.description,\n        product.category_id,\n        product.brand_id,\n        product.unit_id,\n        product.purchase_unit_id,\n        product.units_per_purchase_unit,\n        product.default_purchase_price_in_minor_units,\n        product.sale_unit_id,\n        product.units_per_sale_unit,\n        product.parcel_only,\n        product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n        product.cost_price_in_minor_units,\n        product.sale_price_in_minor_units,\n        product.wholesale_price_in_minor_units,\n        product.min_stock_level,\n        product.max_stock_level,\n        product.is_active,\n        product.flavor_master_product_id,\n        product.flavor_name_ar,\n        product.is_flavor_master,\n        product.flavor_sort_order,\n        product.created_at,\n        product.updated_at,\n        jsonb_build_object('id', base_unit.id, 'name_ar', base_unit.name_ar, 'code', base_unit.code) AS base_unit,\n        jsonb_build_object('id', purchase_unit.id, 'name_ar', purchase_unit.name_ar, 'code', purchase_unit.code) AS purchase_unit,\n        jsonb_build_object('id', sale_unit.id, 'name_ar', sale_unit.name_ar, 'code', sale_unit.code) AS sale_unit,\n        product.on_hand_quantity,\n        product.reserved_quantity,\n        product.available_quantity,\n        product.warehouse_id,\n        COALESCE(page_stock.warehouse_balances, '[]'::JSONB) AS warehouse_balances,\n        product.has_sales,\n        COALESCE(movement_count.value, 0)::INTEGER AS movement_count,\n        image.image_url\n      FROM paged_catalog product\n      LEFT JOIN public.units base_unit ON base_unit.id = product.unit_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.units purchase_unit ON purchase_unit.id = product.purchase_unit_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.units sale_unit ON sale_unit.id = product.sale_unit_id\n      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(\n          'warehouse_id', balance.warehouse_id,\n          'on_hand_quantity', balance.on_hand_quantity,\n          'reserved_quantity', balance.reserved_quantity,\n          'available_quantity', balance.available_quantity\n        ) ORDER BY balance.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_balances\n        FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n        JOIN public.warehouses balance_warehouse\n          ON balance_warehouse.id = balance.warehouse_id\n        WHERE balance.product_id = product.id\n          AND (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR balance.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)\n          AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR balance_warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n      ) page_stock ON true\n      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS value\n        FROM public.inventory_movements movement\n        JOIN public.warehouses movement_warehouse ON movement_warehouse.id = movement.warehouse_id\n        WHERE movement.product_id = product.id\n          AND (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR movement.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)\n          AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR movement_warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n      ) movement_count ON true\n      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n        SELECT pi.image_url\n        FROM public.product_images pi\n        WHERE pi.product_id = product.id AND pi.is_primary = true\n        ORDER BY pi.display_order, pi.created_at\n        LIMIT 1\n      ) image ON true\n    ),\n    inventory_metrics AS (\n      SELECT\n        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS total_items,\n        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE product.is_active = true)::INTEGER AS active_items,\n        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE product.available_quantity > 0)::INTEGER AS available_stock,\n        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(\n          product.on_hand_quantity::NUMERIC\n            * COALESCE(\n                product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,\n                product.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC\n              )\n        ), 0), 0)::BIGINT AS total_cost_in_minor_units,\n        COALESCE(SUM(product.sale_price_in_minor_units * product.on_hand_quantity), 0)::BIGINT\n          AS total_retail_in_minor_units,\n        COUNT(*) FILTER (\n          WHERE product.available_quantity > 0\n            AND product.available_quantity <= product.min_stock_level\n        )::INTEGER AS low_stock,\n        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE product.available_quantity <= 0)::INTEGER AS out_of_stock,\n        COUNT(*) FILTER (\n          WHERE product.has_sales = false AND product.on_hand_quantity > 0\n        )::INTEGER AS stagnant\n      FROM inventory_catalog product\n    )\n    SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n      'products', COALESCE((\n        SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(item) ORDER BY item.name_ar, item.id)\n        FROM detailed_page item\n      ), '[]'::JSONB),\n      'total_count', (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM filtered_catalog),\n      'metrics', COALESCE((SELECT to_jsonb(metric) FROM inventory_metrics metric), '{}'::JSONB)\n    )\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_parcel_configuration_context_v1()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_products JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'],'إعداد الطرود');\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(\n    'familyProductId',family.id,'nameAr',family.name_ar,'sku',family.sku,\n    'isFlavorMaster',family.is_flavor_master,'unitsPerParcel',family.units_per_sale_unit,\n    'parcelPriceInMinorUnits',family.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n    'configuration',CASE WHEN configuration.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE to_jsonb(configuration) END,\n    'allowedProductIds',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(allowed.product_id ORDER BY allowed.product_id)\n      FROM public.product_parcel_allowed_components allowed\n      JOIN public.products active_component ON active_component.id=allowed.product_id AND active_component.is_active\n      WHERE allowed.configuration_id=configuration.id),'[]'::JSONB),\n    'components',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('productId',component.id,\n      'nameAr',component.name_ar,'sku',component.sku,'flavorNameAr',component.flavor_name_ar,\n      'packetPriceInMinorUnits',component.sale_price_in_minor_units) ORDER BY component.name_ar,component.id)\n      FROM public.products component WHERE component.is_active AND\n        (component.flavor_master_product_id=family.id OR component.id=family.id)),'[]'::JSONB)\n    ) ORDER BY family.name_ar,family.id),'[]'::JSONB) INTO v_products\n  FROM public.products family LEFT JOIN public.product_parcel_configurations configuration\n    ON configuration.family_product_id=family.id\n  WHERE family.is_active AND family.flavor_master_product_id IS NULL AND family.sale_unit_id IS NOT NULL;\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('featureState',public.get_configurable_parcel_feature_state(),'products',v_products);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_product_listing()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY[\n      'owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant', 'cashier', 'sales',\n      'warehouse_keeper', 'orders', 'delivery_driver', 'view_only'\n    ],\n    'عرض قائمة المنتجات الإدارية'\n  );\n\n  RETURN (\n    WITH listing AS (\n      SELECT\n        p.id,\n        p.sku,\n        p.barcode,\n        p.name_ar,\n        p.description,\n        p.category_id,\n        p.brand_id,\n        p.unit_id,\n        p.purchase_unit_id,\n        p.units_per_purchase_unit,\n        p.default_purchase_price_in_minor_units,\n        p.sale_unit_id,\n        p.units_per_sale_unit,\n        p.parcel_only,\n        p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n        p.cost_price_in_minor_units,\n        p.sale_price_in_minor_units,\n        p.wholesale_price_in_minor_units,\n        p.min_stock_level,\n        p.max_stock_level,\n        p.is_active,\n        p.flavor_master_product_id,\n        p.flavor_name_ar,\n        p.is_flavor_master,\n        p.flavor_sort_order,\n        p.created_at,\n        p.updated_at,\n        jsonb_build_object(\n          'id', base_unit.id,\n          'name_ar', base_unit.name_ar,\n          'code', base_unit.code\n        ) AS base_unit,\n        jsonb_build_object(\n          'id', purchase_unit.id,\n          'name_ar', purchase_unit.name_ar,\n          'code', purchase_unit.code\n        ) AS purchase_unit,\n        jsonb_build_object(\n          'id', sale_unit.id,\n          'name_ar', sale_unit.name_ar,\n          'code', sale_unit.code\n        ) AS sale_unit,\n        COALESCE(stock.on_hand_quantity, 0)::INTEGER AS on_hand_quantity,\n        COALESCE(stock.reserved_quantity, 0)::INTEGER AS reserved_quantity,\n $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_page INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page, 1);\n  v_page_size INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page_size, 24);\n  v_search TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_search), '');\n  v_status TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_status), ''), 'all');\n  v_sort TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_sort), ''), 'name');\n  v_offset INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY[\n      'owner', 100000 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الصفحة غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_page_size < 1 OR v_page_size > 100 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حجم الصفحة يجب أن يكون بين 1 و100.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_search IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_search) > 100 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عبارة البحث طويلة جدًا.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_status NOT IN ('all', 'healthy', 'low_stock', 'out_of_stock', 'hidden') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'فلتر حالة المنتج غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_sort NOT IN ('name', 'stock_asc', 'stock_desc', 'profit_desc') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ترتيب المنتجات غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_offset := (v_page - 1) * v_page_size;\n\n  RETURN (\n    WITH stock_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT\n        ib.product_id,\n        SUM(ib.on_hand_quantity)::INTEGER AS on_hand_quantity,\n        SUM(ib.reserved_quantity)::INTEGER AS reserved_quantity,\n        SUM(ib.available_quantity)::INTEGER AS available_quantity,\n        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MIN(ib.warehouse_id::TEXT)::UUID END AS warehouse_id,\n        jsonb_agg(\n          jsonb_build_object(\n            'warehouse_id', ib.warehouse_id,\n            'on_hand_quantity', ib.on_hand_quantity,\n            'reserved_quantity', ib.reserved_quantity,\n            'available_quantity', ib.available_quantity\n          ) ORDER BY ib.warehouse_id\n        ) AS product_id,\n        COALESCE(SUM(stock.on_hand_quantity), 0)::INTEGER AS on_hand_quantity,\n        COALESCE(SUM(stock.reserved_quantity), 0)::INTEGER AS reserved_quantity,\n        COALESCE(SUM(stock.available_quantity), 0)::INTEGER AS available_quantity,\n        COALESCE(SUM(\n          COALESCE(stock.on_hand_quantity, 0)::NUMERIC\n            * COALESCE(\n                child.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,\n                child.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC\n              )\n        ), 0)::NUMERIC AS inventory_value_in_minor_units_exact\n      FROM public.products child\n      LEFT JOIN stock_by_product stock ON stock.product_id = child.id\n      WHERE child.flavor_master_product_id IS NOT NULL\n      GROUP BY child.flavor_master_product_id\n    ),\n    root_catalog AS MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT\n        product.*,\n        CASE WHEN product.is_flavor_master\n          THEN COALESCE(family.on_hand_quantity, 0)\n          ELSE COALESCE(stock.on_hand_quantity, 0)\n        END::INTEGER AS effective_on_hand_quantity,\n        CASE WHEN product.is_flavor_master\n          THEN COALESCE(family.reserved_quantity, 0)\n          ELSE COALESCE(stock.reserved_quantity, 0)\n        END::INTEGER AS effective_reserved_quantity,\n        CASE WHEN product.is_flavor_master\n          THEN COALESCE(family.available_quantity, 0)\n                product.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC\n              )\n        END::NUMERIC AS effective_inventory_value_in_minor_units_exact\n      FROM public.products product\n      LEFT JOIN 'all'\n          OR (v_status = 'hidden' AND root.is_active = false)\n          OR (\n            root.is_active = true\n            AND (\n              (v_status = 'healthy' AND CASE WHEN v_sort = 'stock_desc' THEN root.effective_available_quantity END DESC,\n        CASE WHEN v_sort = 'profit_desc' THEN\n          COALESCE(root.default_sale_price_in_minor_units, 0)\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_cash_shift_archive_page(p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_cashier_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_status text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_shift_number text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_date_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_date_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_limit integer DEFAULT 25, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE v_status TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_status), '');\n  v_number_query TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_shift_number), '');\n  v_total_count INTEGER := 0;\n  v_items JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_cashiers JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'عرض أرشيف الورديات'\n  );\n\n  IF v_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حجم صفحة أرشيف الورديات غير صحيح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_offset < 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'بداية صفحة أرشيف الورديات غير صحيحة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_status IS NOT NULL AND v_status NOT IN ('open', 'closed', 'cancelled', 'reversed') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حالة الوردية غير صحيحة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_date_from IS NOT NULL AND p_date_to IS NOT NULL AND p_date_from > p_date_to THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تاريخ البداية يجب أن يسبق تاريخ النهاية.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER\n  INTO v_total_count\n  FROM public.cash_shifts cs\n  WHERE (p_branch_id IS NULL OR cs.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n    AND (p_cashier_id IS NULL OR cs.opened_by = p_cashier_id)\n    AND (v_status IS NULL OR cs.status = v_status)\n    AND (v_number_query IS NULL OR cs.shift_number ILIKE '%' || v_number_query || '%')\n    AND (p_date_from IS NULL OR cs.opened_at >= p_date_from::TIMESTAMPTZ)\n    AND (p_date_to IS NULL OR cs.opened_at < (p_date_to + 1)::TIMESTAMPTZ);\n\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(public.get_cash_shift_display_summary(page.id) ORDER BY page.opened_at DESC, page.id DESC), '[]'::JSONB)\n  INTO v_items\n  FROM (\n    SELECT cs.id, cs.opened_at\n    FROM public.cash_shifts cs\n    WHERE (p_branch_id IS NULL OR cs.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n      AND (p_cashier_id IS NULL OR cs.opened_by = p_cashier_id)\n      AND (v_status IS NULL OR cs.status = v_status)\n      AND (v_number_query IS NULL OR cs.shift_number ILIKE '%' || v_number_query || '%')\n      AND (p_date_from IS NULL OR cs.opened_at >= p_date_from::TIMESTAMPTZ)\n      AND (p_date_to IS NULL OR cs.opened_at < (p_date_to + 1)::TIMESTAMPTZ)\n    ORDER BY cs.opened_at DESC, cs.id DESC\n    OFFSET v_offset\n    LIMIT v_limit\n  ) page;\n\n  -- Filter choices are bounded and exposed only through this protected read model.\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', source.id, 'name', source.name) ORDER BY source.name), '[]'::JSONB)\n  INTO v_cashiers\n  FROM (\n    SELECT DISTINCT cs.opened_by AS id, COALESCE(profile.full_name, 'مستخدم النظام') AS name\n    FROM public.cash_shifts cs\n    LEFT JOIN public.profiles profile ON profile.id = cs.opened_by\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR cs.branch_id = p_branch_id\n    ORDER BY name\n    LIMIT 100\n  ) source;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'items', v_items,\n    'totalCount',         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_cash_shift_closing_report(p_shift_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_shift public.cash_shifts%ROWTYPE;\n  v_report JSONB;\n  v_section JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'عرض تقرير إغلاق الوردية'\n  );\n  SELECT * INTO v_shift\n  FROM public.cash_shifts\n  WHERE id = p_shift_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الوردية المحددة غير موجودة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_shift.status = 'closed'\n    AND v_shift.closing_report_snapshot IS NOT NULL\n  THEN\n    RETURN v_shift.closing_report_snapshot;\n  END IF;\n  v_report := public._get_cash_shift_closing_report_before_snapshot(p_shift_id);\n  v_section := public.owner_withdrawal_closing_section_internal(p_shift_id);\n  IF jsonb_array_length(v_section->'items') > 0 THEN\n    v_section := v_section || jsonb_build_object('netMovementAfterWithdrawalsInMinorUnits',\n      (v_report #>> '{reconciliation,netMovementInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT\n        - (v_section->>'netInMinorUnits')::BIGINT);\n    v_report := v_report || jsonb_build_object('ownerWithdrawals', v_section);\n  END IF;\n  v_section:=public.cheque_shift_settlement_section_internal(p_shift_id);\n  IF jsonb_array_length(v_section->'items')>0 THEN\n    v_report:=v_report||jsonb_build_object('chequeCompensationSettlements',v_section);\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_report || jsonb_build_object(\n    'snapshotStatus',\n    CASE\n      WHEN v_shift.status = 'open' THEN 'live'\n      WHEN v_shift.status = 'closed' THEN 'legacy_recalculated'\n      ELSE 'not_applicable'\n    END\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_cash_shift_display_summary(p_shift_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_shift public.cash_shifts%ROWTYPE; v_opened_by_name TEXT; v_actor_name TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  -- Authorize before reading even the cancelled/reversed short-circuit.\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','accountant','sales'], 'عرض ملخص الوردية');\n  SELECT * INTO v_shift FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id=p_shift_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الوردية المحددة غير موجودة.'; END IF;\n  IF v_shift.status NOT IN ('cancelled','reversed') THEN RETURN public.get_cash_shift_summary(p_shift_id); END IF;\n  SELECT full_name INTO v_opened_by_name FROM public.profiles WHERE id=v_shift.opened_by;\n  SELECT full_name INTO v_actor_name FROM public.profiles WHERE id=CASE WHEN v_shift.status='cancelled' THEN v_shift.cancelled_by ELSE v_shift.reversed_by END;\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('id',v_shift.id,'shiftNumber',v_shift.shift_number,'branchId',v_shift.branch_id,'cashierName',COALESCE(v_opened_by_name,'مستخدم النظام'),'startTime',v_shift.opened_at,'endTime',CASE WHEN v_shift.status='cancelled' THEN v_shift.cancelled_at ELSE v_shift.reversed_at END,'openingCashInMinorUnits',v_shift.opening_cash_in_minor_units,'cashSalesInMinorUnits',0,'cliqSalesInMinorUnits',0,'cardSalesInMinorUnits',0,'cashReceiptsInMinorUnits',0,'cliqReceiptsInMinorUnits',0,'cashSupplierPaymentsInMinorUnits',0,'cliqSupplierPaymentsInMinorUnits',0,'cashExpensesInMinorUnits',0,'cliqExpensesInMinorUnits',0,'cashRefundsInMinorUnits',0,'cliqRefundsInMinorUnits',0,'expectedCashInMinorUnits',v_shift.opening_cash_in_minor_units,'actualCashInMinorUnits',NULL,'cashDiscrepancyInMinorUnits',NULL,'discrepancyReason',NULL,'status',v_shift.status,'managerSignOffBy',NULL,'cancelledByName',CASE WHEN v_shift.status='cancelled' THEN v_actor_name ELSE NULL END,'cancelledAt',v_shift.cancelled_at,'cancellationReason',v_shift.cancellation_reason,'reversedByName',CASE WHEN v_shift.status='reversed' THEN v_actor_name ELSE NULL END,'reversedAt',v_shift.reversed_at,'reversalReason',v_shift.reversal_reason,'reversalId',v_shift.reversal_id);\nEND;         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_cash_shift_movement_page(p_shift_id uuid, p_kind text, p_method text DEFAULT 'cash'::text, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_shift public.cash_shifts%ROWTYPE;\n  v_summary JSONB;\n  v_key TEXT;\n  v_canonical BIGINT;\n  v_end TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','accountant'], 'عرض تفاصيل حركة الوردية');\n  IF p_shift_id IS NULL OR p_kind IS NULL OR p_method IS NULL\n    OR p_kind NOT IN ('sales','receipts','supplier_payments','expenses','refunds','withdrawals','withdrawal_returns')\n    OR p_method NOT IN ('cash','cliq','card')\n    OR (p_method='card' AND p_kind<>'sales')\n    OR (p_kind IN ('withdrawals','withdrawal_returns') AND p_method<>'cash')\n    OR p_page IS NULL OR p_page<1 OR p_page>1000000\n    OR p_page_size IS NULL OR p_page_size<1 OR p_page_size>100\n  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'معايير تفاصيل الوردية غير صالحة.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO v_shift FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id=p_shift_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'الوردية المحددة غير موجودة.' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;\n  v_summary:=public.get_cash_shift_summary(p_shift_id);\n  v_end:=CASE WHEN v_shift.status='open' THEN NOW() ELSE COALESCE(v_shift.closed_at,NOW()) END;\n  v_key:=CASE p_kind\n    WHEN 'sales' THEN p_method||'SalesInMinorUnits'\n    WHEN 'receipts' THEN p_method||'ReceiptsInMinorUnits'\n    WHEN 'supplier_payments' THEN p_method||'SupplierPaymentsInMinorUnits'\n    WHEN 'expenses' THEN p_method||'ExpensesInMinorUnits'\n    WHEN 'refunds' THEN p_method||'RefundsInMinorUnits'\n    WHEN 'withdrawals' THEN 'ownerWithdrawalsInMinorUnits'\n    WHEN 'withdrawal_returns' THEN 'ownerWithdrawalReturnsInMinorUnits' END;\n  v_canonical:=(v_summary->>v_key)::BIGINT;\n  -- 044 fallback attribution and 078 reversal predicates are retained exactly.\n  -- In particular a legacy reversed receipt with NULL shift still belongs to\n  -- the old aggregate; it is labelled, never silently corrected by this reader.\n  WITH attributed_sales AS (\n    SELECT o.id,o.order_number,o.payment_method,o.total_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE((SELECT MIN(h.created_at) FROM public.order_status_history h\n        WHERE h.order_id=o.id AND h.new_status='completed'),o.updated_at) at,\n      o.cash_shift_id\n    FROM public.orders o WHERE p_kind='sales' AND o.branch_id=v_shift.branch_id\n      AND o.status IN ('completed','returned')\n      AND (o.payment_method::TEXT=p_method OR (p_method='cash' AND o.payment_method='cash_on_delivery'))\n  ), evidence(source,id,reference,at,method,amount,note) AS (\n    SELECT 'order'::TEXT,o.id,o.order_number,o.at,p_method,o.total_in_minor_units,NULL::TEXT\n    FROM attributed_sales o WHERE o.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id OR\n      (o.cash_shift_id IS NULL AND o.at>=v_shift.opened_at AND o.at<=v_end)\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'customer_payment',cp.id,o.order_number,cp.created_at,cp.payment_method::TEXT,cp.amount_in_minor_units,\n      CASE WHEN cp.is_reversed THEN 'سند تاريخي بلا وردية؛ محفوظ ضمن إجمالي القارئ القديم' END\n    FROM public.customer_payments cp JOIN public.orders o ON o.id=cp.order_id\n    WHERE p_kind='receipts' AND cp.payment_method::TEXT=p_method AND o.branch_id=v_shift.branch_id\n      AND o.payment_method='debt' AND (cp.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id OR\n        (cp.cash_shift_id IS NULL AND cp.created_at>=v_shift.opened_at AND cp.created_at<=v_end))\n      AND NOT (COALESCE(cp.is_reversed,false) AND cp.cash_shift_id IS NOT NULL)\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'opening_collection',c.id,c.operation_number,c.created_at,c.payment_method::TEXT,c.opening_amount_in_minor_units,'تحصيل دين البداية'\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c WHERE p_kind='receipts' AND c.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id\n      AND NOT c.is_reversed AND c.payment_method::TEXT=p_method AND c.opening_amount_in_minor_units>0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'cheque_collection',c.id,c.operation_number,c.created_at,c.payment_method::TEXT,c.compensation_amount_in_minor_units,'تحصيل تعويض شيك'\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c WHERE p_kind='receipts' AND c.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id\n      AND NOT c.is_reversed AND c.payment_method::TEXT=p_method AND c.compensation_amount_in_minor_units>0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'supplier_payment',sp.id,COALESCE(sr.receipt_number,po.purchase_order_number,sp.id::TEXT),sp.payment_date,sp.payment_method::TEXT,sp.amount_in_minor_units,NULL::TEXT\n    FROM public.supplier_payments sp LEFT JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON po.id=sp.purchase_order_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.supplier_receipts sr ON sr.id=sp.supplier_receipt_id\n    WHERE p_kind='supplier_payments' AND sp.payment_method::TEXT=p_method\n      AND COALESCE(po.branch_id,sr.branch_id)=v_shift.branch_id AND NOT COALESCE(sp.is_reversed,false)\n      AND (sp.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id OR (sp.cash_shift_id IS NULL AND sp.payment_date>=v_shift.opened_at AND sp.payment_date<=v_end))\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'supplier_opening_payment',sp.id,sp.id::TEXT,sp.payment_date,sp.payment_method::TEXT,sp.amount_in_minor_units,'دفعة دين بداية لمورد'\n    FROM public.supplier_opening_payments l JOIN public.supplier_payments sp ON sp.id=l.supplier_payment_id\n    WHERE p_kind='supplier_payments' AND l.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id AND sp.payment_method::TEXT=p_method AND NOT COALESCE(sp.is_reversed,false)\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'supplier_cheque_payment',sp.id,c.reference,sp.payment_date,sp.payment_method::TEXT,l.amount_in_minor_units,'دفعة تعويض شيك لمورد'\n    FROM public.supplier_cheque_claim_payments l JOIN public.supplier_payments sp ON sp.id=l.supplier_payment_id\n      JOIN public.cheque_compensation_claims c ON c.id=l.claim_id\n    WHERE p_kind='supplier_payments' AND l.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id AND sp.payment_method::TEXT=p_method AND NOT sp.is_reversed\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'expense',e.id,e.expense_number,e.created_at,e.payment_method::TEXT,e.amount_in_minor_units,e.description\n    FROM public.operational_expenses e WHERE p_kind='expenses' AND e.shift_id=p_shift_id\n      AND e.payment_method::TEXT=p_method AND NOT COALESCE(e.is_reversed,false)\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'legacy_return',r.id,r.return_number,r.created_at,r.refund_method::TEXT,r.refund_amount_in_minor_units,'مرتجع تاريخي'\n    FROM public.sales_returns r WHERE p_kind='refunds' AND r.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id AND r.refund_method::TEXT=p_method\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'return_event',r.id,r.id::TEXT,r.created_at,r.refund_method::TEXT,r.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units,'مبلغ مسترد مسوّى'\n    FROM public.sales_return_events r WHERE p_kind='refunds' AND r.cash_shift_id=p_shift_id AND r.refund_method::TEXT=p_method\n      AND r.settlement_status='settled' AND r.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units>0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'order',o.id,o.order_number,x.created_at,p_method,(x.prepared_plan->>'moneyReceivedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT,'فرق مستلم من تبديل بصنف آخر'\n    FROM public.aftercare215_exchanges x JOIN public.aftercare215_exchange_results result ON result.operation_id=x.operation_id JOIN public.orders o ON o.id=result.new_order_id\n    WHERE p_kind='sales' AND(x.prepared_plan->>'cashShiftId')::UUID=p_shift_id AND x.prepared_plan->>'differenceMethod'=p_method\n     AND(x.prepared_plan->>'moneyReceivedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT>0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT 'return_event',r.id,r.return_number,x.created_at,p_method,(x.prepared_plan->>'moneyRefundInMinorUnits')::BIGINT,'فرق مرجع من تبديل بصنف آخر'\n    FROM public.aftercare215_exchanges x JOIN public.aftercare215_exchange_results result ON result.operation_id=x.operation_id JOIN public.sales_return_events r ON r.operation_id=result.return_operation_id\n    WHERE p_kind='refunds' AND(x.prepared_plan->>'cashShiftId')::UUID=p_shift_id AND x.prepared_plan->>'differenceMethod'=p_method\n     AND(x.prepared_plan->>'moneyRefundInMinorUnits')::BIGINT>0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_cash_shift_summary(p_shift_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE result JSONB; status TEXT; cash_in BIGINT; cliq_in BIGINT; cash_out BIGINT; cliq_out BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n result:=public.tb215_shift_before_exchange_internal(p_shift_id);\n SELECT s.status INTO status FROM public.cash_shifts s WHERE s.id=p_shift_id;\n IF status IS DISTINCT FROM 'open' THEN RETURN result; END IF;\n SELECT COALESCE(sum((x.prepared_plan->>'moneyReceivedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT) FILTER(WHERE x.prepared_plan->>'differenceMethod'='cash'),0),\n  COALESCE(sum((x.prepared_plan->>'moneyReceivedInMinorUnits')::BIGINT) FILTER(WHERE x.prepared_plan->>'differenceMethod'='cliq'),0),\n  COALESCE(sum((x.prepared_plan->>'moneyRefundInMinorUnits')::BIGINT) FILTER(WHERE x.prepared_plan->>'differenceMethod'='cash'),0),\n  COALESCE(sum((x.prepared_plan->>'moneyRefundInMinorUnits')::BIGINT) FILTER(WHERE x.prepared_plan->>'differenceMethod'='cliq'),0)\n INTO cash_in,cliq_in,cash_out,cliq_out FROM public.aftercare215_exchanges x JOIN public.aftercare215_exchange_results r ON r.operation_id=x.operation_id\n WHERE(x.prepared_plan->>'cashShiftId')::UUID=p_shift_id;\n result:=jsonb_set(result,'{cashSalesInMinorUnits}',to_jsonb((result->>'cashSalesInMinorUnits')::BIGINT+cash_in));\n result:=jsonb_set(result,'{cliqSalesInMinorUnits}',to_jsonb((result->>'cliqSalesInMinorUnits')::BIGINT+cliq_in));\n result:=jsonb_set(result,'{cashRefundsInMinorUnits}',to_jsonb((result->>'cashRefundsInMinorUnits')::BIGINT+cash_out));\n result:=jsonb_set(result,'{cliqRefundsInMinorUnits}',to_jsonb((result->>'cliqRefundsInMinorUnits')::BIGINT+cliq_out));\n RETURN jsonb_set(result,'{expectedCashInMinorUnits}',to_jsonb((result->>'expectedCashInMinorUnits')::BIGINT+cash_in-cash_out));\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_crm_customer_detail_page(p_customer_id uuid, p_history_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_history_page_size integer DEFAULT 25)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_orders JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  v_result := public._get_crm_customer_detail_page_before_phase42_receivables(\n    p_customer_id, p_history_page, p_history_page_size\n  );\n  SELECT COALESCE(JSONB_AGG(\n    order_row.value || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'amount_due_in_minor_units', CASE\n        WHEN order_row.value->>'status' IN ('completed', 'delivered')\n          THEN COALESCE((SELECT position.outstanding_total_in_minor_units\n            FROM public.phase42_order_financial_position_internal(\n              (order_row.value->>'id')::UUID\n            ) position), 0)\n        ELSE 0\n      END\n    ) ORDER BY order_row.ordinality\n  ), '[]'::JSONB)\n  INTO v_orders\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(COALESCE(v_result->'orders', '[]'::JSONB))\n    WITH ORDINALITY order_row(value, ordinality);\n  v_result := JSONB_SET(v_result, '{orders}', v_orders, true);\n  v_result := JSONB_SET(\n    v_result, '{stats,outstanding_in_minor_units}',\n    TO_JSONB(public.phase42_customer_receivable_total_internal(p_customer_id)),\n    true\n  );\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_crm_customer_page(p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 10, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_status text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'latest'::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_page INTEGER := TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_sort), ''), 'latest');\n  v_offset INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY[\n      'owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant', 'cashier', 'sales',\n      'warehouse_keeper', 'orders', 'delivery_driver', 'view_only'\n    ],\n    'عرض دليل العملاء'\n  );\n  IF v_page < 1 OR v_page > 100000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الصفحة غير صالح.'; END IF;\n  IF v_page_size < 1 OR v_page_size > 100 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'حجم الصفحة يجب أن يكون بين 1 و100.'; END IF;\n  IF v_status NOT IN ('all', 'vip', 'active', 'inactive', 'blocked',\n    'has_debt', 'overdue', 'over_limit', 'wholesale') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'فلتر العملاء غير صالح.'; END IF;\n  IF v_sort NOT IN ('latest', 'highest_spending', 'most_orders') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ترتيب العملاء غير صالح.'; END IF;\n  IF v_search IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_search) > 100 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'عبارة البحث طويلة جدًا.'; END IF;\n  v_offset := (v_page - 1) * v_page_size;\n\n  RETURN (\n    WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT c.* FROM public.customers c\n      WHERE c.is_deleted = false\n        AND (v_search IS NULL OR c.full_name ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(c.phone, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(c.email, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%')\n        AND (v_status IN ('all', 'has_debt', 'overdue', 'over_limit')\n          OR (v_status = 'vip' AND c.is_vip = true)\n          OR (v_status = 'active' AND c.is_active = true AND c.is_blocked = false)\n          OR (v_status = 'inactive' AND c.is_active = false AND c.is_blocked = false)\n          OR (v_status = 'blocked' AND c.is_blocked = true)\n          OR (v_status = 'wholesale' AND c.customer_type = 'wholesale'))\n    ), eligible AS MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.total_in_minor_units,\n        o.amount_paid_in_minor_units, o.operation_id\n      FROM public.orders o JOIN candidates c ON c.id = o.customer_id\n      WHERE v_status IN ('has_debt', 'overdue', 'over_limit')\n        AND o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')\n        AND (COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos' OR o.payment_method = 'debt')\n        -- A fully covered order without an active payment has zero principal\n        -- and zero outstanding in136,so it cannot affect balance or FIFO.\n        -- Retain fully covered orders WITH active payments:their coverage still\n        -- pays the oldest principal (including a different,undated order).\n        AND (o.amount_paid_in_minor_units < o.total_in_minor_units\n          OR (v_status = 'overdue' AND o.id IN (\n            SELECT p.order_id FROM public.customer_payments p WHERE NOT p.is_reversed)))\n    ), prior_debt AS MATERIALIZED (\n      -- Same prior_debt source and set-based expression proven in136 against\n      -- phase42_customer_receivable_total_internal for every fixture customer.\n      SELECT e.order_id, SUM(e.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units)::BIGINT AS amount\n      FROM public.sales_return_events e JOIN eligible o ON o.id = e.order_id\n      WHERE e.settlement_status = 'settled' AND e.contract_version = 401\n        AND o.amount_paid_in_minor_units < o.total_in_minor_units\n      GROUP BY e.order_id\n    ), financial_positions AS NOT MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT o.*, CASE\n        WHEN o.amount_paid_in_minor_units >= o.total_in_minor_units THEN 0::BIGINT\n        ELSE GREATEST(o.total_in_minor_units - o.amount_paid_in_minor_units\n          - COALESCE(d.amount, 0), 0)::BIGINT END AS outstanding\n      FROM eligible o LEFT JOIN prior_debt d ON d.order_id = o.id\n    ), opening_debts AS MATERIALIZED (\n      -- 161: active opening debts of candidate customers, original date kept.\n      SELECT opening.id, opening.customer_id, opening.principal, opening.outstanding AS amount,\n        opening.occurred_at\n      FROM public.go_live_customer_opening_positions_internal(NULL) opening\n      JOIN candidates c ON c.id = opening.customer_id\n      WHERE v_status IN ('has_debt', 'overdue', 'over_limit')\n      UNION ALL\n      SELECT d.id,d.customer_id,d.principal,d.outstanding,d.occurred_at\n      FROM public.cheque_customer_claim_positions_internal(NULL)d JOIN candidates c ON c.id=d.customer_id\n      WHERE v_status IN ('has_debt','overdue','over_limit')\n    ), balances AS (\n      SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount)::BIGINT AS amount\n      FROM (SELECT customer_id, outstanding AS amount FROM financial_positions\n        UNION ALL SELECT customer_id, amount FROM opening_debts) debt\n      GROUP BY customer_id\n    ), active_payments AS NOT MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT p.order_id, SUM(p.amount_in_minor_units)::BIGINT AS amount\n      FROM public.customer_payments p JOIN eligible o ON o.id = p.order_id\n      WHERE v_status = 'overdue' AND NOT p.is_reversed\n      GROUP BY p.order_id\n    ), completion_history AS NOT MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT h.order_id, MIN(h.created_at) AS at\n      FROM public.order_status_history h JOIN eligible o ON o.id = h.order_id\n      WHERE v_status = 'overdue' AND h.new_status = 'completed'\n      GROUP BY h.order_id\n    ), completion_operations AS NOT MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT o.id AS order_id, MIN(b.completed_at) AS at\n      FROM eligible o JOIN public.business_operations b\n        ON b.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_completion_v1'\n        AND b.result_snapshot->>'order_id' = o.id::TEXT\n        AND b.request_identity_snapshot->>'order_id' = o.id::TEXT\n        AND b.completed_at IS NOT NULL\n      WHERE v_status = 'overdue'\n      GROUP BY o.id\n    ), principals AS NOT MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.outstanding,\n        LEAST(o.total_in_minor_units, GREATEST(\n          o.total_in_minor_units - o.amount_paid_in_minor_units\n            + COALESCE(p.amount, 0), o.outstanding, 0))::BIGINT AS principal,\n        COALESCE(h.at, c.at, CASE\n          WHEN creation.operation_type = 'phase3_pos_sale_v1'\n            AND creation.result_snapshot->>'orderId' = o.id::TEXT\n          THEN creation.completed_at END) AS completed_at\n      FROM financial_positions o\n      LEFT JOIN active_payments p ON p.order_id = o.id\n      LEFT JOIN completion_history h ON h.order_id = o.id\n      LEFT JOIN completion_operations c ON c.order_id = o.id\n      LEFT JOIN public.business_operations creation ON creation.id = o.operation_id\n      WHERE v_status = 'overdue'\n      UNION ALL\n      SELECT opening.id, opening.customer_id, opening.amount, opening.principal, opening.occurred_at\n      FROM opening_debts opening WHERE v_status = 'overdue'\n    ), ordered AS (\n      SELECT *, SUM(principal - outstanding) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS coverage,\n        COALESCE(SUM(principal) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id\n          ORDER BY completed_at NULLS FIRST, id\n          ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS prior_principal\n      FROM principals WHERE principal > 0\n    ), allocated AS (\n      SELECT *, GREATEST(principal - GREATEST(coverage - prior_principal, 0), 0)::BIGINT AS remaining,\n        CASE WHEN completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(\n          (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE\n          - (completed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE, 0) END AS age_days\n      FROM ordered\n    ), overdue AS (\n      SELECT customer_id, SUM(remaining)::BIGINT AS amount\n      FROM allocated\n      WHERE age_days > 30\n      GROUP BY customer_id\n    ), customer_directory AS (\n      SELECT c.id, c.full_name, c.phone, c.email, c.whatsapp, c.governorate,\n        c.notes, c.customer_type, c.is_active, c.is_vip, c.is_blocked, c.is_deleted,\n        c.credit_limit_in_minor_units, c.created_at, c.updated_at,\n        COALESCE(c.governorate, '') AS address_governorate,\n        COALESCE(order_stats.total_orders_count, 0)::INTEGER AS total_orders_count,\n        COALESCE(order_stats.total_spending_in_minor_units, 0)::BIGINT AS total_spending_in_minor_units\n      FROM candidates c\n      LEFT JOIN balances balance ON balance.customer_id = c.id\n      LEFT JOIN overdue debt_age ON debt_age.customer_id = c.id\n      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n        SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos')::INTEGER AS total_orders_count,\n total_spending_in_minor_units\n        FROM public.orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id\n          AND v_sort IN ('highest_spending', 'most_orders')\n      ) order_stats ON true\n      WHERE (v_status <> 'has_debt' OR COALESCE(balance.amount, 0) > 0)\n        AND (v_status <> 'overdue' OR COALESCE(debt_age.amount, 0) > 0)\n        AND (v_status <> 'over_limit' OR (c.credit_limit_in_minor_units > 0\n          AND COALESCE(balance.amount, 0) > c.credit_limit_in_minor_units))\n    ), paged_customers AS (\n      SELECT * FROM customer_directory\n      ORDER BY\n        CASE WHEN v_sort = 'highest_spending' THEN total_spending_in_minor_units END DESC,\n        CASE WHEN v_sort = 'most_orders' THEN total_orders_count END DESC,\n        CASE WHEN v_sort = 'latest' THEN created_at END DESC,\n        id DESC\n      OFFSET v_offset LIMIT v_page_size\n    )\n    SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n      'customers', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(pc) || jsonb_build_object(\n        -- Display-only fields are read for the page,not every matching client.\n        -- Historical spend/count are still computed before paging when sorting\n        -- by them;their old definitions and tie-break order are unchanged.\n        'address_governorate', COALESCE(address.governorate, pc.governorate, ''),\n        'total_orders_count', CASE WHEN v_sort = 'latest'\n          THEN COALESCE(order_stats.total_orders_count, 0) ELSE pc.total_orders_count END,\n        'total_spending_in_minor_units', CASE WHEN v_sort = 'latest'\n          THEN COALESCE(order_stats.total_spending_in_minor_units, 0) ELSE pc.total_spending_in_minor_units END,\n        'current_balance_in_minor_units', public.phase42_customer_receivable_total_internal(pc.id),\n        'outstanding_cheques_in_minor_units',COALESCE((SELECT SUM(q.amount_in_minor_units) FROM public.deferred_cheques q\n          WHERE q.customer_id=pc.id AND q.status IN ('pending','endorsed')),0),\n        'has_returned_cheque',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.deferred_cheques q WHERE q.customer_id=pc.id AND q.status='returned')))\n        FROM paged_customers pc\n        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n          SELECT ca.governorate FROM public.customer_addresses ca\n          WHERE ca.customer_id = pc.id\n          ORDER BY ca.is_default DESC, ca.created_at DESC LIMIT 1\n COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units) FILTER (\n              WHERE COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos'\n                AND o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')), 0)::BIGINT AS total_spending_in_minor_units\n          FROM public.orders o WHERE o.customer_id = pc.id AND v_sort = 'latest'\n        ) order_stats ON true), '[]'::JSONB),\n      'total_count', (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM customer_directory)\n    )\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_customer_debt_aging(p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant', 'sales'],\n    'عرض عمر ذمم العملاء'\n  );\n\n  WITH eligible AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.total_in_minor_units,\n      o.amount_paid_in_minor_units, o.operation_id\n    FROM public.orders o\n    WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')\n      AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL\n      AND (p_customer_id IS NULL OR o.customer_id = p_customer_id)\n      AND (COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos' OR o.payment_method = 'debt')\n  ), prior_debt AS MATERIALIZED (\n    -- Exact set-based form of121 phase42_order_financial_position_internal's\n    -- prior_debt source.         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_damage_history_page_v1(p_period text DEFAULT 'today'::text, p_from_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_reason text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE owner_values BOOLEAN; from_at TIMESTAMPTZ; to_at TIMESTAMPTZ; today DATE;\n result JSONB; item RECORD; dto JSONB; entries JSONB:='[]'::JSONB; case_dto JSONB; blocked TEXT;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM public.sr208_assert_role_internal('read');owner_values:=public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner']);\n today:=(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE;\n IF p_period IS NULL OR p_period NOT IN('today','week','month','range') OR p_reason IS NULL\n  OR p_reason NOT IN('all','shop_breakage','expired','storage_damage','other','customer_return_final','supplier_writeoff','customer_replacement')\n  OR p_page IS NULL OR p_page NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000 OR p_page_size IS NULL OR p_page_size NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'TRIAL212_DAMAGE_FILTER_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023';\n END IF;\n IF p_period='range' THEN\n  IF p_from_date IS NULL OR p_to_date IS NULL OR p_from_date>p_to_date OR p_to_date-p_from_date>365 THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'TRIAL212_DAMAGE_DATE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;\n ELSE\n  p_from_date:=CASE p_period WHEN 'today' THEN today WHEN 'week' THEN today-6 ELSE date_trunc('month',today)::DATE END;p_to_date:=today;\n END IF;\n from_at:=p_from_date::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';to_at:=(p_to_date+1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n -- Original immutable loss evidence only: no new net-profit or financial\n -- calculation. Reversal/reclassification are separately labelled states.\n WITH evidence AS(\n  SELECT 'damage'::TEXT source,d.id,d.product_id,d.quantity,d.reason_code,d.reason,d.occurred_at,\n   d.origin,d.loss_in_minor_units loss,r.order_id,\n   (SELECT c.id FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases c WHERE c.damage_event_id=d.id AND c.origin='shop_damage') case_id,\n   CASE WHEN d.origin='customer_return' THEN 'return'::TEXT END reclass_kind\n  FROM public.inventory_damage_events d LEFT JOIN public.sales_return_events r ON r.id=d.return_event_id\n  WHERE d.occurred_at>=from_at AND d.occurred_at<to_at\n  UNION ALL\n  SELECT 'replacement',f.replacement_item_id,f.product_id,f.issued_quantity,'customer_replacement',e.reason,e.issued_at,\n   'customer_return',f.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units,e.root_order_id,NULL::UUID,'replacement'\n  FROM public.phase43_replacement_inventory_effects f JOIN public.sales_replacement_events e ON e.id=f.replacement_event_id\n  WHERE e.issued_at>=from_at AND e.issued_at<to_at AND e.issuance_status='issued'\n  UNION ALL\n  SELECT 'supplier_writeoff',e.id,c.product_id,e.quantity,'supplier_writeoff',e.reason,e.occurred_at,\n   'supplier_rejected',e.expense_delta_in_minor_units,NULL::UUID,c.id,NULL::TEXT\n  FROM public.supplier_replacement_events e JOIN public.supplier_replacement_cases c ON c.id=e.case_id\n  WHERE e.action='writeoff' AND e.occurred_at>=from_at AND e.occurred_at<to_at\n ), filtered AS(SELECT * FROM evidence WHERE p_reason='all' OR reason_code=p_reason), page AS(\n  SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id DESC,source LIMIT p_page_size OFFSET(p_page::BIGINT-1)*p_page_size\n ) SELECT jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',212,'page',p_page,'pageSize',p_page_size,\n  'totalCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),'fromDate',p_from_date,'toDate',p_to_date,\n  'rows',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id DESC,source) FROM page),'[]')) INTO result;\n FOR item IN SELECT x FROM jsonb_array_elements(result->'rows') x LOOP\n  case_dto:=NULL;blocked:=NULL;\n  dto:=jsonb_build_object('source',item.x->>'source','id',item.x->>'id','productId',item.x->>'product_id',\n   'productName',(SELECT p.name_ar FROM public.products p WHERE p.id=(item.x->>'product_id')::UUID),\n   'unitName',COALESCE((SELECT u.name_ar FROM public.products p LEFT JOIN public.units u ON u.id=p.unit_id WHERE p.id=(item.x->>'product_id')::UUID),'حبة'),\n   'quantity',item.x->'quantity','reasonCode',item.x->>'reason_code','reason',item.x->>'reason','occurredAt',item.x->'occurred_at','origin',item.x->>'origin');\n  IF item.x->>'case_id' IS NOT NULL THEN\n   -- The existing immutable case reader proves reversal/state evidence.\n   case_dto:=public.sr208_case_dto_internal((item.x->>'case_id')::UUID,owner_values);\n   dto:=dto||jsonb_build_object('isReversed',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(case_dto->'events') e WHERE e->>'action'='reverse'\n    AND e->>'reversesEventId'=CASE WHEN item.x->>'source'='supplier_writeoff' THEN item.x->>'id'\n      ELSE(SELECT e->>'id' FROM jsonb_array_elements(case_dto->'events') e WHERE e->>'action'='damage' LIMIT 1) END));\n  ELSE dto:=dto||jsonb_build_object('isReversed',false); END IF;\n  IF item.x->>'reclass_kind' IS NOT NULL THEN\n   blocked:=public.sr211_blocked_internal(item.x->>'reclass_kind',(item.x->>'id')::UUID);\n   dto:=dto||jsonb_build_object('isReclassified',COALESCE(blocked='AFTERCARE211_ALREADY_CLASSIFIED',false));\n  ELSE dto:=dto||jsonb_build_object('isReclassified',false); END IF;\n  IF owner_values THEN\n   dto:=dto||jsonb_build_object('lossAtRegistrationInMinorUnits',item.x->'loss');\n   IF case_dto IS NOT NULL AND NOT (dto->>'isReversed')::BOOLEAN THEN\n    dto:=dto||jsonb_build_object('reversal',jsonb_build_object('case',case_dto,'eventId',CASE WHEN item.x->>'source'='supplier_writeoff' THEN item.x->>'id'\n     ELSE(SELECT e->>'id' FROM jsonb_array_elements(case_dto->'events') e WHERE e->>'action'='damage' LIMIT 1) END));\n   END IF;\n   IF item.x->>'reclass_kind' IS NOT NULL THEN\n    dto:=dto||jsonb_build_object('reclassification',jsonb_build_object('kind',item.x->>'reclass_kind','sourceId',item.x->>'id',\n     'orderId',item.x->>'order_id','blockedReason',blocked));\n   END IF;\n  END IF;\n  entries:=entries||jsonb_build_array(dto);\n END LOOP;\n RETURN (result-'rows')||jsonb_build_object('rows',entries);\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_damage_ledger_page_v2(p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_state text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_reason text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_search text DEFAULT ''::text, p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n#variable_conflict use_column\nDECLARE owner_values BOOLEAN; result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM public.sr208_assert_role_internal('read');owner_values:=public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner']);\n IF p_from IS NULL OR p_to IS NULL OR p_to<=p_from OR p_to-p_from>INTERVAL '367 days'\n  OR p_state IS NULL OR p_state NOT IN('all','pending_supplier','finished_supplier','final_owner') OR p_reason IS NULL OR length(p_reason)>80\n  OR p_search IS NULL OR length(p_search)>120 OR p_page IS NULL OR p_page NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000 OR p_page_size IS NULL OR p_page_size NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100\n THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DAMAGE215_PAGE_INVALID'; END IF;\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tb215_damage_roots_internal() r\n  WHERE(r.unit_cost_exact IS NULL OR r.unit_cost_exact<0) AND(p_branch_id IS NULL OR r.branch_id=p_branch_id)\n   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tb215_damage_movements_internal() m WHERE m.root_kind=r.root_kind AND m.root_id=r.root_id AND m.occurred_at>=p_from AND m.occurred_at<p_to))\n THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DAMAGE_HISTORICAL_COST_MISSING'; END IF;\n WITH period_movements AS MATERIALIZED(\n  SELECT m.root_kind,m.root_id,sum(m.loss_delta)::BIGINT period_loss,max(m.occurred_at) last_at,\n   jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',m.movement_id,'action',m.action,'quantity',m.quantity,'occurredAt',m.occurred_at,'reason',m.reason)\n    ||CASE WHEN owner_values THEN jsonb_build_object('lossDeltaInMinorUnits',m.loss_delta::TEXT) ELSE '{}'::JSONB END ORDER BY m.occurred_at DESC,m.movement_id) movements\n  FROM public.tb215_damage_movements_internal() m WHERE m.occurred_at>=p_from AND m.occurred_at<p_to GROUP BY m.root_kind,m.root_id\n ), states AS MATERIALIZED(\n  SELECT s.root_kind,s.root_id,sum(s.pending_quantity)::BIGINT pending,\n   sum(s.received_quantity+s.credited_quantity+s.immediate_quantity)::BIGINT finished,sum(s.reversed_damage_quantity)::BIGINT restored,\n   sum(s.received_quantity+s.immediate_quantity)::BIGINT received,sum(s.credited_quantity)::BIGINT credited,\n   array_agg(s.case_id ORDER BY s.case_id) case_ids\n  FROM public.tb215_damage_case_states_internal() s GROUP BY s.root_kind,s.root_id\n ), classified AS MATERIALIZED(\n  SELECT r.*,p.name_ar product_name,p.sku,\n   (SELECT image.image_url FROM public.product_images image WHERE image.product_id=p.id ORDER BY image.is_primary DESC,image.display_order,image.created_at,image.id LIMIT 1) image_url,\n   m.period_loss,m.last_at,m.movements,\n   public.tb215_damage_nonnegative_quantity_internal(COALESCE(s.pending,0)) pending,public.tb215_damage_nonnegative_quantity_internal(COALESCE(s.finished,0)) finished,COALESCE(s.received,0) received,COALESCE(s.credited,0) credited,\n   public.tb215_damage_nonnegative_quantity_internal(r.original_bad_quantity-COALESCE(s.restored,0)) active_bad,\n   public.tb215_damage_nonnegative_quantity_internal(r.original_bad_quantity-COALESCE(s.restored,0)-COALESCE(s.pending,0)-COALESCE(s.finished,0)) final_quantity,\n   COALESCE(s.case_ids,'{}'::UUID[]) case_ids,\n   o.order_number,ret.return_number,\n   CASE WHEN r.root_kind='replacement' THEN r.base_loss-round(r.original_bad_quantity*r.unit_cost_exact)::BIGINT ELSE 0 END cost_difference\n  FROM public.tb215_damage_roots_internal() r JOIN period_movements m ON m.root_kind=r.root_kind AND m.root_id=r.root_id\n  JOIN public.products p ON p.id=r.product_id LEFT JOIN states s ON s.root_kind=r.root_kind AND s.root_id=r.root_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON o.id=r.order_id LEFT JOIN public.sales_return_events ret ON ret.id=r.return_event_id\n  WHERE(p_branch_id IS NULL OR r.branch_id=p_branch_id) AND(p_reason='all' OR r.reason_code=p_reason)\n   AND(p_search='' OR p.name_ar ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%' OR p.sku ILIKE '%'||p_search||'%')\n ), selected AS MATERIALIZED(\n  SELECT * FROM classified x WHERE(x.active_bad>0 OR owner_values AND x.period_loss<>0)\n   AND(p_state='all' OR p_state='pending_supplier' AND x.pending>0 OR p_state='finished_supplier' AND x.finished>0\n    OR p_state='final_owner' AND(x.final_quantity>0 OR owner_values AND x.active_bad=0 AND x.period_loss<>0))\n ), page AS(\n  SELECT * FROM selected ORDER BY last_at DESC,root_kind,root_id LIMIT p_page_size OFFSET(p_page::BIGINT-1)*p_page_size\n ), dto AS(\n  SELECT x.last_at,x.root_kind,x.root_id,\n   jsonb_build_object('source',x.root_kind,'id',x.root_id,'productId',x.product_id,'productName',x.product_name,'imageUrl',x.image_url,\n    'quantity',x.active_bad,'historicalParcelSize',CASE WHEN COALESCE(x.parcel_size_known,false) THEN x.historical_parcel_size END,\n    'parcelSizeKnown',COALESCE(x.parcel_size_known,false),'unitName','باكيت','registeredAt',x.occurred_at,'occurredAt',x.last_at,\n    'reasonCode',x.reason_code,'reason',x.reason,'movements',x.movements,'pendingQuantity',x.pending,'receivedQuantity',x.received,'creditedQuantity',x.credited,\n    'finishedSupplierQuantity',x.finished,'finalOwnerQuantity',x.final_quantity,'financialOnly',x.active_bad=0,\n    'states',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('state',state,'quantity',quantity)),'[]') FROM(VALUES('pending_supplier',x.pending),('finished_supplier',x.finished),('final_owner',x.final_quantity)) s(state,quantity) WHERE quantity>0),\n    'document',CASE WHEN x.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('type','order','id',x.order_id,'number',x.order_number,'returnNumber',x.return_number) ELSE NULL END)\n   ||CASE WHEN owner_values THEN jsonb_build_object('unitCostInMinorUnitsExact',x.unit_cost_exact::TEXT,'periodLossInMinorUnits',x.period_loss::TEXT,\n    'costDifferenceInMinorUnits',x.cost_difference::TEXT,'actions',jsonb_build_object(\n     'cases',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(public.sr208_case_dto_internal(c.id,true) ORDER BY c.id),'[]') FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases c WHERE c.id=ANY(x.case_ids)),\n     'reclassification',CASE WHEN x.active_bad>0 AND(x.root_kind='replacement' OR x.root_kind='damage' AND x.order_id IS NOT NULL) THEN\n      jsonb_build_object('kind',CASE WHEN x.root_kind='replacement' THEN 'replacement' ELSE 'return' END,'sourceId',x.root_id,\n       'blockedReason',public.sr211_blocked_internal(CASE WHEN x.root_kind='replacement' THEN 'replacement' ELSE 'return' END,x.root_id)) ELSE NULL END))\n    ELSE '{}'::JSONB END item FROM page x\n )\n SELECT jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',215,'from',p_from,'to',p_to,'state',p_state,'page',p_page,'pageSize',p_page_size,\n  'totalCount',(SELECT count(*) FROM selected),'totalPages',GREATEST(1,CEIL((SELECT count(*) FROM selected)::NUMERIC/p_page_size)),\n  'rows',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY last_at DESC,root_kind,root_id) FROM dto),'[]'),\n  'quantitySummary',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) ORDER BY g.product_name,g.product_id),'[]') FROM(\n   SELECT product_id,max(product_name) product_name,sum(pending)::BIGINT pending_quantity,sum(finished)::BIGINT finished_supplier_quantity,\n    sum(final_quantity)::BIGINT final_owner_quantity FROM selected GROUP BY product_id) g))\n  ||CASE WHEN owner_values THEN jsonb_build_object('periodLossInMinorUnits',(SELECT COALESCE(sum(period_loss),0)::TEXT FROM selected)) ELSE '{}'::JSONB END INTO result;\n RETURN result;\nEND $function$\n",
