        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_dashboard_analytics()\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_today_start TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('day', NOW());\n  v_yesterday_start TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('day', NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day');\n  v_week_start TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('week', NOW());\n  v_month_start TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('month', NOW());\n  v_30_days_ago TIMESTAMPTZ := date_trunc('day', NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days');\n\n  -- KPI Variables\n  v_today_sales NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_yesterday_sales NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_week_sales NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_month_sales NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_total_revenue NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_total_cost NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_net_profit NUMERIC := 0;\n  v_today_orders_count INT := 0;\n  v_active_customers_count INT := 0;\n  v_total_products_count INT := 0;\n  v_low_stock_count INT := 0;\n  v_out_of_stock_count INT := 0;\n\n  -- Result Arrays\n  v_daily_sales JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_monthly_revenue JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_orders_by_status JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_top_selling_products JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_sales_by_warehouse JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_sales_by_branch JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_latest_orders JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_latest_customers JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_low_stock_alerts JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_recent_inventory_movements JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_today_notifications JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\nBEGIN\n  -- 1. KPI Calculations\n\n  -- Today Sales & Orders Count (Column in orders is total_in_minor_units)\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0, COUNT(*)\n  INTO v_today_sales, v_today_orders_count\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE created_at >= v_today_start AND status != 'cancelled';\n\n  -- Yesterday Sales\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0\n  INTO v_yesterday_sales\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE created_at >= v_yesterday_start AND created_at < v_today_start AND status != 'cancelled';\n\n  -- This Week Sales\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0\n  INTO v_week_sales\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE created_at >= v_week_start AND status != 'cancelled';\n\n  -- This Month Sales\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0\n  INTO v_month_sales\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE created_at >= v_month_start AND status != 'cancelled';\n\n  -- Total Revenue\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0\n  INTO v_total_revenue\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE status != 'cancelled';\n\n  -- Net Profit Calculation\n  SELECT\n    COALESCE(SUM(oi.line_total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0,\n    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * COALESCE(p.cost_price_in_minor_units, 0)), 0) / 1000.0\n  INTO v_total_revenue, v_total_cost\n  FROM public.order_items oi\n  JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id\n  WHERE o.status != 'cancelled';\n\n  v_net_profit := GREATEST(0, v_total_revenue - v_total_cost);\n\n  -- Counts\n  -- Note: customers table does NOT have is_active column; total registered customers are counted\n  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_active_customers_count FROM public.customers;\n  -- products table DOES have is_active column\n  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_total_products_count FROM public.products WHERE is_active = true;\n\n  -- Stock Status Counts (Column in products is min_stock_level, NOT reorder_level)\n  WITH prod_stock AS (\n    SELECT\n      p.id,\n      p.min_stock_level,\n      COALESCE(SUM(b.on_hand_quantity - b.reserved_quantity), 0) AS total_available\n    FROM public.products p\n    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances b ON b.product_id = p.id\n    WHERE p.is_active = true\n    GROUP BY p.id, p.min_stock_level\n  )\n  SELECT\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE total_available <= min_stock_level AND total_available > 0),\n    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE total_available <= 0)\n  INTO v_low_stock_count, v_out_of_stock_count\n  FROM prod_stock;\n\n\n  -- 2. Daily Sales (Last 30 Days)\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(d), '[]'::jsonb)\n  INTO v_daily_sales\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      to_char(d.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date,\n      to_char(d.day, 'DD/MM') AS \"formattedDate\",\n      COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS sales,\n      COUNT(o.id) AS \"ordersCount\"\n    FROM generate_series(v_30_days_ago, date_trunc('day', NOW()), INTERVAL '1 day') AS d(day)\n    LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON date_trunc('day', o.created_at) = d.day AND o.status != 'cancelled'\n    GROUP BY d.day\n    ORDER BY d.day ASC\n  ) d;\n\n\n  -- 3. Monthly Revenue\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(m), '[]'::jsonb)\n  INTO v_monthly_revenue\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      to_char(m.month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,\n      to_char(m.month, 'Mon YYYY') AS \"monthName\",\n      COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS revenue\n    FROM generate_series(date_trunc('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '11 months'), date_trunc('month', NOW()), INTERVAL '1 month') AS m(month)\n    LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON date_trunc('month', o.created_at) = m.month AND o.status != 'cancelled'\n    GROUP BY m.month\n    ORDER BY m.month ASC\n  ) m;\n\n\n  -- 4. Orders by Status\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(s), '[]'::jsonb)\n  INTO v_orders_by_status\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      status,\n      COUNT(*) AS count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS \"totalAmount\"\n    FROM public.orders\n    GROUP BY status\n  ) s;\n\n\n  -- 5. Top Selling Products\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(tp), '[]'::jsonb)\n  INTO v_top_selling_products\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      p.id,\n      p.name_ar AS \"nameAr\",\n      p.sku,\n      COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS \"totalQuantity\",\n      COALESCE(SUM(oi.line_total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS \"totalRevenue\"\n    FROM public.order_items oi\n    JOIN public.products p ON p.id = oi.product_id\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id\n    WHERE o.status != 'cancelled'\n    GROUP BY p.id, p.name_ar, p.sku\n    ORDER BY \"totalRevenue\" DESC\n    LIMIT 5\n  ) tp;\n\n\n  -- 6. Sales by Warehouse\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(w), '[]'::jsonb)\n  INTO v_sales_by_warehouse\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      wh.id,\n      wh.name_ar AS \"nameAr\",\n      COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 AS sales,\n      COUNT(o.id) AS \"ordersCount\",\n      CASE\n        WHEN v_total_revenue > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(o.total_in_minor_units), 0) / 1000.0 / v_total_revenue) * 100.0, 1)\n        ELSE 0\n      END AS percentage\n    FROM public.warehouses wh\n    LEFT JOIN public.orders o ON o.warehouse_id = wh.id AND o.status != 'cancelled'\n    GROUP BY wh.id, wh.name_ar\n  ) w;\n\n\n  -- 7.         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_operational_business_report(p_branch_id uuid, p_date_from date, p_date_to date)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_totals JSONB;\n  v_profit BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  v_result := public._get_operational_business_report_before133(p_branch_id, p_date_from, p_date_to);\n  v_result := jsonb_set(v_result, '{balances}', (v_result->'balances') || public.phase133_supplier_balances_internal());\n  IF public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner']) THEN\n    v_totals := public.owner_withdrawal_period_totals_internal(\n      p_branch_id,\n      p_date_from::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman',\n      (p_date_to + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman');\n    v_profit := COALESCE((v_result #>> '{sales,netProfitInMinorUnits}')::BIGINT, 0);\n    v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object('ownerWithdrawals', v_totals || jsonb_build_object(\n      'netProfitInMinorUnits', v_profit,\n      'remainingAfterWithdrawalsInMinorUnits', v_profit - (v_totals->>'netInMinorUnits')::BIGINT));\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_operational_orders_page(p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25, p_filter text DEFAULT 'action'::text, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_sort text DEFAULT 'newest'::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_page INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page, 1);\n  v_page_size INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page_size, 25);\n  v_filter TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_filter), ''), 'action');\n  v_search TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_search), '');\n  v_sort TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_sort), ''), 'newest');\n  v_offset INTEGER;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY[\n      'owner',\n      'admin',\n      'manager',\n      'accountant',\n      'cashier',\n      'sales',\n      'orders',\n      'delivery_driver'\n    ],\n    'عرض قائمة طلبات المتجر'\n  );\n\n  IF v_page < 1 OR v_page > 100000 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الصفحة غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_page_size < 1 OR v_page_size > 100 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حجم الصفحة يجب أن يكون بين 1 و100.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_filter NOT IN (\n    'all',\n    'action',\n    'active',\n    'completed',\n    'returned',\n    'cancelled'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'فلتر الطلبات غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_sort NOT IN ('newest', 'oldest') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'ترتيب الطلبات غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_search IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_search) > 100 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عبارة البحث طويلة جدًا.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_offset := (v_page - 1) * v_page_size;\n\n  WITH filtered_orders AS (\n    SELECT o.id, o.created_at\n    FROM public.orders o\n    LEFT JOIN public.customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id\n    WHERE COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos'\n      AND (\n        v_filter = 'all'\n        OR (v_filter = 'action' AND o.status = 'new')\n        OR (\n          v_filter = 'active'\n          AND o.status IN (\n            'confirmed',\n            'preparing',\n            'processing',\n            'ready',\n            'out_for_delivery'\n          )\n        )\n        OR (v_filter = 'completed' AND o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered'))\n        OR (v_filter = 'returned' AND o.status = 'returned')\n        OR (v_filter = 'cancelled' AND o.status = 'cancelled')\n      )\n      AND (\n        v_search IS NULL\n        OR o.order_number ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n        OR COALESCE(o.customer_name_snapshot, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n        OR COALESCE(c.full_name, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n        OR COALESCE(c.phone, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n      )\n  ),\n  paged_orders AS (\n    SELECT id\n    FROM filtered_orders\n    ORDER BY\n      CASE WHEN v_sort = 'oldest' THEN created_at END ASC,\n      CASE WHEN v_sort = 'oldest' THEN id END ASC,\n      CASE WHEN v_sort = 'newest' THEN created_at END DESC,\n      CASE WHEN v_sort = 'newest' THEN id END DESC\n    OFFSET v_offset\n    LIMIT v_page_size\n  ),\n  operational_summary AS (\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'new')::INTEGER AS review_count,\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (\n        WHERE o.status IN (\n          'confirmed',\n          'preparing',\n          'processing',\n          'ready',\n          'out_for_delivery'\n        )\n      )::INTEGER AS active_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(\n        GREATEST(\n          o.total_in_minor_units - o.amount_paid_in_minor_units,\n          0\n        )\n      ) FILTER (WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')), 0)::BIGINT\n        AS due_in_minor_units\n    FROM public.orders o\n    WHERE COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos'\n  )\n  SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n    'order_ids', COALESCE(\n      (SELECT jsonb_agg(id) FROM paged_orders),\n      '[]'::JSONB\n    ),\n    'total_count', (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM filtered_orders),\n    'summary', jsonb_build_object(\n      'review_count', operational_summary.review_count,\n      'active_count', operational_summary.active_count,\n      'due_in_minor_units', operational_summary.due_in_minor_units\n    )\n  )\n  INTO v_result\n  FROM operational_summary;\n\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_or_create_pos_receipt_token(p_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_token UUID;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'إنشاء رابط إيصال البيع المباشر'\n  );\n\n  SELECT *\n  INTO v_order\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_order.source IS DISTINCT FROM 'pos' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'فاتورة البيع المباشر المطلوبة غير موجودة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_order.status NOT IN ('completed', 'returned') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن نشر رابط قبل اكتمال فاتورة البيع.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_token := COALESCE(v_order.public_receipt_token, gen_random_uuid());\n\n  IF v_order.public_receipt_token IS NULL THEN\n    UPDATE public.orders\n    SET public_receipt_token = v_token,\n        updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE id = v_order.id;\n\n    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n      user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details\n    ) VALUES (\n      auth.uid(),\n      'CREATE_PUBLIC_POS_RECEIPT_LINK',\n      'orders',\n      v_order.id,\n      jsonb_build_object('order_number', v_order.order_number)\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'receiptToken', v_token,\n    'orderNumber', v_order.order_number\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_order_exchange_details_v1(p_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE funding JSONB; exchanges JSONB;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','accountant','cashier','sales','orders','delivery_driver'],'عرض تفاصيل وصل التبديل');\n IF p_order_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_ORDER_REQUIRED'; END IF;\n PERFORM public.tb215_assert_exchange_internal(x.operation_id) FROM public.aftercare215_exchanges x JOIN public.aftercare215_exchange_results r ON r.operation_id=x.operation_id\n WHERE r.new_order_id=p_order_id OR x.order_id=p_order_id;\n SELECT public.tb215_exchange_public_result_internal(r.operation_id)-'referenceNumber' INTO funding FROM public.aftercare215_exchange_results r WHERE r.new_order_id=p_order_id;\n SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(public.tb215_exchange_public_result_internal(x.operation_id)-'referenceNumber' ORDER BY x.created_at,x.operation_id),'[]') INTO exchanges\n FROM public.aftercare215_exchanges x WHERE x.order_id=p_order_id;\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',215,'funding',funding,'exchanges',exchanges);\nEND $function$\n",

document links count too.\n      'hasProductAssociations',(\n        EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_balances WHERE warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.order_inventory_reservations WHERE warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.stock_alerts WHERE warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_opening_sessions d JOIN public.inventory_opening_items i ON i.session_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.orders d JOIN public.order_items i ON i.order_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_orders d JOIN public.purchase_order_items i ON i.purchase_order_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_receipts d JOIN public.purchase_receipt_items i ON i.purchase_receipt_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)\n        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_receipts d JOIN public.supplier_receipt_items i ON i.supplier_receipt_id=d.id WHERE d.warehouse_id=w.id)\n      )\n    ) ORDER BY w.code,w.id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.warehouses w)\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

p_date_from > 366 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_PERIOD_INVALID: الفترة لا تتجاوز سنة.';\n  END IF;\n  v_from := p_date_from::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n  v_to := (p_date_to + 1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_total FROM public.owner_withdrawal_events_internal(p_branch_id, v_from, v_to);\n  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_json ORDER BY sort_at DESC, sort_number DESC, sort_kind), '[]'::JSONB) INTO v_rows\n  FROM (\n    SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n      'kind', event.event_kind,\n      'at', event.event_at,\n      'direction', event.direction,\n      'amountInMinorUnits', event.amount_in_minor_units,\n      'withdrawalId', event.withdrawal_id,\n      'withdrawalNumber', event.withdrawal_number,\n      'branchId', event.branch_id,\n      'branchName', branch.name_ar,\n      'shiftId', event.shift_id,\n      'shiftNumber', shift.shift_number,\n      'actorName', profile.full_name,\n      'reason', event.reason,\n      'isReversed', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals active\n        WHERE active.withdrawal_id = event.withdrawal_id AND active.voided_at IS NULL)\n    ) AS row_json, event.event_at AS sort_at, event.withdrawal_number AS sort_number, event.event_kind AS sort_kind\n    FROM public.owner_withdrawal_events_internal(p_branch_id, v_from, v_to) event\n    LEFT JOIN public.branches branch ON branch.id = event.branch_id\n    LEFT JOIN public.cash_shifts shift ON shift.id = event.shift_id\n    LEFT JOIN public.profiles profile ON profile.id = event.actor_id\n    ORDER BY event.event_at DESC, event.withdrawal_number DESC, event.event_kind\n    LIMIT v_size OFFSET (v_page - public.categories c\n    LEFT JOIN catalog_source cs ON cs.category_id = c.id\n    WHERE c.is_active = true\n    GROUP BY c.id, c.code, c.name_ar\n  )\n  SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n    'items',\n 'unitsPerSalePackage', units_per_sale_unit,\n          'parcelOnly', parcel_only,\n          'salePackagePriceInMinorUnits',\n            default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n category_summary\n    ), '[]'::jsonb),\n    'total', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog),\n    'limit', LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 100), 1), 200),\n    'offset', GREATEST(COALESCE(p_offset, 0), 0)\n NULLIF(BTRIM(p_number_search),'');\n  v_today DATE := (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE;\n  v_from DATE;\n  v_to DATE;\n  v_start TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_end TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','accountant','cashier','sales','orders','delivery_driver'],\n    'عرض سجل المبيعات'\n  );\n  IF v_page<1 OR v_page>100000 OR v_size<1 OR v_size>100 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الصفحة أو حجمها غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_period NOT IN ('day','week','month','range','all') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'فترة سجل المبيعات غير صالحة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_method NOT IN ('all','cash','cliq','bank_transfer','cheque','card','debt','mixed','unknown')\n     OR v_source NOT IN ('all','pos','website','unknown') تاريخ صحيحاً.';\n    END IF;\n    v_from:=p_from_date;v_to:=p_to_date;\n  ELSE\n    IF p_from_date IS NOT NULL OR p_to_date IS NOT NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'التواريخ المخصصة تتطلب اختيار مدى.';\n    END IF;\n    v_from:=CASE v_period WHEN 'day' THEN v_today WHEN 'week' THEN v_today-6\n      WHEN 'month' THEN date_trunc('month',v_today)::DATE ELSE NULL END;\n    v_to:=CASE WHEN v_period='all' THEN NULL ELSE v_today END;\n  END IF;\n  v_start:=v_from::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n  v_end:=(v_to+1)::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman';\n\n  WITH first_completion AS   WHERE (v_method='all' OR o.payment_method::TEXT=v_method\n      OR (v_method='cash' AND o.payment_method::TEXT='cash_on_delivery')\n      OR (v_method='unknown' AND (o.payment_method IS NULL OR strpos(lower(COALESCE(o.order_number,'')),lower(v_number))>0)\n  ), filtered AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT * FROM evidence\n    WHERE (v_start IS NULL OR listed_at>=v_start) AND (v_end IS NULL OR listed_at<v_end)\n      AND (NOT COALESCE(p_sales_only,false) OR counts_as_sale)\n  ), totals AS (\n    SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE counts_as_sale) AS sale_count,\n      COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units) FILTER(WHERE counts_as_sale),0)::BIGINT AS sales,\n      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE first_completed_at IS NULL AND status IN ('completed','returned')) AS undated_count\n    FROM filtered\n  ), page_rows AS (\n    SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY listed_at DESC,id DESC\n    OFFSET ((v_page-1)*v_size) LIMIT v_size\n  )\n  SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n    'success',true,'generatedAt',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'timeZone','Asia/Amman',\n    'page',v_page,'pageSize',v_size,'totalCount',t.invoice_count,\n    'totalPages',GREATEST(1,CEIL(t.invoice_count::NUMERIC/v_size)::INTEGER),\n    'period',jsonb_build_object('kind',v_period,'fromDate',v_from,'toDate',v_to),\n    'summary',jsonb_build_object('invoiceCount',t.invoice_count,'salesCount',t.sale_count,\n      'salesInMinorUnits',t.sales,'undatedInvoiceCount',t.undated_count),\n    'rows',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(\n      'id',r.id,'orderNumber',r.order_number,'listedAt',r.listed_at,\n      'firstCompletedAt',r.first_completed_at,'dateBasis',CASE WHEN r.first_completed_at IS NULL THEN 'creation' ELSE 'completion' END,\n      'customerName',r.customer_name,'customerPhone',r.customer_phone,\n      'totalInMinorUnits',r.total_in_minor_units,'paymentMethod',r.payment_method,\n      'paymentStatus',r.payment_status,'source',r.source,'status',r.status,\n      'countsAsSale',r.counts_as_sale) ORDER BY r.listed_at DESC,r.id DESC) FROM page_rows r),'[]'::JSONB)\n  ) INTO v_result FROM totals t;\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

sa.first_triggered_at,\n        'lastUpdatedAt', sa.last_updated_at,\n        'resolvedAt', sa.resolved_at\n      ) AS item,\n      CASE WHEN sa.severity = 'out_of_stock' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS END IF;\n  v_offset := (v_page - 1) * v_page_size;\n\n  RETURN (\n    WITH filtered_payments AS (\n      SELECT sp.*, s.company_name AS supplier_name, po.purchase_order_number\n      FROM public.supplier_payments sp\n      JOIN public.suppliers s ON s.id = sp.supplier_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON po.id = sp.purchase_order_id\n      WHERE (p_supplier_id IS NULL OR sp.supplier_id = p_supplier_id)\n        AND (v_payment_method = 'all' OR sp.payment_method = v_payment_method)\n        AND (\n          v_search IS NULL\n          OR s.company_name ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(po.purchase_order_number, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(sp.reference_number, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(sp.notes, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n        )\n    ),\n    paged_payments AS (\n      SELECT * FROM filtered_payments ORDER BY payment_date DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC OFFSET v_offset LIMIT v_page_size\n    ),\n    summary AS (\n      SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS total_count,\n        COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS total_in_minor_units\n      FROM filtered_payments\n    )\n    SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n      'payments', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(\n        'id', id, 'supplier_id', supplier_id, 'supplier_name', supplier_name,\n        'purchase_order_id', purchase_order_id, 'purchase_order_number', purchase_order_number,\n        'amount_in_minor_units', amount_in_minor_units, 'payment_method', payment_method,\n        'reference_number', reference_number, 'payment_date', payment_date, 'notes', notes,\n        'created_by', created_by, 'created_at', created_at\n      )) FROM paged_payments), '[]'::JSONB),\n      'total_count', summary.total_count,\n      'summary', jsonb_build_object('total_in_minor_units', summary.total_in_minor_units)\n    ) FROM summary\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

UNION ALL\n      SELECT i.id,0,\n        CASE WHEN i.units_per_package>1 THEN 'legacy_single_sku_parcel' ELSE 'base_unit' END,\n ))\n      FROM public.supplier_receipt_items i LEFT JOIN public.products p ON p.id=i.product_id\n      WHERE i.supplier_receipt_id=p_receipt_id AND i.commercial_line_id IS NULL\n    ) e\n DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_page INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page, 1);\n  v_page_size INTEGER := COALESCE(p_page_size, 25);\n  v_search TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_search), '');\n  v_payment_status TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_payment_status), ''), 'all');\n  v_offset INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant', 'warehouse_keeper'],\n    'عرض سندات استلام الموردين'\n  );\n\n  IF v_page < 1 OR v_page > 100000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم الصفحة غير صالح.'; END IF;\n  IF v_page_size < 1 OR v_page_size > 100 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'حجم الصفحة يجب أن يكون بين 1 و100.'; END IF;\n  IF v_payment_status NOT IN ('all', 'unpaid', 'partially_paid', 'paid') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION RETURN (\n    WITH filtered_receipts AS (\n      SELECT sr.*, s.company_name AS supplier_name, s.phone AS supplier_phone,\n             w.name_ar AS warehouse_name, b.name_ar AS branch_name, pr.full_name AS received_by_name\n      FROM public.supplier_receipts sr\n      JOIN public.suppliers s ON s.id = sr.supplier_id\n      JOIN public.warehouses w ON w.id = sr.warehouse_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.branches b ON b.id = sr.branch_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id = sr.received_by\n      WHERE sr.is_archived = COALESCE(p_is_archived, false)\n        AND (p_supplier_id IS NULL OR sr.supplier_id = p_supplier_id)\n        AND (p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR sr.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id)\n        AND (v_payment_status = 'all' OR sr.payment_status = v_payment_status)\n        AND (\n          v_search IS NULL\n          OR sr.receipt_number ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(sr.supplier_invoice_number, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR s.company_name ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n        )\n    ),\n    paged_receipts AS (\n      SELECT * FROM filtered_receipts ORDER BY received_at DESC, id DESC OFFSET v_offset LIMIT v_page_size\n    ),\n    receipt_rows AS (\n      SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n        'id', sr.id, 'receipt_number', sr.receipt_number, 'supplier_id', sr.supplier_id,\n        'warehouse_id', sr.warehouse_id, 'branch_id', sr.branch_id,\n        'supplier_invoice_number', sr.supplier_invoice_number, 'supplier_invoice_date', sr.supplier_invoice_date,\n        'received_at', sr.received_at, 'received_by', sr.received_by,\n        'subtotal_in_minor_units', sr.subtotal_in_minor_units, 'discount_in_minor_units', sr.discount_in_minor_units,\n        'delivery_fee_in_minor_units', sr.delivery_fee_in_minor_units, 'tax_in_minor_units', sr.tax_in_minor_units,\n        'total_in_minor_units', sr.total_in_minor_units, 'amount_paid_in_minor_units', sr.amount_paid_in_minor_units,\n        'amount_due_in_minor_units', sr.amount_due_in_minor_units, 'payment_status', sr.payment_status,\n        'payment_method', sr.payment_method, 'payment_reference', sr.payment_reference,\n        'notes', sr.notes, 'internal_notes', sr.internal_notes, 'status', sr.status,\n        'is_archived', sr.is_archived, 'created_at', sr.created_at, 'updated_at', sr.updated_at,\n        'suppliers', jsonb_build_object('company_name', sr.supplier_name, 'phone', sr.supplier_phone),\n        'warehouses', jsonb_build_object('name_ar', sr.warehouse_name),\n        'branches', CASE WHEN sr.branch_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object('name_ar', sr.branch_name) END,\n        'profiles', CASE WHEN sr.received_by IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object('full_name', sr.received_by_name) END,\n        'supplier_receipt_items', COALESCE(items.items, '[]'::JSONB),\n        'supplier_payments', '[]'::JSONB\n      ) AS row\n      FROM paged_receipts sr\n      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n        SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(\n          'id', sri.id, 'supplier_receipt_id', sri.supplier_receipt_id, 'product_id', sri.product_id,\n          'purchase_unit_id', sri.purchase_unit_id, 'units_per_package', sri.units_per_package,\n          'total_base_units', sri.total_base_units, 'package_price_in_minor_units', sri.package_price_in_minor_units,\n          'base_unit_cost_in_minor_units', sri.base_unit_cost_in_minor_units,\n          'discount_in_minor_units', sri.discount_in_minor_units, 'line_total_in_minor_units', sri.line_total_in_minor_units,\n          'batch_number', sri.batch_number, 'production_date', sri.production_date, 'expiry_date', sri.expiry_date,\n          'notes', sri.notes, 'created_at', sri.created_at,\n          'products', CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object('name_ar', p.name_ar, 'sku', p.sku, 'barcode', p.barcode) END\n        ) ORDER BY sri.created_at, sri.id) AS items\n        FROM public.supplier_receipt_items sri\n        LEFT JOIN public.products p ON p.id = sri.product_id\n        WHERE sri.supplier_receipt_id = sr.id\n      ) items ON true\n    ),\n    summary AS (\n      SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS total_count,\n        COALESCE(SUM(amount_due_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS due_in_minor_units,\n        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE received_at::DATE = CURRENT_DATE)::INTEGER AS today_count,\n        COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units) FILTER (WHERE received_at::DATE = CURRENT_DATE), 0)::BIGINT AS today_total_in_minor_units,\n        COALESCE(SUM(amount_paid_in_minor_units) FILTER (WHERE received_at::DATE = CURRENT_DATE), 0)::BIGINT AS today_paid_in_minor_units,\n        COALESCE(SUM(item_count), 0)::INTEGER AS item_count\n      FROM (\n        SELECT fr.*, (SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM public.supplier_receipt_items sri WHERE sri.supplier_receipt_id = fr.id) AS item_count\n        FROM filtered_receipts fr\n      ) summarized\n    )\n    SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n      'receipts', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(row) FROM receipt_rows), '[]'::JSONB),\n      'total_count', summary.total_count,\n      'summary', jsonb_build_object('due_in_minor_units', summary.due_in_minor_units, 'today_count', summary.today_count, 'today_total_in_minor_units', summary.today_total_in_minor_units, 'today_paid_in_minor_units', summary.today_paid_in_minor_units, 'item_count', summary.item_count)\n    ) FROM summary\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_supplier_replacement_credits_v1(p_supplier_id uuid, p_page integer DEFAULT 1, p_page_size integer DEFAULT 25)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE rows JSONB; total BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM public.sr208_assert_role_internal('values');\n IF p_page IS NULL OR p_page<1 OR p_page>1000000 OR p_page_size IS NULL OR p_page_size NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_CREDIT_PAGE_INVALID'; END IF;\n SELECT count(*) INTO total FROM public.supplier215_credits WHERE supplier_id=p_supplier_id;\n SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.created_at DESC,x.event_id),'[]') INTO rows FROM(\n  SELECT c.event_id,c.operation_id,c.case_id,c.amount_delta_in_minor_units::TEXT AS amount_delta_in_minor_units,\n   c.balance_before_in_minor_units::TEXT AS balance_before_in_minor_units,c.balance_after_in_minor_units::TEXT AS balance_after_in_minor_units,c.reverses_credit_event_id,c.created_at,e.reason,\n   p.name_ar AS product_name FROM public.supplier215_credits c JOIN public.supplier_replacement_cases sc ON sc.id=c.case_id\n   JOIN public.products p ON p.id=sc.product_id JOIN public.supplier_replacement_events e ON e.id=c.event_id\n   WHERE c.supplier_id=p_supplier_id ORDER BY c.created_at DESC,c.event_id LIMIT p_page_size OFFSET(p_page-1)*p_page_size) x;\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',215,'page',p_page,'pageSize',p_page_size,'totalCount',total,'rows',rows);\nEND $function$\n",

suppliers JSONB; product_ids UUID[]; receiving JSONB;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM public.sr208_assert_role_internal(p_action);\n IF p_action NOT IN('shop_pending','shop_immediate','shop_damage','customer_return') OR length(COALESCE(p_product_search,''))>200 OR length(COALESCE(p_supplier_search,''))>200 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_OPTIONS_INVALID'; END IF;\n WITH candidates AS(SELECT p.*,(SELECT COALESCE(sum(b.available_quantity),0) FROM public.inventory_balances b JOIN public.warehouses w ON w.id=b.warehouse_id AND w.is_active JOIN public.branches br ON br.id=w.branch_id AND br.is_active WHERE b.product_id=p.id) picker_available FROM public.products p WHERE p.is_active AND NOT COALESCE(p.is_flavor_master,false)\n  AND(p_product_id IS NULL OR p.id=p_product_id) AND(p_product_search IS NULL OR p_product_search='' OR p.name_ar ILIKE '%'||p_product_search||'%' OR p.sku ILIKE '%'||p_product_search||'%')\n ), page AS(SELECT * FROM candidates ORDER BY (picker_available>0) DESC,name_ar,id LIMIT 50)\n SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'name',p.name_ar,'sku',p.sku,'imageUrl',(SELECT image.image_url FROM public.product_images image WHERE image.product_id=p.id ORDER BY image.is_primary DESC,image.display_order,image.created_at,image.id LIMIT 1),'availableQuantity',p.picker_available,'baseUnitName',COALESCE(u.name_ar,'باكيت'),'unitsPerParcel',p.units_per_sale_unit) ORDER BY (p.picker_available>0) DESC,p.name_ar,p.id),'[]'),array_agg(p.id ORDER BY p.id)\n INTO products,product_ids FROM page p LEFT JOIN public.units u ON u.id=p.unit_id;\n IF cardinality(product_ids)>0 THEN receiving:=public.get_receiving_purchase_context(product_ids); END IF;\n SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'name',s.company_name) ORDER BY s.company_name,s.id),'[]') INTO suppliers\n FROM(SELECT id,company_name FROM public.suppliers WHERE is_active AND(p_supplier_search IS NULL OR p_supplier_search='' OR company_name ILIKE '%'||p_supplier_search||'%') ORDER BY company_name,id LIMIT 100) s;\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',208,'products',products,'suppliers',CASE WHEN p_action='shop_damage' THEN '[]'::JSONB ELSE suppliers END,\n  'warehouses',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',w.id,'branchId',w.branch_id,'name',w.name_ar) ORDER BY w.name_ar,w.id),'[]') FROM public.warehouses w JOIN public.branches b ON b.id=w.branch_id AND b.is_active WHERE w.is_active),\n  'lastSuppliers',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('productId',x->>'productId','supplierId',x->'lastPurchase'->>'supplierId','supplierName',x->'lastPurchase'->>'supplierName')),'[]') FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(receiving->'products','[]')) x));\nEND $function$\n",

p_page_size IS NULL OR p_page_size NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_PAGE_INVALID';\n END IF;\n -- The ledger is derived, never a writable pending-balance cache.\n (c.origin<>'shop_damage' OR p_status='all') AND (p_supplier_id IS NULL OR c.supplier_id=p_supplier_id) AND(p_branch_id IS NULL OR c.branch_id=p_branch_id)\n  GROUP BY c.id\n ), filtered AS(SELECT * FROM balances WHERE p_status='all' OR(p_status='pending' AND held>0) OR(p_status='closed' AND held=0))\n SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),ARRAY(SELECT id FROM filtered ORDER BY occurred_at,id LIMIT p_page_size OFFSET(p_page::BIGINT-1)*p_page_size)\n INTO total,ids;\n PERFORM public.sr208_assert_operation_internal(x.operation_id) FROM (\n  SELECT DISTINCT e.operation_id FROM c.supplier_id=p_supplier_id) AND(p_branch_id IS NULL OR c.branch_id=p_branch_id)\n  UNION SELECT c.operation_id FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases c\n  WHERE (c.origin<>'shop_damage' OR         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_cash_shift_closing_report_snapshot()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  -- A captured report is an audit artifact: it can never be overwritten,\n  -- cleared, or version-swapped after it has been stored.\n  IF OLD.closing_report_snapshot IS NOT NULL\n    AND (\n      NEW.closing_report_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.closing_report_snapshot\n      OR NEW.closing_report_snapshotted_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.closing_report_snapshotted_at\n      OR NEW.closing_report_snapshot_version IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.closing_report_snapshot_version\n    )\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لقطة تقرير الإغلاق محفوظة ولا يمكن تعديلها أو حذفها.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Historical closed shifts deliberately remain without a fabricated\n  -- snapshot. The one permitted late write is the second update performed by\n  -- close_cash_shift in the same transaction that changed open -> closed.\n  IF OLD.closing_report_snapshot IS NULL\n    AND NEW.closing_report_snapshot IS NOT NULL\n    AND NOT (\n      NEW.status = 'closed'\n      AND (\n        OLD.status = 'open'\n        OR (\n          OLD.status = 'closed'\n          AND OLD.closed_at = transaction_timestamp()\n        )\n      )\n    )\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إضافة لقطة تقرير إلى وردية تاريخية مغلقة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_finalized_order_parcel_item_history()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_cost_transition BOOLEAN := false;\nBEGIN\n  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN\n    v_cost_transition :=\n      OLD.cost_finalized_at IS NULL\n      AND NEW.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL\n      AND public.phase3_customer_cost_finalization_allowed_internal(\n        OLD.order_id, 'order_item', OLD.id\n      )\n      AND ROW(\n        NEW.order_id, NEW.product_id, NEW.product_name_snapshot, NEW.sku_snapshot,\n        NEW.quantity, NEW.unit_price_in_minor_units, NEW.line_total_in_minor_units,\n        NEW.sale_package_quantity, NEW.units_per_sale_package,\n        NEW.sale_package_name_snapshot, NEW.sale_package_price_in_minor_units,\n        NEW.commercial_line_kind, NEW.family_product_id,\n        NEW.parcel_configuration_id, NEW.parcel_configuration_revision,\n        NEW.base_unit_name_snapshot,\n        NEW.allocated_discount_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n        NEW.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units, NEW.created_at\n      ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(\n        OLD.order_id, OLD.product_id, OLD.product_name_snapshot, OLD.sku_snapshot,\n        OLD.quantity, OLD.unit_price_in_minor_units, OLD.line_total_in_minor_units,\n        OLD.sale_package_quantity, OLD.units_per_sale_package,\n        OLD.sale_package_name_snapshot, OLD.sale_package_price_in_minor_units,\n        OLD.commercial_line_kind, OLD.family_product_id,\n        OLD.parcel_configuration_id, OLD.parcel_configuration_revision,\n        OLD.base_unit_name_snapshot,\n        OLD.allocated_discount_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n        OLD.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units, OLD.created_at\n      );\n    IF v_cost_transition THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n  WHERE instance.order_item_id = OLD.id ORDER BY instance.id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.order_parcel_instances WHERE order_item_id = OLD.id) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_LINE_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن تعديل السطر التجاري بعد بدء إنشاء طرد مرتبط به.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.order_inventory_reservations reservation\n  WHERE reservation.order_item_id = OLD.id ORDER BY reservation.id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.order_inventory_reservations WHERE order_item_id = OLD.id) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'RESERVED_ORDER_ITEM_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن تعديل السطر التجاري بعد إنشاء حجز مرتبط به.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.sales_return_items return_item\n  WHERE return_item.order_item_id = OLD.id ORDER BY return_item.id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_return_items WHERE order_item_id = OLD.id) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'RETURNED_ORDER_ITEM_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن تعديل السطر التجاري بعد إنشاء إرجاع مرتبط به.';\n  END IF;\n  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN\n    RETURN OLD;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_order_parcel_component_history()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_id UUID;\n  v_finalized_at TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_cost_transition BOOLEAN := false;\nBEGIN\n  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN\n    SELECT instance.order_id, instance.finalized_at\n    INTO v_order_id, v_finalized_at\n    FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n    WHERE instance.id = OLD.parcel_instance_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT instance.order_id, instance.finalized_at\n    INTO v_order_id, v_finalized_at\n    FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n    WHERE instance.id = NEW.parcel_instance_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN\n    IF v_finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'FINALIZED_PARCEL_COMPONENT_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن حذف مكونات طرد مكتمل.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN OLD;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN\n    v_cost_transition :=\n      OLD.cost_finalized_at IS NULL\n      AND NEW.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL\n      AND public.phase3_customer_cost_finalization_allowed_internal(\n        v_order_id, 'parcel_component', OLD.id\n      )\n      AND ROW(\n        NEW.parcel_instance_id, NEW.operation_id, NEW.product_id,\n        NEW.base_quantity, NEW.product_name_snapshot, NEW.sku_snapshot,\n        NEW.base_unit_name_snapshot,\n        NEW.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n        NEW.created_at\n      ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(\n        OLD.parcel_instance_id, OLD.operation_id, OLD.product_id,\n        OLD.base_quantity, OLD.product_name_snapshot, OLD.sku_snapshot,\n        OLD.base_unit_name_snapshot,\n        OLD.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n        OLD.created_at\n      );\n    IF v_cost_transition THEN RETURN NEW;         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_paid_order_customer_payment_reversal()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_status TEXT;\n  v_payment_method TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.is_reversed AND NOT OLD.is_reversed AND OLD.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    SELECT status, payment_method INTO v_status, v_payment_method\n    FROM public.orders\n    WHERE id = OLD.order_id;\n    IF v_status = 'completed'\n      AND COALESCE(v_payment_method, 'cash_on_delivery') <> 'debt'\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PAYMENT_REVERSAL_PAID_ORDER_UNSUPPORTED: لا يمكن عكس سند قبض لطلب مكتمل غير آجل؛ هذا العكس غير مدعوم حاليًا.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_phase2_detail_history()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF COALESCE(OLD.operation_id, NEW.operation_id) IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_DETAIL_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن تعديل مكونات أو تكاليف سند Phase 2.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_phase2_receipt_header_history()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_old_core JSONB;\n  v_new_core JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF OLD.phase2_finalized_at IS NULL THEN RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD); END IF;\n  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_HISTORY_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن حذف سند Phase 2 النهائي.';\n  END IF;\n  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'supplier_receipts' THEN\n    v_old_core := to_jsonb(OLD) - ARRAY[\n      'status', 'is_archived', 'amount_paid_in_minor_units',\n      'amount_due_in_minor_units', 'payment_status', 'updated_at',\n      'phase2_cancelled_at', 'phase2_cancelled_by',\n      'phase2_cancellation_reason'\n    ];\n    v_new_core := to_jsonb(NEW) - ARRAY[\n      'status', 'is_archived', 'amount_paid_in_minor_units',\n      'amount_due_in_minor_units', 'payment_status', 'updated_at',\n      'phase2_cancelled_at', 'phase2_cancelled_by',\n      'phase2_cancellation_reason'\n    ];\n  ELSE\n    v_old_core := to_jsonb(OLD) - ARRAY[\n      'status', 'phase2_cancelled_at', 'phase2_cancelled_by',\n      'phase2_cancellation_reason'\n    ];\n    v_new_core := to_jsonb(NEW) - ARRAY[\n      'status', 'phase2_cancelled_at', 'phase2_cancelled_by',\n      'phase2_cancellation_reason'\n    ];\n  END IF;\n  IF v_old_core IS DISTINCT FROM v_new_core THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_FINANCIAL_SNAPSHOT_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن تعديل الحقيقة المالية التاريخية للسند.';\n  END IF;\n  IF OLD.status = 'cancelled' AND NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_CANCELLATION_IMMUTABLE: لا يمكن إعادة تفعيل سند ملغى.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_phase3_customer_order_cost_finalization()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.cost_finalized_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.cost_finalized_at THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF OLD.cost_finalized_at IS NULL\n    AND NEW.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL\n    AND EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.phase3_customer_cost_finalization_guards guard_authorization\n      WHERE guard_authorization.transaction_id = pg_current_xact_id()\n        AND guard_authorization.order_id = OLD.id\n        AND guard_authorization.row_kind = 'order'\n        AND guard_authorization.row_id = OLD.id\n        AND guard_authorization.lifecycle_operation_id::TEXT = CURRENT_SETTING(\n          'nawasrah.customer_cost_finalization_operation_id', true\n        )\n    )\n  THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n    MESSAGE = 'CUSTOMER_ORDER_COST_FINALIZATION_IMMUTABLE: حد تكلفة الطلب أحادي الاتجاه ومحمي.';\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_phase3_customer_v2_terminal_status()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_operation_type TEXT;\n  v_expected_reservation_state TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.status\n    OR NEW.status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled', 'expired')\n  THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT operation.operation_type INTO v_operation_type\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.id = OLD.operation_id;\n\n  IF v_operation_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1' THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.phase3_customer_lifecycle_transition_guards lifecycle_guard\n    WHERE lifecycle_guard.transaction_id = pg_current_xact_id()\n      AND lifecycle_guard.order_id = OLD.id\n      AND lifecycle_guard.target_status = NEW.status\n      AND lifecycle_guard.lifecycle_operation_id::TEXT = CURRENT_SETTING(\n        'nawasrah.customer_lifecycle_operation_id', true\n      )\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_V2_LIFECYCLE_COORDINATOR_REQUIRED: Customer V2 terminal transitions require the approved coordinator.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.status = 'completed' THEN\n    IF NEW.cost_finalized_at IS NULL\n      OR EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items item\n        WHERE item.order_id = OLD.id\n          AND (item.cost_finalized_at IS NULL\n            OR item.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NULL)\n      )\n      OR EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n        WHERE instance.order_id = OLD.id\n          AND (instance.cost_finalized_at IS NULL\n            OR instance.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NULL)\n      )\n      OR EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1\n        FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n        JOIN public.order_parcel_instances instance\n          ON instance.id = component.parcel_instance_id\n        WHERE instance.order_id = OLD.id\n          AND (component.cost_finalized_at IS NULL\n            OR component.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NULL)\n      )\n      OR EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_inventory_reservations reservation\n        WHERE reservation.order_id = OLD.id\n          AND reservation.reservation_state <> 'consumed'\n      )\n      OR EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1\n        FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n        WHERE instance.order_id = OLD.id\n          AND (\n            instance.cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM (\n              SELECT COALESCE(SUM(component.cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT\n              FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n              WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = instance.id\n            )\n            OR instance.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM (\n              SELECT COALESCE(SUM(component.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::NUMERIC(30,6)\n              FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n              WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = instance.id\n            )\n          )\n      )\n      OR EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1\n        FROM public.order_items item\n        WHERE item.order_id = OLD.id\n          AND item.commercial_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel'\n          AND (\n            item.cogs_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM (\n              SELECT COALESCE(SUM(instance.cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT\n              FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n              WHERE instance.order_item_id = item.id\n            )\n            OR item.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM (\n              SELECT COALESCE(SUM(instance.exact_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::NUMERIC(30,6)\n              FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n              WHERE instance.order_item_id = item.id\n            )\n          )\n      )\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_COST_FINALIZATION_INCOMPLETE: Customer V2 completion cost is incomplete.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    v_expected_reservation_state := CASE NEW.status\n      WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'released' END;\n    IF NEW.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL\n      OR EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items item\n        WHERE item.order_id = OLD.id AND item.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL\n      )\n      OR EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n        WHERE instance.order_id = OLD.id AND instance.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL\n      )\n      OR EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1\n        FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n        JOIN public.order_parcel_instances instance\n          ON instance.id = component.parcel_instance_id\n        WHERE instance.order_id = OLD.id\n          AND component.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL\n      )\n      OR EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM public.order_inventory_reservations reservation\n        WHERE reservation.order_id = OLD.id\n          AND reservation.reservation_state <> v_expected_reservation_state\n      )\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_LIFECYCLE_INCOMPLETE: Customer V2 reservation release is incomplete.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_phase4_aftercare_consumption_history()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'IMMUTABLE_BUSINESS_HISTORY: Phase-4 consumption evidence cannot be deleted.';\n  END IF;\n  IF OLD.consumption_state = 'draft'\n    AND NEW.consumption_state = 'settled'\n    AND NEW.settled_at IS NOT NULL\n    AND CURRENT_SETTING('nawasrah.phase4_finalization_operation_id', true)\n      = OLD.operation_id::TEXT\n    AND ROW(\n      NEW.id, NEW.operation_id, NEW.return_item_id, NEW.replacement_item_id,\n      NEW.source_kind, NEW.source_id, NEW.product_id, NEW.consumed_quantity,\n      NEW.consumption_kind, NEW.created_at\n    ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(\n      OLD.id, OLD.operation_id, OLD.return_item_id, OLD.replacement_item_id,\n      OLD.source_kind, OLD.source_id, OLD.product_id, OLD.consumed_quantity,\n      OLD.consumption_kind, OLD.created_at\n    )\n  THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n  IF OLD.consumption_state = 'draft'\n    AND NEW.consumption_state = 'cancelled'\n    AND NEW.settled_at IS NULL\n    AND CURRENT_SETTING('nawasrah.phase4_cancellation_operation_id', true)\n      = OLD.operation_id::TEXT\n    AND ROW(\n      NEW.id, NEW.operation_id, NEW.return_item_id, NEW.replacement_item_id,\n      NEW.source_kind, NEW.source_id, NEW.product_id, NEW.consumed_quantity,\n      NEW.consumption_kind, NEW.created_at\n    ) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ROW(\n      OLD.id, OLD.operation_id, OLD.return_item_id, OLD.replacement_item_id,\n      OLD.source_kind, OLD.source_id, OLD.product_id, OLD.consumed_quantity,\n      OLD.consumption_kind, OLD.created_at\n    )\n  THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n    MESSAGE = 'IMMUTABLE_BUSINESS_HISTORY: Phase-4 consumption transition is not authorized.';\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.import_go_live_products_v1(p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb, p_dry_run boolean DEFAULT false)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_replay JSONB;\n  v_row JSONB;\n  v_n INTEGER := 0;\n  v_errors JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_error TEXT;\n  v_sku TEXT;\n  v_barcode TEXT;\n  v_name TEXT;\n  v_category_id UUID;\n  v_unit_id UUID;\n  v_purchase_unit_id UUID;\n  v_sale_unit_id UUID;\n  v_units_per_purchase INTEGER;\n  v_units_per_sale INTEGER;\n  v_sale_price BIGINT;\n  v_purchase_price BIGINT;\n  v_cost BIGINT;\n  v_min_stock INTEGER;\n  v_count INTEGER;\n  v_created JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_product JSONB;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'استيراد منتجات بداية التشغيل');\n  PERFORM public.go_live_assert_setup_open_internal();\n  IF NOT COALESCE(p_dry_run, false) THEN\n    v_replay := public.go_live_begin_batch_internal('products', p_idempotency_key, p_rows);\n    IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN\n      RETURN v_replay;\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF p_rows IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_rows) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الدفعة يجب أن تحتوي من 1 إلى 500 سطر.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)\n  LOOP\n    v_n := v_n + 1;\n    v_error := NULL;\n    v_sku := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'sku'), '');\n    v_barcode := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'barcode'), '');\n    v_name := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'name_ar'), '');\n    v_category_id := NULL;         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner217_claim_deliveries_internal(p_channel text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10, p_lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 120)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_channel TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_channel, '')));\n  v_limit INTEGER := LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 10), 1), 50);\n  v_lease_seconds INTEGER :=\n    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_lease_seconds, 120), 30), 900);\n  v_items JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_channel NOT IN ('telegram', 'whatsapp') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid automation delivery channel.';\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.automation_event_deliveries (event_id, channel)\n  SELECT ae.id, v_channel\n  FROM public.automation_events ae\n  WHERE ae.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'\n  ON CONFLICT (event_id, channel) DO NOTHING;\n\n  -- Finalize exhausted retries explicitly. A live lease is never stolen; an\n  -- exhausted processing row is dead-lettered only after its lease expires.\n  UPDATE public.automation_event_deliveries d\n  SET\n    status = 'dead_letter',\n    dead_lettered_at = COALESCE(d.dead_lettered_at, NOW()),\n    lease_expires_at = NULL,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE d.channel = v_channel\n    AND d.attempt_count >= 10\n    AND (\n      d.status IN ('pending', 'failed')\n      OR (d.status = 'processing' AND d.lease_expires_at <= NOW())\n    );\n\n  WITH candidates AS (\n    SELECT d.event_id\n    FROM public.automation_event_deliveries d\n    JOIN public.automation_events ae ON ae.id = d.event_id\n    WHERE d.channel = v_channel\n      AND d.attempt_count < 10\n      AND (\n        (d.status IN ('pending', 'failed') AND d.next_attempt_at <= NOW())\n        OR\n        (d.status = 'processing' AND d.lease_expires_at <= NOW())\n      )\n    ORDER BY ae.created_at, ae.id\n    FOR UPDATE OF d SKIP LOCKED\n    LIMIT v_limit\n  ), claimed AS (\n    UPDATE public.automation_event_deliveries d\n    SET\n      status = 'processing',\n      attempt_count = d.attempt_count + 1,\n      first_attempt_at = COALESCE(d.first_attempt_at, NOW()),\n      last_attempt_at = NOW(),\n      lease_expires_at = NOW() + make_interval(secs => v_lease_seconds),\n      last_error = NULL,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n    FROM candidates c\n    WHERE d.event_id = c.event_id\n      AND d.channel = v_channel\n    RETURNING d.event_id, d.attempt_count, d.lease_expires_at\n  )\n  SELECT jsonb_agg(\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'eventId', ae.id,\n      'eventType', ae.event_type,\n      'entityId', ae.entity_id,\n      'payload', ae.payload,\n      'createdAt', ae.created_at,\n      'attemptCount', c.attempt_count,\n      'leaseExpiresAt', c.lease_expires_at\n    ) ORDER BY ae.created_at, ae.id\n  ) INTO v_items\n  FROM claimed c\n  JOIN public.automation_events ae ON ae.id = c.event_id;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'channel', v_channel,\n    'items', COALESCE(v_items, '[]'::JSONB)\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner217_complete_delivery_internal(p_event_id uuid, p_channel text, p_success boolean, p_error text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_channel TEXT := LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(p_channel, '')));\n  v_status TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_event_id IS NULL OR v_channel NOT IN ('telegram', 'whatsapp') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid automation delivery completion.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.automation_event_deliveries d\n  SET\n    status = CASE\n      WHEN COALESCE(p_success, false) THEN 'delivered'\n      WHEN d.attempt_count >= 10 THEN 'dead_letter'\n      ELSE 'failed'\n    END,\n    delivered_at = CASE WHEN COALESCE(p_success, false)\n      THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,\n    dead_lettered_at = CASE\n      WHEN NOT COALESCE(p_success, false) AND d.attempt_count >= 10\n        THEN COALESCE(d.dead_lettered_at, NOW())\n      ELSE NULL\n    END,\n    next_attempt_at = CASE WHEN COALESCE(p_success, false)\n      THEN d.next_attempt_at\n      ELSE NOW() + make_interval(\n        secs => LEAST(3600, 60 * power(2, LEAST(d.attempt_count, 6))::INTEGER)\n      )\n    END,\n    lease_expires_at = NULL,\n    last_error = CASE WHEN COALESCE(p_success, false)\n      THEN NULL ELSE LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_error), ''), 'Delivery failed'), 1000)\n    END,\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE d.event_id = p_event_id\n    AND d.channel = v_channel\n    AND d.status = 'processing'\n  RETURNING d.status INTO v_status;\n\n  IF v_status IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Automation delivery is not currently processing.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'eventId', p_event_id,\n    'channel', v_channel,\n    'status', v_status\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_assert_whole_single_sku_quantity_internal(p_order_item_id uuid, p_quantity integer)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_item public.order_items%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO v_item FROM public.order_items WHERE id=p_order_item_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_SOURCE_INVALID: Missing immutable sale root'; END IF;\n  IF v_item.commercial_line_kind='legacy_single_sku_parcel' AND (\n    v_item.units_per_sale_package IS NULL OR v_item.units_per_sale_package<=0\n    OR v_item.sale_package_quantity IS NULL OR v_item.sale_package_quantity<=0\n    OR v_item.quantity::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM v_item.sale_package_quantity::bigint*v_item.units_per_sale_package\n    OR p_quantity IS NULL OR p_quantity<=0\n    OR mod(p_quantity, v_item.units_per_sale_package)<>0\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PACKAGE_D_WHOLE_SINGLE_SKU_PARCEL_REQUIRED: اختر كراتين كاملة حسب حجم الكرتونة التاريخي';\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_capture_single_sku_price_snapshot()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_type TEXT; v_phone TEXT; v_code TEXT; v_frozen TIMESTAMPTZ; v_packet_price BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN\n    IF NEW.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM\n       OLD.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      OR (OLD.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NOT NULL\n        AND ROW(NEW.order_id,NEW.product_id,NEW.commercial_line_kind,NEW.quantity,NEW.units_per_sale_package,\n          NEW.sale_package_quantity,NEW.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units)\n        IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.order_id,OLD.product_id,OLD.commercial_line_kind,OLD.quantity,OLD.units_per_sale_package,\n          OLD.sale_package_quantity,OLD.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units)) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='P0001',\n        MESSAGE='PACKAGE_D_CARTON_PRICE_IMMUTABLE: Historical standalone price cannot be changed or backfilled.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='P0001',\n      MESSAGE='PHASE4_STANDALONE_PRICE_SERVER_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED: Caller supplied snapshot forbidden.';\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.commercial_line_kind='legacy_single_sku_parcel' THEN\n    SELECT sale_price_in_minor_units INTO v_packet_price FROM public.products\n    WHERE id=NEW.product_id AND is_active AND NOT is_flavor_master FOR SHARE;\n    -- A missing standalone packet price is not a missing carton price. Keep\n    -- the nullable evidence absent; only CUSTOMER_DAMAGE requires this fact.\n    -- Do not catch unrelated pricing/promotion/authority errors.\n    IF FOUND AND v_packet_price=0 THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n    SELECT op.operation_type, c.phone, o.promotion_code_snapshot, op.completed_at\n      INTO v_type,v_phone,v_code,v_frozen\n    FROM public.orders o JOIN public.business_operations op ON op.id=o.operation_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.id=NEW.order_id;\n    IF v_type='phase3_pos_sale_v1' THEN\n      NEW.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units :=\n        public.phase4_effective_standalone_unit_price_internal(NEW.product_id,'admin_pos',NULL,NULL,v_frozen);\n    ELSIF v_type='phase3_customer_reservation_v1' THEN\n      NEW.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units :=\n        public.phase4_effective_standalone_unit_price_internal(NEW.product_id,'customer_v2',v_phone,v_code,v_frozen);\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_create_customer_order_before_source_guard_internal(p_customer_full_name text, p_customer_phone text, p_customer_email text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_governorate text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_city text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_area text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_street text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_building text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_floor text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_apartment text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_address_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_latitude double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_longitude double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_formatted_address text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_google_maps_url text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_location_source text DEFAULT 'manual'::text, p_branch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_items jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_discount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_customer_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_internal_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_source text DEFAULT 'website'::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_item JSONB;\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_package_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_units_per_package INTEGER;\n  v_package_price BIGINT;\n  v_package_name TEXT;\n  v_base_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_line_total BIGINT;\n  v_exact_subtotal BIGINT := 0;\n  v_exact_total BIGINT;\n  v_base_items JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_line_snapshots JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;\n  v_legacy_result JSONB;\n  v_order_id UUID;\n  v_customer_id UUID;\n  v_order_number TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_items IS NULL\n    OR jsonb_typeof(p_items) <> 'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'سلة الطلب فارغة، يجب اختيار طرد واحد على الأقل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF COALESCE(p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units, 0) < 0\n    OR COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0) < 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رسوم التوصيل والخصم لا يمكن أن تكون سالبة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_item IN\n    SELECT item.value\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) AS item(value)\n    ORDER BY item.value->>'product_id'\n  LOOP\n    BEGIN\n      v_product_id := (v_item->>'product_id')::UUID;\n      v_package_quantity := (v_item->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n    EXCEPTION\n      WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION 'بيانات أحد طرود الطلب غير صحيحة.';\n    END;\n\n    IF v_product_id IS NULL\n      OR v_package_quantity IS NULL\n      OR v_package_quantity <= 0\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'كل صنف يحتاج منتجاً وعدد طرود صحيحاً أكبر من صفر.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT\n      p.units_per_sale_unit,\n      p.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(su.name_ar, 'طرد')\n    INTO\n      v_units_per_package,\n      v_package_price,\n      v_package_name\n    FROM public.products p\n    LEFT JOIN public.units su ON su.id = p.sale_unit_id\n    WHERE p.id = v_product_id\n      AND p.is_active = true;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'أحد منتجات الطلب غير متاح للبيع على الموقع.';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF COALESCE(v_units_per_package, 0) <= 0\n      OR COALESCE(v_package_price, 0) <= 0\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'طرد بيع المنتج غير مضبوط، تواصل مع إدارة المتجر.';\n    END IF;\n\n    v_base_quantity := v_package_quantity * v_units_per_package;\n    v_line_total := v_package_quantity * v_package_price;\n    v_exact_subtotal := v_exact_subtotal + v_line_total;\n\n    v_base_items := v_base_items || jsonb_build_array(\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'product_id', v_product_id,\n        'quantity', v_base_quantity\n      )\n    );\n    v_line_snapshots := v_line_snapshots || jsonb_build_array(\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'product_id', v_product_id,\n        'package_quantity', v_package_quantity,\n        'units_per_package', v_units_per_package,\n        'package_name', v_package_name,\n        'package_price', v_package_price,\n        'line_total', v_line_total\n      )\n    );\n  END LOOP;\n\n  v_exact_total :=\n    v_exact_subtotal\n    + COALESCE(p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units, 0)\n    - COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0);\n\n  IF v_exact_total < 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'قيمة الخصم أكبر من إجمالي الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_legacy_result :=\n    public.create_customer_order_base_units_legacy(\n      p_customer_full_name,\n      p_customer_phone,\n      p_customer_email,\n      p_governorate,\n      p_city,\n      p_area,\n      p_street,\n      p_building,\n      p_floor,\n      p_apartment,\n      p_address_notes,\n      p_latitude,\n      p_longitude,\n      p_formatted_address,\n      p_google_maps_url,\n      p_location_source,\n      p_branch_id,\n      p_warehouse_id,\n      v_base_items,\n      p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units,\n      0,\n      p_customer_notes,\n      p_internal_notes,\n      p_source\n    );\n\n  IF NOT COALESCE((v_legacy_result->>'success')::BOOLEAN, false) THEN\n    RETURN v_legacy_result;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_order_id := (v_legacy_result->>'order_id')::UUID;\n  v_customer_id := (v_legacy_result->>'customer_id')::UUID;\n  v_order_number := v_legacy_result->>'order_number';\n\n  UPDATE public.customers\n  SET customer_type = 'wholesale', updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = v_customer_id;\n\n  FOR v_item IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_line_snapshots)\n  LOOP\n    UPDATE public.order_items\n    SET\n      sale_package_quantity =\n        (v_item->>'package_quantity')::INTEGER,\n      units_per_sale_package =\n        (v_item->>'units_per_package')::INTEGER,\n      sale_package_name_snapshot = v_item->>'package_name',\n      sale_package_price_in_minor_units =\n        (v_item->>'package_price')::BIGINT,\n      line_total_in_minor_units =\n        (v_item->>'line_total')::BIGINT,\n      cogs_in_minor_units =\n        quantity * unit_cost_in_minor_units,\n      profit_in_minor_units =\n        (v_item->>'line_total')::BIGINT\n        - (quantity * unit_cost_in_minor_units)\n    WHERE order_id = v_order_id\n      AND product_id = (v_item->>'product_id')::UUID;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET\n    subtotal_in_minor_units = v_exact_subtotal,\n    discount_in_minor_units =\n      COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0),\n    total_in_minor_units = v_exact_total,\n    whatsapp_message =\n      'تم استلام طلبك رقم '\n      || v_order_number\n      || ' بقيمة إجمالية '\n      || (v_exact_total::NUMERIC / 1000)::TEXT\n      || ' د.أ. سيتم التواصل معك لتأكيد التوصيل.',\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = v_order_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    auth.uid(),\n    'APPLY_WHOLESALE_CUSTOMER_ORDER_ACCOUNTING',\n    'orders',\n    v_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'subtotal_in_minor_units', v_exact_subtotal,\n      'delivery_fee_in_minor_units',\n        COALESCE(p_delivery_fee_in_minor_units, 0),\n      'discount_in_minor_units',\n        COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0),\n      'total_in_minor_units', v_exact_total,\n      'package_lines', v_line_snapshots\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'order_id', v_order_id,\n    'order_number', v_order_number,\n    'customer_id', v_customer_id,\n    'customer_address_id',\n      v_legacy_result->>'customer_address_id',\n    'customer_reused',\n      COALESCE(\n        (v_legacy_result->>'customer_reused')::BOOLEAN,\n        false\n      ),\n    'subtotal', v_exact_subtotal,\n    'total', v_exact_total,\n    'status', 'new',\n    'message', 'تم إنشاء طلب طرود الجملة وحجز حباتها من المخزون بدقة.'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_create_pos_sale_before_attempt_guard_internal(p_warehouse_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_customer_name text, p_payment_method text, p_lines jsonb, p_discount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_amount_received_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  -- Apply the exact centralized POS authorization/MFA policy before any\n  -- Customer-specific lookup or lock.  The private implementation keeps the\n  -- same guard as defense in depth after this serialization boundary.\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'تنفيذ بيع نقطة البيع بالإصدار المحمي'\n  );\n\n  IF p_customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM 1\n    FROM public.customers customer\n    WHERE customer.id = p_customer_id\n    FOR KEY SHARE;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_CUSTOMER_INVALID: العميل المحدد غير موجود.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN public._create_pos_sale_v2_before_registered_customer_lock(\n    p_warehouse_id,\n    p_branch_id,\n    p_customer_id,\n    p_customer_name,\n    p_payment_method,\n    p_lines,\n    p_discount_in_minor_units,\n    p_amount_received_in_minor_units,\n    p_idempotency_key\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_guard_physical_capacity_internal()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_capacity INTEGER; v_used BIGINT; v_root RECORD;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.consumption_state NOT IN ('draft', 'settled') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_operation_order_internal(NEW.operation_id, NULL);\n  SELECT * INTO v_root FROM public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(NEW.source_kind,NEW.source_id,NEW.product_id);\n  IF v_root.root_kind='base_order_item' THEN\n    PERFORM public.aftercare211_assert_replacement_root_internal(v_root.root_id,NEW.consumed_quantity);\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'phase4-aftercare|' || NEW.source_kind || '|' || NEW.source_id::TEXT, 0\n  ));\n  IF NEW.source_kind = 'base_order_item' THEN\n    SELECT quantity INTO v_capacity FROM public.order_items\n    WHERE id = NEW.source_id AND product_id = NEW.product_id FOR UPDATE;\n  ELSIF NEW.source_kind = 'parcel_component' THEN\n    SELECT base_quantity INTO v_capacity FROM public.order_parcel_components\n    WHERE id = NEW.source_id AND product_id = NEW.product_id FOR UPDATE;\n  ELSIF NEW.source_kind = 'replacement_item' THEN\n    SELECT quantity INTO v_capacity FROM public.sales_replacement_items\n    WHERE id = NEW.source_id AND product_id = NEW.product_id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(consumed_quantity), 0) INTO v_used\n  FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions\n  WHERE source_kind = NEW.source_kind AND source_id = NEW.source_id\n    AND id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id\n    AND (consumption_state = 'settled'\n      OR (operation_id = NEW.operation_id AND consumption_state = 'draft'));\n  IF v_capacity IS NULL OR NEW.consumed_quantity <= 0\n    OR v_used + NEW.consumed_quantity > v_capacity THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_LOGICAL_QUANTITY_ALREADY_CONSUMED: تغيرت الكمية المتبقية لهذه القطعة؛ أعد تحميل الطلب.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",
