        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_public_parcel_options_before_policy_internal(p_family_product_ids uuid[])\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_feature_state TEXT := public.get_configurable_parcel_feature_state();\n  v_requested_count INTEGER := COALESCE(CARDINALITY(p_family_product_ids), 0);\n  v_options JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_requested_count < 1\n    OR v_requested_count > 48\n    OR ARRAY_POSITION(p_family_product_ids, NULL) IS NOT NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PUBLIC_CONFIGURABLE_PARCEL_REQUEST_INVALID: Provide between 1 and 48 valid Family IDs.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- OWNER_PILOT intentionally grants no Customer guest creation capability.\n  -- Returning an empty projection also prevents stale configuration discovery\n  -- while creation is unavailable to the public guest actor.\n  IF v_feature_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'ENABLED' THEN\n    RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'featureState', v_feature_state,\n      'guestCreationEnabled', false,\n      'options', '[]'::JSONB\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  WITH requested_families AS (\n    SELECT DISTINCT requested.family_product_id\n    FROM UNNEST(p_family_product_ids) AS requested(family_product_id)\n  ), storefront_warehouse AS (\n    -- This is intentionally identical to the Customer V2 warehouse selector.\n    SELECT warehouse.id\n    FROM public.warehouses warehouse\n    JOIN public.branches branch\n      ON branch.id = warehouse.branch_id\n    WHERE warehouse.is_active\n      AND branch.is_active\n    ORDER BY warehouse.created_at, warehouse.id\n    LIMIT 1\n  ), configuration_source AS (\n    SELECT\n      configuration.id AS parcel_configuration_id,\n      configuration.family_product_id,\n      configuration.configuration_revision,\n      configuration.composition_mode,\n      family.units_per_sale_unit AS units_per_parcel,\n      family.default_sale_price_in_minor_units AS parcel_price_in_minor_units,\n      base_unit.name_ar AS base_unit_name_ar,\n      sale_unit.name_ar AS sale_unit_name_ar\n    FROM requested_families requested\n    JOIN public.product_parcel_configurations configuration\n      ON configuration.family_product_id = requested.family_product_id\n    JOIN public.products family\n      ON family.id = configuration.family_product_id\n    JOIN public.categories family_category\n      ON family_category.id = family.category_id\n      AND family_category.is_active\n    JOIN public.units base_unit\n      ON base_unit.id = family.unit_id\n    JOIN public.units sale_unit\n      ON sale_unit.id = family.sale_unit_id\n    WHERE configuration.is_active\n      AND configuration.composition_mode = 'configurable_mix'\n      AND configuration.configuration_revision > 0\n      AND family.is_active\n      AND family.is_flavor_master\n      AND family.units_per_sale_unit > 0\n      AND family.default_sale_price_in_minor_units > 0\n      AND sale_unit.code <> 'PCS'\n  ), eligible_components AS (\n    SELECT\n      configuration.parcel_configuration_id,\n      configuration.family_product_id,\n      configuration.configuration_revision,\n      configuration.composition_mode,\n      configuration.units_per_parcel,\n      configuration.parcel_price_in_minor_units,\n      configuration.base_unit_name_ar,\n      configuration.sale_unit_name_ar,\n      component.id AS product_id,\n      component.sku,\n      component.name_ar,\n      component.flavor_name_ar,\n      component_unit.name_ar AS component_unit_name_ar,\n      image.image_url,\n      COALESCE(balance.available_quantity, 0)::INTEGER AS available_quantity\n    FROM configuration_source configuration\n    CROSS JOIN storefront_warehouse warehouse\n    JOIN public.products component\n      ON component.flavor_master_product_id = configuration.family_product_id\n      AND component.is_active\n      AND NOT component.is_flavor_master\n      AND component.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact IS NOT NULL\n    JOIN public.categories component_category\n      ON component_category.id = component.category_id\n      AND component_category.is_active\n    JOIN public.units component_unit\n      ON component_unit.id = component.unit_id\n    JOIN public.units component_sale_unit\n      ON component_sale_unit.id = component.sale_unit_id\n    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_balances balance\n      ON balance.warehouse_id = warehouse.id\n      AND balance.product_id = component.id\n    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n      SELECT product_image.image_url\n      FROM public.product_images product_image\n      WHERE product_image.product_id = component.id\n      ORDER BY product_image.is_primary DESC,\n        product_image.display_order,\n        product_image.created_at,\n        product_image.id\n      LIMIT 1\n    ) image ON true\n    WHERE component.units_per_sale_unit > 0\n      AND component.default_sale_price_in_minor_units > 0\n      AND component_sale_unit.code <> 'PCS'\n  ), option_groups AS (\n    SELECT\n      component.parcel_configuration_id,\n      component.family_product_id,\n      component.configuration_revision,\n      component.composition_mode,\n      component.units_per_parcel,\n      component.parcel_price_in_minor_units,\n      component.base_unit_name_ar,\n      component.sale_unit_name_ar,\n      SUM(component.available_quantity)::BIGINT AS total_available_quantity,\n      JSONB_AGG(\n        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n          'productId', component.product_id,\n          'sku', component.sku,\n          'nameAr', component.name_ar,\n          'flavorNameAr', component.flavor_name_ar,\n          'unitNameAr', component.component_unit_name_ar,\n          'imageUrl', component.image_url,\n          'availableQuantity', component.units_per_parcel\n  )\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    JSONB_AGG(\n      JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n        'familyProductId', option_group.family_product_id,\n        'parcelConfigurationId', option_group.units_per_parcel,\n        'parcelPriceInMinorUnits', option_group.parcel_price_in_minor_units,\n        'baseUnitNameAr', option_group.base_unit_name_ar,\n        'saleUnitNameAr',         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_replacement_evidence_before_carton_internal(p_operation_id uuid, p_require_issued boolean)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_operation public.business_operations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_event public.sales_replacement_events%ROWTYPE;\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_evidence public.phase43_replacement_settlement_evidence%ROWTYPE;\n  v_actual JSONB;\n  v_expected_count INTEGER;\n  v_actual_count INTEGER;\n  v_covered_item_count INTEGER;\n  v_effect_count INTEGER;\n  v_movement_count INTEGER;\n  v_consumption_count INTEGER;\n  v_operation_consumption_count INTEGER;\n  v_request_count INTEGER;\n  v_issued_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_replacement_cogs BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_require_issued IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: Evidence lifecycle requirement is missing.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO v_operation FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.id = p_operation_id;\n  SELECT * INTO v_event FROM public.sales_replacement_events event\n  WHERE event.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.orders customer_order\n  WHERE customer_order.id = v_event.root_order_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_operation.operation_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'phase4_replacement_v1'\n    OR v_operation.request_identity_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'operationalCoordinatorVersion')::INTEGER IS DISTINCT FROM 403\n    OR v_event.contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n    OR v_event.issuance_coordinator_version IS DISTINCT FROM 403\n    OR v_event.branch_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order.branch_id\n    OR v_event.warehouse_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order.warehouse_id\n    OR v_event.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_operation.initiated_by\n    OR JSONB_TYPEOF(v_operation.request_identity_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n    OR (v_operation.request_identity_snapshot->>'order_id')::UUID\n      IS DISTINCT FROM v_event.root_order_id\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_OPERATIONAL_REPLACEMENT_UNPROVEN: Replacement coordinator identity is incomplete.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_evidence FROM public.phase43_replacement_settlement_evidence evidence\n  WHERE evidence.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  v_actual := public.phase43_inventory_effects_snapshot_internal(p_operation_id);\n  IF NOT FOUND\n    OR v_evidence.replacement_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_event.id\n    OR v_evidence.order_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_event.root_order_id\n    OR v_evidence.result_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM v_operation.result_snapshot\n    OR v_evidence.inventory_effects_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM v_actual\n    OR JSONB_TYPEOF(v_operation.result_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'success')::BOOLEAN IS DISTINCT FROM true\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'idempotentReplay')::BOOLEAN IS DISTINCT FROM false\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'operationId')::UUID IS DISTINCT FROM v_operation.id\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'replacementId')::UUID IS DISTINCT FROM v_event.id\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'orderId')::UUID IS DISTINCT FROM v_event.root_order_id\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'operationalCoordinatorVersion')::INTEGER\n      IS DISTINCT FROM 403\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'moneyRefundInMinorUnits')::BIGINT IS DISTINCT FROM 0\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'debtReductionInMinorUnits')::BIGINT IS DISTINCT FROM 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: Durable Replacement evidence does not match the operation.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_expected_count\n  FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n  WHERE item.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  SELECT JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(v_operation.request_identity_snapshot->'items')\n  INTO v_request_count;\n\n  -- Operational issuance creates exactly one consumption per immutable item.\n  -- Row UUID is not its business identity: (operation_id, replacement_item_id)\n  -- is. Check both directions before joins can multiply A and hide missing B.\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n    WHERE item.operation_id = p_operation_id\n      AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n        WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n          AND consumption.replacement_item_id = item.id) <> 1\n  ) OR EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n    WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n      AND NOT EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n        WHERE item.operation_id = p_operation_id\n          AND item.id = consumption.replacement_item_id\n      )\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_EFFECTS_INCOMPLETE: Each authoritative item requires exactly one owned consumption.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER, COUNT(DISTINCT item.id)::INTEGER,\n    COALESCE(SUM(effect.issued_quantity), 0)::INTEGER,\n    COALESCE(SUM(effect.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT\n  INTO v_actual_count, v_covered_item_count, v_issued_quantity, v_replacement_cogs\n  FROM public.phase43_replacement_inventory_effects effect\n  JOIN public.sales_replacement_items item\n    ON item.id = effect.replacement_item_id\n    AND item.operation_id = effect.operation_id\n    AND item.replacement_event_id = effect.replacement_event_id\n    AND item.product_id = effect.product_id\n    AND item.quantity = effect.issued_quantity\n    AND item.replacement_unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact\n      = effect.replacement_unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact\n    AND item.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      = effect.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n    AND item.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      = ROUND(item.replacement_unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact * item.quantity)::BIGINT\n    AND effect.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n      = ROUND(effect.replacement_unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact\n        * effect.issued_quantity)::BIGINT\n  JOIN public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n    ON consumption.operation_id = effect.operation_id\n    AND consumption.replacement_item_id = effect.replacement_item_id\n    AND consumption.consumption_kind = 'replacement'\n    AND consumption.source_kind = effect.source_kind\n    AND consumption.source_id = effect.source_id\n    AND consumption.product_id = effect.product_id\n    AND consumption.consumed_quantity = effect.issued_quantity\n    AND consumption.consumption_state = CASE\n      WHEN p_require_issued THEN 'settled'\n      ELSE 'draft'\n    END\n    AND (\n      (p_require_issued AND consumption.settled_at IS NOT NULL)\n      OR (NOT p_require_issued AND consumption.settled_at IS NULL)\n    )\n  JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_operation.request_identity_snapshot->'items') request_item\n    ON request_item->>'source_kind' = effect.source_kind\n    AND (request_item->>'source_id')::UUID = effect.source_id\n    AND (request_item->>'quantity')::INTEGER = effect.issued_quantity\n  JOIN public.inventory_movements movement\n    ON movement.id = effect.inventory_movement_id\n    AND movement.operation_id = effect.operation_id\n    AND movement.warehouse_id = effect.warehouse_id\n    AND movement.product_id = effect.product_id\n    AND movement.movement_type = 'sales_deduction'\n    AND movement.quantity = -effect.issued_quantity\n    AND movement.balance_before = effect.target_balance_before\n    AND movement.balance_after = effect.target_balance_after\n    AND movement.reference_type = 'phase4_replacement_item'\n    AND movement.reference_id = effect.replacement_item_id\n    AND movement.created_by IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_operation.initiated_by\n  CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n    effect.source_kind, effect.source_id, effect.product_id\n  ) source_root\n  LEFT JOIN public.order_items root_item\n    ON source_root.root_kind = 'base_order_item'\n    AND root_item.id = source_root.root_id\n    AND root_item.order_id = v_event.root_order_id\n    AND root_item.product_id = effect.product_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.order_parcel_components root_component\n    ON source_root.root_kind = 'parcel_component'\n    AND root_component.id = source_root.root_id\n    AND root_component.product_id = effect.product_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.order_parcel_instances root_instance\n    ON root_instance.id = root_component.parcel_instance_id\n    AND root_instance.order_id = v_event.root_order_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.sales_replacement_items source_replacement\n    ON effect.source_kind = 'replacement_item'\n    AND source_replacement.id = effect.source_id\n    AND source_replacement.product_id = effect.product_id\n  LEFT JOIN public.sales_replacement_events source_event\n    ON source_event.id = source_replacement.replacement_event_id\n    AND source_event.replacement_status = 'settled'\n    AND source_event.issuance_status = 'issued'\n    AND source_event.issuance_coordinator_version = 403\n  WHERE effect.operation_id = p_operation_id\n    AND effect.replacement_event_id = v_event.id\n    AND effect.warehouse_id = v_event.warehouse_id\n    AND (\n      (source_root.root_kind = 'base_order_item' AND root_item.id IS NOT NULL)\n      OR (source_root.root_kind = 'parcel_component' AND root_instance.id IS NOT NULL)\n    )\n    AND (\n      (source_root.root_kind = 'base_order_item'\n        AND item.root_order_item_id = root_item.id\n        AND item.root_parcel_instance_id IS NULL\n        AND item.root_parcel_component_id IS NULL\n        AND item.original_sale_operation_id IS NULL)\n      OR (source_root.root_kind = 'parcel_component'\n        AND item.root_order_item_id = root_instance.order_item_id\n        AND item.root_parcel_instance_id = root_instance.id\n        AND item.root_parcel_component_id = root_component.id\n        AND item.original_sale_operation_id = root_component.operation_id)\n    )\n    AND (\n      (effect.source_kind = 'replacement_item'\n        AND source_event.id IS NOT NULL\n        AND source_event.root_order_id = v_event.root_order_id\n        AND item.parent_replacement_item_id = source_replacement.id)\n      OR (effect.source_kind <> 'replacement_item'\n        AND item.parent_replacement_item_id IS NULL)\n    );\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_consumption_count\n  FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n  WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n    AND consumption.consumption_kind = 'replacement';\n\n  -- Distinct authoritative item coverage and per-item consumption cardinality\n  -- prove identity, not merely bag counts. Raw operation counts additionally\n  -- exclude orphan evidence; totals below are supplementary arithmetic checks.\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_effect_count\n  FROM public.phase43_replacement_inventory_effects effect\n  WHERE effect.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_movement_count\n  FROM public.inventory_movements movement\n  WHERE movement.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_operation_consumption_count\n  FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n  WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n\n  IF v_expected_count <= 0\n    OR v_request_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR v_actual_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR v_covered_item_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR v_effect_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR v_movement_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR v_consumption_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR v_operation_consumption_count IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_count\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'issuedQuantity')::INTEGER\n      IS DISTINCT FROM v_issued_quantity\n    OR (v_operation.result_snapshot->>'replacementCogsInMinorUnits')::BIGINT\n      IS DISTINCT FROM v_replacement_cogs\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_EFFECTS_INCOMPLETE: Every issued Replacement item requires exact inventory and cost evidence.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF (p_require_issued AND (\n      v_event.replacement_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'settled'\n      OR v_event.settled_at IS NULL\n      OR v_event.issuance_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'issued'\n      OR v_event.issued_at IS NULL\n    )) OR (NOT p_require_issued AND (\n      v_event.replacement_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'draft'\n      OR v_event.settled_at IS NOT NULL\n      OR v_event.issuance_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'not_issued'\n      OR v_event.issued_at IS NOT NULL\n    )) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_NOT_ISSUED: Foundation settlement is not operational issuance.';\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_settle_sales_replacement_before_guard_internal(p_order_id uuid, p_idempotency_key text, p_items jsonb, p_reason text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_actor_hash TEXT;\n  v_key TEXT;\n  v_canonical JSONB;\n  v_fingerprint TEXT;\n  v_replay JSONB;\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_creation_type TEXT;\n  v_completion_at TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_operation_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_event_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_now TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_item JSONB;\n  v_prepared JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_product_ids UUID[];\n  v_source_kind TEXT;\n  v_source_id UUID;\n  v_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_root_order_item_id UUID;\n  v_root_parcel_instance_id UUID;\n  v_root_parcel_component_id UUID;\n  v_original_sale_operation_id UUID;\n  v_parent_replacement_item_id UUID;\n  v_capacity INTEGER;\n  v_consumed INTEGER;\n  v_wac NUMERIC(24, 6);\n  v_cogs BIGINT;\n  v_replacement_item_id UUID;\n  v_before INTEGER;\n  v_available INTEGER;\n  v_after INTEGER;\n  v_movement_id UUID;\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_total_quantity INTEGER := 0;\n  v_total_cogs BIGINT := 0;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner', 'admin'], 'إصدار استبدال مبيعات Phase 4.3');\n  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '42501',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_ACTOR_REQUIRED: Authenticated ERP actor is required.';\n  END IF;\n  v_key := public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(p_idempotency_key);\n  v_canonical := public.phase43_canonicalize_replacement_request_internal(\n    p_order_id, p_items, p_reason, p_notes\n  );\n  v_actor_hash := public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal('erp_user', v_user_id, NULL, NULL);\n  v_fingerprint := public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(v_canonical);\n  v_replay := public.phase43_resolve_replacement_replay_internal(\n    v_key, v_actor_hash, v_fingerprint\n  );\n  IF v_replay->>'decision' = 'REPLAY' THEN\n    RETURN v_replay->'result_snapshot';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_customer_order_context_internal(p_order_id, false, false);\n  SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.orders customer_order\n  WHERE customer_order.id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_order.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed'\n    OR v_order.branch_id IS NULL OR v_order.warehouse_id IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_ORIGINAL_SALE_INVALID: Replacement requires a completed sale with branch and warehouse evidence.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT operation.operation_type INTO v_creation_type\n  FROM public.business_operations operation WHERE operation.id = v_order.operation_id FOR SHARE;\n  IF v_creation_type IS NULL OR v_creation_type NOT IN ('phase3_pos_sale_v1', 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_SALE_CONTRACT_UNSUPPORTED: Only proven Phase-3 POS V2 and Customer V2 sales are supported.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical->'items')\n    ORDER BY value->>'source_kind', value->>'source_id'\n  LOOP\n    v_source_kind := v_item->>'source_kind';\n    v_source_id := (v_item->>'source_id')::UUID;\n    v_quantity := (v_item->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n    v_root_order_item_id := NULL;\n    v_root_parcel_instance_id := NULL;\n    v_root_parcel_component_id := NULL;\n    v_original_sale_operation_id := NULL;\n    v_parent_replacement_item_id := NULL;\n\n    IF v_source_kind = 'base_order_item' THEN\n      SELECT item.id, item.product_id, item.quantity\n      INTO v_root_order_item_id, v_product_id, v_capacity\n      FROM public.order_items item\n      WHERE item.id = v_source_id AND item.order_id = p_order_id\n        AND item.commercial_line_kind IN ('base_unit','legacy_single_sku_parcel');\n    ELSIF v_source_kind = 'parcel_component' THEN\n      SELECT order_item.id, instance.id, component.id, component.operation_id,\n        component.product_id, component.base_quantity\n      INTO v_root_order_item_id, v_root_parcel_instance_id,\n        v_root_parcel_component_id, v_original_sale_operation_id,\n        v_product_id, v_capacity\n      FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n      JOIN public.order_parcel_instances instance ON instance.id = component.parcel_instance_id\n      JOIN public.order_items order_item ON order_item.id = instance.order_item_id\n      WHERE component.id = v_source_id AND instance.order_id = p_order_id;\n    ELSE\n      SELECT item.root_order_item_id, item.root_parcel_instance_id,\n        item.root_parcel_component_id, item.original_sale_operation_id,\n        item.product_id, item.quantity, item.id\n      INTO v_root_order_item_id, v_root_parcel_instance_id,\n        v_root_parcel_component_id, v_original_sale_operation_id,\n        v_product_id, v_capacity, v_parent_replacement_item_id\n      FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n      JOIN public.sales_replacement_events event ON event.id = item.replacement_event_id\n      WHERE item.id = v_source_id AND event.root_order_id = p_order_id\n        AND event.replacement_status = 'settled'\n        AND event.issuance_status = 'issued'\n        AND event.issuance_coordinator_version = 403;\n      IF v_parent_replacement_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n        PERFORM public.phase43_assert_operational_replacement_evidence_internal(\n          (SELECT operation_id FROM public.sales_replacement_items WHERE id = v_parent_replacement_item_id), true\n        );\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_product_id IS NULL OR v_capacity IS NULL OR v_quantity > v_capacity THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_SOURCE_INVALID: Source is unavailable or quantity exceeds its immutable capacity.';\n    END IF;\n    PERFORM public.package_d_assert_whole_single_sku_quantity_internal(v_root_order_item_id,v_quantity);\n    v_prepared := v_prepared || JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'source_kind', v_source_kind, 'source_id', v_source_id,\n      'quantity', v_quantity, 'product_id', v_product_id,\n      'root_order_item_id', v_root_order_item_id,\n      'root_parcel_instance_id', v_root_parcel_instance_id,\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.package_d_validate_configurable_parcel_before_policy_internal(p_actor_scope_type text, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_family_product_id uuid, $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_configuration public.product_parcel_configurations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_capacity INTEGER;\n  v_family_is_master BOOLEAN;\n  v_components JSONB;\n  v_component_total BIGINT;\n  v_product_ids UUID[];\n  v_invalid_count INTEGER;\n  v_missing_wac_count INTEGER;\n  v_enriched JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.phase3_assert_configurable_parcel_creation_allowed_internal(\n    p_actor_scope_type, p_actor_user_id\n  );\n\n  IF p_configuration_revision IS NULL OR p_configuration_revision <= 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_CONFIGURATION_STALE: Parcel configuration revision is invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_configuration\n  FROM public.product_parcel_configurations configuration\n  WHERE configuration.id = p_parcel_configuration_id\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND\n    OR NOT v_configuration.is_active\n    OR v_configuration.composition_mode <> 'configurable_mix'\n    OR v_configuration.family_product_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_family_product_id\n    OR v_configuration.configuration_revision IS DISTINCT FROM p_configuration_revision\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_CONFIGURATION_STALE: Parcel configuration is unavailable or changed.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT product.units_per_sale_unit, product.is_flavor_master\n  INTO v_components := public.phase3_canonicalize_components_internal(p_components);\n  SELECT\n    SUM((component->>'base_quantity')::BIGINT),\n    ARRAY_AGG((component->>'product_id')::UUID ORDER BY (component->>'product_id')::UUID)\n  INTO v_component_total, v_product_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_components) component;\n\n  IF v_component_total IS DISTINCT FROM v_capacity::BIGINT THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'phase3_parcel_capacity_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_CAPACITY_MISMATCH: Parcel composition must equal configured capacity.';\n  END COALESCE(product.flavor_master_product_id, product.id)\n        IS DISTINCT FROM p_family_product_id\n  ), COUNT(*) FILTER (\n    WHERE product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact IS NULL\n  )\n  INTO CONSTRAINT = 'phase3_parcel_component_family_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_COMPONENT_FAMILY_MISMATCH: Parcel component is not a stocked SKU in the configured Family.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_missing_wac_count <> 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_EXACT_WAC_UNAVAILABLE: Exact WAC is required for configurable Parcel sale.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT JSONB_AGG(\n    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'product_id', LOWER(product.id::TEXT),\n      'base_quantity', (component->>'base_quantity')::INTEGER,\n      'product_name_snapshot', product.name_ar,\n      'sku_snapshot', product.sku,\n      'base_unit_name_snapshot', unit.name_ar,\n      'unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact', product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact\n    )\n    ORDER BY product.id\n  )\n  INTO v_enriched\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_components) component\n  JOIN public.products product\n    ON product.id = (component->>'product_id')::UUID\n  LEFT JOIN public.units unit ON unit.id = 'configuration_revision', p_configuration_revision,\n    'units_per_parcel', v_component_total,\n    'composition_fingerprint', public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(v_components),\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.parcel209_pos_customer_internal(p_warehouse_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_customer_name text, p_payment_method text, p_lines jsonb, p_discount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_amount_received_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  -- Apply the exact centralized POS authorization/MFA policy before any\n  -- Customer-specific lookup or lock.  The private implementation keeps the\n  -- same guard as defense in depth after this serialization boundary.\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'تنفيذ بيع نقطة البيع بالإصدار المحمي'\n  );\n\n  IF p_customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM 1\n    FROM public.customers customer\n    WHERE customer.id = p_customer_id\n    FOR KEY SHARE;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_CUSTOMER_INVALID: العميل المحدد غير موجود.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN public.parcel209_pos_sale_internal(\n    p_warehouse_id,\n    p_branch_id,\n    p_customer_id,\n    p_customer_name,\n    p_payment_method,\n    p_lines,\n    p_discount_in_minor_units,\n    p_amount_received_in_minor_units,\n    p_idempotency_key\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.parcel209_pos_sale_internal(p_warehouse_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid, p_customer_id uuid, p_customer_name text, p_payment_method text, p_lines jsonb, p_discount_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_amount_received_in_minor_units bigint DEFAULT 0, p_idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_key TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), '');\n  v_payment_method TEXT := LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_payment_method), ''), 'cash'));\n  v_customer_name TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_customer_name), ''), 'زبون نقدي');\n  v_customer_identity_hash TEXT;\n  v_actor_hash TEXT;\n  v_request JSONB;\n  v_canonical_request JSONB;\n  v_fingerprint TEXT;\n  v_replay JSONB;\n  v_line JSONB;\n  v_instance JSONB;\n  v_validated JSONB;\n  v_cogs_allocation JSONB;\n  v_plan_lines JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_final_lines JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_plan_instances JSONB;\n  v_final_instances JSONB;\n  v_plan_components JSONB;\n  v_line_weighted_keys JSONB;\n  v_instance_weighted_keys JSONB;\n  v_product_ids UUID[];\n  v_configuration_ids UUID[];\n  v_family_ids UUID[];\n  v_line_sequence INTEGER := 0;\n  v_line_kind TEXT;\n  v_product public.products%ROWTYPE;\n  v_order_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_operation_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_order_item_id UUID;\n  v_parcel_instance_id UUID;\n  v_order_number TEXT;\n  v_shift_id UUID;\n  v_base_unit_name TEXT;\n  v_parcel_unit_name TEXT;\n  v_commercial_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_base_quantity BIGINT;\n  v_units_per_parcel INTEGER;\n  v_unit_price BIGINT;\n  v_line_gross BIGINT;\n  v_line_cogs BIGINT;\n  v_unit_cost_exact NUMERIC(24,6);\n  v_line_exact_cogs NUMERIC(30,6);\n  v_line_discount BIGINT;\n  v_line_net BIGINT;\n  v_line_profit BIGINT;\n  v_instance_discount BIGINT;\n  v_subtotal BIGINT := 0;\n  v_total BIGINT;\n  v_paid BIGINT;\n  v_change BIGINT;\n  v_demand RECORD;\n  v_on_hand INTEGER;\n  v_reserved INTEGER;\n  v_balance_after INTEGER;\n  v_result_items JSONB;\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_component JSONB;\n  v_movement_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_constraint_name TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'تنفيذ بيع نقطة البيع بالإصدار المحمي'\n  );\n\n  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED: المستخدم الحالي غير مصادق عليه.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_key IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_IDEMPOTENCY_INPUT_INVALID: مفتاح إعادة المحاولة غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR p_branch_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_LOCATION_REQUIRED: المستودع والفرع مطلوبان.';\n  END IF;\n  IF COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, -1) < 0\n    OR COALESCE(p_amount_received_in_minor_units, -1) < 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_MONEY_INVALID: قيم الخصم أو المبلغ المستلم غير صالحة.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_payment_method NOT IN (\n    'cash', 'cliq', 'card', 'bank_transfer', 'debt', 'mixed'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PAYMENT_METHOD_INVALID: طريقة الدفع غير معتمدة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Cross-version order is deliberate: V1 and V2 first serialize on the exact\n  -- same raw-key lock.  Only then may V2 enter its versioned operation lock.\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(v_key));\n\n  v_actor_hash := public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal(\n    'erp_user', v_user_id, NULL, NULL\n  );\n  IF p_customer_id IS NULL THEN\n    v_customer_identity_hash := ENCODE(extensions.digest(\n      'phase3:walk-in-customer:v1|' || LOWER(v_customer_name),\n      'sha256'::TEXT\n    ), 'hex');\n  END IF;\n\n  v_request := JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'contract_version', 'phase3-sale-v1',\n    'actor_scope_type', 'erp_user',\n    'actor_scope_hash', v_actor_hash,\n    'operation_source', 'admin_pos',\n    'warehouse_id', p_warehouse_id,\n    'branch_id', p_branch_id,\n    'customer_id', p_customer_id,\n    'customer_identity_hash', v_customer_identity_hash,\n    'payment_method', v_payment_method,\n    'order_discount_in_minor_units', COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0),\n    'amount_received_in_minor_units', COALESCE(p_amount_received_in_minor_units, 0),\n    'lines', p_lines\n  );\n  v_canonical_request := public.phase3_canonicalize_sale_request_internal(v_request);\n  v_fingerprint := public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(v_canonical_request);\n  v_replay := public.phase3_resolve_operation_replay_internal(\n    'phase3_pos_sale_v1', v_key, 'erp_user', v_actor_hash, v_fingerprint\n  );\n  IF v_replay->>'decision' = 'REPLAY' THEN\n    RETURN v_replay->'result_snapshot';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- A key already consumed by V1 can never be reconstructed as a proven V2\n  -- request.  Reject generically without exposing the historical order.\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.orders existing_order\n    WHERE existing_order.idempotency_key = v_key\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Operation identity is unavailable.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM 1\n  FROM public.warehouses warehouse\n  WHERE warehouse.id = p_warehouse_id\n    AND warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id\n    AND warehouse.is_active;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_LOCATION_INVALID: المستودع لا يتبع الفرع المحدد أو غير نشط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    SELECT customer.full_name INTO v_customer_name\n    FROM public.customers customer\n    WHERE customer.id = p_customer_id;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_CUSTOMER_INVALID: العميل المحدد غير موجود.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF v_payment_method = 'debt' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_DEBT_CUSTOMER_REQUIRED: البيع الآجل يحتاج عميلاً مسجلاً.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Shift precedes configuration/product/inventory locks throughout the paid\n  -- operational paths and their reversal orchestrator.\n  SELECT shift.id INTO v_shift_id\n  FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n  WHERE shift.branch_id = p_branch_id AND shift.status = 'open'\n  ORDER BY shift.id\n  LIMIT 1\n  FOR SHARE;\n  IF v_shift_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_OPEN_SHIFT_REQUIRED: افتح وردية الصندوق قبل إتمام البيع.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical_request->'lines') candidate\n    WHERE candidate->>'commercial_line_kind' = 'configurable_parcel'\n  ) THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase3_assert_configurable_parcel_creation_allowed_internal(\n      'erp_user', v_user_id\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical_request->'lines') candidate\n    WHERE COALESCE((candidate->>'line_discount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT, 0) <> 0\n      OR candidate->>'price_authority' <> 'server_catalog'\n      OR candidate->'commercial_unit_price_override_in_minor_units' <> 'null'::JSONB\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PRICE_AUTHORITY_INVALID: هذا المسار يعتمد سعر الخادم وخصم الطلب الحالي فقط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.parcel209_guard_modern_lines_internal(v_canonical_request->'lines');\n\n  SELECT\n    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT (candidate->>'parcel_configuration_id')::UUID\n      ORDER BY (candidate->>'parcel_configuration_id')::UUID),\n    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT (candidate->>'family_product_id')::UUID\n      ORDER BY (candidate->>'family_product_id')::UUID)\n  INTO v_configuration_ids, v_family_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical_request->'lines') candidate\n  WHERE candidate->>'commercial_line_kind' = 'configurable_parcel';\n\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_configuration_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM configuration.id\n    FROM public.product_parcel_configurations configuration\n    WHERE configuration.id = ANY(v_configuration_ids)\n    ORDER BY configuration.id\n    FOR SHARE;\n\n    PERFORM family.id\n    FROM public.products family\n    WHERE family.id = ANY(v_family_ids)\n    ORDER BY family.id\n    FOR SHARE;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT identity.product_id ORDER BY identity.product_id)\n  INTO v_product_ids\n  FROM (\n    SELECT (candidate->>'product_id')::UUID AS product_id\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical_request->'lines') candidate\n    WHERE candidate->>'commercial_line_kind' IN ('base_unit', 'legacy_single_sku_parcel')\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT (component->>'product_id')::UUID\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical_request->'lines') candidate\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(candidate->'parcel_instances') parcel\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(parcel->'components') component\n    WHERE candidate->>'commercial_line_kind' = 'configurable_parcel'\n  ) identity;\n\n  -- Family is commercial identity, never stock identity. Keep its shared\n  -- snapshot lock ahead of the global stock-product hierarchy, but never pass\n  -- it to the inventory helper (which would attempt a row-lock upgrade).\n  PERFORM public.phase3_lock_inventory_products_internal(v_product_ids);\n\n  -- Build a complete immutable plan before any business row is inserted.\n  FOR v_line IN\n    SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical_request->'lines')\n    ORDER BY value::TEXT\n  LOOP\n    v_line_sequence := v_line_sequence + 1;\n    v_order_item_id := gen_random_uuid();\n    v_line_kind := v_line->>'commercial_line_kind';\n    v_plan_instances := '[]'::JSONB;\n    v_unit_cost_exact := NULL;\n    v_line_exact_cogs := NULL;\n\n    IF v_line_kind = 'base_unit' THEN\n      SELECT * INTO v_product FROM public.products\n      WHERE id = (v_line->>'product_id')::UUID AND is_active;\n      IF NOT FOUND OR v_product.is_flavor_master THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PRODUCT_INVALID: منتج الوحدة الأساسية غير صالح للبيع.';\n      END IF;\n      v_commercial_quantity := (v_line->>'base_quantity')::INTEGER;\n      v_base_quantity := v_commercial_quantity;\n      v_units_per_parcel := 1;\n      v_unit_price := v_product.sale_price_in_minor_units;\n      v_unit_cost_exact := COALESCE(v_product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,\n        v_product.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC);\n      v_line_exact_cogs := ROUND(v_base_quantity::NUMERIC * v_unit_cost_exact, 6);\n      -- Round once at the financial line boundary, never per physical unit.\n      v_line_cogs := ROUND(v_line_exact_cogs)::BIGINT;\n      SELECT COALESCE(unit.name_ar, 'وحدة') INTO v_base_unit_name\n      FROM public.units unit WHERE unit.id = v_product.unit_id;\n      v_base_unit_name := COALESCE(v_base_unit_name, 'وحدة');\n      v_parcel_unit_name := v_base_unit_name;\n    ELSIF v_line_kind = 'legacy_single_sku_parcel' THEN\n      SELECT * INTO v_product FROM public.products\n      WHERE id = (v_line->>'product_id')::UUID AND is_active;\n      IF NOT FOUND THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PRODUCT_INVALID: منتج الطرد التجاري غير صالح للبيع.';\n      END IF;\n      IF v_product.units_per_sale_unit IS DISTINCT FROM\n          (v_line->>'units_per_parcel')::INTEGER\n        OR COALESCE(v_product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units, 0) <= 0\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PRICE_OR_PACKAGE_STALE: إعداد الطرد أو سعره تغير.';\n      END IF;\n      v_commercial_quantity := (v_line->>'parcel_quantity')::INTEGER;\n      v_units_per_parcel := v_product.units_per_sale_unit;\n      v_base_quantity := v_commercial_quantity::BIGINT * v_units_per_parcel::BIGINT;\n      IF v_base_quantity > 2147483647 THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22003',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_QUANTITY_OVERFLOW: كمية الوحدات الأساسية تتجاوز الحد الآمن.';\n      END IF;\n      v_unit_price := v_product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units;\n      v_unit_cost_exact := COALESCE(v_product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,\n        v_product.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC);\n      v_line_exact_cogs := ROUND(v_base_quantity::NUMERIC * v_unit_cost_exact, 6);\n      -- Round once at the financial line boundary, never per physical unit.\n      v_line_cogs := ROUND(v_line_exact_cogs)::BIGINT;\n      SELECT COALESCE(base_unit.name_ar, 'وحدة'), COALESCE(parcel_unit.name_ar, 'طرد')\n      INTO v_base_unit_name, v_parcel_unit_name\n      FROM public.products product\n      LEFT JOIN public.units base_unit ON base_unit.id = product.unit_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.units parcel_unit ON parcel_unit.id = product.sale_unit_id\n      WHERE product.id = v_product.id;\n    ELSE\n      SELECT * INTO v_product FROM public.products\n      WHERE id = (v_line->>'family_product_id')::UUID AND is_active;\n      IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_product.is_flavor_master\n        OR COALESCE(v_product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units, 0) <= 0\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PRICE_OR_PACKAGE_STALE: عائلة الطرد أو سعرها غير صالح.';\n      END IF;\n      v_commercial_quantity := (v_line->>'parcel_quantity')::INTEGER;\n      v_units_per_parcel := v_product.units_per_sale_unit;\n      v_base_quantity := v_commercial_quantity::BIGINT * v_units_per_parcel::BIGINT;\n      v_unit_price := v_product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units;\n      v_line_cogs := 0;\n      SELECT COALESCE(base_unit.name_ar, 'وحدة'), COALESCE(parcel_unit.name_ar, 'طرد')\n      INTO         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase2_allocate_largest_remainder_internal(p_total bigint, p_weighted_keys jsonb)\n RETURNS TABLE(allocation_key text, allocated_amount bigint)\n LANGUAGE sql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  WITH parsed AS (\n    SELECT\n      NULLIF(BTRIM(item->>'key'), '') AS allocation_key,\n      (item->>'weight')::NUMERIC AS weight\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p_weighted_keys, '[]'::JSONB)) item\n  ), basis AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(weight), 0::NUMERIC) AS total_weight FROM parsed\n  ), shares AS (\n    SELECT\n      parsed.allocation_key,\n      CASE\n        WHEN p_total = 0 OR basis.total_weight = 0 THEN 0::BIGINT\n        ELSE FLOOR((p_total::NUMERIC * parsed.weight) / basis.total_weight)::BIGINT\n      END AS base_amount,\n      CASE\n        WHEN p_total = 0 OR basis.total_weight = 0 THEN 0::NUMERIC\n        ELSE (p_total::NUMERIC * parsed.weight) / basis.total_weight\n          - FLOOR((p_total::NUMERIC * parsed.weight) / basis.total_weight)\n      END AS fractional_remainder\n    FROM parsed CROSS JOIN basis\n  ), residual AS (\n    SELECT p_total - COALESCE(SUM(base_amount), 0) AS units FROM shares\n  ), ranked AS (\n    SELECT\n      shares.*,\n      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n        ORDER BY fractional_remainder DESC, allocation_key ASC\n      ) AS residual_rank\n    FROM shares\n  )\n  SELECT\n    ranked.allocation_key,\n    ranked.base_amount\n      + CASE WHEN ranked.residual_rank <= residual.units THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\n  FROM ranked CROSS JOIN residual\n  ORDER BY ranked.allocation_key;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(p_product_ids uuid[])\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_ids UUID[];v_id UUID;v_requested INTEGER;v_found INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT count(DISTINCT id) INTO v_requested FROM unnest(p_product_ids) id WHERE id IS NOT NULL;\n  IF v_requested=0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023',MESSAGE='PHASE2_PRODUCT_LOCK_SET_EMPTY: مجموعة منتجات الاستلام فارغة.';\n  END IF;\n  v_ids:=public.parcel209_inventory_family_set_internal(p_product_ids);\n  FOREACH v_id IN ARRAY v_ids LOOP\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('inventory-product:'||v_id::TEXT,0));\n  END LOOP;\n  -- A newly created/moved flavor cannot be added late to an already locked set.\n  IF v_ids IS DISTINCT FROM public.parcel209_inventory_family_set_internal(p_product_ids) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='PARCEL209_FAMILY_CHANGED_RETRY: تغيّرت النكهات؛ حدّث البيانات ثم أعد المحاولة.';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM b.id FROM public.inventory_balances b WHERE b.product_id=ANY(v_ids)\n    ORDER BY b.product_id,b.warehouse_id FOR UPDATE;\n  PERFORM p.id FROM public.products p WHERE p.id=ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY p.id FOR NO KEY UPDATE;\n  SELECT count(*) INTO v_found FROM public.products p WHERE p.id=ANY(p_product_ids);\n  IF v_found<>v_requested THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23503',CONSTRAINT='phase2_receipt_product_lock_set_check',\n      MESSAGE='PHASE2_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: أحد منتجات الاستلام غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_ids IS DISTINCT FROM public.parcel209_inventory_family_set_internal(p_product_ids) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='PARCEL209_FAMILY_CHANGED_RETRY: تغيّرت النكهات؛ حدّث البيانات ثم أعد المحاولة.';\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase2_lock_payment_shift_internal(p_branch_id uuid, p_payment_method text, p_amount bigint)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  -- Callers pass the payment method after applying their own existing contract.\n  -- Keep this comparison exact so lock selection cannot broaden accepted inputs.\n  IF p_amount > 0 AND p_payment_method IN ('cash', 'cliq') THEN\n    IF p_branch_id IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_PAYMENT_BRANCH_REQUIRED: تعذر تحديد فرع دفعة المورد.';\n    END IF;\n    PERFORM shift.id FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n    WHERE shift.branch_id = p_branch_id AND shift.status = 'open'\n    ORDER BY shift.id FOR SHARE;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_OPEN_SHIFT_REQUIRED: افتح وردية الصندوق قبل تسجيل دفعة المورد.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase2_reverse_inventory_and_wac_internal(p_original_operation_id uuid, p_reversal_operation_id uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid, p_source_kind text, p_source_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_reason text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_snapshot public.phase2_receipt_wac_snapshots%ROWTYPE;\n  v_original_movement public.inventory_movements%ROWTYPE;\n  v_target_on_hand INTEGER;\n  v_target_reserved INTEGER;\n  v_global_on_hand INTEGER;\n  v_current_exact NUMERIC(24, 6);\n  v_current_legacy BIGINT;\n  v_running_balance INTEGER;\n  v_reversed_units INTEGER := 0;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_source_kind NOT IN ('supplier_receipt', 'purchase_receipt') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE2_REVERSAL_SOURCE_INVALID';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY(\n    SELECT snapshot.product_id\n    FROM public.phase2_receipt_wac_snapshots snapshot\n    WHERE snapshot.operation_id = p_original_operation_id\n    ORDER BY snapshot.product_id\n  ));\n\n  FOR v_snapshot IN\n    SELECT * FROM public.phase2_receipt_wac_snapshots snapshot\n    WHERE snapshot.operation_id = p_original_operation_id\n    ORDER BY snapshot.product_id\n  LOOP\n    SELECT\n      product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,\n      product.cost_price_in_minor_units\n    INTO v_current_exact, v_current_legacy\n    FROM public.products product\n    WHERE product.id = v_snapshot.product_id;\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance.on_hand_quantity), 0)::INTEGER\n    INTO v_global_on_hand\n    FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n    WHERE balance.product_id = v_snapshot.product_id;\n    SELECT balance.on_hand_quantity, balance.reserved_quantity\n    INTO v_target_on_hand, v_target_reserved\n    FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n    WHERE balance.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n      AND balance.product_id = v_snapshot.product_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    IF v_current_exact IS DISTINCT FROM v_snapshot.resulting_exact_wac_in_minor_units\n      OR v_current_legacy IS DISTINCT FROM v_snapshot.resulting_legacy_wac_in_minor_units\n      OR v_global_on_hand IS DISTINCT FROM\n        v_snapshot.opening_global_quantity + v_snapshot.received_base_quantity\n      OR COALESCE(v_target_on_hand, 0) - v_snapshot.received_base_quantity\n        < COALESCE(v_target_reserved, 0)\n      OR EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_movements movement\n        WHERE movement.product_id = v_snapshot.product_id\n          AND movement.mutation_sequence > v_snapshot.receipt_movement_sequence_max\n      )\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_REVERSAL_UNSAFE: تحرك المخزون أو تغير WAC بعد السند؛ يلزم مسار تصحيحي مستقل.';\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  FOR v_snapshot IN\n    SELECT * FROM public.phase2_receipt_wac_snapshots snapshot\n    WHERE snapshot.operation_id = p_original_operation_id\n    ORDER BY snapshot.product_id\n  LOOP\n    SELECT balance.on_hand_quantity\n    INTO v_running_balance\n    FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n    WHERE balance.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n      AND balance.product_id = v_snapshot.product_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    FOR v_original_movement IN\n      SELECT movement.*\n      FROM public.inventory_movements movement\n      WHERE movement.operation_id = p_original_operation_id\n        AND movement.product_id = v_snapshot.product_id\n        AND movement.movement_type = 'purchase_receipt'\n      ORDER BY movement.mutation_sequence DESC\n    LOOP\n      INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements (\n        warehouse_id, product_id, movement_type, quantity,\n        balance_before, balance_after, reference_type, reference_id,\n        notes, created_by, operation_id, reversed_movement_id\n      ) VALUES (\n        p_warehouse_id, v_snapshot.product_id, 'return_out',\n        -v_original_movement.quantity,\n        v_running_balance,\n        v_running_balance - v_original_movement.quantity,\n        p_source_kind || '_cancellation', p_source_id,\n        'عكس استلام Phase 2: ' || p_reason,\n        p_user_id, p_reversal_operation_id, v_original_movement.id\n      );\n      v_running_balance := v_running_balance - v_original_movement.quantity;\n      v_reversed_units := v_reversed_units + v_original_movement.quantity;\n    END LOOP;\n\n    UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n    SET on_hand_quantity = v_running_balance, updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n      AND product_id = v_snapshot.product_id;\n    UPDATE public.products\n    SET\n      wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact = CASE\n        WHEN v_snapshot.opening_global_quantity = 0 THEN NULL\n        ELSE v_snapshot.prior_exact_wac_in_minor_units\n      END,\n      cost_price_in_minor_units = v_snapshot.prior_legacy_wac_in_minor_units,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE id = v_snapshot.product_id;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'reversed_base_units', v_reversed_units,\n    'original_operation_id', p_original_operation_id,\n    'reversal_operation_id', p_reversal_operation_id\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase2_validate_receipt_lines_internal(p_lines jsonb)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_line JSONB;\n  v_component JSONB;\n  v_line_kind TEXT;\n  v_family_id UUID;\n  v_configuration_id UUID;\n  v_configuration_revision INTEGER;\n  v_commercial_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_units_per_parcel INTEGER;\n  v_gross BIGINT;\n  v_line_discount BIGINT;\n  v_line_net BIGINT;\n  v_component_count INTEGER;\n  v_explicit_count INTEGER;\n  v_component_quantity NUMERIC;\n  v_explicit_total NUMERIC;\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_product_family UUID;\n  v_is_master BOOLEAN;\n  v_is_active BOOLEAN;\n  v_config public.product_parcel_configurations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_family public.products%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_lines IS NULL\n    OR jsonb_typeof(p_lines) <> 'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_lines) = 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_LINES_REQUIRED: يجب إضافة سطر استلام واحد على الأقل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) line\n    GROUP BY (line->>'client_line_id')::UUID\n    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23505',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_client_line_identity_unique',\n      MESSAGE = 'DUPLICATE_COMMERCIAL_LINE_IDENTITY: هوية السطر التجاري مكررة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_line IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_lines)\n  LOOP\n    PERFORM (v_line->>'client_line_id')::UUID;\n    v_line_kind := LOWER(BTRIM(v_line->>'line_kind'));\n    v_family_id := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'family_product_id'), '')::UUID;\n    v_configuration_id :=\n      NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'parcel_configuration_id'), '')::UUID;\n    v_configuration_revision :=\n      NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'configuration_revision'), '')::INTEGER;\n    v_commercial_quantity := (v_line->>'commercial_quantity')::INTEGER;\n    v_units_per_parcel :=\n      NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'units_per_parcel'), '')::INTEGER;\n    v_gross := (v_line->>'gross_amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;\n    v_line_discount :=\n      COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'line_discount_in_minor_units'), '')::BIGINT, 0);\n\n    IF v_line_kind NOT IN ('base_unit', 'configurable_parcel') THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '22023',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_LINE_KIND_INVALID: نوع السطر التجاري غير مدعوم.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_commercial_quantity <= 0 OR v_gross < 0 OR v_line_discount < 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '22023',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_LINE_VALUE_INVALID: الكمية والأسعار والخصومات يجب أن تكون ضمن الحدود المسموحة.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_line_discount > v_gross THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_line_discount_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_LINE_DISCOUNT_EXCEEDS_GROSS: خصم السطر يتجاوز إجماليه.';\n    END IF;\n    IF NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'base_unit_name'), '') IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '22023',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_BASE_UNIT_NAME_REQUIRED: اسم وحدة المخزون الأساسية مطلوب.';\n    END IF;\n\n    v_line_net := v_gross - v_line_discount;\n    v_component_count := jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(v_line->'components', '[]'::JSONB));\n    IF v_component_count = 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '22023',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_RECEIPT_COMPONENTS_REQUIRED: مكونات السطر التجاري مطلوبة.';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_line->'components') component\n      GROUP BY (component->>'product_id')::UUID\n      HAVING COUNT(*) > 1\n    ) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23505',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_component_identity_unique',\n        MESSAGE = 'DUPLICATE_COMPONENT_IDENTITY: لا يجوز تكرار نفس SKU داخل السطر التجاري.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (\n        WHERE NULLIF(BTRIM(component->>'explicit_merchandise_cost_in_minor_units'), '') IS NOT NULL\n      ),\n      COALESCE(SUM((component->>'base_quantity')::NUMERIC), 0),\n      COALESCE(SUM(\n        NULLIF(BTRIM(component->>'explicit_merchandise_cost_in_minor_units'), '')::NUMERIC\n      ), 0)\n    INTO v_explicit_count, v_component_quantity, v_explicit_total\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_line->'components') component;\n\n    IF v_explicit_count NOT IN (0, v_component_count) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_component_cost_completeness_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'PARTIAL_EXPLICIT_COMPONENT_COST: يجب إدخال تكلفة كل المكونات أو عدم إدخالها كلها.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_explicit_count = v_component_count\n      AND v_explicit_total IS DISTINCT FROM v_line_net::NUMERIC\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_component_merchandise_cost_total_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'EXPLICIT_COMPONENT_COST_MISMATCH: تكاليف المكونات لا تطابق صافي السطر التجاري.';\n    END IF;\n\n    FOR v_component IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_line->'components')\n    LOOP\n      v_product_id := (v_component->>'product_id')::UUID;\n      IF (v_component->>'base_quantity')::INTEGER <= 0 THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '22023',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_COMPONENT_QUANTITY_INVALID: كمية مكون SKU يجب أن تكون موجبة.';\n      END IF;\n      IF NULLIF(BTRIM(v_component->>'explicit_merchandise_cost_in_minor_units'), '')::BIGINT < 0 THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '22023',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_COMPONENT_COST_INVALID: تكلفة مكون SKU لا يمكن أن تكون سالبة.';\n      END IF;\n\n      SELECT\n        COALESCE(product.flavor_master_product_id, product.id),\n        product.is_flavor_master,\n        product.is_active\n      INTO v_product_family, v_is_master, v_is_active\n      FROM public.products product\n      WHERE product.id = v_product_id;\n\n      IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_is_active OR v_is_master THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '23514',\n          CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_stocked_sku_check',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_STOCKED_SKU_REQUIRED: الاستلام يقبل SKU مخزنيًا نشطًا فقط.';\n      END IF;\n      IF v_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel'\n        AND v_product_family IS DISTINCT FROM v_family_id\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '23514',\n          CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_component_family_check',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_COMPONENT_FAMILY_MISMATCH: مكون الطرد خارج العائلة التجارية.';\n      END IF;\n    END LOOP;\n\n    IF v_component_quantity > 2147483647::NUMERIC THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '22003',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_COMPONENT_QUANTITY_OVERFLOW: إجمالي كمية المكونات يتجاوز الحد المدعوم.';\n    END IF;\n\n    IF v_line_kind = 'base_unit' THEN\n      IF v_family_id IS NOT NULL\n        OR v_configuration_id IS NOT NULL\n        OR v_configuration_revision IS NOT NULL\n        OR v_units_per_parcel IS NOT NULL\n        OR NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'parcel_unit_name'), '') IS NOT NULL\n        OR v_component_count <> 1\n        OR v_component_quantity <> v_commercial_quantity::NUMERIC\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '23514',\n          CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_base_unit_line_shape_check',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_BASE_UNIT_LINE_INVALID: سطر الوحدة الأساسية يجب أن يحتوي SKU واحدًا وكمية مطابقة.';\n      END IF;\n    ELSE\n      PERFORM public.assert_configurable_parcel_creation_allowed();\n\n      SELECT * INTO v_config\n      FROM public.product_parcel_configurations configuration\n      WHERE configuration.id = v_configuration_id\n      FOR SHARE;\n      SELECT * INTO v_family\n      FROM public.products product\n      WHERE product.id = v_family_id\n      FOR SHARE;\n\n      IF v_config.id IS NULL\n        OR NOT v_config.is_active\n        OR v_config.composition_mode <> 'configurable_mix'\n        OR v_config.family_product_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_family_id\n        OR v_config.configuration_revision IS DISTINCT FROM v_configuration_revision\n        OR v_family.id IS NULL\n        OR NOT v_family.is_flavor_master\n        OR v_units_per_parcel IS DISTINCT FROM v_family.units_per_sale_unit\n        OR NULLIF(BTRIM(v_line->>'parcel_unit_name'), '') IS NULL\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '23514',\n          CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_parcel_configuration_check',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_PARCEL_CONFIGURATION_MISMATCH: إعداد الطرد أو نسخته أو سعته غير متطابقة.';\n      END IF;\n\n      IF v_component_quantity\n        <> v_commercial_quantity::NUMERIC * v_units_per_parcel::NUMERIC\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n          ERRCODE = '23514',\n          CONSTRAINT = 'phase2_receipt_parcel_capacity_check',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE2_PARCEL_CAPACITY_MISMATCH: مجموع وحدات الطرد لا يطابق العدد والسعة.';\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase35_report_base_unit_count_internal(p_order_item_id uuid, p_commercial_line_kind text, p_legacy_quantity integer)\n RETURNS bigint\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT CASE\n    WHEN p_commercial_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel' THEN COALESCE((\n      SELECT SUM(component.base_quantity)::BIGINT\n      FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n      JOIN public.order_parcel_components component\n        ON component.parcel_instance_id = instance.id\n      WHERE instance.order_item_id = p_order_item_id\n    ), 0::BIGINT)\n    ELSE COALESCE(p_legacy_quantity, 0)::BIGINT\n  END;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase35_report_package_count_internal(p_order_item_id uuid, p_commercial_line_kind text, p_sale_package_quantity integer, p_units_per_sale_package integer)\n RETURNS bigint\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT CASE\n    WHEN p_commercial_line_kind = 'base_unit' THEN 0::BIGINT\n    WHEN p_commercial_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel' THEN (\n      SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT\n      FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n      WHERE instance.order_item_id = p_order_item_id\n    )\n    WHEN p_commercial_line_kind = 'legacy_single_sku_parcel' THEN\n      COALESCE(p_sale_package_quantity, 0)::BIGINT\n    WHEN p_commercial_line_kind IS NULL\n      AND p_sale_package_quantity IS NOT NULL\n      AND p_units_per_sale_package IS NOT NULL\n      AND p_units_per_sale_package > 0\n    THEN p_sale_package_quantity::BIGINT\n    ELSE 0::BIGINT\n  END;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal(p_actor_scope_type text, p_erp_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_guest_phone_hash text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_guest_session_hash text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_scope_type TEXT := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_actor_scope_type), ''));\n  v_material TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF v_scope_type = 'erp_user' THEN\n    IF p_erp_user_id IS NULL OR p_guest_phone_hash IS NOT NULL\n      OR p_guest_session_hash IS NOT NULL\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_SCOPE_INVALID: ERP actor scope is malformed.';\n    END IF;\n    v_material := 'phase3:erp_user:v1|' || LOWER(p_erp_user_id::TEXT);\n  ELSIF v_scope_type = 'guest_gateway' THEN\n    IF p_erp_user_id IS NOT NULL\n      OR COALESCE(p_guest_phone_hash, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\n      OR COALESCE(p_guest_session_hash, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_SCOPE_INVALID: Guest actor scope is malformed.';\n    END IF;\n    v_material := 'phase3:guest_gateway:v1|'\n      || p_guest_phone_hash || '|' || p_guest_session_hash;\n  ELSIF v_scope_type = 'system_job' THEN\n    IF p_erp_user_id IS NOT NULL OR p_guest_phone_hash IS NOT NULL\n      OR p_guest_session_hash IS NOT NULL\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_SCOPE_INVALID: System actor scope is malformed.';\n    END IF;\n    v_material := 'phase3:system_job:v1|customer-reservation-lifecycle';\n  ELSE\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_SCOPE_INVALID: Unsupported actor scope.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN ENCODE(extensions.digest(v_material, 'sha256'::TEXT), 'hex');\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_allocate_parcel_cogs_internal(p_components jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_duplicate_count INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  IF JSONB_TYPEOF(p_components) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'\n    OR JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(p_components) = 0\n    OR JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(p_components) > 200\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_COGS_INPUT_INVALID: COGS components are invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT component->>'product_id')\n  INTO v_duplicate_count\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_components) component;\n  IF v_duplicate_count <> 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_COGS_INPUT_INVALID: COGS components must be canonical and unique.';\n  END IF;\n\n  BEGIN\n    WITH parsed AS (\n      SELECT\n        (component->>'product_id')::UUID AS product_id,\n        (component->>'base_quantity')::INTEGER AS base_quantity,\n        (component->>'unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact')::NUMERIC(24, 6)\n          AS unit_cost,\n        (component->>'base_quantity')::INTEGER\n          * (component->>'unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact')::NUMERIC(24, 6)\n          AS exact_cost\n      FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_components) component\n    ), validated AS (\n      SELECT * FROM parsed\n      WHERE base_quantity > 0 AND unit_cost >= 0\n    ), totals AS (\n      SELECT\n        ROUND(SUM(exact_cost), 0)::BIGINT AS target_total,\n        SUM(FLOOR(exact_cost))::BIGINT AS floor_total,\n        COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS item_count\n      FROM validated\n    ), ranked AS (\n      SELECT\n        validated.*,\n        FLOOR(exact_cost)::BIGINT AS floor_cost,\n        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (\n          ORDER BY exact_cost - FLOOR(exact_cost) DESC, product_id\n        )::BIGINT AS residual_rank,\n        totals.target_total,\n        totals.target_total - totals.floor_total AS residual,\n        totals.item_count\n      FROM validated CROSS JOIN totals\n    )\n    SELECT JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'rounding_boundary', 'parcel_instance',\n      'total_cogs_in_minor_units', MAX(target_total),\n      'components', JSONB_AGG(\n        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n          'product_id', LOWER(product_id::TEXT),\n          'base_quantity', base_quantity,\n          'unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact', unit_cost,\n          'exact_cogs_in_minor_units', exact_cost,\n          'allocated_cogs_in_minor_units',\n            floor_cost + CASE WHEN residual_rank <= residual THEN 1 ELSE 0 END\n        )\n        ORDER BY product_id\n      )\n    )\n    INTO v_result\n    FROM ranked;\n  EXCEPTION\n    WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_COGS_INPUT_INVALID: COGS component values are malformed.';\n  END;\n\n  IF v_result IS NULL\n    OR JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(v_result->'components') <> JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(p_components)\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_COGS_INPUT_INVALID: COGS component values are invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_assert_configurable_parcel_creation_allowed_internal(p_actor_scope_type text, p_actor_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_scope_type TEXT := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_actor_scope_type), ''));\n  v_state TEXT := public.get_configurable_parcel_feature_state();\nBEGIN\n  IF v_scope_type = 'erp_user' THEN\n    IF p_actor_user_id IS NULL\n      OR auth.uid() IS NULL\n      OR p_actor_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid()\n      OR NOT public.is_active_erp_staff()\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED: ERP actor is not authorized.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF v_scope_type = 'guest_gateway' THEN\n    IF p_actor_user_id IS NOT NULL OR auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Guest gateway proof is invalid.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Unsupported actor scope.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_state = 'ENABLED' THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n  IF v_state = 'OWNER_PILOT'\n    AND v_scope_type = 'erp_user'\n    AND public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'])\n  THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n\n  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n    MESSAGE = 'CONFIGURABLE_PARCEL_DISABLED: الوظيفة غير مفعلة لإنشاء عمليات جديدة.';\nEND;\n$function$\n",

= 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Parcel components must be a non-empty array.';\n  END IF;\n  IF JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(p_components) > 200 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Parcel component entry limit exceeded.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_component IN SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_components)\n  LOOP\n    IF JSONB_TYPEOF(v_component) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Parcel component must be an object.';\n    END IF;\n    PERFORM public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n      v_component->>'product_id', 'component product_id'\n    );\n    PERFORM public.phase3_require_positive_integer_internal(\n      v_component->>'base_quantity', 'component base_quantity'\n    );\n  END LOOP;\n\n  SELECT SUM(quantity), JSONB_AGG(\n    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'product_id', LOWER(product_id::TEXT),\n      'base_quantity', quantity\n    )\n    ORDER BY product_id\n  )\n  INTO v_total, v_result\n  FROM (\n    SELECT\n      (component->>'product_id')::UUID AS product_id,\n      SUM((component->>'base_quantity')::BIGINT) AS quantity\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_components) component\n    GROUP BY (component->>'product_id')::UUID\n  ) normalized;\n\n  IF v_total > 2147483647\n    OR EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_result) component\n      WHERE BIGINT;\n  v_price_override BIGINT;\n  v_price_authority TEXT;\n  v_total_commercial_quantity BIGINT := 0;\n  v_total_instances INTEGER := 0;\n  v_branch_id UUID;\n  v_customer_id UUID;\n  v_customer_hash TEXT;\n  v_delivery_hash TEXT;\n  v_amount_received BIGINT;\nBEGIN\n  IF JSONB_TYPEOF(p_request) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n    OR p_request->>'contract_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'phase3-sale-v1'\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Unsupported sale contract version.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_actor_scope_type := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'actor_scope_type'), ''));\n  v_actor_scope_hash := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'actor_scope_hash'), ''));\n  v_source := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'operation_source'), ''));\n  IF v_actor_scope_type NOT IN ('erp_user', 'guest_gateway')\n    OR COALESCE(v_actor_scope_hash, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\n    OR v_source NOT IN ('admin_pos', 'customer_reservation')\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Actor or operation source is invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n    p_request->>'warehouse_id', 'warehouse_id'\n  );\n  IF NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'branch_id'), '') IS NOT NULL THEN\n    v_branch_id := public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n      p_request->>'branch_id', 'branch_id'\n    );\n  END IF;\n  IF NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'customer_id'), '') IS NOT NULL THEN\n    v_customer_id := public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n      p_request->>'customer_id', 'customer_id'\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  v_customer_hash := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'customer_identity_hash'), ''));\n  v_delivery_hash := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'delivery_identity_hash'), ''));\n  IF (v_customer_hash IS NOT NULL AND v_customer_hash !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')\n    OR (v_delivery_hash IS NOT NULL AND v_delivery_hash !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Privacy-safe customer or delivery identity is invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NULLIF(BTRIM(p_request->>'amount_received_in_minor_units'), '') IS NOT NULL THEN\n    v_amount_received := public.phase3_require_nonnegative_bigint_internal(\n      p_request->>'amount_received_in_minor_units',\n      'amount_received_in_minor_units'\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  v_lines := p_request->'lines';\n  IF JSONB_TYPEOF(v_lines) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'\n    OR JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(v_lines) = 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Sale lines must be a non-empty array.';\n  END IF;\n  IF         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_customer_cost_finalization_allowed_internal(p_order_id uuid, p_row_kind text, p_row_id uuid)\n RETURNS boolean\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT\n    EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.orders customer_order\n      JOIN public.business_operations creation\n        ON creation.id = customer_order.operation_id\n      WHERE customer_order.id = p_order_id\n        AND customer_order.source = 'website'\n        AND customer_order.status IN ('ready', 'out_for_delivery')\n        AND customer_order.cost_finalized_at IS NULL\n        AND creation.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1'\n    )\n    AND EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.phase3_customer_cost_finalization_guards guard_authorization\n      WHERE guard_authorization.transaction_id = pg_current_xact_id()\n        AND guard_authorization.order_id = p_order_id\n        AND guard_authorization.row_kind = p_row_kind\n        AND guard_authorization.row_id = p_row_id\n        AND guard_authorization.lifecycle_operation_id::TEXT = CURRENT_SETTING(\n          'nawasrah.customer_cost_finalization_operation_id', true\n        )\n    );\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_customer_line_identity_internal(p_line jsonb)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n IMMUTABLE\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_kind TEXT := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_line->>'commercial_line_kind'), ''));\nBEGIN\n  IF v_kind = 'base_unit' THEN\n    RETURN 'base_unit:' || LOWER(public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n      p_line->>'product_id', 'quote product_id'\n    )::TEXT);\n  ELSIF v_kind = 'legacy_single_sku_parcel' THEN\n    RETURN 'legacy_single_sku_parcel:' || LOWER(public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n      p_line->>'product_id', 'quote product_id'\n    )::TEXT);\n  ELSIF v_kind = 'configurable_parcel' THEN\n    RETURN 'configurable_parcel:'\n      || LOWER(public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n        p_line->>'family_product_id', 'quote family_product_id'\n      )::TEXT) || ':'\n      || LOWER(public.phase3_require_uuid_internal(\n        p_line->>'parcel_configuration_id', 'quote parcel_configuration_id'\n      )::TEXT) || ':'\n      || public.phase3_require_positive_integer_internal(\n        p_line->>'configuration_revision', 'quote configuration_revision'\n      )::TEXT;\n  END IF;\n  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n    MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_SALE_CONTRACT_INVALID: Unsupported Customer line kind.';\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_expire_customer_order_v2_internal(p_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_key TEXT := 'expiry:' || LOWER(p_order_id::TEXT);\n  v_actor_hash TEXT := public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal(\n    'system_job', NULL, NULL, NULL\n  );\n  v_request JSONB := JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'contract_version', 'phase3-customer-expiry-v1',\n    'order_id', LOWER(p_order_id::TEXT)\n  );\n  v_fingerprint TEXT;\n  v_replay JSONB;\n  v_operation_id UUID := gen_random_uuid();\n  v_reason CONSTANT TEXT := 'انتهت مهلة حجز طلب الموقع (5 ساعات) قبل قبول الطلب.';\nBEGIN\n  v_fingerprint := public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(v_request);\n  v_replay := public.phase3_resolve_operation_replay_internal(\n    'phase3_customer_expiry_v1', v_key, 'system_job', v_actor_hash, v_fingerprint\n  );\n  IF v_replay->>'decision' = 'REPLAY' THEN\n    RETURN v_replay->'result_snapshot';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN public.phase3_release_customer_reservations_internal(\n    p_order_id, v_operation_id, 'phase3_customer_expiry_v1', v_key,\n    v_fingerprint, v_request, 'system_job', v_actor_hash, NULL,\n    'released', v_reason\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",
