        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_lock_open_pos_shift_internal(p_branch_id uuid)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_shift_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_branch_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تنفيذ البيع المباشر دون فرع محدد.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT shift.id INTO v_shift_id\n  FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n  WHERE shift.branch_id = p_branch_id\n    AND shift.status = 'open'\n  ORDER BY shift.id\n  LIMIT 1;\n\n  IF v_shift_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'افتح وردية الصندوق أولاً قبل إتمام البيع المباشر.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Full-shift reversal and POS reversal already serialize on this key before\n  -- taking the shift row.  Joining that gate prevents the historical\n  -- Inventory -> Shift / Shift -> Inventory cycle without changing V1 data or\n  -- its caller-visible contract.\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'cash-shift-full-reversal:' || v_shift_id::TEXT,\n    0\n  ));\n\n  PERFORM shift.id\n  FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n  WHERE shift.id = v_shift_id\n    AND shift.branch_id = p_branch_id\n    AND shift.status = 'open'\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'افتح وردية الصندوق أولاً قبل إتمام البيع المباشر.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN v_shift_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_pos_reversal_inventory_rows_internal(p_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS TABLE(order_item_id uuid, product_id uuid, base_quantity integer, parcel_component_id uuid, operation_id uuid)\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  SELECT\n    item.id,\n    item.product_id,\n    item.quantity,\n    NULL::UUID,\n    orders.operation_id\n  FROM public.order_items item\n  JOIN public.orders orders ON orders.id = item.order_id\n  WHERE item.order_id = p_order_id\n    AND item.product_id IS NOT NULL\n    AND item.commercial_line_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'configurable_parcel'\n  UNION ALL\n  SELECT\n    instance.order_item_id,\n    component.product_id,\n    component.base_quantity,\n    component.id,\n    component.operation_id\n  FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n  JOIN public.order_parcel_instances instance\n    ON instance.id = component.parcel_instance_id\n  JOIN public.order_items item ON item.id = instance.order_item_id\n  WHERE instance.order_id = p_order_id\n    AND item.commercial_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel';\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_release_customer_reservations_internal(p_order_id uuid, p_lifecycle_operation_id uuid, p_operation_type text, p_idempotency_key text, p_request_fingerprint text, p_request_snapshot jsonb, p_actor_scope_type text, p_actor_scope_hash text, p_initiated_by uuid, p_terminal_state text, p_reason text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_product_ids UUID[];\n  v_demand RECORD;\n  v_now TIMESTAMPTZ := NOW();\n  v_result JSONB;\n  v_target_order_status TEXT;\n  v_target_reservation_state TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_operation_type NOT IN (\n      'phase3_customer_cancellation_v1', 'phase3_customer_expiry_v1'\n    ) OR p_terminal_state NOT IN ('cancelled', 'released')\n    OR (p_operation_type = 'phase3_customer_cancellation_v1'\n      AND p_terminal_state <> 'cancelled')\n    OR (p_operation_type = 'phase3_customer_expiry_v1'\n      AND p_terminal_state <> 'released')\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_LIFECYCLE_INVALID: Release protocol is invalid.';\n  END IF;\n  v_target_order_status := CASE WHEN p_terminal_state = 'released'\n    THEN 'expired' ELSE 'cancelled' END;\n  v_target_reservation_state := p_terminal_state;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_order FROM public.orders WHERE id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.business_operations operation\n    WHERE operation.id = v_order.operation_id\n      AND operation.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_LIFECYCLE_CONTRACT_MISMATCH: Order is not Customer V2.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_order.status = 'completed' OR v_order.cost_finalized_at IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_LIFECYCLE_INVALID: Completed order cannot release reservations.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_terminal_state = 'released' AND (\n    v_order.status <> 'new' OR v_order.reservation_expires_at IS NULL\n      OR v_order.reservation_expires_at > NOW()\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_LIFECYCLE_INVALID: Order is not eligible for expiry.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT reservation.product_id ORDER BY reservation.product_id)\n  INTO v_product_ids FROM public.order_inventory_reservations reservation\n  WHERE reservation.order_id = p_order_id\n    AND reservation.reservation_state = 'active';\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_product_ids), 0) = 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_RESERVATION_TERMINAL: No active reservation remains.';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM public.phase3_lock_inventory_products_internal(v_product_ids);\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n  WHERE balance.warehouse_id = v_order.warehouse_id\n    AND balance.product_id = ANY(v_product_ids)\n  ORDER BY balance.product_id FOR UPDATE;\n\n  FOR v_demand IN\n    SELECT reservation.product_id,\n      SUM(reservation.reserved_quantity)::INTEGER quantity\n    FROM public.order_inventory_reservations reservation\n    WHERE reservation.order_id = p_order_id\n      AND reservation.reservation_state = 'active'\n    GROUP BY reservation.product_id ORDER BY reservation.product_id\n  LOOP\n    UPDATE public.inventory_balances balance\n    SET reserved_quantity = balance.reserved_quantity - v_demand.quantity,\n      updated_at = v_now\n    WHERE balance.warehouse_id = v_order.warehouse_id\n      AND balance.product_id = v_demand.product_id\n      AND balance.reserved_quantity >= v_demand.quantity;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_CUSTOMER_RESERVATION_MISMATCH: Reserved quantity cannot be released.';\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  UPDATE public.order_inventory_reservations SET\n    reservation_state = v_target_reservation_state, resolved_at = v_now\n  WHERE order_id = p_order_id AND reservation_state = 'active';\n  PERFORM SET_CONFIG(\n    'nawasrah.customer_lifecycle_operation_id',\n    p_lifecycle_operation_id::TEXT, true\n  );\n  INSERT INTO public.phase3_customer_lifecycle_transition_guards(\n    transaction_id, lifecycle_operation_id, order_id, target_status\n  ) VALUES (\n    pg_current_xact_id(), p_lifecycle_operation_id, p_order_id,\n    v_target_order_status\n  );\n  UPDATE public.orders SET\n    status = v_target_order_status, reservation_released_at = v_now,\n    expired_at = CASE WHEN v_target_order_status = 'expired' THEN v_now ELSE expired_at END,\n    expired_reason = CASE WHEN v_target_order_status = 'expired'\n      THEN p_reason ELSE expired_reason END,\n    updated_at = v_now\n  WHERE id = p_order_id;\n  DELETE FROM public.phase3_customer_lifecycle_transition_guards\n  WHERE transaction_id = pg_current_xact_id()\n    AND lifecycle_operation_id = p_lifecycle_operation_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.order_status_history(order_id, old_status, new_status, changed_by, notes)\n  VALUES (p_order_id, v_order.status, v_target_order_status, p_initiated_by, p_reason);\n  v_result := JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'success', true, 'idempotent_replay', false,\n    'operation_id', p_lifecycle_operation_id, 'order_id', p_order_id,\n    'order_number', v_order.order_number, 'status', v_target_order_status,\n    'reservation_state', v_target_reservation_state,\n    'released_reservations', (SELECT COUNT(*)\n      FROM         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_resolve_legacy_pos_location_internal(p_warehouse_id uuid, p_branch_id uuid)\n RETURNS TABLE(warehouse_id uuid, branch_id uuid)\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_warehouse_id UUID := p_warehouse_id;\n  v_branch_id UUID := p_branch_id;\nBEGIN\n  -- Preserve the published V1 resolver exactly. An explicit warehouse preserves an explicit branch,\n  -- including the historical mismatch behavior, and infers only a NULL one.\n  IF v_warehouse_id IS NULL THEN\n    SELECT warehouse.id, warehouse.branch_id\n    INTO v_warehouse_id, v_branch_id\n    FROM public.warehouses warehouse\n    WHERE warehouse.is_active = true\n    ORDER BY warehouse.created_at\n    LIMIT 1;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT COALESCE(v_branch_id, warehouse.branch_id)\n    INTO v_branch_id\n    FROM public.warehouses warehouse\n    WHERE warehouse.id = v_warehouse_id\n      AND warehouse.is_active = true;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'المستودع المحدد غير موجود أو غير نشط.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_warehouse_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يوجد مستودع نشط لتنفيذ البيع.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_warehouse_id, v_branch_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'phase3-operation:' || v_operation_type || ':' || v_key, 0\n  ));\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_operation\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase3_validate_configurable_parcel_internal(p_actor_scope_type text, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_family_product_id uuid, p_parcel_configuration_id uuid, p_configuration_revision integer, p_components jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  -- Every caller, including receiving/quotes, takes inventory/family locks\n  -- before the historical configuration/family snapshot locks.\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY[p_family_product_id]||ARRAY(\n    SELECT (c->>'product_id')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_components) c));\n  v_result:=public.package_d_validate_configurable_parcel_before_policy_internal(\n    p_actor_scope_type,p_actor_user_id,p_family_product_id,p_parcel_configuration_id,\n    p_configuration_revision,p_components);\n  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_result->'components') component\n    WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.product_parcel_allowed_components allowed\n      WHERE allowed.configuration_id=p_parcel_configuration_id\n        AND allowed.product_id=(component->>'product_id')::UUID)) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='P0001',\n      MESSAGE='PARCEL_COMPONENT_NOT_ALLOWED: إحدى النكهات غير مسموحة لهذا الطرد.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase42_apply_return_inventory_before_phase43_internal(p_operation_id uuid, p_return_event_id uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid, p_sources jsonb, p_user_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_product RECORD;\n  v_opening_global INTEGER;\n  v_target_before INTEGER;\n  v_target_after INTEGER;\n  v_prior_exact NUMERIC(24, 6);\n  v_prior_legacy BIGINT;\n  v_restock_value NUMERIC(30, 6);\n  v_resulting_value NUMERIC(30, 6);\n  v_resulting_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_new_exact NUMERIC(24, 6);\n  v_new_legacy BIGINT;\n  v_movement_id UUID;\n  v_effects JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_operation_id IS NULL OR p_return_event_id IS NULL\n    OR p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR p_user_id IS NULL\n    OR p_sources IS NULL OR JSONB_TYPEOF(p_sources) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_INVENTORY_EFFECT_INPUT_INVALID: Return inventory effect input is invalid.';\n  END IF;\n  IF JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(p_sources) = 0 THEN\n    RETURN v_effects;\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY(\n    SELECT DISTINCT (source->>'product_id')::UUID\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_sources) source\n    ORDER BY (source->>'product_id')::UUID\n  ));\n\n  FOR v_product IN\n    SELECT (source->>'product_id')::UUID AS product_id,\n      SUM((source->>'quantity')::INTEGER)::INTEGER AS quantity,\n      SUM((source->>'historical_value_exact')::NUMERIC(30, 6))::NUMERIC(30, 6)\n        AS historical_value_exact,\n      JSONB_AGG(source ORDER BY source->>'source_kind', source->>'source_id')\n        AS source_evidence\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_sources) source\n    GROUP BY (source->>'product_id')::UUID\n    ORDER BY (source->>'product_id')::UUID\n  LOOP\n    IF v_product.quantity <= 0 OR v_product.historical_value_exact < 0 THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_INVENTORY_EFFECT_INVALID: Sellable quantity and historical value must be valid.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,\n      product.cost_price_in_minor_units\n    INTO v_prior_exact, v_prior_legacy\n    FROM public.products product\n    WHERE product.id = v_product.product_id\n    FOR NO KEY UPDATE;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_RETURN_PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND: Return product is unavailable.';\n    END IF;\n    v_prior_exact := COALESCE(v_prior_exact, v_prior_legacy::NUMERIC);\n\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance.on_hand_quantity), 0)::INTEGER\n    INTO v_opening_global\n    FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n    WHERE balance.product_id = v_product.product_id;\n\n    INSERT INTO public.inventory_balances(\n      warehouse_id, product_id, on_hand_quantity, reserved_quantity\n    ) VALUES (p_warehouse_id, v_product.product_id, 0, 0)\n    ON CONFLICT (warehouse_id, product_id) DO NOTHING;\n\n    SELECT balance.on_hand_quantity INTO v_target_before\n    FROM public.inventory_balances balance\n    WHERE balance.warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n      AND balance.product_id = v_product.product_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    v_restock_value := v_product.historical_value_exact;\n    v_resulting_quantity := v_opening_global + v_product.quantity;\n    v_resulting_value := ROUND(\n      v_opening_global::NUMERIC * v_prior_exact + v_restock_value, 6\n    );\n    v_new_exact := ROUND(\n      v_resulting_value / v_resulting_quantity::NUMERIC, 6\n    );\n    v_new_legacy := ROUND(v_new_exact)::BIGINT;\n    v_target_after := v_target_before + v_product.quantity;\n    v_movement_id := gen_random_uuid();\n\n    UPDATE public.products\n    SET wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact = v_new_exact,\n      cost_price_in_minor_units = v_new_legacy,\n      updated_at = clock_timestamp()\n    WHERE id = v_product.product_id;\n\n    UPDATE public.inventory_balances\n    SET on_hand_quantity = v_target_after, updated_at = clock_timestamp()\n    WHERE warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n      AND product_id = v_product.product_id;\n\n    INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements(\n      id, warehouse_id, product_id, movement_type, quantity,\n      balance_before, balance_after, reference_type, reference_id,\n      notes, created_by\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_movement_id, p_warehouse_id, v_product.product_id, 'return_in',\n      v_product.quantity, v_target_before, v_target_after,\n      'phase4_sales_return', p_return_event_id,\n      'Phase 4.2 historical-cost sellable Return restock', p_user_id\n    );\n\n    INSERT INTO public.phase42_return_inventory_effects(\n      operation_id, return_event_id, warehouse_id, product_id,\n      inventory_movement_id, sellable_quantity,\n      historical_restock_value_in_minor_units_exact,\n      opening_global_quantity, target_balance_before, target_balance_after,\n      prior_wac_in_minor_units_exact, resulting_wac_in_minor_units_exact,\n      resulting_global_quantity, resulting_global_value_in_minor_units_exact,\n      source_evidence\n    ) VALUES (\n      p_operation_id, p_return_event_id, p_warehouse_id,\n      v_product.product_id, v_movement_id, v_product.quantity,\n      v_restock_value, v_opening_global, v_target_before, v_target_after,\n      v_prior_exact, v_new_exact, v_resulting_quantity,\n      v_resulting_value, v_product.source_evidence\n    );\n\n    v_effects := v_effects || JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'productId', v_product.product_id,\n      'quantity', v_product.quantity,\n      'historicalRestockValueInMinorUnitsExact', v_restock_value,\n      'priorWacInMinorUnitsExact', v_prior_exact,\n      'resultingWacInMinorUnitsExact', v_new_exact,\n      'inventoryMovementId', v_movement_id\n    ));\n  END LOOP;\n  RETURN v_effects;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase42_assert_operational_return_evidence_before_phase43(p_operation_id uuid, p_require_settled boolean)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_operation public.business_operations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_event public.sales_return_events%ROWTYPE;\n  v_order public.orders%ROWTYPE;\n  v_evidence public.phase42_return_settlement_evidence%ROWTYPE;\n  v_creation_type TEXT;\n  v_inventory JSONB;\n  v_expected_inventory JSONB;\n  v_actual_inventory JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO v_operation\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.id = p_operation_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_operation.operation_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'phase4_return_v1' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_OPERATIONAL_EVIDENCE_INVALID: Return operation identity is missing or invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_event\n  FROM public.sales_return_events event\n  WHERE event.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_OPERATIONAL_EVIDENCE_INVALID: Return event identity is missing.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_order\n  FROM public.orders customer_order\n  WHERE customer_order.id = v_event.order_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_OPERATIONAL_EVIDENCE_INVALID: Return sale identity is missing.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT creation.operation_type INTO v_creation_type\n  FROM public.business_operations creation\n  WHERE creation.id = v_order.operation_id;\n\n  -- Historical/non-modern Returns retain the Phase 4.1 foundation contract.\n  IF v_creation_type NOT IN (\n    'phase3_pos_sale_v1', 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1'\n  ) THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_evidence\n  FROM public.phase42_return_settlement_evidence evidence\n  WHERE evidence.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  v_inventory := public.phase42_inventory_effects_snapshot_internal(\n    p_operation_id\n  );\n\n  -- Derive the complete required restoration independently from persisted\n  -- operational effects. This binds quantity, historical valuation and every\n  -- logical source to the immutable sale/inspection evidence.\n  v_expected_inventory :=\n    public.phase42_expected_return_inventory_effects_internal(p_operation_id);\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    JSONB_OBJECT_AGG(product_id::TEXT, JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n      'quantity', sellable_quantity,\n      'historicalValueExact',\n        historical_restock_value_in_minor_units_exact,\n      'sourceEvidence', source_evidence\n    )),\n    '{}'::JSONB\n  )\n  INTO v_actual_inventory\n  FROM public.phase42_return_inventory_effects effect\n  WHERE effect.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  IF v_actual_inventory IS DISTINCT FROM v_expected_inventory THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_OPERATIONAL_EFFECTS_INCOMPLETE: Inventory effects do not match accepted sellable evidence.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Durable evidence must point to the exact inventory movement produced for\n  -- this Return and its authoritative sale warehouse. Current balances are not\n  -- consulted, so legitimate later inventory activity cannot invalidate replay.\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.phase42_return_inventory_effects effect\n    LEFT JOIN public.inventory_movements movement\n      ON movement.id = effect.inventory_movement_id\n    WHERE effect.operation_id = p_operation_id\n      AND (\n        effect.return_event_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_event.id\n        OR v_event.warehouse_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order.warehouse_id\n        OR effect.warehouse_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order.warehouse_id\n        OR effect.target_balance_after IS DISTINCT FROM\n          effect.target_balance_before + effect.sellable_quantity\n        OR effect.resulting_global_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM\n (source->>'root_source_id')::UUID)\n        OR\n        (source->>'root_source_kind' = 'parcel_component'\n          AND return_item.return_scope = 'parcel_instance'\n          AND EXISTS (\n            SELECT 1 FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n            WHERE component.id = (source->>'root_source_id')::UUID\n              AND component.parcel_instance_id = return_item.parcel_instance_id\n          ))\n      )\n  ), actual AS (\n    SELECT consumption.return_item_id,\n      root.root_kind root_source_kind, root.root_id root_source_id,\n      consumption.source_kind, consumption.source_id,\n      consumption.product_id, consumption.consumed_quantity quantity\n    FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n      consumption.source_kind, consumption.source_id, consumption.product_id\n    ) root\n    WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n      AND consumption.consumption_kind = 'return'\n  ), delta AS (\n    (SELECT * FROM expected EXCEPT SELECT * FROM actual)\n    UNION ALL\n    (SELECT * FROM actual EXCEPT SELECT * FROM expected)\n  )\n  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM delta) INTO v_mismatch;\n  IF v_mismatch THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH: Expected and      ON return_item.id = inspection.sales_return_item_id\n      AND return_item.operation_id = p_operation_id\n    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n      SELECT\n 'parcel_component'\n        AND (source->>'root_source_id')::UUID = inspection.parcel_component_id\n    ) allocation ON true\n    WHERE inspection.accepted_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM allocation.sellable + allocation.defect\n      OR inspection.rejected_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM allocation.damage\n      OR (allocation.sellable > 0 AND (\n        inspection.accepted_condition IS DISTINCT FROM 'sellable'\n        OR inspection.accepted_stock_disposition IS DISTINCT FROM 'restock'))\n      OR (allocation.sellable = 0 AND allocation.defect > 0 AND (\n        inspection.accepted_condition IS DISTINCT FROM 'supplier_defect'\n        OR inspection.accepted_stock_disposition IS DISTINCT FROM 'non_sellable'))\n      OR (allocation.damage > 0 AND (\n        inspection.rejection_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'customer_damage'\n        OR inspection.rejected_stock_disposition IS DISTINCT FROM 'returned_to_customer'))\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE p_source_id AND event.issuance_status = 'issued'\n      AND event.issuance_coordinator_version = 403;\n    IF v_operation_id IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_LINEAGE_INVALID: Replacement leaf lacks operational issuance evidence.';\n    END IF;\n    PERFORM !~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'\n      OR COALESCE(v_source->>'sellable_restock_quantity', '') !~ '^[0-9]+$'\n      OR COALESCE(v_source->>'defect_non_sellable_quantity', '') !~ '^[0-9]+$'\n      OR v_source_kind, 'source_id', LOWER(v_source_id::TEXT),\n      'product_id', LOWER(v_product_id::TEXT), 'quantity', v_quantity,\n      'sellable_restock_quantity', v_sellable,\n   GROUP BY source->>'source_kind', source->>'source_id'\n    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22023',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_PHYSICAL_SOURCE_DUPLICATE: A         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase43_current_physical_representatives_internal(p_root_kind text, p_root_id uuid, p_product_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n  WITH root_capacity AS (\n    SELECT CASE\n      WHEN p_root_kind = 'base_order_item' THEN (\n        SELECT item.quantity FROM public.order_items item\n        WHERE item.id = p_root_id AND item.product_id = p_product_id\n      )\n      WHEN p_root_kind = 'parcel_component' THEN (\n        SELECT component.base_quantity FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n        WHERE component.id = p_root_id AND component.product_id = p_product_id\n      )\n    END::INTEGER quantity\n  ), original AS (\n    SELECT p_root_kind source_kind, p_root_id source_id, p_product_id product_id,\n      GREATEST(root.quantity - COALESCE((\n        SELECT SUM(consumption.consumed_quantity)::INTEGER\n        FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n        WHERE consumption.source_kind = p_root_kind\n          AND consumption.source_id = p_root_id\n          AND consumption.consumption_state = 'settled'\n      ), 0), 0)::INTEGER remaining_quantity,\n      NULL::UUID parent_replacement_item_id\n    FROM root_capacity root WHERE root.quantity IS NOT NULL\n  ), replacements AS (\n    SELECT 'replacement_item'::TEXT source_kind, item.id source_id,\n      item.product_id,\n      GREATEST(item.quantity - COALESCE((\n        SELECT SUM(consumption.consumed_quantity)::INTEGER\n        FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n        WHERE consumption.source_kind = 'replacement_item'\n          AND consumption.source_id = item.id\n          AND consumption.consumption_state = 'settled'\n      ), 0), 0)::INTEGER remaining_quantity,\n      item.parent_replacement_item_id\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n    JOIN public.sales_replacement_events event ON event.id = item.replacement_event_id\n    JOIN public.phase43_replacement_settlement_evidence evidence\n      ON evidence.operation_id = item.operation_id\n      AND evidence.replacement_event_id = event.id\n    WHERE item.product_id = p_product_id\n      AND CASE WHEN p_root_kind = 'base_order_item'\n        THEN item.root_parcel_component_id IS NULL\n          AND item.root_order_item_id = p_root_id\n        ELSE item.root_parcel_component_id = p_root_id END\n      AND event.root_order_id = (\n        SELECT CASE WHEN p_root_kind = 'base_order_item'\n          THEN (SELECT order_id FROM public.order_items WHERE id = p_root_id)\n          ELSE (SELECT instance.order_id\n            FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n            JOIN public.order_parcel_instances instance\n              ON instance.id = component.parcel_instance_id\n            WHERE component.id = p_root_id) END\n      )\n      AND event.replacement_status = 'settled'\n      AND event.issuance_status = 'issued'\n      AND event.issuance_coordinator_version = 403\n  ), representatives AS (\n    SELECT * FROM original UNION ALL SELECT * FROM replacements\n  )\n  SELECT COALESCE(JSONB_AGG(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'sourceKind', source_kind, 'sourceId', source_id,\n    'productId', product_id, 'remainingQuantity', remaining_quantity,\n    'parentReplacementItemId', parent_replacement_item_id\n  ) ORDER BY source_kind, source_id) FILTER (WHERE remaining_quantity > 0), '[]'::JSONB)\n  FROM representatives;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase43_rebind_return_consumption_to_leaf()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_id UUID;\n  v_sources JSONB;\n  v_source JSONB;\n  v_total INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.consumption_kind <> 'return'\n    OR pg_trigger_depth() > 1\n  THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT event.order_id, operation.request_identity_snapshot->'physical_sources'\n  INTO v_order_id, v_sources\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  JOIN public.sales_return_events event ON event.operation_id = operation.id\n  WHERE operation.id = NEW.operation_id;\n  IF v_sources IS NULL OR JSONB_ARRAY_LENGTH(v_sources) = 0 THEN\n    IF EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n      JOIN public.sales_replacement_events event ON event.id = item.replacement_event_id\n      CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n        'replacement_item', item.id, item.product_id\n      ) root\n      WHERE root.root_kind = NEW.source_kind AND root.root_id = NEW.source_id\n        AND root.product_id = NEW.product_id AND event.issuance_status = 'issued'\n    ) THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_PHYSICAL_LINEAGE_REQUIRED: Return must identify every current physical representative.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM((source->>'quantity')::INTEGER), 0)::INTEGER INTO v_total\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_sources) source\n  WHERE source->>'root_source_kind' = NEW.source_kind\n    AND (source->>'root_source_id')::UUID = NEW.source_id\n    AND (source->>'product_id')::UUID = NEW.product_id;\n  IF v_total = 0 THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n  IF v_total IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.consumed_quantity THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_LINEAGE_QUANTITY_INVALID: Physical lineage does not cover the exact Return consumption.';\n  END IF;\n  FOR v_source IN SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_sources)\n    WHERE value->>'root_source_kind' = NEW.source_kind\n      AND (value->>'root_source_id')::UUID = NEW.source_id\n      AND (value->>'product_id')::UUID = NEW.product_id\n    ORDER BY value->>'source_kind', value->>'source_id'\n  LOOP\n    PERFORM public.phase43_assert_return_physical_source_internal(\n      v_order_id, NEW.source_kind, NEW.source_id,\n      v_source->>'source_kind', (v_source->>'source_id')::UUID, NEW.product_id\n    );\n    INSERT INTO public.sales_aftercare_consumptions(\n      operation_id, return_item_id, source_kind, source_id, product_id,\n      consumed_quantity, consumption_kind\n    ) VALUES (\n      NEW.operation_id, NEW.return_item_id, v_source->>'source_kind',\n      (v_source->>'source_id')::UUID, NEW.product_id,\n      (v_source->>'quantity')::INTEGER, 'return'\n    );\n  END LOOP;\n  RETURN NULL;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase43_resolve_replacement_replay_internal(p_idempotency_key text, p_actor_scope_hash text, p_request_fingerprint text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_replay JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  v_replay := public.phase4_resolve_operation_replay_internal(\n    'phase4_replacement_v1', p_idempotency_key,\n    p_actor_scope_hash, p_request_fingerprint\n  );\n  IF v_replay->>'decision' = 'REPLAY' THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase43_assert_operational_replacement_evidence_internal(\n      (v_replay->>'operation_id')::UUID, true\n    );\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_replay;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase43_return_inventory_sources_internal(p_operation_id uuid, p_sources jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_request JSONB;\n  v_order_id UUID;\n  v_root JSONB;\n  v_leaf JSONB;\n  v_result JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_mapped INTEGER;\n  v_unit_cost NUMERIC(24, 6);\n  v_leaf_quantity INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT operation.request_identity_snapshot, event.order_id\n  INTO v_request, v_order_id\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  JOIN public.sales_return_events event ON event.operation_id = operation.id\n  WHERE operation.id = p_operation_id;\n  IF v_request->'physical_sources' IS NULL THEN RETURN p_sources; END IF;\n  FOR v_root IN SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(p_sources)\n  LOOP\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM((leaf->>'sellable_restock_quantity')::INTEGER), 0)::INTEGER\n    INTO v_mapped FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_request->'physical_sources') leaf\n    WHERE leaf->>'root_source_kind' = v_root->>'source_kind'\n      AND leaf->>'root_source_id' = v_root->>'source_id';\n    IF v_mapped > (v_root->>'quantity')::INTEGER THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE43_RETURN_RESTOCK_LINEAGE_INCOMPLETE: Sellable leaf allocation exceeds accepted Return evidence.';\n    END IF;\n    FOR v_leaf IN SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_request->'physical_sources')\n      WHERE value->>'root_source_kind' = v_root->>'source_kind'\n        AND value->>'root_source_id' = v_root->>'source_id'\n        AND (value->>'sellable_restock_quantity')::INTEGER > 0\n      ORDER BY value->>'source_kind', value->>'source_id'\n    LOOP\n      PERFORM public.phase43_assert_return_physical_source_internal(\n        v_order_id, v_root->>'source_kind', (v_root->>'source_id')::UUID,\n        v_leaf->>'source_kind', (v_leaf->>'source_id')::UUID,\n        (v_leaf->>'product_id')::UUID\n      );\n      v_leaf_quantity := (v_leaf->>'sellable_restock_quantity')::INTEGER;\n      IF v_leaf->>'source_kind' = 'replacement_item' THEN\n        SELECT item.replacement_unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact\n        INTO v_unit_cost FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n        WHERE item.id = (v_leaf->>'source_id')::UUID;\n      ELSE\n        v_unit_cost := (v_root->>'historical_value_exact')::NUMERIC\n          / (v_root->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n      END IF;\n      v_result := v_result || JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n        'source_kind', v_leaf->>'source_kind',\n        'source_id', v_leaf->>'source_id',\n        'return_item_id', v_root->>'return_item_id',\n        'product_id', v_leaf->>'product_id', 'quantity', v_leaf_quantity,\n        'historical_value_exact', ROUND(v_unit_cost * v_leaf_quantity, 6)\n      ));\n    END LOOP;\n  END LOOP;\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(p_source_kind text, p_source_id uuid, p_product_id uuid)\n RETURNS TABLE(root_kind text, root_id uuid, product_id uuid)\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF p_source_kind IN ('base_order_item', 'parcel_component') THEN\n    root_kind := p_source_kind;\n    root_id := p_source_id;\n    product_id := p_product_id;\n    RETURN NEXT;\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n  IF p_source_kind = 'replacement_item' THEN\n    RETURN QUERY\n    SELECT CASE WHEN replacement.root_parcel_component_id IS NULL\n        THEN 'base_order_item' ELSE 'parcel_component' END,\n      COALESCE(replacement.root_parcel_component_id,\n        replacement.root_order_item_id),\n      replacement.product_id\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_items replacement\n    JOIN public.sales_replacement_events event\n      ON event.id = replacement.replacement_event_id\n    WHERE replacement.id = p_source_id\n      AND replacement.product_id = p_product_id\n      AND event.replacement_status = 'settled';\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_assert_aftercare_operation_binding_internal(p_operation_id uuid, p_entity_kind text, p_entity_id uuid, p_contract_version smallint)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_operation public.business_operations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_expected_type TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_operation_id IS NULL OR p_entity_id IS NULL\n    OR p_entity_kind NOT IN ('return', 'replacement')\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE =         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_effective_standalone_unit_price_internal(p_product_id uuid, p_channel text, p_customer_phone text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_promotion_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_price_frozen_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS bigint\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_price BIGINT;\n  v_effective_at TIMESTAMPTZ := COALESCE(p_price_frozen_at, statement_timestamp());\n  v_code TEXT := UPPER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_promotion_code), ''));\n  v_phone TEXT := CASE\n    WHEN NULLIF(BTRIM(p_customer_phone), '') IS NULL THEN NULL\n    ELSE public.normalize_customer_phone(p_customer_phone)\n  END;\n  v_promotion public.promotion_codes%ROWTYPE;\n  v_discount BIGINT := 0;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_channel NOT IN ('admin_pos', 'customer_v2') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_STANDALONE_PRICE_CONTEXT_INVALID: Unsupported commercial channel.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT product.sale_price_in_minor_units\n  INTO v_price\n  FROM public.products product\n  WHERE product.id = p_product_id\n    AND product.is_active\n    AND NOT product.is_flavor_master\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR COALESCE(v_price, 0) <= 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_STANDALONE_PRICE_UNPROVEN: The authoritative standalone Base Unit price cannot be proven.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- POS V2 has no standalone promotion-code contract.  Its existing total\n  -- discount must never be reinterpreted as a unit promotion.\n  IF p_channel = 'admin_pos' OR v_code IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN v_price;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT promotion.*\n  INTO v_promotion\n  FROM public.promotion_codes promotion\n  WHERE promotion.code = v_code\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  -- A pinned order promotion affects the standalone snapshot only when that\n  -- exact one-unit hypothetical sale is itself eligible.  Ineligibility means\n  -- the normal server price is the correct result, not a fallback guess.\n  IF NOT FOUND\n    OR NOT v_promotion.is_active\n    OR (v_promotion.starts_at IS NOT NULL AND v_effective_at < v_promotion.starts_at)\n    OR (v_promotion.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND v_effective_at >= v_promotion.expires_at)\n    OR v_price < v_promotion.minimum_subtotal_in_minor_units\n    OR (v_promotion.maximum_redemptions_per_phone IS NOT NULL AND v_phone IS NULL)\n  THEN\n    RETURN v_price;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_promotion.maximum_total_redemptions IS NOT NULL AND (\n    SELECT COUNT(*)\n    FROM public.promotion_redemptions redemption\n    WHERE redemption.promotion_code_id = v_promotion.id\n  ) >= v_promotion.maximum_total_redemptions THEN\n    RETURN v_price;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_promotion.maximum_redemptions_per_phone IS NOT NULL AND (\n    SELECT COUNT(*)\n    FROM public.promotion_redemptions redemption\n    WHERE redemption.promotion_code_id = v_promotion.id\n      AND redemption.customer_phone = v_phone\n  ) >= v_promotion.maximum_redemptions_per_phone THEN\n    RETURN v_price;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_promotion.discount_type = 'fixed' THEN\n    v_discount := LEAST(v_promotion.discount_value, v_price);\n  ELSIF v_promotion.discount_type = 'percentage' THEN\n    v_discount := FLOOR(v_price::NUMERIC * v_promotion.discount_value / 10000)::BIGINT;\n    IF v_promotion.maximum_discount_in_minor_units IS NOT NULL THEN\n      v_discount := LEAST(v_discount, v_promotion.maximum_discount_in_minor_units);\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_STANDALONE_PRICE_UNPROVEN: Promotion pricing contract is unsupported.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN v_price - LEAST(GREATEST(v_discount, 0), v_price);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_guard_aftercare_operation_order_gate()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.operation_type NOT IN ('phase4_return_v1', 'phase4_replacement_v1') THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- This is the single earliest Phase-4 write boundary. Invalid operations are\n  -- rejected with zero writes; valid operations acquire their root Order gate\n  -- before the INSERT can take FK locks or persist evidence.\n  IF COALESCE(NEW.request_fingerprint, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\n    OR NEW.request_identity_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n    OR NEW.request_identity_snapshot IS NULL\n    OR JSONB_TYPEOF(NEW.request_identity_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n    OR COALESCE(LOWER(NEW.request_identity_snapshot->>'order_id'), '') !~\n      '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'\n    OR NEW.completed_at IS NULL\n    OR NEW.actor_scope_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'erp_user'\n    OR COALESCE(NEW.actor_scope_hash, '') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'\n    OR NEW.initiated_by IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_INSERT_SHAPE_INVALID: Phase-4 operation identity and structural result evidence must be complete.';\n  END IF;\n\n  NEW.idempotency_key := public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(\n    NEW.idempotency_key\n  );\n\n  PERFORM public.phase4_assert_success_result_internal(\n    NEW.id, NEW.operation_type, NEW.result_snapshot, NULL\n  );\n\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_order_gate_internal(\n    NEW.operation_type, NEW.request_identity_snapshot, NULL\n  );\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_guard_customer_payment_reversal_dependency()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.is_reversed AND NOT OLD.is_reversed AND OLD.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase4_assert_no_settled_aftercare_for_order_internal(OLD.order_id);\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_guard_order_reversal_dependency()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.status = 'cancelled' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled' THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase4_assert_no_settled_aftercare_for_order_internal(OLD.id);\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_guard_replacement_event_insert_state()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_operation_order_internal(\n    NEW.operation_id, NEW.root_order_id\n  );\n  PERFORM public.phase4_assert_aftercare_operation_binding_internal(\n    NEW.operation_id, 'replacement', NEW.id, NEW.contract_version\n  );\n  IF NEW.replacement_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'draft'\n    OR NEW.settled_at IS NOT NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_REPLACEMENT_INITIAL_STATE_INVALID: Replacement evidence must begin as an unsettled draft.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_guard_return_event_insert_state()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  -- Historical/non-versioned Returns keep their pre-Phase-4 contract. Only a\n  -- versioned Return participates in the new root-Order serialization gate.\n  IF NEW.contract_version IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_operation_order_internal(\n      NEW.operation_id, NEW.order_id\n    );\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM public.phase4_assert_aftercare_operation_binding_internal(\n    NEW.operation_id, 'return', NEW.id, NEW.contract_version\n  );\n  IF NEW.contract_version IS NOT NULL\n    AND (NEW.settlement_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'draft'\n      OR NEW.settled_at IS NOT NULL)\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_INITIAL_STATE_INVALID: Versioned Return evidence must begin as an unsettled draft.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_lock_aftercare_operation_order_internal(p_operation_id uuid, p_expected_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_operation_type TEXT;\n  v_request_identity_snapshot JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT operation.operation_type, operation.request_identity_snapshot\n  INTO v_operation_type, v_request_identity_snapshot\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.id = p_operation_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_NOT_FOUND: Business operation does not exist.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN public.phase4_lock_aftercare_order_gate_internal(\n    v_operation_type, v_request_identity_snapshot, p_expected_order_id\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_lock_aftercare_order_gate_internal(p_operation_type text, p_request_identity_snapshot jsonb, p_expected_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_text TEXT;\n  v_order_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_operation_type NOT IN ('phase4_return_v1', 'phase4_replacement_v1')\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_ORDER_IDENTITY_INVALID: Unsupported Phase-4 operation type.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_request_identity_snapshot IS NULL\n    OR JSONB_TYPEOF(p_request_identity_snapshot) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_ORDER_IDENTITY_INVALID: Immutable request evidence must contain one root Order.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_order_text := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(\n    p_request_identity_snapshot->>'order_id'\n  ), ''));\n  IF v_order_text IS NULL OR v_order_text !~\n    '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_ORDER_IDENTITY_INVALID: Immutable request evidence has an invalid root Order.';\n  END IF;\n  v_order_id := v_order_text::UUID;\n\n  IF p_expected_order_id IS NOT NULL\n    AND v_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_order_id\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_ORDER_IDENTITY_INVALID: Immutable request evidence does not match the aftercare root Order.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'phase4-order|' || v_order_id::TEXT, 0\n  ));\n  RETURN v_order_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "identity": "phase4_lock_aftercare_parent_order_internal(p_parent_kind text, p_parent_id uuid, p_expected_operation_id uuid, p_expected_order_id uuid)",
        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_lock_aftercare_parent_order_internal(p_parent_kind text, p_parent_id uuid, p_expected_operation_id uuid, p_expected_order_id uuid)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_operation_id UUID;\n  v_order_id UUID;\n  v_contract_version SMALLINT;\n  v_operation_type TEXT;\n  v_request_identity_snapshot JSONB;\n  v_fresh_operation_id UUID;\n  v_fresh_order_id UUID;\n  v_fresh_contract_version SMALLINT;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_parent_id IS NULL OR p_parent_kind NOT IN (\n    'return_event', 'return_item',\n    'replacement_event', 'replacement_item'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_IDENTITY_INVALID: Aftercare parent identity is invalid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Discovery is deliberately non-locking.  No FK/header/child row lock may\n  -- precede the canonical root advisory gate.\n  IF p_parent_kind = 'return_event' THEN\n    SELECT event.operation_id, event.order_id, event.contract_version\n    INTO v_operation_id, v_order_id, v_contract_version\n    FROM public.sales_return_events event\n    WHERE event.id = p_parent_id;\n  ELSIF p_parent_kind = 'return_item' THEN\n    SELECT item.operation_id, item.order_id, event.contract_version\n    INTO v_operation_id, v_order_id, v_contract_version\n    FROM public.sales_return_items item\n    JOIN public.sales_return_events event\n      ON event.id = item.sales_return_event_id\n    WHERE item.id = p_parent_id;\n  ELSIF p_parent_kind = 'replacement_event' THEN\n    SELECT event.operation_id, event.root_order_id, event.contract_version\n    INTO v_operation_id, v_order_id, v_contract_version\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_events event\n    WHERE event.id = p_parent_id;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT item.operation_id, event.root_order_id, event.contract_version\n    INTO v_operation_id, v_order_id, v_contract_version\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n    JOIN public.sales_replacement_events event\n      ON event.id = item.replacement_event_id\n    WHERE item.id = p_parent_id;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_operation_id IS NULL OR v_order_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_NOT_FOUND: Aftercare parent does not exist.';\n  END IF;\n  IF (p_expected_operation_id IS NOT NULL\n      AND v_operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_operation_id)\n    OR (p_expected_order_id IS NOT NULL\n      AND v_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_expected_order_id)\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_IDENTITY_INVALID: Aftercare parent does not match the submitted operation or Order.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT operation.operation_type, operation.request_identity_snapshot\n  INTO v_operation_type, v_request_identity_snapshot\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.id = v_operation_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_NOT_FOUND: Business operation does not exist.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Historical Return rows keep the pre-Phase-4 contract.  A Phase-4\n  -- operation may never masquerade as one by omitting the parent version.\n  IF v_contract_version IS NULL\n    AND p_parent_kind IN ('return_event', 'return_item')\n    AND v_operation_type NOT IN ('phase4_return_v1', 'phase4_replacement_v1')\n  THEN\n    RETURN v_order_id;\n  END IF;\n  IF v_contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_CONTRACT_INVALID: Versioned aftercare evidence requires contract version 401.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_order_gate_internal(\n    v_operation_type, v_request_identity_snapshot, v_order_id\n  );\n\n  -- Fresh lock/revalidation after the gate.  Operation always precedes its\n  -- header, and an item parent is locked only after its header.\n  SELECT operation.operation_type, operation.request_identity_snapshot\n  INTO v_operation_type, v_request_identity_snapshot\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.id = v_operation_id\n  FOR SHARE;\n  IF NOT FOUND\n    OR v_operation_type NOT IN ('phase4_return_v1', 'phase4_replacement_v1')\n    OR LOWER(v_request_identity_snapshot->>'order_id')\n      IS DISTINCT FROM LOWER(v_order_id::TEXT)\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_REVALIDATION_FAILED: Operation root identity changed during evidence creation.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_parent_kind IN ('return_event', 'return_item') THEN\n    SELECT event.operation_id, event.order_id, event.contract_version\n    INTO v_fresh_operation_id, v_fresh_order_id, v_fresh_contract_version\n    FROM public.sales_return_events event\n    WHERE event.id = CASE p_parent_kind\n      WHEN 'return_event' THEN p_parent_id\n      ELSE (SELECT item.sales_return_event_id\n        FROM public.sales_return_items item WHERE item.id = p_parent_id)\n    END\n    FOR SHARE;\n    IF p_parent_kind = 'return_item' THEN\n      PERFORM 1 FROM public.sales_return_items item\n      WHERE item.id = p_parent_id FOR SHARE;\n      IF NOT FOUND THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_NOT_FOUND: Return Item parent does not exist.';\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n    IF v_operation_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'phase4_return_v1' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_CONTRACT_INVALID: Return evidence requires a Return operation.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT event.operation_id, event.root_order_id, event.contract_version\n    INTO v_fresh_operation_id, v_fresh_order_id, v_fresh_contract_version\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_events event\n    WHERE event.id = CASE p_parent_kind\n      WHEN 'replacement_event' THEN p_parent_id\n      ELSE (SELECT item.replacement_event_id\n        FROM public.sales_replacement_items item WHERE item.id = p_parent_id)\n    END\n    FOR SHARE;\n    IF p_parent_kind = 'replacement_item' THEN\n      PERFORM 1 FROM public.sales_replacement_items item\n      WHERE item.id = p_parent_id FOR SHARE;\n      IF NOT FOUND THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_NOT_FOUND: Replacement Item parent does not exist.';\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n    IF v_operation_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'phase4_replacement_v1' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_CONTRACT_INVALID: Replacement evidence requires a Replacement operation.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_fresh_operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_operation_id\n    OR v_fresh_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order_id\n    OR v_fresh_contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '40001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARENT_ROOT_REVALIDATION_FAILED: Parent identity changed; retry safely.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN v_order_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_lock_customer_order_context_internal(p_order_id uuid, p_require_open_shift boolean, p_lock_inventory boolean)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_branch_id UUID;\n  v_shift_id UUID;\n  v_locked_branch_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(\n    hashtextextended('phase4-order|' || p_order_id::TEXT, 0)\n  );\n\n  SELECT customer_order.branch_id INTO v_branch_id\n  FROM public.orders customer_order WHERE customer_order.id = p_order_id;\n  IF v_branch_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_ORDER_CONTEXT_INVALID: Order or branch is unavailable.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT shift.id INTO v_shift_id\n  FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n  WHERE shift.branch_id = v_branch_id AND shift.status = 'open'\n  ORDER BY shift.id LIMIT 1;\n\n  IF v_shift_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n    WHERE shift.id = v_shift_id FOR UPDATE;\n  ELSIF p_require_open_shift THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPEN_SHIFT_REQUIRED: An open Shift is required.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT customer_order.branch_id INTO v_locked_branch_id\n  FROM public.orders customer_order\n  WHERE customer_order.id = p_order_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF v_locked_branch_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_branch_id\n    OR (v_shift_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n      WHERE shift.id = v_shift_id\n        AND shift.branch_id = v_locked_branch_id\n        AND shift.status = 'open'\n    ))\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '40001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_LOCK_PLAN_CHANGED_RETRY: Customer Order lock plan changed.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_lock_inventory THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase4_lock_order_inventory_internal(p_order_id);\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM set_config(\n    'nawasrah.phase4_prelocked_shift_id', COALESCE(v_shift_id::TEXT, ''), true\n  );\n  RETURN v_shift_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_lock_full_shift_context_internal(p_shift_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_plan JSONB;\n  v_fresh JSONB;\n  v_ids UUID[];\n  v_shift_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_plan := public.phase4_full_shift_context_snapshot_internal(p_shift_id);\n\n  FOR v_shift_id IN\n    SELECT value::UUID\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'shift_ids')\n    ORDER BY value::UUID\n  LOOP\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n      'cash-shift-full-reversal:' || v_shift_id::TEXT, 0\n    ));\n  END LOOP;\n  v_fresh := public.phase4_full_shift_context_snapshot_internal(p_shift_id);\n  IF v_fresh IS DISTINCT FROM v_plan THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '40001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_LOCK_PLAN_CHANGED_RETRY: Full Shift resource set changed before locking.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'shift_ids');\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n  WHERE shift.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY shift.id FOR UPDATE;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'order_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders customer_order\n    WHERE customer_order.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY customer_order.id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'product_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase3_lock_inventory_products_internal(v_ids);\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'supplier_receipt_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.supplier_receipts receipt\n    WHERE receipt.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY receipt.id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'purchase_receipt_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.purchase_receipts receipt\n    WHERE receipt.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY receipt.id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'purchase_order_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.purchase_orders purchase_order\n    WHERE purchase_order.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY purchase_order.id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'supplier_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers supplier\n    WHERE supplier.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY supplier.id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'customer_payment_ids');\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_ids), 0) > 0 THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.customer_payments payment\n    WHERE payment.id = ANY(v_ids) ORDER BY payment.id FOR UPDATE NOWAIT;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT ARRAY_AGG(value::UUID ORDER BY value::UUID) INTO v_ids\n  FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS_TEXT(v_plan->'supplier_payment_ids');\n  IF 'PHASE4_IDEMPOTENCY_INPUT_INVALID: Invalid operation identity.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_key := public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(\n    p_idempotency_key\n  );\n\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(\n    'phase4-operation|' || v_type || '|' || v_actor_hash || '|' || v_key, 0\n  ));\n  SELECT * INTO v_operation\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.operation_type = v_type\n    AND operation.actor_scope_type = 'erp_user'\n    AND operation.actor_scope_hash = v_actor_hash\n    AND public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(\n      operation.idempotency_key\n    ) = v_key\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('decision', 'NEW');\n  END IF;\n  IF v_operation.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM v_fingerprint THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Operation identity is unavailable.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_operation.request_identity_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n    OR v_operation.request_identity_snapshot IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.result_snapshot IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.completed_at IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_IDENTITY_UNPROVEN: Stored operation identity is incomplete.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_type = 'phase4_return_v1' THEN\n    SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER,\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event.settlement_status = 'settled'\n        AND event.settled_at IS NOT NULL\n        AND event.operation_id = v_operation.id;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_outcome_count IS DISTINCT FROM 1\n    OR v_settled_outcome_count IS DISTINCT FROM 1\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_NOT_SETTLED: Stored operation is not a committed successful aftercare outcome.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM public.phase4_assert_aftercare_operation_binding_internal(\n    v_operation.id,\n    CASE v_type WHEN 'phase4_return_v1' THEN 'return' ELSE 'replacement' END,\n    v_outcome_id,\n    401::SMALLINT\n  );\n\n  IF v_type = 'phase4_return_v1' THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase42_assert_operational_return_evidence_internal(\n      v_operation.id, true\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'decision', 'REPLAY',\n    'operation_id',         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase4_validate_return_item_insert()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_contract_version SMALLINT;\n  v_status TEXT;\n  v_event_operation_id UUID;\n  v_event_order_id UUID;\n  v_original_entitlement BIGINT;\n  v_original_cogs BIGINT;\n  v_total_units INTEGER;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_parent_order_internal(\n    'return_event', NEW.sales_return_event_id,\n    NEW.operation_id, NEW.order_id\n  );\n\n  SELECT event.contract_version, event.settlement_status,\n    event.operation_id, event.order_id\n  INTO v_contract_version, v_status, v_event_operation_id, v_event_order_id\n  FROM public.sales_return_events event\n  WHERE event.id = NEW.sales_return_event_id\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_EVENT_REQUIRED: Return Item must reference an existing Return event.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_contract_version IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n  IF v_contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n    OR v_event_operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.operation_id\n    OR v_event_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.order_id\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_ITEM_CHAIN_INVALID: Versioned Return Item must match its event operation and order.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_status NOT IN ('draft', 'inspected') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_EVIDENCE_CLOSED: Versioned Return evidence is closed.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- A versioned Return Item is immutable, so all settlement-relevant evidence\n  -- must be structurally complete at its first and only write.  Historical\n  -- Return Items retain their nullable pre-Phase-4 shape above.\n  IF NEW.accepted_base_quantity IS NULL\n    OR NEW.rejected_base_quantity IS NULL\n    OR NEW.original_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NULL\n    OR NEW.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units IS NULL\n    OR NEW.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units IS NULL\n    OR NEW.accepted_base_quantity < 0\n    OR NEW.rejected_base_quantity < 0\n    OR NEW.accepted_base_quantity + NEW.rejected_base_quantity <= 0\n    OR NEW.original_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units < 0\n    OR NEW.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units < 0\n    OR NEW.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units < 0\n    OR NEW.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n      > NEW.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_ITEM_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: Versioned Return Item evidence must be complete and internally valid.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.return_scope = 'base_unit' THEN\n    PERFORM public.package_d_assert_carton_return_item_internal(to_jsonb(NEW));\n    IF NEW.accepted_base_quantity + NEW.rejected_base_quantity\n        IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.returned_quantity\n      OR (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.order_items oi WHERE oi.id=NEW.order_item_id\n        AND oi.commercial_line_kind='legacy_single_sku_parcel') AND (\n          NEW.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units <> 0\n          OR NEW.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units <> 0))\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_BASE_RETURN_ITEM_EVIDENCE_INVALID: Base Unit Return evidence does not match its immutable quantity contract.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT instance.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n      instance.cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n      instance.units_per_parcel_snapshot\n    INTO v_original_entitlement, v_original_cogs, v_total_units\n    FROM public.order_parcel_instances instance\n    WHERE instance.id = NEW.parcel_instance_id\n      AND instance.order_item_id = NEW.order_item_id\n    FOR SHARE;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND\n      OR NEW.accepted_base_quantity + NEW.rejected_base_quantity\n        IS DISTINCT FROM v_total_units\n      OR NEW.original_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n        IS DISTINCT FROM v_original_cogs\n      OR NEW.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n        IS DISTINCT FROM LEAST(\n          v_original_entitlement,\n          NEW.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n        )\n      OR NEW.refund_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units IS DISTINCT FROM\n        v_original_entitlement\n          - NEW.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARCEL_RETURN_ITEM_EVIDENCE_INVALID: Parcel Return evidence does not match its immutable sale snapshots.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",
