        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.phase6_financial_facts_before208_internal(p_branch_id uuid, p_period_start timestamp with time zone, p_period_end timestamp with time zone, p_timezone text, p_verify_evidence boolean)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_facts JSONB;\n  v_damage JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_period_start IS NULL OR p_period_end IS NULL\n    OR p_period_end <= p_period_start OR NULLIF(BTRIM(p_timezone), '') IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid Phase 6 financial facts period.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Fail closed on corrupt evidence for the rows this period reports.\n  IF p_verify_evidence THEN\n    PERFORM public.phase42_assert_operational_return_evidence_internal(e.operation_id, true)\n    FROM public.sales_return_events e\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = e.order_id\n    JOIN public.business_operations creation ON creation.id = o.operation_id\n    WHERE e.contract_version = 401 AND e.settlement_status = 'settled'\n      AND creation.operation_type IN ('phase3_pos_sale_v1', 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1')\n      AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n      AND e.settled_at >= p_period_start AND e.settled_at < p_period_end;\n\n    PERFORM public.phase43_assert_operational_replacement_evidence_internal(e.operation_id, true)\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_events e\n    JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = e.root_order_id\n    WHERE e.issuance_status = 'issued'\n      AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n      AND e.issued_at >= p_period_start AND e.issued_at < p_period_end;\n  END IF;\n\n  v_damage := public.inventory_damage_period_totals_internal(p_branch_id,p_period_start,p_period_end);\n  WITH first_completion AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT h.order_id, MIN(h.created_at) AS at\n    FROM public.order_status_history h\n    WHERE h.new_status = 'completed'\n    GROUP BY h.order_id\n  ), completion_ops AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT DISTINCT ON (b.result_snapshot->>'order_id')\n      b.result_snapshot->>'order_id' AS order_key,\n      b.result_snapshot, b.completed_at, b.request_identity_snapshot\n    FROM public.business_operations b\n    WHERE b.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_completion_v1'\n      AND b.result_snapshot->>'order_id' = b.request_identity_snapshot->>'order_id'\n    ORDER BY b.result_snapshot->>'order_id', b.completed_at, b.id\n  ), order_scope AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.branch_id, o.status, o.payment_method, o.delivery_fee_in_minor_units, o.total_in_minor_units, o.source, o.created_at, o.amount_paid_in_minor_units, o.operation_id, fc.at AS completion_at, creation.operation_type,\n      creation.result_snapshot AS creation_result, creation.completed_at AS creation_recorded_at,\n      completion.result_snapshot AS completion_result,\n      completion.completed_at AS completion_recorded_at,\n      completion.request_identity_snapshot AS completion_request\n    FROM public.orders o\n    JOIN first_completion fc ON fc.order_id = o.id\n    LEFT JOIN public.business_operations creation ON creation.id = o.operation_id\n    LEFT JOIN completion_ops completion ON completion.order_key = o.id::TEXT\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id\n  ), modern_returns AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT e.*\n    FROM public.sales_return_events e JOIN order_scope o ON o.id = e.order_id\n    WHERE e.contract_version = 401 AND e.settlement_status = 'settled'\n      AND o.operation_type IN ('phase3_pos_sale_v1', 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1')\n  ), issued AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT e.*\n    FROM public.sales_replacement_events e JOIN order_scope o ON o.id = e.root_order_id\n    WHERE e.issuance_status = 'issued'\n  ), return_rows AS (\n    SELECT e.id, e.order_id, e.settled_at AS at,\n      e.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units AS debt,\n      e.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units AS refund, e.refund_method,\n      e.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units + e.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units AS entitlement,\n      COALESCE((SELECT SUM(f.historical_restock_value_in_minor_units_exact)\n        FROM public.phase42_return_inventory_effects f WHERE f.return_event_id = e.id), 0) AS recovery\n    FROM modern_returns e\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT e.id, e.order_id, e.created_at, 0, e.refund_amount_in_minor_units, e.refund_method,\n      e.refund_amount_in_minor_units,\n      CASE WHEN e.stock_disposition = 'restock' THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.cogs_in_minor_units)\n        FROM public.order_items i WHERE i.order_id = e.order_id), 0) ELSE 0 END\n    FROM public.sales_returns e JOIN order_scope o ON o.id = e.order_id\n    WHERE o.operation_type IS NULL OR o.operation_type NOT IN\n      ('phase3_pos_sale_v1', 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1')\n  ), initial_collections AS (\n    SELECT o.id AS order_id,\n      CASE WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_pos_sale_v1' THEN o.creation_recorded_at\n        ELSE COALESCE(o.completion_recorded_at, o.completion_at) END AS at,\n      CASE WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_pos_sale_v1' THEN o.creation_result->>'paymentMethod'\n        WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1' THEN o.completion_request->>'payment_method'\n        WHEN o.payment_method = 'cash_on_delivery' THEN 'cash' ELSE o.payment_method END AS method,\n      CASE WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_pos_sale_v1' THEN (o.creation_result->>'amountPaidInMinorUnits')::BIGINT\n        WHEN o.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1' THEN\n          CASE WHEN NULLIF(o.completion_result->>'customer_payment_number', '') IS NOT NULL THEN 0\n            ELSE (o.completion_result->>'amount_paid_in_minor_units')::BIGINT END\n        WHEN o.payment_method = 'debt' THEN 0 ELSE o.total_in_minor_units END AS amount\n    FROM order_scope o\n  ), money_events AS (\n    SELECT order_id, at, method, amount AS collection, 0::BIGINT AS reversal, 0::BIGINT AS refund\n    FROM initial_collections WHERE amount > 0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT p.order_id, p.created_at, p.payment_method, p.amount_in_minor_units, 0, 0\n    FROM public.customer_payments p JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = p.order_id\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT p.order_id, p.reversed_at, p.payment_method, 0, p.amount_in_minor_units, 0\n    FROM public.customer_payments p JOIN public.orders o ON o.id = p.order_id\n    WHERE p.is_reversed AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT r.order_id, r.created_at, m.method, 0, m.amount, 0\n    FROM public.pos_sale_reversals r JOIN order_scope o ON o.id = r.order_id\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES\n      ('cash', (r.actual_effect->>'cash_in_minor_units')::BIGINT),\n      ('cliq', (r.actual_effect->>'cliq_in_minor_units')::BIGINT)) m(method, amount)\n    WHERE m.amount > 0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT order_id, at, refund_method, 0, 0, refund FROM return_rows WHERE refund > 0\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT NULL::UUID,c.created_at,c.payment_method,a.amount_in_minor_units,0,0\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c JOIN public.customer_collection_cheque_allocations a ON a.operation_id=c.id\n    JOIN public.cheque_compensation_claims k ON k.id=a.claim_id JOIN public.deferred_cheques q ON q.id=k.cheque_id\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.branch_id,q.branch_id)=p_branch_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT NULL::UUID,c.reversed_at,c.payment_method,0,a.amount_in_minor_units,0\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c JOIN public.customer_collection_cheque_allocations a ON a.operation_id=c.id\n    JOIN public.cheque_compensation_claims k ON k.id=a.claim_id JOIN public.deferred_cheques q ON q.id=k.cheque_id\n    WHERE c.is_reversed AND(p_branch_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.branch_id,q.branch_id)=p_branch_id)\n    UNION ALL\n    -- Opening allocation is not a customer_payment. The order allocation is\n    -- already counted above and must never be added from collection totals.\n    SELECT NULL::UUID,c.created_at,c.payment_method,a.amount_in_minor_units,0,0\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c\n    JOIN public.customer_collection_opening_allocations a ON a.operation_id=c.id\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.branch_id,public.go_live_main_branch_internal())=p_branch_id\n    UNION ALL\n    SELECT NULL::UUID,c.reversed_at,c.payment_method,0,a.amount_in_minor_units,0\n    FROM public.customer_collection_operations c\n    JOIN public.customer_collection_opening_allocations a ON a.operation_id=c.id\n    WHERE c.is_reversed AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR COALESCE(c.branch_id,public.go_live_main_branch_internal())=p_branch_id)\n  ), coverage_by_order AS (\n    SELECT order_id, SUM(collection - reversal)::BIGINT AS coverage\n    FROM money_events GROUP BY order_id\n  ), debt_by_order AS (\n    SELECT order_id, SUM(debt)::BIGINT AS debt_reduction\n    FROM return_rows GROUP BY order_id\n  ), positions AS (\n    SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.status, o.total_in_minor_units,\n      COALESCE(c.coverage, 0)::BIGINT AS coverage,\n      COALESCE(d.debt_reduction, 0)::BIGINT AS debt_reduction,\n      GREATEST(o.total_in_minor_units - COALESCE(c.coverage, 0) - COALESCE(d.debt_reduction, 0), 0)::BIGINT AS due\n    FROM order_scope o\n    LEFT JOIN coverage_by_order c ON c.order_id = o.id\n    LEFT JOIN debt_by_order d ON d.order_id = o.id\n  ), period_sales AS (\n    SELECT * FROM order_scope WHERE status IN ('completed', 'returned')\n      AND completion_at >= p_period_start AND completion_at < p_period_end\n  ), sales_totals AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS gross,\n      COALESCE(SUM(delivery_fee_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS delivery,\n      COUNT(*) AS count FROM period_sales\n  ), period_returns AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(entitlement), 0)::BIGINT AS entitlement,\n      COALESCE(SUM(refund), 0)::BIGINT AS refund, COALESCE(SUM(debt), 0)::BIGINT AS debt,\n      ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(recovery), 0))::BIGINT AS recovery, COUNT(*) AS count\n    FROM return_rows WHERE at >= p_period_start AND at < p_period_end\n  ), costs AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.cogs_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS cogs\n    FROM public.order_items i JOIN period_sales o ON o.id = i.order_id\n  ), replacement_costs AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.replacement_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS cost\n    FROM issued e JOIN public.phase43_replacement_inventory_effects f ON f.operation_id = e.operation_id\n    WHERE e.issued_at >= p_period_start AND e.issued_at < p_period_end\n  ), flows AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(collection - reversal) FILTER (WHERE method = 'cash'), 0)::BIGINT AS cash_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection - reversal) FILTER (WHERE method = 'cliq'), 0)::BIGINT AS cliq_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection-reversal) FILTER(WHERE method='bank_transfer'),0)::BIGINT AS bank_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection-reversal) FILTER(WHERE method='cheque'),0)::BIGINT AS cheque_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection-reversal) FILTER(WHERE COALESCE(method,'') NOT IN ('cash','cliq','bank_transfer','cheque')),0)::BIGINT AS other_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(collection-reversal),0)::BIGINT AS total_received,\n      COALESCE(SUM(refund) FILTER (WHERE method = 'cash'), 0)::BIGINT AS cash_refunded,\n      COALESCE(SUM(refund) FILTER (WHERE method = 'cliq'), 0)::BIGINT AS cliq_refunded\n    FROM money_events WHERE at >= p_period_start AND at < p_period_end\n  ), eligible AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.total_in_minor_units,\n      o.amount_paid_in_minor_units, o.operation_id\n    FROM public.orders o\n    WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'delivered')\n      AND o.customer_id IS NOT NULL\n      AND (p_branch_id IS NULL OR o.branch_id = p_branch_id)\n      AND (COALESCE(o.source, 'website') <> 'pos' OR o.payment_method = 'debt')\n  ), prior_debt AS MATERIALIZED (\n    -- Exact set-based form of121 phase42_order_financial_position_internal's\n    -- prior_debt source. Do not introduce a projection/cache or new authority.\n    SELECT e.order_id, SUM(e.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units)::BIGINT AS amount\n    FROM public.sales_return_events e JOIN eligible o ON o.id = e.order_id\n    WHERE e.settlement_status = 'settled' AND e.contract_version = 401\n      AND o.amount_paid_in_minor_units < o.total_in_minor_units\n    GROUP BY e.order_id\n  ), financial_positions AS MATERIALIZED (\n    SELECT o.*, CASE\n      WHEN o.amount_paid_in_minor_units >= o.total_in_minor_units THEN 0::BIGINT\n      ELSE GREATEST(o.total_in_minor_units - o.amount_paid_in_minor_units\n        - COALESCE(d.amount, 0), 0)::BIGINT END AS outstanding\n    FROM eligible o LEFT JOIN prior_debt d ON d.order_id = o.id\n  ), canonical_order_due AS (\n    -- Same set-based canonical positions used by192 aging/CRM;see parity guard.\n    SELECT id, customer_id, outstanding AS due FROM financial_positions\n  ), opening_due AS (\n    -- Preserve164 main-branch attribution;do not clamp signed source values.\n    SELECT opening.customer_id, opening.outstanding AS due\n    FROM public.go_live_customer_opening_positions_internal(NULL) opening\n    WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR p_branch_id = public.go_live_main_branch_internal()\n  ), balances AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(due), 0)::BIGINT AS due,\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE due > 0 AND is_order) AS orders,\n      COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FILTER (WHERE due > 0) AS customers\n    FROM (\n      SELECT true AS is_order, customer_id, due FROM canonical_order_due\n      UNION ALL\n      SELECT false, customer_id, due FROM opening_due\n      UNION ALL\n      SELECT false,c.customer_id,c.outstanding FROM public.cheque_customer_claim_positions_internal() c\n      JOIN public.cheque_compensation_claims k ON k.id=c.id JOIN public.deferred_cheques q ON q.id=k.cheque_id\n      WHERE p_branch_id IS NULL OR q.branch_id=p_branch_id\n    ) receivables\n  ), cohort AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.coverage), 0)::BIGINT AS coverage,\n      COALESCE(SUM(p.due), 0)::BIGINT AS due\n    FROM positions p JOIN period_sales o ON o.id = p.id\n  ), expenses AS (\n    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT AS amount,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = 'cash'), 0)::BIGINT AS cash,\n      COALESCE(SUM(amount_in_minor_units) FILTER (WHERE payment_method = 'cliq'), 0)::BIGINT AS cliq,\n      COUNT(*) AS count\n    FROM public.operational_expenses\n    WHERE (p_branch_id IS NULL OR branch_id = p_branch_id)\n      AND NOT COALESCE(is_reversed, false)\n      AND created_at >= p_period_start AND created_at < p_period_end\n  ), daily_collections AS (\n    -- One period-local END IF;\n  result:=jsonb_build_object('contractVersion',208,'action',p_action,'quantity',qty,'availableQuantity',available,\n   'eligible',blocked IS NULL,'blockedReason',blocked,'unitName',CASE WHEN p_payload->>'unit'='parcel' THEN 'طرد' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT name_ar FROM public.units WHERE id=p.unit_id),'باكيت') END);\n  IF public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner']) THEN result:=result||jsonb_build_object('valueInMinorUnitsExact',(qty*COALESCE(p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,p.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC))::TEXT);         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_erp_staff_password_reset(p_user_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_full_name TEXT;\n  v_target_is_owner BOOLEAN := false;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'إعادة تعيين كلمة مرور مستخدم');\n  IF p_user_id IS NULL OR p_user_id = auth.uid() THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إعادة تعيين كلمة مرور حسابك الحالي من هذه الشاشة.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT profile.full_name INTO v_full_name FROM public.profiles profile WHERE profile.id = p_user_id;\n  IF v_full_name IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حساب المستخدم غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles assignment\n    JOIN public.roles role ON role.id = assignment.role_id\n    WHERE assignment.user_id = p_user_id AND role.code = 'owner'\n  ) INTO v_target_is_owner;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)\n  VALUES (\n    auth.uid(),\n    CASE WHEN v_target_is_owner THEN 'إعادة تعيين كلمة مرور مالك نظام' ELSE 'إعادة تعيين كلمة مرور مستخدم' END,\n    'staff_account', p_user_id,\n    jsonb_build_object('full_name', v_full_name, 'is_owner', v_target_is_owner)\n  );\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'userId', p_user_id, 'message', 'تم تسجيل إعادة تعيين كلمة المرور.');\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_external_monitoring_snapshot(p_checks jsonb, p_observed_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())\n RETURNS integer\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_item JSONB;\n  v_count INTEGER := 0;\n  v_allowed CONSTANT TEXT[] := ARRAY[\n    'external:backup:erp','external:backup:n8n','external:backup:restore',\n    'external:infrastructure:docker','external:infrastructure:n8n',\n    'external:deployment:github','external:deployment:uptime',\n    'external:deployment:cloudflare-admin','external:deployment:cloudflare-customer'\n  ];\nBEGIN\n  IF p_observed_at IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_checks)<>'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_checks)>20 OR octet_length(p_checks::TEXT)>16384\n  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid external monitoring snapshot.'; END IF;\n  FOR v_item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_checks)\n  LOOP\n    IF NOT (v_item->>'key'=ANY(v_allowed))\n      OR v_item->>'category' NOT IN ('backup','infrastructure','deployment')\n      OR v_item->>'status' NOT IN ('healthy','warning','critical','unknown')\n      OR v_item->>'severity' NOT IN ('low','medium','high','critical')\n      OR COALESCE((v_item->>'issueCount')::INTEGER,-1)<0\n    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid external monitoring item.'; END IF;\n    PERFORM public._set_advanced_monitoring_check(\n      v_item->>'key',v_item->>'category','external',v_item->>'status',\n      v_item->>'severity',(v_item->>'issueCount')::INTEGER,\n      LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(v_item->>'summary'),''),'External check'),240),\n      COALESCE(v_item->'details','{}'::JSONB),p_observed_at);\n    v_count:=v_count+1;\n  END LOOP;\n  RETURN v_count;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_go_live_cheques_v1(p_branch_id uuid, p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_envelope JSONB:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('branch',p_branch_id,'rows',p_rows));\n  v_replay JSONB;v_plan JSONB;v_locked_rows JSONB;v_row JSONB;v_party RECORD;v_id UUID;v_index INTEGER:=0;v_created JSONB:='[]'::JSONB;v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'],'تسجيل الشيكات القائمة قبل التشغيل');\n  v_replay:=public.go_live_begin_batch_internal('opening_cheques',p_idempotency_key,v_envelope);\n  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.go_live_import_batches WHERE idempotency_key=p_idempotency_key AND created_by<>auth.uid()) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'GO_LIVE_BATCH_KEY_CONFLICT: المفتاح يخص عملية لفاعل آخر.';END IF;\n  IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN v_replay;END IF;\n  PERFORM public.go_live_assert_setup_open_internal();\n  -- Discover all parties before row locks. Same customer gate as collection;\n  -- supplier rows are locked in UUID order before any cheque row is created.\n  v_plan:=public.preview_go_live_cheques_v1(p_branch_id,p_rows);\n  IF jsonb_array_length(v_plan->'errors')>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE='GO_LIVE_CHEQUE_ROWS_INVALID: صحح الأسطر قبل الحفظ.',DETAIL=(v_plan->'errors')::TEXT;END IF;\n  v_locked_rows:=v_plan->'rows';\n  FOR v_party IN SELECT DISTINCT (r->>'customerId')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'rows') r\n    WHERE r->>'customerId' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LOOP\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('go-live-collection-customer:'||v_party.id::TEXT,0));\n  END LOOP;\n  FOR v_party IN SELECT DISTINCT (r->>'customerId')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'rows') r\n    WHERE r->>'customerId' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LOOP\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.customers WHERE id=v_party.id AND NOT is_deleted FOR UPDATE;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'العميل غير موجود أو حُذف؛ أعد المعاينة.';END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  FOR v_party IN SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(r->>'supplierId',r->>'endorsedSupplierId')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'rows') r\n    WHERE COALESCE(r->>'supplierId',r->>'endorsedSupplierId') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LOOP\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=v_party.id FOR UPDATE;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'المورد غير موجود؛ أعد المعاينة.';END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  -- Revalidate duplicates under party gates;preview is never write authority.\n  v_plan:=public.preview_go_live_cheques_v1(p_branch_id,p_rows);\n  IF jsonb_array_length(v_plan->'errors')>0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING MESSAGE='GO_LIVE_CHEQUE_ROWS_INVALID: صحح الأسطر قبل الحفظ.',DETAIL=(v_plan->'errors')::TEXT;END IF;\n  IF v_plan->'rows' IS DISTINCT FROM v_locked_rows THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'GO_LIVE_CHEQUE_PARTIES_CHANGED: تغيّرت هوية الأطراف أثناء الحفظ؛ أعد المعاينة.';\n  END IF;\n  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'rows') LOOP\n    v_index:=v_index+1;v_id:=gen_random_uuid();\n    INSERT INTO public.deferred_cheques(id,tracking_number,direction,origin,cheque_number,bank_name,due_date,amount_in_minor_units,\n      customer_id,supplier_id,endorsed_supplier_id,branch_id,status,original_debt_at,notes,created_by,changed_by)\n    VALUES(v_id,'CHQ-'||lpad(nextval('public.deferred_cheque_number_seq')::TEXT,8,'0'),v_row->>'direction','opening',\n      v_row->>'number',v_row->>'bank',(v_row->>'dueDate')::DATE,(v_row->>'amount')::BIGINT,\n      (v_row->>'customerId')::UUID,(v_row->>'supplierId')::UUID,(v_row->>'endorsedSupplierId')::UUID,p_branch_id,\n      v_row->>'status',(v_row->>'originalDebtAt')::TIMESTAMPTZ,v_row->>'notes',auth.uid(),auth.uid());\n    FOR v_party IN SELECT 'customer'::TEXT kind,(v_row->>'customerId')::UUID id WHERE v_row->>'customerId' IS NOT NULL\n      UNION ALL SELECT 'supplier',COALESCE(v_row->>'supplierId',v_row->>'endorsedSupplierId')::UUID\n        WHERE COALESCE(v_row->>'supplierId',v_row->>'endorsedSupplierId') IS NOT NULL LOOP\n      INSERT INTO public.cheque_party_keys(party_kind,party_id,bank_key,cheque_number,cheque_id)\n      VALUES(v_party.kind,v_party.id,lower(v_row->>'bank'),v_row->>'number',v_id);\n      INSERT INTO public.deferred_cheque_allocations(cheque_id,party_kind,party_id,origin_kind,origin_id,original_debt_at,amount_in_minor_units)\n      VALUES(v_id,v_party.kind,v_party.id,'opening_cheque',v_id,(v_row->>'originalDebtAt')::TIMESTAMPTZ,(v_row->>'amount')::BIGINT);\n    END LOOP;\n    v_result:=public.cheque_finish_event_internal(v_id,'opening_registered',NULL,NULL,\n      'opening-cheque-'||md5(p_idempotency_key)||'-'||v_index::TEXT,\n      jsonb_build_object('action','opening_register','branch',p_branch_id,'batchKey',p_idempotency_key,'row',v_row));\n    v_created:=v_created||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id',v_id,'trackingNumber',v_result#>>'{cheque,tracking_number}'));\n  END LOOP;\n  v_result:=jsonb_build_object('success',true,'idempotentReplay',false,'created',v_created,'rowCount',v_index,\n    'parties',v_plan->'parties','balanceEffectInMinorUnits',0);\n  INSERT INTO public.go_live_import_batches(batch_kind,idempotency_key,request_hash,row_count,result,created_by)\n  VALUES('opening_cheques',p_idempotency_key,md5(v_envelope::TEXT),v_index,v_result,auth.uid());\n  RETURN v_result;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_supplier_opening_balances_v1(p_idempotency_key text, p_rows jsonb, p_dry_run boolean DEFAULT false, p_confirm_new_suppliers boolean DEFAULT false)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_replay JSONB;\n  v_row JSONB;\n  v_n INTEGER := 0;\n  v_errors JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_error TEXT;\n  v_supplier_id UUID;\n  v_count INTEGER;\n  v_warning BOOLEAN;\n  v_name TEXT;\n  v_phone TEXT;\n  v_other TEXT;\n  v_new_key TEXT;\n  v_new JSONB := '{}'::JSONB;\n  v_created_suppliers JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_date DATE;\n  v_direction TEXT;\n  v_notes TEXT;\n  v_today DATE := (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE;\n  v_valid JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_batch_id UUID;\n  v_created JSONB := '[]'::JSONB;\n  v_entry public.supplier_opening_balances%ROWTYPE;\n  v_payable BIGINT := 0;\n  v_advance BIGINT := 0;\n  v_supplier UUID;\n  v_signed BIGINT;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'], 'إدخال أرصدة الموردين الافتتاحية');\n  PERFORM public.go_live_assert_setup_open_internal();\n  IF NOT COALESCE(p_dry_run, false) THEN\n    v_replay := public.go_live_begin_batch_internal('supplier_opening', p_idempotency_key, p_rows);\n    IF v_replay IS NOT NULL THEN\n      RETURN v_replay;\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF p_rows IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(p_rows) <> 'array'\n    OR jsonb_array_length(p_rows) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 500 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الدفعة يجب أن تحتوي من 1 إلى 500 سطر.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)\n  LOOP\n    v_n := v_n + 1;\n    v_error := NULL; v_warning := false; v_supplier_id := NULL; v_date := NULL; v_new_key := NULL; v_other := NULL;\n    v_name := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'supplier_name'), '');\n    v_phone := NULLIF(public.normalize_customer_phone(COALESCE(v_row->>'supplier_phone', '')), '');\n    v_direction := v_row->>'direction';\n    v_notes := NULLIF(BTRIM(v_row->>'notes'), '');\n    IF jsonb_typeof(v_row) <> 'object' THEN\n      v_error := 'بيانات السطر غير صحيحة.';\n    ELSIF v_direction IS NULL OR v_direction NOT IN ('payable', 'advance') THEN\n      v_error := 'اتجاه الرصيد يجب أن يكون \"له\" أو \"عليه\".';\n    ELSIF COALESCE(v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units', '') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,11}$' THEN\n      v_error := 'المبلغ يجب أن يكون أكبر من صفر وبثلاث منازل عشرية كحد أقصى.';\n    ELSIF COALESCE(v_row->>'original_balance_date', '') !~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN\n      v_error := 'تاريخ الرصيد الأصلي مطلوب بصيغة YYYY-MM-DD.';\n    ELSIF v_notes IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_notes) > 300 THEN\n      v_error := 'الملاحظة أطول من 300 حرف.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL THEN\n      BEGIN\n        v_date := (v_row->>'original_balance_date')::DATE;\n      EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN\n        v_error := 'تاريخ الرصيد الأصلي غير صحيح.';\n      END;\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL AND v_date > v_today THEN\n      v_error := 'تاريخ الرصيد الأصلي لا يمكن أن يكون في المستقبل.';\n    ELSIF v_error IS NULL AND v_date < DATE '2000-01-01' THEN\n      v_error := 'تاريخ الرصيد الأصلي أقدم من المسموح (2000-01-01).';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL AND v_name IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_name) > 150 THEN\n      v_error := 'اسم المورد أطول من المسموح.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL AND COALESCE(v_row->>'supplier_id', '') <> '' THEN\n      IF v_row->>'supplier_id' ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN\n        SELECT id INTO v_supplier_id FROM public.suppliers\n        WHERE id = (v_row->>'supplier_id')::UUID AND is_active;\n      END IF;\n      IF v_supplier_id IS NULL THEN v_error := 'المورد غير موجود أو غير نشط.'; END IF;\n    ELSIF v_error IS NULL AND v_name IS NULL AND v_phone IS NULL THEN\n      v_error := 'اسم المورد أو هاتفه مطلوب لمطابقته.';\n    ELSIF v_error IS NULL THEN\n      IF v_phone IS NOT NULL THEN\n        SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(id::TEXT)::UUID INTO v_count, v_supplier_id FROM public.suppliers\n        WHERE is_active AND NULLIF(public.normalize_customer_phone(COALESCE(phone, '')), '') = v_phone;\n        IF v_count > 1 THEN\n          v_supplier_id := NULL;\n          v_error := 'يوجد أكثر من مورد بهذا الهاتف؛ أدخل الرصيد يدوياً باختيار المورد.';\n        ELSIF v_count = 0 THEN\n          v_supplier_id := NULL;\n        END IF;\n      ELSE\n        SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(id::TEXT)::UUID INTO v_count, v_supplier_id FROM public.suppliers\n        WHERE is_active AND BTRIM(company_name) = v_name;\n        IF v_count > 1 THEN\n          v_supplier_id := NULL;\n          v_error := 'يوجد أكثر من مورد بهذا الاسم؛ أدخل الرصيد يدوياً باختيار المورد.';\n        ELSIF v_count = 0 THEN\n          v_supplier_id := NULL;\n        END IF;\n      END IF;\n      IF v_error IS NULL AND v_supplier_id IS NULL THEN\n        SELECT company_name || COALESCE(' — ' || NULLIF(phone, ''), '') INTO v_other FROM public.suppliers\n        WHERE is_active AND v_name IS NOT NULL\n          AND public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(company_name) = public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(v_name)\n        ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 1;\n        IF v_other IS NOT NULL THEN\n          v_warning := true;\n          v_error := 'تحذير: يوجد مورد باسم مطابق أو مشابه '\n            || CASE WHEN v_phone IS NULL THEN 'والسطر بلا هاتف' ELSE 'وهاتف مختلف' END\n            || ' (' || v_other || ')؛ صحّح السطر أو أدخل الرصيد يدوياً. لن يُنشأ مورد مكرر.';\n        ELSIF v_name IS NULL THEN\n          v_error := 'لا يوجد مورد بهذا الهاتف، واسم المورد مطلوب لإضافته كمورد جديد.';\n        ELSE\n          v_new_key := public.go_live_normalize_name_internal(v_name);\n        END IF;\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NULL AND EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_valid) prior\n      WHERE COALESCE(prior->>'supplier_id', prior->>'new_key') = COALESCE(v_supplier_id::TEXT, v_new_key)) THEN\n      v_error := 'المورد مكرر داخل الملف؛ اجعل لكل مورد سطراً واحداً بصافي رصيده.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_error IS NOT NULL THEN\n      v_errors := v_errors || jsonb_build_object('row', v_n, 'message', v_error,\n        'kind', CASE WHEN v_warning THEN 'warning' ELSE 'error' END);\n    ELSE\n      IF v_new_key IS NOT NULL THEN\n        v_new := v_new || jsonb_build_object(v_new_key, jsonb_build_object('row', v_n, 'name', v_name, 'phone', v_phone));\n      END IF;\n      v_valid := v_valid || jsonb_build_object('row', v_n, 'supplier_id', v_supplier_id, 'new_key', v_new_key,\n        'direction', v_direction, 'amount_in_minor_units', (v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT,\n        'original_balance_date', v_date, 'notes', v_notes);\n      IF v_direction = 'payable' THEN\n        v_payable := v_payable + (v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;\n      ELSE\n        v_advance := v_advance + (v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT;\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  IF COALESCE(p_dry_run, false) THEN\n    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'dryRun', true, 'rowCount', v_n,\n      'validCount', jsonb_array_length(v_valid), 'errors', v_errors,\n      'newSuppliers', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(value ORDER BY (value->>'row')::INTEGER)\n        FROM jsonb_each(v_new)), '[]'::JSONB),\n      'payableTotalInMinorUnits', v_payable, 'advanceTotalInMinorUnits', v_advance);\n  END IF;\n  IF jsonb_array_length(v_errors) > 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_BATCH_INVALID: الملف يحتوي أسطراً غير صالحة أو تحذيرات؛ لم يُحفظ أي سطر.',\n      DETAIL = v_errors::TEXT;\n  END IF;\n  IF v_new <> '{}'::JSONB AND NOT COALESCE(p_confirm_new_suppliers, false) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'GO_LIVE_NEW_PARTIES_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: سيُضاف ' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(v_new))\n        || ' مورد جديد؛ أكّد إضافتهم قبل الحفظ.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_new_key IN SELECT key FROM jsonb_each(v_new) ORDER BY (value->>'row')::INTEGER\n  LOOP\n    INSERT INTO public.suppliers(company_name, phone, is_active)\n    VALUES (v_new->v_new_key->>'name', v_new->v_new_key->>'phone', true)\n    RETURNING id INTO v_supplier_id;\n    v_new := jsonb_set(v_new, ARRAY[v_new_key, 'supplier_id'], to_jsonb(v_supplier_id));\n    v_created_suppliers := v_created_suppliers || jsonb_build_object('supplierId', v_supplier_id,\n      'name', v_new->v_new_key->>'name', 'phone', v_new->v_new_key->>'phone');\n    INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)\n    VALUES (v_user_id, 'GO_LIVE_SUPPLIER_CREATED', 'suppliers', v_supplier_id,\n      jsonb_build_object('company_name', v_new->v_new_key->>'name', 'phone', v_new->v_new_key->>'phone'));\n  END LOOP;\n  v_valid := (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN v->>'supplier_id' IS NULL\n      THEN jsonb_set(v, '{supplier_id}', v_new->(v->>'new_key')->'supplier_id') ELSE v END\n      ORDER BY (v->>'row')::INTEGER), '[]'::JSONB)\n    FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_valid) v);\n\n  -- Lock suppliers in a stable order before changing their stored balances.\n  FOR v_supplier IN SELECT DISTINCT (v->>'supplier_id')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_valid) v ORDER BY 1\n  LOOP\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id = v_supplier FOR UPDATE;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  v_batch_id := gen_random_uuid();\n  FOR v_row IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_valid)\n  LOOP\n    INSERT INTO public.supplier_opening_balances(entry_number, supplier_id, direction,\n      amount_in_minor_units, original_balance_date, notes, batch_id, created_by)\n    VALUES ('SOB-' || LPAD(nextval('public.supplier_opening_balance_number_seq')::TEXT, 6, '0'),\n      (v_row->>'supplier_id')::UUID, v_row->>'direction', (v_row->>'amount_in_minor_units')::BIGINT,\n      (v_row->>'original_balance_date')::DATE, v_row->>'notes', v_batch_id, v_user_id)\n    RETURNING * INTO v_entry;\n    v_signed := CASE WHEN v_entry.direction = 'payable' THEN v_entry.amount_in_minor_units\n      ELSE -v_entry.amount_in_minor_units END;\n    UPDATE public.suppliers\n    SET current_balance_in_minor_units = current_balance_in_minor_units + v_signed, updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE id = v_entry.supplier_id;\n    v_created := v_created || jsonb_build_object('row', (v_row->>'row')::INTEGER,\n      'entryId', v_entry.id, 'entryNumber', v_entry.entry_number, 'supplierId', v_entry.supplier_id,\n      'direction', v_entry.direction, 'amountInMinorUnits', v_entry.amount_in_minor_units,\n      'originalBalanceDate', v_entry.original_balance_date);\n  END LOOP;\n  v_result := jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'dryRun', false, 'idempotentReplay', hashtextextended(\n      v_user_id::TEXT || ':purchase_order_payment:' || v_key,\n      0\n    )\n  );\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing\n  FROM public.supplier_payments\n  WHERE created_by = v_user_id\n DETAIL=jsonb_build_object('payable',v_actual_payable,'paid',v_active_paid,\n          'maxAllowed',GREATEST(v_actual_payable-v_active_paid,0))::TEXT;\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  v_result := VALUES (v_user_id, 'REVERSE_OWNER_WITHDRAWALS_FOR_SHIFT', 'cash_shifts', p_shift_id,\n      jsonb_build_object('reversal_id', v_reversal_id, 'reason', v_reason,\n        'withdrawals_reversed', v_voided_amount));\nEND;\n$function$\n",

PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('go-live-collection-customer:'||v_customer_id::TEXT,0));\n  SELECT * INTO v_operation FROM public.customer_collection_operations WHERE SELECT v_operation.cash_shift_id AS shift_id\n    UNION SELECT (p->>'shiftId')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_plan->'payments') p\n  ) resources WHERE shift_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY shift_id\n  LOOP jsonb_build_object('operation',to_jsonb(v_operation),'payments',\n    COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('link',to_jsonb(link),'paymentId',payment.id,\n      'orderId',payment.order_id,'shiftId',payment.cash_shift_id) ORDER BY payment.id)\n      FROM public.customer_collection_order_payments link\n      JOIN public.customer_payments payment ON payment.id=link.customer_payment_id\n      WHERE link.operation_id=v_operation.id),'[]'::JSONB)) INTO v_locked_plan;\n  IF v_locked_plan IS DISTINCT FROM v_plan THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING   WHERE operation_id = v_operation.id ORDER BY customer_payment_id\n  LOOP\n    PERFORM public.reverse_customer_order_payment(v_payment_id,\n      'عكس عملية تحصيل ' || v_operation.operation_number || ': ' || v_reason);\n  END LOOP;\n  PERFORM set_config('nawasrah.collection_reversal', '', true);\n  UPDATE public.customer_collection_operations\n  SET is_reversed = true, reversed_at = NOW(),         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_customer_order_payment(p_payment_id uuid, p_reason text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_order_id UUID;\n  v_shift_id UUID;\n  v_locked_order_id UUID;\n  v_locked_shift_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant'],\n    'عكس سند قبض عميل'\n  );\n  SELECT payment.order_id, payment.cash_shift_id\n  INTO v_order_id, v_shift_id\n  FROM public.customer_payments payment WHERE payment.id = p_payment_id;\n  IF v_order_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001', MESSAGE = 'Customer payment not found.';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('phase4-order|' || v_order_id::TEXT, 0));\n  IF v_shift_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.cash_shifts shift WHERE shift.id = v_shift_id FOR UPDATE;\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.orders customer_order WHERE customer_order.id = v_order_id FOR UPDATE;\n  SELECT payment.order_id, payment.cash_shift_id\n  INTO v_locked_order_id, v_locked_shift_id\n  FROM public.customer_payments payment\n  WHERE payment.id = p_payment_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF v_locked_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order_id\n    OR v_locked_shift_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_shift_id\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '40001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_LOCK_PLAN_CHANGED_RETRY: Customer Payment relationship changed.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN public._reverse_customer_order_payment_before_phase4_lock(\n    p_payment_id, p_reason\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reverse_owner_cash_withdrawal_v1(p_withdrawal_id uuid, p_reason text, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY ''));\n  v_fingerprint TEXT;\n  v_existing public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals%ROWTYPE;\n  v_withdrawal public.owner_cash_withdrawals%ROWTYPE;\n  v_original public.cash_shifts%ROWTYPE;\n  v_effective_shift UUID;\n  v_lock UUID;\n  v_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_user_id := public.assert_reversal_owner('عكس سحب المالك');\n  IF char_length(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION مطلوب (5 إلى 500 حرف).';\n  END IF;\n  v_fingerprint := md5(COALESCE(p_withdrawal_id::TEXT, '') || '|' || v_reason);\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_existing FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawal_reversals\n  WHERE reversed_by = v_user_id AND idempotency_key = v_key;\n  IF FOUND THEN\n    IF v_existing.request_fingerprint <> v_fingerprint THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_KEY_CONFLICT: استُخدم مفتاح العملية لطلب عكس مختلف.';\n    END IF;\n    RETURN public.owner_withdrawal_result_internal(v_existing.withdrawal_id, true)\n      || jsonb_build_object('reversalId', v_existing.id, 'effectiveShiftId', v_existing.effective_shift_id);\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_withdrawal FROM public.owner_cash_withdrawals WHERE id = p_withdrawal_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_NOT_FOUND: السحب المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO v_original FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE id = v_withdrawal.cash_shift_id;\n  -- The return goes back into the withdrawal's shift while it is open,\n  -- otherwise into the open shift of the same branch (one per branch).\n  IF v_original.status = 'open' THEN\n    v_effective_shift := v_original.id;\n  ELSE\n    SELECT shift.id INTO v_effective_shift FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n    WHERE shift.branch_id = v_withdrawal.branch_id AND shift.status = 'open';\n    IF v_effective_shift IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'OWNER_WITHDRAWAL_REVERSAL_NEEDS_OPEN_SHIFT: افتح وردية في فرع السحب ليُعاد المبلغ إلى درجها.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Lock order: reversal domains (sorted), shift rows (sorted),         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_product_unit(p_name_ar text, p_code text, p_conversion_factor integer DEFAULT 1, p_unit_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n SELECT u.id, u.is_active, u.is_system\n    INTO v_unit_id, v_existing_active, v_existing_system\n    FROM public.units u\n    WHERE u.code = v_code\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    IF FOUND AND public.units\n    WHERE id = p_unit_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'وحدة القياس المحددة غير موجودة.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_existing_system THEN\n      RAISE entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    auth.uid(),\n    CASE\n      WHEN v_was_restored THEN 'RESTORE_PRODUCT_UNIT'\n      WHEN v_is_new THEN 'CREATE_PRODUCT_UNIT'\n      ELSE );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.scan_business_summaries(p_observed_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now())\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_settings public.business_alert_settings%ROWTYPE;\n  v_local_now TIMESTAMP;\n  v_latest_daily_due DATE;\n  v_latest_weekly_due DATE;\n  v_date DATE;\n  v_due_at TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_daily_created BOOLEAN := false;\n  v_weekly_created BOOLEAN := false;\n  v_missed INTEGER := 0;\n  v_result JSONB;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_observed_at IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Business summary observation time is required.';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '3s', true);\n  PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout', '25s', true);\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('scan-business-summaries', 0));\n\n  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_settings\n  FROM public.business_alert_settings WHERE id = true;\n  v_local_now := p_observed_at AT TIME ZONE v_settings.business_timezone;\n\n  IF v_settings.daily_summary_enabled THEN\n    v_latest_daily_due := v_local_now::DATE\n      - CASE WHEN v_local_now::TIME < v_settings.daily_summary_local_time\n        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;\n    FOR v_date IN\n      SELECT day_value::DATE\n      FROM generate_series(\n        GREATEST(\n          (v_settings.summaries_activated_at AT TIME ZONE v_settings.business_timezone)::DATE,\n          v_latest_daily_due - 30\n        ),\n        v_latest_daily_due,\n        INTERVAL '1 day'\n      ) day_value\n      ORDER BY day_value\n    LOOP\n      v_due_at := (v_date + v_settings.daily_summary_local_time)\n        AT TIME ZONE v_settings.business_timezone;\n      CONTINUE WHEN v_due_at < v_settings.summaries_activated_at\n        OR v_due_at > p_observed_at\n        OR v_date - 1 < (\n          v_settings.summaries_activated_at AT TIME ZONE v_settings.business_timezone\n        )::DATE;\n      IF v_date < v_latest_daily_due THEN\n        INSERT INTO public.business_summary_runs(\n          summary_type, period_start, period_end, scheduled_for, run_status\n        ) VALUES ('daily', v_date - 1, v_date - 1, v_due_at, 'missed')\n        ON CONFLICT (summary_type, period_start, period_end) DO NOTHING;\n        v_missed := v_missed + (FOUND)::INTEGER;\n      ELSE\n        v_result := public.enqueue_business_summary(\n          'daily', v_date - 1, v_date - 1, v_due_at, p_observed_at\n        );\n        v_daily_created := COALESCE((v_result->>'created')::BOOLEAN, false);\n      END IF;\n    END LOOP;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_settings.weekly_summary_enabled THEN\n    v_latest_weekly_due := v_local_now::DATE\n      - MOD(\n          EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM v_local_now::DATE)::INTEGER\n          - v_settings.weekly_summary_iso_day + 7,\n          7\n        );\n    IF v_latest_weekly_due = v_local_now::DATE\n      AND v_local_now::TIME < v_settings.weekly_summary_local_time\n    THEN\n      v_latest_weekly_due := v_latest_weekly_due - 7;\n    END IF;\n\n    FOR v_date IN\n      SELECT due_date::DATE\n      FROM generate_series(\n        GREATEST(\n          (v_settings.summaries_activated_at AT TIME ZONE v_settings.business_timezone)::DATE,\n          v_latest_weekly_due - 56\n        ),\n        v_latest_weekly_due,\n        INTERVAL '1 day'\n      ) due_date\n      WHERE EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM due_date)::INTEGER\n        = v_settings.weekly_summary_iso_day\n      ORDER BY due_date\n    LOOP\n      v_due_at := (v_date + v_settings.weekly_summary_local_time)\n        AT TIME ZONE v_settings.business_timezone;\n      CONTINUE WHEN v_due_at < v_settings.summaries_activated_at\n        OR v_due_at > p_observed_at\n        OR v_date - 7 < (\n          v_settings.summaries_activated_at AT TIME ZONE v_settings.business_timezone\n        )::DATE;\n      IF v_date < v_latest_weekly_due THEN\n        INSERT INTO public.business_summary_runs(\n          summary_type, period_start, period_end, scheduled_for, run_status\n        ) VALUES ('weekly', v_date - 7, v_date - 1, v_due_at, 'missed')\n        ON CONFLICT (summary_type, period_start, period_end) DO NOTHING;\n        v_missed := v_missed + (FOUND)::INTEGER;\n      ELSE\n        v_result := public.enqueue_business_summary(\n          'weekly', v_date - 7, v_date - 1, v_due_at, p_observed_at\n        );\n        v_weekly_created := COALESCE((v_result->>'created')::BOOLEAN, false);\n      END IF;\n    END LOOP;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'dailyCreated', v_daily_created,\n    'weeklyCreated', v_weekly_created,\n    'missedRecorded', v_missed\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.scan_core_business_alerts(p_observed_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now(), p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 100)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_settings public.business_alert_settings%ROWTYPE;\n  v_row RECORD;\n  v_transition TEXT;\n  v_opened INTEGER := 0;\n  v_resolved INTEGER := 0;\n  v_max_close_at TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_active BOOLEAN;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_observed_at IS NULL OR p_batch_size IS NULL\n    OR p_batch_size NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 200\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid Business alert scan request.';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout', '3s', true);\n  PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout', '25s', true);\n\n  SELECT * INTO STRICT v_settings\n  FROM public.business_alert_settings\n  WHERE id = true;\n\n  -- Delayed order: two hours old and still in an actual open workflow state.\n  FOR v_row IN\n    SELECT o.id, o.order_number, o.status, o.created_at\n    FROM public.orders o\n    WHERE o.status IN ('new', 'confirmed', 'preparing', 'ready', 'out_for_delivery')\n      AND o.created_at <= p_observed_at\n        - make_interval(mins => v_settings.order_unprocessed_after_minutes)\n    ORDER BY o.created_at, o.id\n    LIMIT p_batch_size\n  LOOP\n    v_transition := public._transition_business_alert_incident(\n      'order_unprocessed:' || v_row.id::TEXT,\n      'order_unprocessed', v_row.id, true, p_observed_at,\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'orderNumber', v_row.order_number,\n        'createdAt', v_row.created_at,\n        'status', v_row.status,\n        'thresholdMinutes', v_settings.order_unprocessed_after_minutes\n      )\n    );\n    v_opened := v_opened + (v_transition = 'opened')::INTEGER;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  -- Preserve the separately approved website reservation-expiry warning.\n  IF v_settings.order_near_expiry_minutes IS NOT NULL THEN\n    FOR v_row IN\n      SELECT o.id, o.order_number, o.reservation_expires_at\n      FROM public.orders o\n      WHERE o.source = 'website' AND o.status = 'new'\n        AND o.reservation_expires_at > p_observed_at\n        AND o.reservation_expires_at <= p_observed_at\n          + make_interval(mins => v_settings.order_near_expiry_minutes)\n      ORDER BY o.reservation_expires_at, o.id\n      LIMIT p_batch_size\n    LOOP\n      v_transition := public._transition_business_alert_incident(\n        'order_near_expiry:' || v_row.id::TEXT,\n        'order_near_expiry', v_row.id, true, p_observed_at,\n        jsonb_build_object(\n          'orderNumber', v_row.order_number,\n          'expiresAt', v_row.reservation_expires_at\n        )\n      );\n      v_opened := v_opened + (v_transition = 'opened')::INTEGER;\n    END LOOP;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_settings.purchase_order_overdue_enabled THEN\n    FOR v_row IN\n      SELECT po.id, po.purchase_order_number, po.status,\n             po.expected_delivery_date, s.company_name AS supplier_name\n      FROM public.purchase_orders po\n      JOIN public.suppliers s ON s.id = po.supplier_id\n      WHERE po.status IN ('sent', 'approved', 'partially_received')\n        AND po.expected_delivery_date IS NOT NULL\n        AND po.expected_delivery_date < p_observed_at\n      ORDER BY po.expected_delivery_date, po.id\n      LIMIT p_batch_size\n    LOOP\n      v_transition := public._transition_business_alert_incident(\n        'purchase_order_overdue:' || v_row.id::TEXT,\n        'purchase_order_overdue', v_row.id, true, p_observed_at,\n        jsonb_build_object(\n          'purchaseOrderNumber', v_row.purchase_order_number,\n          'supplierName', v_row.supplier_name,\n          'expectedDeliveryAt', v_row.expected_delivery_date,\n          'status', v_row.status\n        )\n      );\n      v_opened := v_opened + (v_transition = 'opened')::INTEGER;\n    END LOOP;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- An open shift cannot exceed either 15 elapsed hours or its opening local\n  -- calendar day. The earlier absolute instant is authoritative.\n  FOR v_row IN\n    SELECT cs.id, cs.shift_number, cs.opened_at\n    FROM public.cash_shifts cs\n    WHERE cs.status = 'open'\n    ORDER BY cs.opened_at, cs.id\n    LIMIT p_batch_size\n  LOOP\n    v_max_close_at := LEAST(\n      v_row.opened_at + INTERVAL '15 hours',\n      (\n        (v_row.opened_at AT TIME ZONE v_settings.business_timezone)::DATE + 1\n      )::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE v_settings.business_timezone\n    );\n    v_transition := public._transition_business_alert_incident(\n      'shift_close_overdue:' || v_row.id::TEXT,\n      'shift_close_overdue', v_row.id,\n      p_observed_at >= v_max_close_at, p_observed_at,\n      jsonb_build_object(\n        'shiftNumber', v_row.shift_number,\n        'openedAt', v_row.opened_at,\n        'expectedCloseAt', v_max_close_at,\n        'maxDurationHours', 15,\n        'timezone', v_settings.business_timezone\n      )\n    );\n    v_opened := v_opened + (v_transition = 'opened')::INTEGER;\n    v_resolved := v_resolved + (v_transition = 'resolved')::INTEGER;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  -- Resolve only incident types owned by this scanner. Legacy shift-reminder\n  -- and expense-threshold incidents are closed because those rules are off.\n  FOR v_row IN\n    SELECT bi.*\n    FROM public.business_alert_incidents bi\n    WHERE bi.state = 'open'\n      AND bi.alert_type IN (\n        'order_unprocessed', 'order_near_expiry',\n        'shift_close_reminder', 'shift_close_overdue',\n        'purchase_order_overdue', 'expense_daily_threshold'\n      )\n    ORDER BY bi.last_seen_at, bi.incident_key\n    LIMIT p_batch_size\n  LOOP\n    v_active := CASE v_row.alert_type\n      WHEN 'order_unprocessed' THEN EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1 FROM public.orders o\n        WHERE o.id = v_row.entity_id\n          AND o.status IN ('new', 'confirmed', 'preparing', 'ready', 'out_for_delivery')\n          AND o.created_at <= p_observed_at\n            - make_interval(mins => v_settings.order_unprocessed_after_minutes)\n      )\n      WHEN 'order_near_expiry' THEN\n        v_settings.order_near_expiry_minutes IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 FROM public.orders o\n          WHERE o.id = v_row.entity_id AND o.source = 'website' AND o.status = 'new'\n            AND o.reservation_expires_at > p_observed_at\n            AND o.reservation_expires_at <= p_observed_at\n              + make_interval(mins => v_settings.order_near_expiry_minutes)\n        )\n      WHEN 'purchase_order_overdue' THEN\n        v_settings.purchase_order_overdue_enabled AND EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1 FROM public.purchase_orders po\n          WHERE po.id = v_row.entity_id\n            AND po.status IN ('sent', 'approved', 'partially_received')\n            AND po.expected_delivery_date IS NOT NULL\n            AND po.expected_delivery_date < p_observed_at\n        )\n      WHEN 'shift_close_overdue' THEN EXISTS (\n        SELECT 1\n        FROM public.cash_shifts cs\n        WHERE cs.id = v_row.entity_id\n          AND cs.status = 'open'\n          AND p_observed_at >= LEAST(\n            cs.opened_at + INTERVAL '15 hours',\n            (\n              (cs.opened_at AT TIME ZONE v_settings.business_timezone)::DATE + 1\n            )::TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE v_settings.business_timezone\n          )\n      )\n      WHEN 'shift_close_reminder' THEN false\n      WHEN 'expense_daily_threshold' THEN false\n      ELSE false\n    END;\n\n    IF NOT v_active THEN\n      v_transition := public._transition_business_alert_incident(\n        v_row.incident_key, v_row.alert_type, v_row.entity_id,\n        false, p_observed_at,\n        jsonb_build_object('reference', v_row.incident_key)\n      );\n      v_resolved := v_resolved + (v_transition = 'resolved')::INTEGER;\n    END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n\n  PERFORM public.scan_deferred_cheque_alerts_internal(p_observed_at);\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'opened', v_opened,\n    'resolved', v_resolved,\n    'rules', jsonb_build_object(\n      'delayedOrderMinutes', v_settings.order_unprocessed_after_minutes,\n      'cashDifference', 'non_zero',\n      'dailyExpenseWindow', 'calendar_day',\n      'shiftMaxDurationHours', 15,\n      'timezone', v_settings.business_timezone\n    )\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.scan_deferred_cheque_alerts_internal(p_observed_at timestamp with time zone)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_day DATE:=(p_observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Amman')::DATE;v_c public.deferred_cheques%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  -- The existing five-minute core scan calls this; no new cron, HTTP or secret.\n  -- Incoming endorsed cheques are held by the supplier, not for our deposit.\n  FOR v_c IN SELECT * FROM public.deferred_cheques WHERE status='pending' AND due_date=v_day+2 ORDER BY id LOOP\n    PERFORM public.enqueue_automation_event('cheque-due:'||v_c.id::TEXT||':'||v_c.due_date::TEXT,'cheque_due',v_c.id,\n      jsonb_build_object('trackingNumber',v_c.tracking_number,'direction',v_c.direction,'dueDate',v_c.due_date,\n        'amountInMinorUnits',v_c.amount_in_minor_units,'audience','owner','screen','cheques',\n        'instruction',CASE WHEN v_c.direction='outgoing' THEN 'تأكد من كفاية الرصيد' ELSE 'تذكير بإيداع الشيك' END));\n  END LOOP;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_admin_products(p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 24, p_category_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_purpose text DEFAULT 'stockable'::text, p_product_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_search TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_search), '');\n  v_limit INTEGER := COALESCE(p_limit, 24);\n  v_purpose TEXT := COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_purpose), ''), 'stockable');\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY[\n      'owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'accountant', 'cashier', 'sales',\n      'warehouse_keeper', 'orders', 'delivery_driver', 'view_only'\n    ],\n    'البحث في المنتجات الإدارية'\n  );\n\n  IF v_limit < 1 OR v_limit > 50 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حد نتائج البحث يجب أن يكون بين 1 و50.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_search IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(v_search) > 100 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'عبارة البحث طويلة جدًا.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_purpose NOT IN ('any', 'stockable', 'receiving', 'sellable') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'غرض البحث عن المنتج غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN (\n    WITH matched AS MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT product.*\n      FROM public.products product\n      LEFT JOIN public.units sale_unit ON sale_unit.id = product.sale_unit_id\n      WHERE (p_product_id IS NULL OR product.id = p_product_id)\n        AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR product.category_id = p_category_id)\n        AND (\n          v_search IS NULL\n          OR product.name_ar ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(product.flavor_name_ar, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR product.sku ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR COALESCE(product.barcode, '') ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'\n          OR product.id::TEXT = v_search\n        )\n        AND (\n          v_purpose = 'any'\n          OR (\n            product.is_active = true\n            AND product.is_flavor_master = false\n            AND (\n              v_purpose <> 'sellable'\n              OR (\n                product.sale_unit_id IS NOT NULL\n                AND COALESCE(product.units_per_sale_unit, 0) > 0\n                AND COALESCE(product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units, 0) > 0\n                AND COALESCE(sale_unit.code, '') <> 'PCS'\n              )\n            )\n          )\n        )\n      ORDER BY\n        CASE WHEN v_search IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(BTRIM(product.barcode)) = LOWER(v_search) THEN 0\n             WHEN v_search IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(BTRIM(product.sku)) = LOWER(v_search) THEN 1\n             ELSE 2 END,\n        product.name_ar,\n        product.id\n      LIMIT v_limit\n    ),\n    stock_by_product AS MATERIALIZED (\n      SELECT\n        ib.product_id,\n        SUM(ib.on_hand_quantity)::INTEGER AS on_hand_quantity,\n        SUM(ib.reserved_quantity)::INTEGER AS reserved_quantity,\n        SUM(ib.available_quantity)::INTEGER AS available_quantity,\n        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MIN(ib.warehouse_id::TEXT)::UUID END AS warehouse_id,\n        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(\n          'warehouse_id', ib.warehouse_id,\n          'on_hand_quantity', ib.on_hand_quantity,\n          'reserved_quantity', ib.reserved_quantity,\n          'available_quantity', ib.available_quantity\n        ) ORDER BY ib.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_balances\n      FROM public.inventory_balances ib\n      JOIN matched product ON product.id = ib.product_id\n      GROUP BY ib.product_id\n    ),\n    detailed AS (\n      SELECT\n        product.id,\n        product.sku,\n        product.barcode,\n        product.name_ar,\n        product.description,\n        product.category_id,\n        product.brand_id,\n        product.unit_id,\n        product.purchase_unit_id,\n        product.units_per_purchase_unit,\n        product.default_purchase_price_in_minor_units,\n        product.sale_unit_id,\n        product.units_per_sale_unit,\n        product.parcel_only,\n        product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units,\n        product.cost_price_in_minor_units,\n        product.sale_price_in_minor_units,\n        product.wholesale_price_in_minor_units,\n        product.min_stock_level,\n        product.max_stock_level,\n        product.is_active,\n        product.flavor_master_product_id,\n        product.flavor_name_ar,\n        product.is_flavor_master,\n        product.flavor_sort_order,\n        product.created_at,\n        product.updated_at,\n        jsonb_build_object('id', base_unit.id, 'name_ar', base_unit.name_ar, 'code', base_unit.code) AS base_unit,\n        jsonb_build_object('id', purchase_unit.id, 'name_ar', purchase_unit.name_ar, 'code', purchase_unit.code) AS purchase_unit,\n        jsonb_build_object('id', sale_unit.id, 'name_ar', sale_unit.name_ar, 'code', sale_unit.code) AS sale_unit,\n        COALESCE(stock.on_hand_quantity, 0)::INTEGER AS on_hand_quantity,\n        COALESCE(stock.reserved_quantity, 0)::INTEGER AS reserved_quantity,\n        COALESCE(stock.available_quantity, 0)::INTEGER AS available_quantity,\n        stock.warehouse_id,\n        COALESCE(stock.warehouse_balances, '[]'::JSONB) AS warehouse_balances,\n        image.image_url\n      FROM matched product\n      LEFT JOIN stock_by_product stock ON stock.product_id = product.id\n      LEFT JOIN public.units base_unit ON base_unit.id = product.unit_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.units purchase_unit ON purchase_unit.id = product.purchase_unit_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.units sale_unit ON sale_unit.id = product.sale_unit_id\n      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n        SELECT pi.image_url\n        FROM public.product_images pi\n        WHERE pi.product_id = product.id AND pi.is_primary = true\n        ORDER BY pi.display_order, pi.created_at\n        LIMIT 1\n      ) image ON true\n    )\n    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(item) ORDER BY item.name_ar, item.id), '[]'::JSONB)\n    FROM detailed item\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_customer_status(p_customer_id uuid, p_action text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE v_user_id UUID:=auth.uid();v_customer_name TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','sales'],'تعديل حالة العميل');\n  IF p_action NOT IN ('block','unblock','delete') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'إجراء حالة العميل غير معتمد.';END IF;\n  IF p_action='delete' THEN\n    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('go-live-collection-customer:'||p_customer_id::TEXT,0));\n  END IF;\n  SELECT full_name INTO v_customer_name FROM public.customers WHERE id=p_customer_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'العميل غير موجود.';END IF;\n  UPDATE public.customers SET\n    is_blocked=CASE WHEN p_action='block' THEN true WHEN p_action='unblock' THEN false ELSE is_blocked END,\n    is_active=CASE WHEN p_action='block' THEN false WHEN p_action='unblock' THEN true WHEN p_action='delete' THEN false ELSE is_active END,\n    is_deleted=CASE WHEN p_action='delete' THEN true ELSE is_deleted END,updated_at=NOW()\n  WHERE id=p_customer_id;\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs(user_id,action,entity_name,entity_id,details)\n  VALUES(v_user_id,CASE p_action WHEN 'block' THEN 'BLOCK_CUSTOMER' WHEN 'unblock' THEN 'UNBLOCK_CUSTOMER' ELSE 'SOFT_DELETE_CUSTOMER' END,\n    'customers',p_customer_id,jsonb_build_object('customer_name',v_customer_name,'action',p_action));\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'customer_id',p_customer_id,'action',p_action);\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_erp_staff_account_active(p_user_id uuid, p_is_active boolean)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO  SELECT profile.full_name INTO v_full_name FROM public.profiles profile WHERE profile.id = p_user_id;\n  IF v_full_name IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'حساب المستخدم غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles assignment\n    JOIN public.roles role ON role.id = assignment.role_id\n    WHERE assignment.user_id = p_user_id AND role.code = 'owner'\n  ) INTO v_target_is_owner;\n\n  -- Serialise owner deactivations so there is always an active owner left.\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtext('nawasrah_active_owner_guard'));\n\n  IF NOT v_is_active AND v_target_is_owner AND (\n    SELECT COUNT(*)\n    FROM public.profiles profile\n    JOIN public.user_roles assignment ON assignment.user_id = profile.id\n    JOIN public.roles role ON role.id = assignment.role_id\n    WHERE profile.is_active = true AND role.code = 'owner'\n  ) <= 1 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن تعطيل آخر مالك نظام نشط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.profiles SET is_active = v_is_active WHERE id = p_user_id;\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details)\n  VALUES (\n    auth.uid(),\n    CASE\n      WHEN v_target_is_owner AND v_is_active THEN 'تفعيل مالك نظام'\n      WHEN v_target_is_owner THEN 'تعطيل مالك نظام'\n      WHEN v_is_active THEN 'تفعيل حساب مستخدم'\n      ELSE 'تعطيل حساب مستخدم'\n    END,\n    'staff_account', p_user_id,\n    jsonb_build_object('full_name', v_full_name, 'is_active', v_is_active, 'is_owner', v_target_is_owner)\n  );\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'userId', p_user_id, 'isActive', v_is_active,\n    'message', CASE WHEN v_is_active THEN 'تم تفعيل الحساب.'         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_product_brand_active(p_brand_id uuid, p_is_active boolean)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_name_ar TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'warehouse_keeper'],\n    'إدارة العلامات التجارية'\n  );\n\n  SELECT name_ar\n  INTO v_name_ar\n  FROM public.brands\n  WHERE id = p_brand_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'العلامة التجارية المحددة غير موجودة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF COALESCE(p_is_active, false) = false\n    AND EXISTS (\n      SELECT 1\n      FROM public.products\n      WHERE brand_id = p_brand_id\n        AND is_active = true\n    )\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'لا يمكن إخفاء علامة مرتبطة بأصناف نشطة. عدّل الأصناف أولاً.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.brands\n  SET\n    is_active = COALESCE(p_is_active, false),\n    updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_brand_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    auth.uid(),\n    CASE\n      WHEN COALESCE(p_is_active, false) THEN 'RESTORE_PRODUCT_BRAND'\n      ELSE 'ARCHIVE_PRODUCT_BRAND'\n    END,\n    'brands',\n    p_brand_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'name_ar', v_name_ar,\n      'is_active', COALESCE(p_is_active, false)\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'brandId', p_brand_id,\n    'isActive', COALESCE(p_is_active, false),\n    'message', CASE\n      WHEN COALESCE(p_is_active, false) THEN 'تمت إعادة إظهار العلامة التجارية.'\n      ELSE 'تم إخفاء العلامة التجارية.'\n    END\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_product_primary_image(p_product_id uuid, p_image_url text)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_image_id UUID;\n  v_image_url TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(p_image_url), '');\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'warehouse_keeper'],\n    'تحديث صورة المنتج'\n  );\n\n  IF p_product_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'معرف المنتج مطلوب.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_image_url IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'رابط صورة المنتج مطلوب.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM 1\n  FROM public.products\n  WHERE id = p_product_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'المنتج المحدد غير موجود.';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.product_images\n  SET is_primary = false\n  WHERE product_id = p_product_id\n    AND is_primary = true;\n\n  SELECT id\n  INTO v_image_id\n  FROM public.product_images\n  WHERE product_id = p_product_id\n    AND image_url = v_image_url\n  ORDER BY created_at\n  LIMIT 1;\n\n  IF v_image_id IS NULL THEN\n    INSERT INTO public.product_images (\n      product_id,\n      image_url,\n      is_primary,\n      display_order\n    ) VALUES (\n      p_product_id,\n      v_image_url,\n      true,\n      1\n    )\n    RETURNING id INTO v_image_id;\n  ELSE\n    UPDATE public.product_images\n    SET\n      is_primary = true,\n      display_order = 1\n    WHERE id = v_image_id;\n  END IF;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id,\n    action,\n    entity_name,\n    entity_id,\n    details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'SET_PRODUCT_PRIMARY_IMAGE',\n    'products',\n    p_product_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'product_image_id', v_image_id,\n      'image_url', v_image_url\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN v_image_id;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

END IF;\n request:=public.tb215_canonical_inspection_internal(p_payload);\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(request->'items') x WHERE x->>'supplierId' IS NOT NULL)\n THEN PERFORM public.sr208_assert_role_internal('customer_return'); END IF;\n key:=public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(p_idempotency_key);\n IF length(key)>200 OR COALESCE(p_preview_fingerprint,'') !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_PREVIEW_REQUIRED'; END IF;\n identity:=jsonb_build_object('request',request,'previewFingerprint',p_preview_fingerprint);\n fingerprint:=encode(extensions.digest(identity::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex');\n actor_hash:=public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal('erp_user',actor,NULL,NULL);\n -- Same legacy operation lock first: a direct old issuer cannot interleave.\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('phase4-operation|phase4_replacement_v1|'||actor_hash||'|'||key,0));\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('aftercare215|'||actor::TEXT||'|'||key,0));\n SELECT * INTO existing FROM public.business_operations WHERE operation_type='aftercare215_inspection' AND initiated_by=actor AND idempotency_key=key;\n IF FOUND THEN\n  IF existing.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM fingerprint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'; END IF;\n PERFORM public.phase4_lock_customer_order_context_internal((request->>'orderId')::UUID,false,false);\n -- Discover all products before locking, then reuse the issuer's canonical\n -- inventory lock hierarchy. No supplier lock is taken ahead of inventory.\n plan:=public.tb215_prepare_inspection_internal(request);\n PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT (x->>'productId')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(plan->'items') x ORDER BY 1));\n plan:=public.tb215_prepare_inspection_internal(request);\n IF p_preview_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(plan::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_PREVIEW_CHANGED'; END IF;\n warehouse:=(plan->'order'->>'warehouseId')::UUID;branch:=(plan->'order'->>'branchId')::UUID;\n -- Re-entrant issuer owns all capacity, sale-window and inventory evidence.\n issued:=public.settle_sales_replacement_v1((request->>'orderId')::UUID,key,\n  (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceKind',x->'sourceKind','sourceId',x->'sourceId','quantity',x->'quantity')) FROM jsonb_array_elements(request->'items') x),\n  request->>'reason',request->>'notes');\n old_op:=(issued->>'operationId')::UUID;\n FOR row IN SELECT DISTINCT (x->>'supplierId')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(request->'items') x WHERE x->>'supplierId' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1 LOOP\n  BEGIN\n   PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=row.id AND is_active FOR SHARE NOWAIT;\n  EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_PARENT_BUSY_RETRY'; END;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n END LOOP;\n FOR row IN SELECT f.* FROM public.phase43_replacement_inventory_effects f WHERE f.operation_id=old_op ORDER BY f.product_id,f.source_kind,f.source_id LOOP\n  SELECT value INTO STRICT x FROM jsonb_array_elements(plan->'items') WHERE value->>'sourceKind'=row.source_kind AND(value->>'sourceId')::UUID=row.source_id;\n  SELECT on_hand_quantity INTO STRICT before_qty FROM public.inventory_balances WHERE warehouse_id=warehouse AND product_id=row.product_id FOR UPDATE;\n  SELECT wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact INTO STRICT before_wac FROM public.products WHERE id=row.product_id FOR NO KEY UPDATE;\n  SELECT COALESCE(sum(on_hand_quantity),0) INTO global_qty FROM public.inventory_balances WHERE product_id=row.product_id;\n  after_wac:=before_wac;movement:=NULL;c_id:=NULL;\n  IF (x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER>0 THEN\n   after_wac:=round((global_qty*before_wac+(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER*(x->>'sourceUnitCostExact')::NUMERIC)/(global_qty+(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER),6);\n   UPDATE public.inventory_balances SET on_hand_quantity=on_hand_quantity+(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE warehouse_id=warehouse AND product_id=row.product_id;\n   UPDATE public.products SET wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact=after_wac,cost_price_in_minor_units=round(after_wac)::BIGINT,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=row.product_id;\n   INSERT INTO public.inventory_movements(warehouse_id,product_id,movement_type,quantity,balance_before,balance_after,reference_type,reference_id,notes,created_by,operation_id,created_at)\n    VALUES(warehouse,row.product_id,'adjustment_add',(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,before_qty,before_qty+(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,\n     'aftercare215_inspection',row.replacement_item_id,'استرداد السليم من استبدال مفحوص',actor,NULL,clock_timestamp()) RETURNING id INTO movement;\n  END IF;\n  IF x->>'supplierId' IS NOT NULL THEN\n   SELECT COALESCE(u.name_ar,'باكيت') INTO unit_name FROM public.products p LEFT JOIN public.units u ON u.id=p.unit_id WHERE p.id=row.product_id;\n   INSERT INTO public.supplier_replacement_cases(operation_id,supplier_id,product_id,warehouse_id,branch_id,origin,quantity,commercial_quantity,\n    units_per_commercial_unit,unit_name,base_unit_name,unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact,occurred_at,created_by)\n    VALUES(tail,(x->>'supplierId')::UUID,row.product_id,warehouse,branch,'inspected_replacement',row.issued_quantity-(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,\n     row.issued_quantity-(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,1,unit_name,unit_name,(x->>'sourceUnitCostExact')::NUMERIC,at,actor) RETURNING id INTO c_id;\n   PERFORM public.sr208_append_event_internal(tail,c_id,'send',row.issued_quantity-(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,row.issued_quantity-(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,\n    -round((row.issued_quantity-(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER)*(x->>'sourceUnitCostExact')::NUMERIC)::BIGINT,0,request->>'reason',at);\n   cases:=array_append(cases,c_id);\n  END IF;\n  INSERT INTO public.aftercare215_inspection_items(replacement_item_id,operation_id,product_id,warehouse_id,good_quantity,bad_quantity,source_unit_cost_exact,\n   global_quantity_before_restock,on_hand_before,on_hand_after,wac_before,wac_after,movement_id,supplier_case_id)\n   VALUES(row.replacement_item_id,op,row.product_id,warehouse,(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,row.issued_quantity-(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,\n    (x->>'sourceUnitCostExact')::NUMERIC,global_qty,before_qty,before_qty+(x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER,before_wac,after_wac,movement,c_id);\n END LOOP;\n SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(good_quantity*source_unit_cost_exact),0))::BIGINT INTO recovery FROM public.aftercare215_inspection_items WHERE operation_id=op;\n INSERT INTO public.aftercare215_inspections VALUES(op,old_op,(request->>'orderId')::UUID,recovery,at,actor);\n IF cardinality(cases)>0 THEN\n  manifest:=public.sr208_operation_manifest_internal(tail);\n  INSERT INTO public.business_operations(id,operation_type,idempotency_key,request_fingerprint,request_identity_version,request_identity_snapshot,initiated_by,result_snapshot,completed_at)\n   VALUES(tail,'supplier_replacement208',key,encode(extensions.digest(jsonb_build_object('action','inspected_replacement','inspectionId',op)::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'),208,\n    jsonb_build_object('action','inspected_replacement','inspectionId',op),actor,jsonb_build_object('evidenceFingerprint',encode(extensions.digest(manifest::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex'),\n     'caseIds',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'id' ORDER BY x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'cases') x),\n     'eventIds',(SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'id' ORDER BY x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(manifest->'events') x)),at);\n END IF;\n         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sr208_assert_role_internal(p_action text)\n RETURNS uuid\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_ROLE_DENIED';\n END IF;\n IF p_action='reverse' THEN\n  IF NOT public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner']) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_OWNER_ONLY'; END IF;\n  RETURN public.assert_reversal_owner('عكس استبدال المورد والتالف');\n ELSIF p_action IN ('writeoff','customer_return','values') THEN\n  IF NOT public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner']) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_OWNER_ONLY'; END IF;\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner'],'استبدال المورد والتالف');\n ELSIF p_action='shop_damage' THEN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','admin','manager','warehouse_keeper'],'تلف المحل');\n ELSIF p_action IN ('shop_pending','shop_immediate','receive','read') THEN\n  IF NOT public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','manager','warehouse_keeper']) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501',MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_ROLE_DENIED';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(ARRAY['owner','manager','warehouse_keeper'],'استبدال المورد');\n ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_ACTION_INVALID';\n END IF;\n RETURN auth.uid();\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sr208_inventory_fingerprint_internal(p_product_id uuid)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n WITH neutral AS (\n  SELECT unnest(f.movement_ids) id FROM public.supplier_replacement_events r\n  JOIN public.supplier_replacement_events e ON e.id=r.reverses_event_id\n  JOIN public.supplier_replacement_inventory_effects f ON f.event_id IN(e.id,r.id)\n  WHERE e.action<>'reverse' AND r.action='reverse'\n ), facts AS (\n  SELECT jsonb_build_object('product',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('wac',wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,'cost',cost_price_in_minor_units) FROM public.products WHERE id=p_product_id),\n   'balances',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(warehouse_id,on_hand_quantity,reserved_quantity) ORDER BY warehouse_id),'[]') FROM public.inventory_balances WHERE product_id=p_product_id),\n   'movements',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(m.id,m.warehouse_id,m.movement_type,m.quantity,m.balance_before,m.balance_after,m.reference_type,m.reference_id) ORDER BY m.id),'[]')\n    FROM public.inventory_movements m WHERE m.product_id=p_product_id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM neutral n WHERE n.id=m.id))) AS data\n ) SELECT encode(extensions.digest(data::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex') FROM facts;\n$function$\n",
