        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sr208_operation_manifest_internal(p_operation_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n SELECT jsonb_build_object(\n  'cases',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c) ORDER BY c.id),'[]') FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases c WHERE c.operation_id=p_operation_id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_events e WHERE e.case_id=c.id AND e.operation_id=p_operation_id)),\n  'events',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY e.id),'[]') FROM public.supplier_replacement_events e WHERE e.operation_id=p_operation_id),\n  'effects',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f) ORDER BY f.event_id),'[]') FROM public.supplier_replacement_inventory_effects f JOIN public.supplier_replacement_events e ON e.id=f.event_id WHERE e.operation_id=p_operation_id),\n  'movements',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY m.id),'[]') FROM public.inventory_movements m WHERE EXISTS(\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_inventory_effects f JOIN public.supplier_replacement_events e ON e.id=f.event_id WHERE e.operation_id=p_operation_id AND m.id=ANY(f.movement_ids))),\n  'damageSources',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d) ORDER BY d.id),'[]') FROM public.inventory_damage_events d WHERE EXISTS(\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases c JOIN public.supplier_replacement_events e ON e.case_id=c.id WHERE e.operation_id=p_operation_id AND c.damage_event_id=d.id)));\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sr211_assert_operation_before211_internal(p_operation_id uuid)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE b public.business_operations%ROWTYPE; m JSONB;\nBEGIN\n SELECT * INTO b FROM public.business_operations WHERE id=p_operation_id;\n m:=public.sr208_operation_manifest_internal(p_operation_id);\n IF b.operation_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'supplier_replacement208' OR b.completed_at IS NULL\n  OR b.request_identity_version IS DISTINCT FROM 208 OR b.request_identity_snapshot IS NULL\n  OR b.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(b.request_identity_snapshot::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex')\n  OR b.result_snapshot->>'evidenceFingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(m::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex')\n  OR b.result_snapshot->'caseIds' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'id' ORDER BY x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(m->'cases') x)\n  OR b.result_snapshot->'eventIds' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT jsonb_agg(x->'id' ORDER BY x->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(m->'events') x)\n  OR jsonb_array_length(m->'events')=0\n  OR jsonb_array_length(m->'events')<>jsonb_array_length(m->'effects') THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_EVIDENCE_INVALID';\n END IF;\n IF b.result_snapshot->>'returnOperationId' IS NOT NULL THEN\n  PERFORM public.phase42_assert_operational_return_evidence_internal((b.result_snapshot->>'returnOperationId')::UUID,true);\n  IF b.result_snapshot->'returnResult' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT result_snapshot FROM public.business_operations WHERE id=(b.result_snapshot->>'returnOperationId')::UUID) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases c\n  WHERE c.id IN(SELECT (x->>'id')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(m->'cases') x)\n   AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_events e WHERE e.case_id=c.id AND e.previous_event_id IS NULL)\n    OR COALESCE((SELECT sum(e.held_delta) FROM public.supplier_replacement_events e WHERE e.case_id=c.id),-1) NOT BETWEEN 0 AND c.quantity))\n  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_events e\n   JOIN public.supplier_replacement_cases c ON c.id=e.case_id\n   LEFT JOIN public.supplier_replacement_events prior ON prior.id=e.previous_event_id\n   LEFT JOIN public.supplier_replacement_events original ON original.id=e.reverses_event_id\n   JOIN public.supplier_replacement_inventory_effects f ON f.event_id=e.id\n   WHERE e.operation_id=p_operation_id AND(e.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM b.initiated_by\n    OR(prior.id IS NOT NULL AND prior.case_id<>e.case_id)\n    OR f.product_id<>c.product_id OR f.warehouse_id<>c.warehouse_id\n    OR(e.action='reverse' AND(original.case_id<>e.case_id OR original.action='reverse' OR original.quantity<>e.quantity OR original.held_delta<>-e.held_delta))\n    OR COALESCE((SELECT sum(mv.quantity) FROM public.inventory_movements mv WHERE mv.id=ANY(f.movement_ids)),0)<>f.on_hand_after-f.on_hand_before\n    OR cardinality(f.movement_ids)<>(SELECT count(*) FROM public.inventory_movements mv WHERE mv.id=ANY(f.movement_ids) AND mv.product_id=c.product_id AND mv.warehouse_id=c.warehouse_id))) THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_EVIDENCE_INVALID';\n END IF;\n PERFORM public.phase42_assert_operational_return_evidence_internal(s.operation_id,true)\n FROM public.sales_return_events s WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(m->'damageSources') d WHERE (d->>'return_event_id')::UUID=s.id);\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.start_or_update_order_delivery(p_order_id uuid, p_eta_minutes integer, p_driver_phone text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();\n  v_order_number TEXT;\n  v_status TEXT;\n  v_source TEXT;\n  v_tracking_token UUID;\n  v_existing_driver_phone TEXT;\n  v_driver_phone TEXT;\n  v_eta TIMESTAMPTZ;\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM public.assert_erp_role(\n    ARRAY['owner', 'admin', 'manager', 'sales'],\n    'بدء توصيل الطلب وتحديد وقت الوصول ورقم السائق'\n  );\n\n  IF p_eta_minutes IS NULL OR p_eta_minutes NOT BETWEEN 5 AND 360 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'وقت الوصول المتوقع يجب أن يكون بين 5 و360 دقيقة.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NULLIF(TRIM(p_driver_phone), '') IS NOT NULL THEN\n    v_driver_phone := public.normalize_customer_phone(p_driver_phone);\n    IF v_driver_phone !~ '^07[789][0-9]{7}$' THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'رقم السائق الأردني غير صحيح.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT\n    order_number,\n    status,\n    source,\n    tracking_token,\n    delivery_driver_phone\n  INTO\n    v_order_number,\n    v_status,\n    v_source,\n    v_tracking_token,\n    v_existing_driver_phone\n  FROM public.orders\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'الطلب المحدد غير موجود في قاعدة البيانات.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_source IS DISTINCT FROM 'website' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'تتبع التوصيل متاح لطلبات الموقع فقط.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_driver_phone := COALESCE(v_driver_phone, v_existing_driver_phone);\n  IF v_driver_phone IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'أدخل رقم السائق قبل بدء التوصيل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_status = 'preparing' THEN\n    PERFORM public.update_order_status(\n      p_order_id,\n      'ready',\n      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_notes), ''), 'اكتمل التجهيز وأصبح الطلب جاهزًا')\n    );\n    v_status := 'ready';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_status = 'ready' THEN\n    PERFORM public.update_order_status(\n      p_order_id,\n      'out_for_delivery',\n      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p_notes), ''), 'بدأ توصيل الطلب')\n    );\n  ELSIF v_status <> 'out_for_delivery' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'يجب أن يكون الطلب قيد التجهيز أو جاهزًا أو خارجًا للتوصيل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  v_eta := NOW() + make_interval(mins => p_eta_minutes);\n\n  UPDATE public.orders\n  SET delivery_started_at = COALESCE(delivery_started_at, NOW()),\n      estimated_arrival_at = v_eta,\n      delivery_driver_phone = v_driver_phone,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_order_id\n  RETURNING tracking_token INTO v_tracking_token;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.audit_logs (\n    user_id, action, entity_name, entity_id, details\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_user_id,\n    'start_or_update_order_delivery',\n    'orders',\n    p_order_id,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'order_number', v_order_number,\n      'eta_minutes', p_eta_minutes,\n      'estimated_arrival_at', v_eta,\n      'driver_phone', v_driver_phone,\n      'notes', NULLIF(TRIM(p_notes), '')\n    )\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'order_id', p_order_id,\n    'order_number', v_order_number,\n    'status', 'out_for_delivery',\n    'estimated_arrival_at', v_eta,\n    'driver_phone', v_driver_phone,\n    'tracking_token', v_tracking_token,\n    'tracking_path', '/#track=' || v_tracking_token::TEXT,\n    'message', 'اكتمل التجهيز وبدأ التوصيل وتم حفظ وقت الوصول ورقم السائق.'\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_guest_customer_order(p_idempotency_key text, p_customer_full_name text, p_customer_phone text, p_governorate text, p_city text, p_area text, p_street text, p_building text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_address_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_google_maps_url text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_latitude double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_longitude double precision DEFAULT NULL::double precision, p_customer_notes text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_items jsonb DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, p_promotion_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_payment_method text DEFAULT 'cash_on_delivery'::text, p_delivery_zone text DEFAULT 'inside_ramtha'::text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_key TEXT := LOWER(NULLIF(BTRIM(p_idempotency_key), ''));\nBEGIN\n  IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Guest checkout requires the protected gateway.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_key, 0));\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.orders customer_order\n    JOIN public.business_operations operation\n      ON operation.id = customer_order.operation_id\n    WHERE customer_order.idempotency_key = v_key\n      AND operation.operation_type = 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Operation identity is unavailable.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN public._submit_guest_customer_order_v1_before_phase3(\n    p_idempotency_key, p_customer_full_name, p_customer_phone,\n    p_governorate, p_city, p_area, p_street, p_building,\n    p_address_notes, p_google_maps_url, p_latitude, p_longitude,\n    p_customer_notes, p_items, p_promotion_code, p_payment_method,\n    p_delivery_zone\n  );\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_order_payment_state()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n  NEW.amount_paid_in_minor_units := LEAST(\n    GREATEST(COALESCE(NEW.amount_paid_in_minor_units, 0), 0),\n    NEW.total_in_minor_units\n  );\n\n  IF NEW.status = 'completed'\n    AND COALESCE(NEW.payment_method, 'cash_on_delivery') <> 'debt'\n  THEN\n    NEW.amount_paid_in_minor_units := NEW.total_in_minor_units;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.status = 'returned' THEN\n    NEW.payment_status := 'refunded';\n  ELSE\n    NEW.payment_status := CASE\n      WHEN NEW.amount_paid_in_minor_units >= NEW.total_in_minor_units\n        THEN 'paid'\n      WHEN NEW.amount_paid_in_minor_units > 0\n        THEN 'partially_paid'\n      ELSE 'unpaid'\n    END;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_stock_alert(p_product_id uuid, p_warehouse_id uuid, p_on_hand_quantity integer, p_reserved_quantity integer)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE 0) - COALESCE(p_reserved_quantity, 0);\n  v_severity TEXT;\n  v_existing_id UUID;\n  v_existing_severity TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT min_stock_level, is_active\n  INTO v_threshold, v_is_active\n  FROM GREATEST(COALESCE(v_threshold, 0), 0);\n\n  SELECT id, severity\n  INTO v_existing_id, v_existing_severity\n  FROM public.stock_alerts\n  WHERE product_id = p_product_id\n    AND warehouse_id = p_warehouse_id\n    AND status = 'active'\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF v_available <= v_threshold THEN\n    v_severity :=\n      CASE WHEN v_available <= 0\n        THEN 'out_of_stock'\n        ELSE 'low_stock'\n      END;\n\n    IF v_existing_id IS NULL THEN\n      INSERT INTO public.stock_alerts (\n        product_id,\n        warehouse_id,\n        severity,\n        status,\n        available_quantity,\n        threshold_quantity\n      ) VALUES (\n        p_product_id,\n        p_warehouse_id,\n        v_severity,\n        'active',\n        v_available,\n        v_threshold\n      );\n    ELSE\n      UPDATE public.stock_alerts\n      SET\n        severity = v_severity,\n        available_quantity = v_available,\n        threshold_quantity = v_threshold,\n        last_updated_at = NOW(),\n        resolved_at = NULL\n      WHERE id = v_existing_id;\n\n      -- A read low-stock alert becomes unread again if the product reaches zero.\n      IF v_existing_severity IS DISTINCT FROM v_severity THEN\n        DELETE FROM public.stock_alert_reads\n        WHERE stock_alert_id = v_existing_id;\n      END IF;\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF v_existing_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    UPDATE public.stock_alerts\n    SET\n      status = 'resolved',\n      available_quantity = v_available,\n      threshold_quantity = v_threshold,\n      resolved_at = NOW(),\n      last_updated_at = NOW()\n    WHERE id = v_existing_id;\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

movements:=array_append(movements,movement_id);\n  INSERT INTO VALUES(c.warehouse_id,c.product_id,'adjustment_add',p_quantity,first_qty,before_qty,'supplier_replacement208',event_id,'استبدال مورد فوري: دخول',auth.uid()) RETURNING id INTO movement_id;\n  movements:=array_append(movements,movement_id);\n ELSIF p_action<>'damage' AND after_qty<>before_qty THEN\n  INSERT INTO membership TEXT; reason TEXT:=nullif(btrim(p_payload->>'reason'),'');\nBEGIN\n IF p_action IS NULL OR p_action NOT IN('credit','reverse_credit') OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'\n  OR reason IS NULL OR length(reason) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 500\n  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_payload) k WHERE NOT k=ANY(CASE WHEN p_action='credit' THEN ARRAY['caseId','quantity','reason'] ELSE ARRAY['eventId','reason'] END))\n THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_CREDIT_REQUEST_INVALID'; END IF;\n IF p_action='credit' THEN\n  IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'quantity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR COALESCE(p_payload->>'quantity','') !~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,8}$'\n  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_QUANTITY_INVALID'; END IF;\n  quantity:=(p_payload->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases WHERE id=(p_payload->>'caseId')::UUID;\n ELSE\n  SELECT * INTO original FROM public.supplier215_credits WHERE event_id=(p_payload->>'eventId')::UUID AND amount_delta_in_minor_units>0;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_CREDIT_EVENT_INVALID'; END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO STRICT event FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE id=original.event_id;\n  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases WHERE id=original.case_id;\n  quantity:=event.quantity;\n END IF;\n IF c.id IS NULL OR c.supplier_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_CREDIT_CASE_INVALID'; END IF;\n SELECT id INTO last_id FROM public.supplier_replacement_events e WHERE e.case_id=c.id\n  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_events n WHERE n.previous_event_id=e.id);\n SELECT COALESCE(sum(held_delta),0) INTO pending FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE case_id=c.id;\n SELECT current_balance_in_minor_units INTO cached FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=c.supplier_id AND is_active;\n IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n SELECT e.balance INTO balance FROM public.phase133_supplier_balance_evidence_internal() e WHERE e.supplier_id=c.supplier_id;\n IF balance IS NULL OR balance IS DISTINCT FROM cached THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_PAYABLE_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;\n membership:=public.tb215_supplier_membership_internal(c.supplier_id);\n IF p_action='credit' THEN\n  IF quantity>pending THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_EXCEEDS_PENDING'; END IF;\n  SELECT COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN e.action='credit' THEN e.quantity ELSE -e.quantity END),0) INTO prior\n   FROM public.supplier215_credits l JOIN public.supplier_replacement_events e ON e.id=l.event_id WHERE l.case_id=c.id;\n  amount:=round((prior+quantity)*c.unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact)::BIGINT-round(prior*c.unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact)::BIGINT;\n  IF amount<=0 OR amount>balance THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_CREDIT_EXCEEDS_PAYABLE'; END IF;\n ELSE\n  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier215_credits WHERE reverses_credit_event_id=original.event_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_ALREADY_REVERSED'; END IF;\n  IF last_id IS DISTINCT FROM original.event_id OR pending+quantity>c.quantity\n   OR balance IS DISTINCT FROM original.balance_after_in_minor_units OR membership IS DISTINCT FROM original.financial_membership_sha256\n  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER215_CREDIT_LATER_DEPENDENCY'; END IF;\n  amount:=-original.amount_delta_in_minor_units;\n END IF;\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'payload',p_payload||jsonb_build_object('reason',reason),'caseId',c.id,'supplierId',c.supplier_id,\n  'productId',c.product_id,'quantity',quantity,'amountDeltaInMinorUnits',amount::TEXT,'balanceBeforeInMinorUnits',balance::TEXT,\n  'balanceAfterInMinorUnits',(balance-amount)::TEXT,'lastEventId',last_id,'pendingBefore',pending,'membership',membership,'reversesEventId',original.event_id);\nEND $function$\n",

'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_ACTOR_NOT_AUTHORIZED: المستخدم الحالي غير مصادق عليه.';\n  END IF;\n  IF v_key IS NULL OR CHAR_LENGTH(v_key) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_IDEMPOTENCY_INPUT_INVALID: مفتاح إعادة المحاولة غير صالح.';\n  END IF;\n  IF p_warehouse_id IS NULL OR p_branch_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING IF;\n  IF v_payment_method NOT IN (\n    'cash', 'cliq', 'card', 'bank_transfer', 'debt', 'mixed', 'exchange_credit'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = Only then may V2 enter its versioned operation lock.\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(v_key));\n\n  v_actor_hash := public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal(\n    'erp_user', v_user_id, NULL, NULL\n  );\n  IF p_customer_id IS NULL THEN\n    v_customer_identity_hash := ENCODE(extensions.digest(\n      'phase3:walk-in-customer:v1|' || LOWER(v_customer_name),\n      'sha256'::TEXT\n    ), 'hex');\n  END IF;\n\n  v_request := JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n    'contract_version', 'phase3-sale-v1',\n    'actor_scope_type', 'erp_user',\n    'actor_scope_hash', v_actor_hash,\n    'operation_source', 'admin_pos',\n    'warehouse_id', p_warehouse_id,\n    'branch_id', p_branch_id,\n    'customer_id', p_customer_id,\n    'customer_identity_hash', v_customer_identity_hash,\n    'payment_method', v_payment_method,\n    'order_discount_in_minor_units', COALESCE(p_discount_in_minor_units, 0),\n    'amount_received_in_minor_units', COALESCE(p_amount_received_in_minor_units, 0),\n    'lines', p_lines\n  );\n  v_canonical_request := public.phase3_canonicalize_sale_request_internal(v_request);\n  v_fingerprint := public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(v_canonical_request);\n  v_replay := public.phase3_resolve_operation_replay_internal(\n    'phase3_pos_sale_v1', v_key, 'erp_user', v_actor_hash, v_fingerprint\n  );\n  IF v_replay->>'decision' = 'REPLAY' THEN\n    RETURN v_replay->'result_snapshot';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- A key already consumed by V1 can never be reconstructed as a proven V2\n  -- request.  Reject generically without exposing the historical order.\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM public.orders existing_order\n    WHERE existing_order.idempotency_key = v_key\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Operation identity is unavailable.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM 1\n  FROM public.warehouses warehouse\n  WHERE warehouse.id = p_warehouse_id\n    AND warehouse.branch_id = p_branch_id\n    AND warehouse.is_active;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = public.customers customer\n    WHERE customer.id = p_customer_id;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_CUSTOMER_INVALID: العميل المحدد غير موجود.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF v_payment_method = 'debt' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_DEBT_CUSTOMER_REQUIRED: البيع الآجل يحتاج عميلاً FROM public.cash_shifts shift\n  WHERE shift.branch_id = p_branch_id AND shift.status = 'open'\n  ORDER BY shift.id\n  LIMIT 1\n  FOR SHARE;\n  IF v_shift_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING COALESCE(v_product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units, 0) <= 0\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PRICE_OR_PACKAGE_STALE: إعداد الطرد أو سعره تغير.';\n      END IF;\n      v_commercial_quantity := (v_line->>'parcel_quantity')::INTEGER;\n      v_units_per_parcel := v_product.units_per_sale_unit;\n      v_base_quantity := 'PHASE3_POS_QUANTITY_OVERFLOW: كمية الوحدات الأساسية تتجاوز الحد الآمن.';\n      END IF;\n      v_unit_price := v_product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units;\n      v_unit_cost_exact := COALESCE(v_product.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,\n        v_product.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC);\n      v_line_exact_cogs := ROUND(v_base_quantity::NUMERIC * v_unit_cost_exact, 6);\n      -- COALESCE(parcel_unit.name_ar, 'طرد')\n      INTO v_base_unit_name, v_parcel_unit_name\n      FROM public.products product\n      LEFT JOIN public.units base_unit ON base_unit.id = product.unit_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.units parcel_unit ON parcel_unit.id = product.sale_unit_id\n      WHERE product.id = v_product.id;\n    ELSE\n      SELECT * INTO v_product FROM public.products\n      WHERE id = (v_line->>'family_product_id')::UUID AND is_active;\n      IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_product.is_flavor_master\n        OR COALESCE(v_product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units, 0) <= 0\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n          MESSAGE = 'PHASE3_POS_PRICE_OR_PACKAGE_STALE: عائلة الطرد أو سعرها غير صالح.';\n      END IF;\n      v_commercial_quantity := (v_line->>'parcel_quantity')::INTEGER;\n      v_units_per_parcel := v_product.units_per_sale_unit;\n      v_base_quantity := v_commercial_quantity::BIGINT * v_units_per_parcel::BIGINT;\n      v_unit_price := v_product.default_sale_price_in_minor_units;\n      v_line_cogs := 0;\n      SELECT COALESCE(base_unit.name_ar, 'وحدة'), COALESCE(parcel_unit.name_ar, 'طرد')\n      INTO v_base_unit_name, v_parcel_unit_name\n      FROM public.products product\n      LEFT JOIN public.units base_unit ON base_unit.id = product.unit_id\n      LEFT JOIN public.units parcel_unit ON parcel_unit.id = product.sale_unit_id\n      WHERE product.id = v_product.id;\n\n      FOR v_instance IN\n        SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_line->'parcel_instances')\n        ORDER BY (v_line->>'family_product_id')::UUID,\n          (v_line->>'parcel_configuration_id')::UUID,\n          (v_line->>'configuration_revision')::INTEGER,\n          v_instance->'components'\n        );\n        v_cogs_allocation := public.phase3_allocate_parcel_cogs_internal(\n          v_validated->'components'\n        );\n        v_parcel_instance_id := gen_random_uuid();\n        SELECT eligibility check.\n  v_replay := public.phase4_resolve_operation_replay_internal(\n    'phase4_return_v1', v_key, v_actor_hash, v_fingerprint\n  );\n  IF v_replay->>'decision' = 'REPLAY' THEN\n NOT IN (\n    'phase3_pos_sale_v1', 'phase3_customer_reservation_v1'\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_SALE_CONTRACT_UNSUPPORTED: Only proven Phase-3 POS V2 and Customer V2 sales use this coordinator.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical->'items') item\n    GROUP BY item->>'return_scope', item->>'order_item_id',\n      COALESCE(item->>'parcel_instance_id', '')\n    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1\n  ) OR EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical->'items') item\n    CROSS v_product_ids\n  FROM (\n    SELECT DISTINCT order_item.product_id\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical->'items') item\n    JOIN public.order_items order_item\n      ON order_item.id = (item->>'order_item_id')::UUID\n      AND order_item.order_id = p_order_id\n    WHERE item->>'return_scope' = 'base_unit'\n    UNION\n    SELECT DISTINCT parcel_component.product_id\n    FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical->'items') item\n    CROSS JOIN LATERAL JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(\n      COALESCE(item->'components', '[]'::JSONB)\n    ) component\n    JOIN public.order_parcel_components parcel_component\n      ON parcel_component.id = (component->>'parcel_component_id')::UUID\n    JOIN public.order_parcel_instances parcel_instance\n      ON parcel_instance.id = parcel_component.parcel_instance_id\n      AND parcel_instance.order_id = p_order_id\n    WHERE item->>'return_scope' = 'parcel_instance'\n  ) products\n  WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL;\n  IF COALESCE(CARDINALITY(v_product_ids), 0) = 0 THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_RETURN_PRODUCTS_UNPROVEN: No authoritative returned SKU set was found.';\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(v_product_ids);\n\n  v_completion_at := public.phase4_authoritative_completion_internal(p_order_id);\n  IF clock_timestamp() > v_completion_at + INTERVAL '48 hours' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED: A new Return cannot be settled after the original 48-hour window.';\n  END IF;\n\n  FOR v_item IN\n    SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_canonical->'items')\n    ORDER BY value->>'order_item_id', value->>'return_scope',\n      COALESCE(value->>'parcel_instance_id', '')\n  LOOP\n    v_scope := v_item->>'return_scope';\n    SELECT order_item.* INTO v_order_item\n    FROM public.order_items order_item\n    WHERE order_item.id = (v_item->>'order_item_id')::UUID\n      AND order_item.order_id = p_order_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n    IF NOT FOUND THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_ORDER_ITEM_INVALID: Return item does not belong to the locked sale.';\n    END IF;\n    v_return_item_id := gen_random_uuid();\n\n    IF v_scope = 'base_unit' THEN\n      v_quantity := (v_item->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n      PERFORM public.package_d_assert_whole_single_sku_quantity_internal(v_order_item.id,v_quantity);\n      IF v_order_item.commercial_line_kind IS NULL OR v_order_item.commercial_line_kind NOT IN ('base_unit','legacy_single_sku_parcel')\n        OR v_order_item.product_id IS NULL\n        OR v_order_item.quantity <= 0\n        OR v_order_item.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NULL\n        OR v_order_item.cogs_in_minor_units IS NULL\n      THEN\n        RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n          MESSAGE COALESCE(SUM(item.refund_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units + item.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT,\n        COALESCE(SUM(item.original_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT\n      INTO v_prior_quantity, v_prior_refund, v_prior_cogs\n      FROM public.sales_return_items item\n      JOIN public.sales_return_events event\n        ON event.id = Requested Base Unit quantity exceeds remaining Return capacity.';\n      END IF;\n      v_target_refund := CASE WHEN v_new_cumulative = v_order_item.quantity\n        THEN v_order_item.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units\n        ELSE FLOOR(\n          v_order_item.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units::NUMERIC\n            * v_new_cumulative::NUMERIC / v_order_item.quantity::NUMERIC\n        )::BIGINT END;\n      v_target_cogs := CASE WHEN v_new_cumulative = v_order_item.quantity\n        THEN v_order_item.cogs_in_minor_units\n        ELSE FLOOR(v_order_item.cogs_in_minor_units::NUMERIC\n          * v_new_cumulative::NUMERIC / v_order_item.quantity::NUMERIC\n        )::BIGINT END;\n      v_item_refund := v_target_refund - v_prior_refund;\n      v_item_cogs := v_target_cogs - v_prior_cogs;\n      v_rejected := COALESCE((v_item->>'customer_damage_quantity')::INTEGER,0);\n      v_accepted := v_quantity-v_rejected;\n      -- One inspected damaged carton per logical item prevents one carton's\n      -- damage from consuming another carton's refundable entitlement.\n      IF v_rejected>0 AND v_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM          MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_HISTORICAL_COST_MISSING: Customer V2 exact historical cost is missing.';\n        END IF;\n        v_unit_cost_exact := v_order_item.unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact;\n      ELSE\n        IF v_order_item.unit_cost_in_minor_units IS NULL THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n            MESSAGE = 'PHASE42_HISTORICAL_COST_MISSING: POS V2 historical cost is missing.';\n        END IF;\n        v_unit_cost_exact := COALESCE(v_order_item.unit_cost_snapshot_in_minor_units_exact,\n        v_historical_value := ROUND(v_unit_cost_exact * v_accepted, 6);\n        v_inventory_sources := v_inventory_sources || JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(\n          JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n            'source_kind', 'base_order_item',\n            'source_id', v_order_item.id,\n            'return_item_id', v_return_item_id,\n            'product_id', v_order_item.product_id,\n            'quantity', v_accepted,\n            'historical_value_exact', v_historical_value\n          )\n        );\n      END IF;\n\n      v_prepared_items := v_prepared_items || JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(\n 'returned_quantity', v_quantity,\n          'refund_amount', v_item_refund,\n          'stock_disposition', v_item_stock_disposition,\n          'accepted_quantity', v_accepted,\n          'rejected_quantity', v_rejected,\n          'original_cogs', v_item_cogs,\n          'raw_damage', v_raw_damage,\n          'applied_damage', v_applied_damage,\n          'components', '[]'::JSONB\n        )\n      );\n      v_total_entitlement := v_total_entitlement + v_item_refund;\n      v_total_raw_damage := v_total_raw_damage + v_raw_damage;\n      v_total_applied_damage := 'PHASE42_PARCEL_INSPECTION_INCOMPLETE: Every historical Parcel Component must be classified.';\n      END IF;\n\n      v_prepared_components := '[]'::JSONB;\n      v_accepted_total := 0;\n      v_rejected_total := 0;\n      v_raw_damage := 0;\n      v_item_stock_disposition := 'damaged';\n      FOR v_component IN\n        SELECT value FROM JSONB_ARRAY_ELEMENTS(v_item->'components')\n (v_component->>'parcel_component_id')::UUID\n          AND component.parcel_instance_id = v_instance.id\n        FOR UPDATE;\n        IF NOT FOUND THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n              'source_kind', 'parcel_component',\n              'source_id', v_component_row.id,\n              'return_item_id', v_return_item_id,\n              'product_id',    v_prepared_components := v_prepared_components || JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(\n          JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n            'parcel_component_id', v_component_row.id,\n            'original_sale_operation_id', v_component_row.operation_id,\n            'product_id', v_component_row.product_id,\n            'original_quantity', v_component_row.base_quantity,\n            'accepted_quantity', v_accepted,\n            'rejected_quantity', v_rejected,\n            'accepted_condition', v_component->>'accepted_condition',\n            'accepted_stock_disposition',\n v_component->>'rejected_stock_disposition'\n          )\n        );\n      END LOOP;\n      IF v_accepted_total + v_rejected_total\n          IS DISTINCT FROM v_instance.units_per_parcel_snapshot      v_applied_damage := LEAST(\n        v_instance.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units, v_raw_damage\n      );\n      v_item_refund :=\n        v_instance.net_refundable_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units\n          - v_applied_damage;\n      v_prepared_items := v_prepared_items || JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(\n        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(\n          'id', v_return_item_id,\n          'return_scope', 'parcel_instance',\n          'order_item_id', v_order_item.id,\n          'parcel_instance_id', v_instance.id,\n          'returned_quantity', 1,\n          'refund_amount', v_item_refund,\n          'stock_disposition', v_item_stock_disposition,\n          'accepted_quantity', v_accepted_total,\n          'rejected_quantity', v_rejected_total,\n          'original_cogs', v_instance.cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units,\n          'raw_damage', v_raw_damage,\n          'applied_damage', v_applied_damage,\n          'components', v_prepared_components\n        )\n      );\n      v_total_entitlement := v_total_entitlement + v_item_refund;\n      v_total_raw_damage := v_total_raw_damage + v_raw_damage;\n      v_total_applied_damage := v_total_applied_damage         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tb215_finalize_before_exchange_internal(p_operation_id uuid)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_operation public.business_operations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_source RECORD;\n  v_item RECORD;\n  v_order_item public.order_items%ROWTYPE;\n  v_return_event public.sales_return_events%ROWTYPE;\n  v_replacement_event public.sales_replacement_events%ROWTYPE;\n  v_capacity INTEGER;\n  v_consumed INTEGER;\n  v_completion_at TIMESTAMPTZ;\n  v_item_count INTEGER;\n  v_other_settled INTEGER;\n  v_original_entitlement BIGINT;\n  v_original_cogs BIGINT;\n  v_total_units INTEGER;\n  v_accepted_units INTEGER;\n  v_rejected_units INTEGER;\n  v_raw_damage BIGINT;\n  v_expected_applied_damage BIGINT;\n  v_item_refund_total BIGINT;\n  v_item_raw_total BIGINT;\n  v_item_applied_total BIGINT;\n  v_current_consumption INTEGER;\n  v_cumulative_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_cumulative_refund BIGINT;\n  v_cumulative_cogs BIGINT;\n  v_return_count INTEGER;\n  v_replacement_count INTEGER;\n  v_now TIMESTAMPTZ;\nBEGIN\n  IF p_operation_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '22004',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_REQUIRED: Operation identity is required.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- Reacquire the same transaction-scoped root gate before locking the\n  -- operation/header. This covers finalization of a draft committed by an\n  -- earlier transaction while remaining re-entrant for create+finalize.\n  PERFORM public.phase4_lock_aftercare_operation_order_internal(\n    p_operation_id, NULL\n  );\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_operation\n  FROM public.business_operations operation\n  WHERE operation.id = p_operation_id FOR UPDATE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_NOT_FOUND: Business operation does not exist.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_operation.idempotency_key IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.request_fingerprint IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.request_identity_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n    OR v_operation.request_identity_snapshot IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.actor_scope_type IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.actor_scope_hash IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.result_snapshot IS NULL\n    OR v_operation.completed_at IS NULL\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: Immutable request/result evidence is required before finalization.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_return_count\n  FROM public.sales_return_events event\n  WHERE event.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n  SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER INTO v_replacement_count\n  FROM public.sales_replacement_events event\n  WHERE event.operation_id = p_operation_id;\n\n  IF (v_operation.operation_type = 'phase4_return_v1'\n      AND (v_return_count <> 1 OR v_replacement_count <> 0))\n    OR (v_operation.operation_type = 'phase4_replacement_v1'\n      AND (v_replacement_count <> 1 OR v_return_count <> 0))\n    OR v_operation.operation_type NOT IN (\n      'phase4_return_v1', 'phase4_replacement_v1'\n    )\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n      MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_OPERATION_SHAPE_INVALID: Operation type and aftercare evidence do not match.';\n  END IF;\n\n  PERFORM set_config(\n    'nawasrah.phase4_finalization_operation_id', p_operation_id::TEXT, true\n  );\n\n  IF v_return_count = 1 THEN\n    SELECT * INTO v_return_event\n    FROM public.sales_return_events event\n    WHERE event.operation_id = p_operation_id\n    FOR UPDATE;\n\n    IF v_return_event.contract_version IS DISTINCT FROM 401\n      OR v_return_event.settlement_status NOT IN ('draft', 'inspected')\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n        MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_RETURN_NOT_FINALIZABLE: Return is not a valid versioned draft.';\n    END IF;\n\n    PERFORM public.phase4_assert_aftercare_operation_binding_internal(\n      v_operation.id, 'return', v_return_event.id,\n      v_return_event.contract_version\n    );\n\n    IF v_return_event.debt_reduction_amount_in_minor_units IS NULL\n      OR v_return_event.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units IS NULL\n      OR (v_return_event.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units = 0 AND (\n (v_return_event.money_refund_amount_in_minor_units > 0 AND (\n        v_return_event.refund_method NOT IN ('cash', 'cliq')\n        OR v_return_event.cash_shift_id IS NULL\n        OR SELECT * INTO v_order_item FROM public.order_items item\n      WHERE item.id = v_item.order_item_id FOR UPDATE;\n\n      IF v_item.return_scope = 'parcel_instance' THEN\n        SELECT other_event\n          ON other_event.id = other_item.sales_return_event_id\n        WHERE other_item.parcel_instance_id = v_item.parcel_instance_id\n          AND other_item.id <> v_item.id\n          AND other_event.settlement_status = 'settled';\n        IF v_other_settled > 0 THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n            MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARCEL_RETURN_ALREADY_CONSUMED: Original Parcel Return identity was already settled.';\n        END IF;\n\n        IF EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n          LEFT JOIN public.sales_return_component_inspections inspection\n            ON inspection.parcel_component_id = component.id\n            AND inspection.sales_return_item_id = v_item.id\n          WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = v_item.parcel_instance_id\n            AND (inspection.id IS NULL\n              OR inspection.accepted_quantity + inspection.rejected_quantity\n                <> component.base_quantity\n              OR (inspection.accepted_quantity > 0 AND (\n                inspection.accepted_condition IS NULL\n                OR inspection.accepted_stock_disposition IS NULL\n                OR (inspection.accepted_condition = 'sellable'\n                  AND inspection.accepted_stock_disposition <> 'restock')\n                OR (inspection.accepted_condition = 'supplier_defect'\n                  AND inspection.accepted_stock_disposition <> 'non_sellable')\n              ))\n              OR (inspection.rejected_quantity > 0 AND (\n                inspection.rejection_reason IS NULL\n                OR inspection.rejection_reason <> 'customer_damage'\n                OR inspection.rejected_stock_disposition IS NULL\n                OR inspection.rejected_stock_disposition <> 'returned_to_customer'\n              )))\n        ) THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n            MESSAGE = 'PHASE4_PARCEL_INSPECTION_INCOMPLETE: Every original Component quantity must be classified before settlement.';\n        END IF;\n\n        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(inspection.accepted_quantity), 0)::INTEGER,\n          COALESCE(SUM(inspection.rejected_quantity), 0)::INTEGER,\n          COALESCE(SUM(inspection.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units), 0)::BIGINT\n        INTO v_expected_applied_damage := LEAST(v_original_entitlement, v_raw_damage);\n\n        IF v_accepted_units + v_rejected_units <> v_total_units\n          OR v_item.accepted_base_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM v_accepted_units\n          OR v_item.rejected_base_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM v_rejected_units\n          OR v_item.raw_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units\n            IS DISTINCT FROM     END IF;\n\n        IF EXISTS (\n          SELECT 1\n          FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n          LEFT JOIN LATERAL (\n            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(consumption.consumed_quantity), 0)::INTEGER quantity\n            FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n            CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n              consumption.source_kind, consumption.source_id,\n              consumption.product_id\n            ) root\n            WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n              AND consumption.return_item_id = v_item.id\n              AND root.root_kind = 'parcel_component'\n              AND root.root_id = component.id\n              AND root.product_id = component.product_id\n              AND consumption.consumption_kind = 'return'\n              AND consumption.consumption_state = 'draft'\n          ) used ON true\n          WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = v_item.parcel_instance_id\n            AND used.quantity <> component.base_quantity\n        ) THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION USING         OR COALESCE(v_item.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units, 0) <> 0))\n        THEN\n          RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0001',\n            MESSAGE = INTO v_current_consumption\n        FROM public.sales_aftercare_consumptions consumption\n        CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n          consumption.source_kind, consumption.source_id,\n          consumption.product_id\n        ) root\n        WHERE consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n          AND consumption.return_item_id = v_item.id\n          AND item.sales_return_event_id\n          CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.phase4_aftercare_source_root_internal(\n            consumption.source_kind, consumption.source_id,\n            consumption.product_id\n          ) root\n          WHERE root.root_kind = 'base_order_item'\n            AND root.root_id = v_item.order_item_id\n            AND consumption.consumption_kind = 'return'\n            AND (consumption.consumption_state = 'settled'\n              OR (consumption.operation_id = p_operation_id\n                AND consumption.consumption_state = 'draft'))\n            AND event.settlement_status <> 'cancelled'\n          GROUP BY item.id, item.refund_amount_snapshot_in_minor_units, item.applied_customer_damage_deduction_in_minor_units,\n            item.original_cogs_snapshot_in_minor_units\n        ) consumed;\n\n        IF v_cumulative_quantity > v_total_units\n          OR v_cumulative_refund > v_original_entitlement\n          OR v_cumulative_cogs > v_original_cogs\n          OR (v_cumulative_quantity = v_total_units\n            AND (v_cumulative_refund <> v_original_entitlement\n              OR v_cumulative_cogs <> The\n -- existing narrow defective-packet exception remains all-bad/same SKU.\n FOR root IN SELECT x->>'rootKind' kind,(x->>'rootId')::UUID id,sum((x->>'quantity')::INTEGER)::INTEGER quantity,\n   sum((x->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER)::INTEGER good FROM jsonb_array_elements(prepared) x GROUP BY 1,2 LOOP\n  IF root.kind='base_order_item' AND root.good>0 THEN\n   PERFORM public.package_d_assert_whole_single_sku_quantity_internal(root.id,root.quantity);\n  END IF;\n END LOOP;\n FOR root IN SELECT DISTINCT (x->>'rootInstanceId')::UUID id FROM jsonb_array_elements(prepared) x\n  WHERE x->>'rootInstanceId' IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(prepared) g\n   WHERE g->>'rootInstanceId'=x->>'rootInstanceId' AND(g->>'goodQuantity')::INTEGER>0) LOOP\n  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.order_parcel_components c WHERE c.parcel_instance_id=root.id AND c.base_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM\n   (SELECT COALESCE(sum((x->>'quantity')::INTEGER),0)::INTEGER FROM jsonb_array_elements(prepared) x WHERE (x->>'rootId')::UUID=c.id))\n  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'AFTERCARE215_WHOLE_PARCEL_INSPECTION_REQUIRED'; END IF;\n END LOOP;\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(prepared) x GROUP BY x->>'productId'\n  HAVING sum((x->>'quantity')::INTEGER)>min((x->>'availableQuantity')::INTEGER))\n THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE43_REPLACEMENT_INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('request',p_request,'order',ctx->'order','items',prepared);\nEND $function$\n",

END IF;\n IF jsonb_array_length(p_request->'supplierAssignments')>0 THEN PERFORM public.sr208_assert_role_internal('customer_return'); END IF;\n FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_request->'baseRequest'->'items') LOOP\n  SELECT * INTO oi FROM public.order_items WHERE id=(item->>'order_item_id')::UUID AND order_items.order_id=order_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE42_ORDER_ITEM_INVALID'; END IF;\n   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sales_return_items i JOIN public.sales_return_events e ON e.id=i.sales_return_event_id\n    WHERE i.parcel_instance_id=instance.id AND e.settlement_status='settled') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE4_LOGICAL_QUANTITY_ALREADY_CONSUMED'; END IF;\n   raw_damage:=0;\n   FOR component IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(item->'components') LOOP\n    SELECT * INTO pc FROM public.order_parcel_components WHERE id=(component->>'parcel_component_id')::UUID AND parcel_instance_id=instance.id;\n    IF NOT FOUND OR pc.base_quantity<>(component->>'accepted_quantity')::INTEGER+(component->>'rejected_quantity')::INTEGER\n     OR((component->>'rejected_quantity')::INTEGER>0 AND pc.effective_standalone_unit_sale_price_snapshot_in_minor_units IS NULL)\n    THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE42_PARCEL_COMPONENT_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;\n  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.suppliers WHERE id=(assignment->>'supplierId')::UUID AND is_active) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n  held_value:=held_value+round((source->>'historicalUnitCostExact')::NUMERIC*(source->>'defect_non_sellable_quantity')::INTEGER)::BIGINT;\n END LOOP;\n SELECT * INTO position FROM public.phase42_order_financial_position_internal(order_id);\n IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'PHASE42_FINANCIAL_POSITION_UNAVAILABLE'; END IF;\n SELECT payment_method INTO original_method FROM public.orders WHERE id=order_id;\n method:=CASE WHEN p_request->>'refundChoice'='auto' THEN CASE WHEN original_method='cash_on_delivery' THEN 'cash' WHEN original_method IN('cash','cliq') THEN original_method ELSE NULL END\n  WHEN p_request->>'refundChoice'='debt' THEN NULL ELSE p_request->>'refundChoice' END;\n SELECT id INTO shift_id FROM public.cash_shifts WHERE branch_id=(ctx->'order'->>'branchId')::UUID AND status='open';\n IF money=0 THEN method:=NULL;\n ELSE\n  IF method IS NULL THEN issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('field','refundMethod','code','AFTERCARE215_REFUND_METHOD_REQUIRED')); END IF;\n  IF shift_id IS NULL THEN issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('field','cashShift','code','PHASE2_OPEN_SHIFT_REQUIRED')); END IF;\n  IF method='cliq' AND p_request->>'referenceNumber' IS NULL THEN issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('field','referenceNumber','code','AFTERCARE215_REFUND_REFERENCE_REQUIRED')); END IF;\n END IF;\n RETURN jsonb_build_object('request',p_request,'order',ctx->'order','originalPaymentMethod',original_method,'financialPosition',to_jsonb(position),\n  'cashShiftId',CASE WHEN money>0 THEN shift_id END,'refundMethod',method,'referenceNumber',CASE WHEN money>0 AND method='cliq' THEN p_request->'referenceNumber' END,\n  'entitlementInMinorUnits',entitlement::TEXT,'debtReductionInMinorUnits',debt::TEXT,'moneyRefundInMinorUnits',money::TEXT,\n  'customerDamageDeductionInMinorUnits',customer_damage::TEXT,'goodQuantity',good_q,'badQuantity',bad_q,'customerDamageQuantity',damage_q,\n  'goodRestockValueExact',good_value::TEXT,'badLossInMinorUnits',bad_value::TEXT,'supplierHeldInMinorUnits',held_value::TEXT,\n  'physicalSources',sources,'issues',issues);\nEND $function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tb215_supplier_membership_internal(p_supplier_id uuid)\n RETURNS text\n LANGUAGE sql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n SELECT encode(extensions.digest(jsonb_build_object(\n  'direct',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id),'[]') FROM public.supplier_receipts r WHERE r.supplier_id=p_supplier_id),\n  'purchase',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.id),'[]') FROM public.purchase_receipts r JOIN public.purchase_orders po ON po.id=r.purchase_order_id WHERE po.supplier_id=p_supplier_id),\n  'legacyPurchasePayable',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.purchase_order_id),'[]') FROM public.phase133_legacy_po_payables_internal() r WHERE r.supplier_id=p_supplier_id),\n  'payments',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id),'[]') FROM public.supplier_payments r WHERE r.supplier_id=p_supplier_id),\n  'opening',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id),'[]') FROM public.supplier_opening_balances r WHERE r.supplier_id=p_supplier_id),\n  'claims',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY id),'[]') FROM public.cheque_compensation_claims r WHERE r.party_kind='supplier' AND r.party_id=p_supplier_id)\n )::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex');\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tb215_supplier_writer_before215_internal(p_action text, p_payload jsonb, p_idempotency_key text)\n RETURNS jsonb\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\n#variable_conflict use_variable\nDECLARE\n actor UUID; k TEXT:=btrim(p_idempotency_key); request JSONB; fingerprint TEXT; operation_id UUID:=gen_random_uuid();\n existing public.business_operations%ROWTYPE; c public.supplier_replacement_cases%ROWTYPE;\n e public.supplier_replacement_events%ROWTYPE; f public.supplier_replacement_inventory_effects%ROWTYPE;\n d public.inventory_damage_events%ROWTYPE; p public.products%ROWTYPE;\n reason TEXT; allowed TEXT[]; supplier_id UUID; product_id UUID; warehouse_id UUID; branch_id UUID;\n commercial INTEGER; units INTEGER; qty INTEGER; held BIGINT; written BIGINT; expense BIGINT:=0; stock_delta INTEGER:=0;\n case_id UUID; event_at TIMESTAMPTZ; before_qty INTEGER; cost NUMERIC(24,6);\n case_ids UUID[]:='{}'::UUID[]; return_result JSONB; financial_request JSONB; financial_replay JSONB; return_operation UUID; return_event UUID;\n assignments JSONB; item JSONB; result JSONB; manifest JSONB; order_id UUID; current_values BOOLEAN;\nBEGIN\n actor:=public.sr208_assert_role_internal(p_action);current_values:=public.has_erp_role(ARRAY['owner']);\n IF k IS NULL OR char_length(k) NOT BETWEEN 16 AND 200 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_KEY_INVALID'; END IF;\n IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_REQUEST_INVALID'; END IF;\n reason:=NULLIF(btrim(p_payload->>'reason'),'');\n IF reason IS NULL OR char_length(reason) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_REASON_INVALID'; END IF;\n allowed:=CASE WHEN p_action IN ('shop_pending','shop_immediate') THEN ARRAY['supplierId','productId','warehouseId','quantity','unit','reason']\n  WHEN p_action='shop_damage' THEN ARRAY['productId','warehouseId','quantity','unit','reason','reasonCode']\n  WHEN p_action IN ('receive','writeoff') THEN ARRAY['caseId','quantity','reason']\n  WHEN p_action='reverse' THEN ARRAY['eventId','reason']\n  ELSE ARRAY['orderId','items','physicalSources','reason','refundMethod','referenceNumber','notes','supplierAssignments'] END;\n IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_payload) x WHERE NOT x=ANY(allowed)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_FIELD_INVALID'; END IF;\n request:=jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'payload',p_payload||jsonb_build_object('reason',reason));\n IF p_action='customer_return' THEN\n  order_id:=(p_payload->>'orderId')::UUID;\n  PERFORM set_config('nawasrah.phase43_return_physical_sources',public.phase43_canonicalize_return_physical_sources_internal(p_payload->'physicalSources')::TEXT,true);\n  financial_request:=public.phase42_canonicalize_return_request_internal(order_id,p_payload->'items',reason,\n   p_payload->>'refundMethod',p_payload->>'referenceNumber',p_payload->>'notes');\n  IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_ASSIGNMENTS_INVALID';\n  END IF;\n  FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') LOOP\n   IF jsonb_typeof(item) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(item))<>3\n    OR NULLIF(item->>'supplierId','') IS NULL OR NULLIF(item->>'sourceId','') IS NULL\n    OR item->>'sourceKind' NOT IN ('base_order_item','parcel_component','replacement_item') THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_ASSIGNMENTS_INVALID';\n   END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') x GROUP BY x->>'sourceKind',(x->>'sourceId')::UUID HAVING count(*)<>1) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_ASSIGNMENTS_INVALID';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sourceKind',x->>'sourceKind','sourceId',(x->>'sourceId')::UUID,'supplierId',(x->>'supplierId')::UUID) ORDER BY x->>'sourceKind',(x->>'sourceId')::UUID)\n  INTO assignments FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_payload->'supplierAssignments') x;\n  request:=jsonb_build_object('action',p_action,'financialRequest',financial_request,'supplierAssignments',assignments);\n  -- Exactly the old canonical key/lock/evidence helper, before ANY order or\n  -- inventory lock. A previously standalone return cannot acquire a C9 tail.\n  financial_replay:=public.phase4_resolve_operation_replay_internal('phase4_return_v1',k,\n   public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal('erp_user',actor,NULL,NULL),public.phase3_request_fingerprint_internal(financial_request));\n END IF;\n fingerprint:=encode(extensions.digest(request::TEXT,'sha256'),'hex');\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('supplier-replacement208|'||actor::TEXT||'|'||k,0));\n SELECT * INTO existing FROM public.business_operations WHERE operation_type='supplier_replacement208' AND initiated_by=actor AND idempotency_key=k;\n IF FOUND THEN\n  IF existing.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM fingerprint THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT'; END IF;\n  PERFORM public.sr208_assert_operation_internal(existing.id);\n  IF p_action='customer_return' AND (financial_replay->>'decision' IS DISTINCT FROM 'REPLAY'\n   OR financial_replay->>'operation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM existing.result_snapshot->>'returnOperationId') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;\n  SELECT array_agg(x::UUID ORDER BY x::UUID) INTO case_ids FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(existing.result_snapshot->'caseIds') x;\n  result:=jsonb_build_object('success',true,'contractVersion',208,'action',p_action,'idempotencyKey',k,'operationId',existing.id,'idempotent',true,\n   'cases',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(public.sr208_case_dto_internal(v,current_values) ORDER BY v),'[]') FROM unnest(case_ids) v));\n  IF p_action='customer_return' THEN result:=result||jsonb_build_object('returnResult',existing.result_snapshot->'returnResult'); END IF;\n  RETURN result;\n END IF;\n IF p_action='customer_return' AND financial_replay->>'decision' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NEW' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_IDENTITY_CONFLICT'; END IF;\n IF p_action IN ('shop_pending','shop_immediate','shop_damage') THEN\n  product_id:=(p_payload->>'productId')::UUID;warehouse_id:=(p_payload->>'warehouseId')::UUID;\n  supplier_id:=(p_payload->>'supplierId')::UUID;\n  IF p_payload->>'unit' IS NULL OR p_payload->>'unit' NOT IN ('base','parcel')\n   OR jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'quantity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (p_payload->>'quantity')!~'^[1-9][0-9]*$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_QUANTITY_INVALID'; END IF;\n  commercial:=(p_payload->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n  -- Warehouse table access precedes inventory locks, matching199 disable.\n  SELECT w.branch_id INTO branch_id FROM public.warehouses w JOIN public.branches b ON b.id=w.branch_id AND b.is_active WHERE w.id=warehouse_id AND w.is_active;\n  IF branch_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_WAREHOUSE_INVALID'; END IF;\n  IF p_action<>'shop_damage' THEN\n   PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers s WHERE s.id=supplier_id AND s.is_active;\n   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n  END IF;\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY[product_id]);\n  IF p_action<>'shop_damage' THEN\n   -- Canonical receipt cancellation locks inventory BEFORE suppliers. Taking\n   -- a blocking supplier FK lock first would invert that hierarchy. Acquire\n   -- the parent late without waiting; this also avoids cross-domain customer\n   -- financial cycles in the atomic-return path below.\n   BEGIN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers s WHERE s.id=supplier_id AND s.is_active FOR SHARE NOWAIT;\n   EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_PARENT_BUSY_RETRY: تغيّر قفل المورد؛ أعد نفس المحاولة.';\n   END;\n   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n  END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO p FROM public.products WHERE id=product_id AND is_active AND NOT COALESCE(is_flavor_master,false);\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_PRODUCT_INVALID'; END IF;\n  units:=CASE WHEN p_payload->>'unit'='parcel' THEN p.units_per_sale_unit ELSE 1 END;\n  IF units IS NULL OR units<1 OR commercial::BIGINT*units>2147483647 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_QUANTITY_INVALID'; END IF;\n  qty:=commercial*units;cost:=COALESCE(p.wac_cost_in_minor_units_exact,p.cost_price_in_minor_units::NUMERIC);\n  SELECT on_hand_quantity INTO before_qty FROM public.inventory_balances WHERE inventory_balances.product_id=product_id AND inventory_balances.warehouse_id=warehouse_id;\n  IF before_qty IS NULL OR before_qty-COALESCE((SELECT reserved_quantity FROM public.inventory_balances WHERE inventory_balances.product_id=product_id AND inventory_balances.warehouse_id=warehouse_id),0)<qty THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_STOCK_RESERVED'; END IF;\n  event_at:=clock_timestamp();\n  IF p_action='shop_damage' THEN\n   IF p_payload->>'reasonCode' IS NULL OR p_payload->>'reasonCode' NOT IN ('shop_breakage','expired','storage_damage','other') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_DAMAGE_REASON_INVALID'; END IF;\n   result:=public.adjust_inventory_stock(warehouse_id,product_id,before_qty-qty,\n    CASE p_payload->>'reasonCode' WHEN 'shop_breakage' THEN 'انكسر بالمحل' WHEN 'expired' THEN 'انتهت الصلاحية' WHEN 'storage_damage' THEN 'تلف تخزين' ELSE 'أخرى' END||': '||reason,\n    CASE WHEN p_payload->>'reasonCode'='expired' THEN 'expired' ELSE 'damage' END);\n   SELECT * INTO STRICT d FROM public.inventory_damage_events WHERE movement_id=(result->>'movementId')::UUID;\n   event_at:=d.occurred_at;\n  END IF;\n  INSERT INTO public.supplier_replacement_cases(operation_id,supplier_id,product_id,warehouse_id,branch_id,origin,damage_event_id,quantity,commercial_quantity,units_per_commercial_unit,unit_name,base_unit_name,unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact,occurred_at,created_by)\n  VALUES(operation_id,supplier_id,product_id,warehouse_id,branch_id,CASE WHEN p_action='shop_damage' THEN 'shop_damage' ELSE 'shop' END,\n   CASE WHEN p_action='shop_damage' THEN d.id END,qty,commercial,units,\n   CASE WHEN p_payload->>'unit'='parcel' THEN 'طرد' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT name_ar FROM public.units WHERE id=p.unit_id),'باكيت') END,\n   COALESCE((SELECT name_ar FROM public.units WHERE id=p.unit_id),'باكيت'),cost,event_at,actor) RETURNING id INTO case_id;\n  PERFORM public.sr208_append_event_internal(operation_id,case_id,CASE p_action WHEN 'shop_pending' THEN 'send' WHEN 'shop_immediate' THEN 'immediate' ELSE 'damage' END,\n   qty,CASE WHEN p_action='shop_pending' THEN qty ELSE 0 END,0,CASE WHEN p_action='shop_pending' THEN -qty ELSE 0 END,reason,event_at);\n  case_ids:=ARRAY[case_id];\n ELSIF p_action IN ('receive','writeoff','reverse') THEN\n  IF p_action='reverse' THEN\n   SELECT * INTO e FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE id=(p_payload->>'eventId')::UUID;\n   IF NOT FOUND OR e.action='reverse' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_EVENT_INVALID'; END IF;\n   case_id:=e.case_id;\n  ELSE case_id:=(p_payload->>'caseId')::UUID; END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO c FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases WHERE id=case_id;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_CASE_INVALID'; END IF;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.warehouses WHERE id=c.warehouse_id;\n  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('supplier-replacement208-case|'||case_id::TEXT,0));\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_cases WHERE id=case_id FOR SHARE;\n  PERFORM public.phase2_lock_inventory_products_internal(ARRAY[c.product_id]);\n  -- Verify every product-local C9 inverse pair before excluding its movements.\n  PERFORM public.sr208_assert_operation_internal(v.operation_id)\n   FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ev.operation_id FROM public.supplier_replacement_events ev JOIN public.supplier_replacement_cases sc ON sc.id=ev.case_id WHERE sc.product_id=c.product_id) v;\n  SELECT COALESCE(sum(held_delta),0) INTO held FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE supplier_replacement_events.case_id=case_id;\n  IF p_action='reverse' THEN\n   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE reverses_event_id=e.id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_ALREADY_REVERSED'; END IF;\n   -- No live descendant may be discarded by reversing an earlier event.\n   IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE descendants AS (SELECT id,action FROM public.supplier_replacement_events WHERE previous_event_id=e.id UNION ALL\n    SELECT n.id,n.action FROM public.supplier_replacement_events n JOIN descendants x ON n.previous_event_id=x.id)\n    SELECT 1 FROM descendants x WHERE x.action<>'reverse' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.supplier_replacement_events r WHERE r.reverses_event_id=x.id)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_DEPENDENCY'; END IF;\n   IF held-e.held_delta<0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_DEPENDENCY'; END IF;\n   SELECT * INTO STRICT f FROM public.supplier_replacement_inventory_effects WHERE supplier_replacement_inventory_effects.event_id=e.id;\n   expense:=-e.expense_delta_in_minor_units;\n   IF e.action='damage' THEN expense:=-((SELECT loss_in_minor_units FROM public.inventory_damage_events WHERE id=c.damage_event_id)); END IF;\n   PERFORM public.sr208_append_event_internal(operation_id,c.id,'reverse',e.quantity,-e.held_delta,expense,f.on_hand_before-f.on_hand_after,reason,clock_timestamp(),e.id);\n  ELSE\n   IF jsonb_typeof(p_payload->'quantity') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR (p_payload->>'quantity')!~'^[1-9][0-9]*$' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_QUANTITY_INVALID'; END IF;\n   qty:=(p_payload->>'quantity')::INTEGER;\n   IF qty>held THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_EXCEEDS_PENDING'; END IF;\n   IF p_action='writeoff' THEN\n    SELECT COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN ev.action='writeoff' THEN ev.quantity WHEN ev.action='reverse' AND original.action='writeoff' THEN -ev.quantity ELSE 0 END),0)\n    INTO written FROM public.supplier_replacement_events ev LEFT JOIN public.supplier_replacement_events original ON original.id=ev.reverses_event_id WHERE ev.case_id=c.id;\n    expense:=round((written+qty)*c.unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact)::BIGINT-round(written*c.unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact)::BIGINT;\n   ELSE stock_delta:=qty; END IF;\n   PERFORM public.sr208_append_event_internal(operation_id,c.id,p_action,qty,-qty,expense,stock_delta,reason,clock_timestamp());\n  END IF;\n  case_ids:=ARRAY[c.id];\n ELSE\n  -- Discover supplier parents without a blocking row lock. The financial\n  -- coordinator owns order/shift/inventory acquisition; no earlier supplier\n  -- lock may reverse the canonical receipt-cancellation hierarchy.\n  FOR supplier_id IN SELECT DISTINCT (x->>'supplierId')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(assignments) x ORDER BY 1 LOOP\n   PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers s WHERE s.id=supplier_id AND s.is_active;\n   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  PERFORM 1 FROM public.warehouses w JOIN public.orders o ON o.warehouse_id=w.id WHERE o.id=order_id;\n  return_result:=public.settle_admin_sales_return_v1(order_id,k,p_payload->'items',p_payload->'physicalSources',reason,\n   p_payload->>'refundMethod',p_payload->>'referenceNumber',p_payload->>'notes');\n  FOR supplier_id IN SELECT DISTINCT (x->>'supplierId')::UUID FROM jsonb_array_elements(assignments) x ORDER BY 1 LOOP\n   BEGIN\n    PERFORM 1 FROM public.suppliers s WHERE s.id=supplier_id AND s.is_active FOR SHARE NOWAIT;\n   EXCEPTION WHEN lock_not_available THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001',MESSAGE='SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_PARENT_BUSY_RETRY: تغيّر قفل المورد؛ أعد نفس المحاولة.';\n   END;\n   IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_SUPPLIER_INVALID'; END IF;\n  END LOOP;\n  SELECT b.id,se.id INTO return_operation,return_event FROM public.business_operations b JOIN public.sales_return_events se ON se.operation_id=b.id\n   WHERE b.operation_type='phase4_return_v1' AND b.actor_scope_hash=public.phase3_actor_scope_hash_internal('erp_user',actor,NULL,NULL)\n    AND public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(b.idempotency_key)=public.phase4_canonicalize_idempotency_key_internal(k);\n  IF return_event IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_EVIDENCE_INVALID'; END IF;\n  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM public.inventory_damage_events WHERE return_event_id=return_event)<>jsonb_array_length(assignments)\n   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.inventory_damage_events de WHERE de.return_event_id=return_event AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(assignments) x WHERE x->>'sourceKind'=de.source_kind AND (x->>'sourceId')::UUID=de.source_id)) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT_RETURN_ASSIGNMENTS_MISMATCH';\n  END IF;\n  -- Canonical return has already discovered AND locked every physical leaf.\n  -- It must remain the only stock/financial writer for the customer return.\n  FOR d IN SELECT de.* FROM public.inventory_damage_events de WHERE de.return_event_id=return_event ORDER BY de.product_id,de.source_kind,de.source_id LOOP\n   SELECT (x->>'supplierId')::UUID INTO supplier_id FROM jsonb_array_elements(assignments) x WHERE x->>'sourceKind'=d.source_kind AND (x->>'sourceId')::UUID=d.source_id;\n   INSERT INTO public.supplier_replacement_cases(operation_id,supplier_id,product_id,warehouse_id,branch_id,origin,damage_event_id,quantity,commercial_quantity,units_per_commercial_unit,unit_name,base_unit_name,unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact,occurred_at,created_by)\n   VALUES(operation_id,supplier_id,d.product_id,d.warehouse_id,d.branch_id,'customer_return',d.id,d.quantity,d.quantity,1,\n    COALESCE((SELECT u.name_ar FROM public.products pr LEFT JOIN public.units u ON u.id=pr.unit_id WHERE pr.id=d.product_id),'باكيت'),\n    COALESCE((SELECT u.name_ar FROM public.products pr LEFT JOIN public.units u ON u.id=pr.unit_id WHERE pr.id=d.product_id),'باكيت'),d.unit_cost_in_minor_units_exact,d.occurred_at,actor) RETURNING id INTO case_id;\n   PERFORM         "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_customer_address_map_url()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_url TEXT := NULLIF(TRIM(NEW.google_maps_url), '');\n  v_coordinates DOUBLE PRECISION[];\nBEGIN\n  IF v_url IS NULL THEN\n    RETURN NEW;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF CHAR_LENGTH(v_url) > 1000\n    OR v_url ~ '[[:space:][:cntrl:]]'\n    OR NOT (\n      v_url ~* '^https://(?:maps\\.app\\.goo\\.gl|maps\\.google\\.com)(?:/|\\?|#|$)'\n      OR v_url ~* '^https://goo\\.gl/maps(?:/|\\?|#|$)'\n      OR v_url ~* '^https://(?:www\\.)?google\\.com/maps(?:/|\\?|#|$)'\n    )\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION\n      'ألصق رابط مشاركة صحيحًا من خرائط Google لموقع التوصيل.';\n  END IF;\n\n  NEW.google_maps_url := v_url;\n\n  IF NEW.latitude IS NULL AND NEW.longitude IS NULL THEN\n    v_coordinates := public.extract_google_maps_coordinates(v_url);\n\n    IF v_coordinates IS NOT NULL THEN\n      NEW.latitude := v_coordinates[1];\n      NEW.longitude := v_coordinates[2];\n      NEW.location_source := 'map_pin';\n      NEW.location_confirmed := true;\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF NEW.latitude IS NOT NULL AND NEW.longitude IS NOT NULL THEN\n    IF NEW.latitude NOT BETWEEN -90 AND 90\n      OR NEW.longitude NOT BETWEEN -180 AND 180\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION 'إحداثيات موقع التوصيل غير صحيحة.';\n    END IF;\n\n    NEW.location_confirmed := true;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_order_inventory_reservation_chain()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_line_kind TEXT;\n  v_order_item_product_id UUID;\n  v_component_quantity INTEGER;\n  v_component_count INTEGER;\n  v_instance_finalized_at TIMESTAMPTZ;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT item.commercial_line_kind, item.product_id\n  INTO v_line_kind, v_order_item_product_id\n  FROM public.order_items item\n  WHERE item.id = NEW.order_item_id\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23503',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'order_inventory_reservations_order_item_id_fkey',\n      MESSAGE = 'Reservation Order Item does not exist.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel' THEN\n    IF NEW.parcel_instance_id IS NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'order_inventory_reservations_parcel_required_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'A configurable Parcel reservation requires its exact Parcel Instance.';\n    END IF;\n\n    SELECT\n      SUM(component.base_quantity)::INTEGER,\n      COUNT(*)::INTEGER,\n      MAX(instance.finalized_at)\n    INTO v_component_quantity, v_component_count, v_instance_finalized_at\n    FROM public.order_parcel_components component\n    JOIN public.order_parcel_instances instance\n      ON instance.id = component.parcel_instance_id\n    WHERE component.parcel_instance_id = NEW.parcel_instance_id\n      AND component.product_id = NEW.product_id\n      AND component.operation_id = NEW.operation_id\n      AND instance.order_item_id = NEW.order_item_id\n      AND instance.order_id = NEW.order_id;\n\n    -- The Phase-1 contract permits a component reservation smaller than the\n    -- immutable component quantity. The later coordinator is responsible for\n    -- atomically reserving the full composition; this generic relationship\n    -- guard only prevents an untraceable or over-capacity component hold.\n    -- Missing/cross-chain component identity is left to the existing composite\n    -- foreign keys so their established SQLSTATE/constraint identities remain\n    -- backward compatible. This guard adds only finalized/quantity semantics.\n    IF v_component_count > 0\n      AND (\n        v_instance_finalized_at IS NULL\n        OR NEW.reserved_quantity > v_component_quantity\n      )\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'order_inventory_reservations_component_quantity_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'PARCEL_RESERVATION_COMPONENT_MISMATCH: Reservation must reference a finalized Parcel component without exceeding its Base Unit quantity.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSE\n    IF NEW.parcel_instance_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'order_inventory_reservations_base_parcel_absent_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'A Base Unit reservation cannot claim a Parcel Instance.';\n    END IF;\n    IF v_order_item_product_id IS NULL\n      OR NEW.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_order_item_product_id\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n        ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'order_inventory_reservations_base_product_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'Base Unit reservation product must match its original Order Item product.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_order_parcel_instance_family()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_configuration public.product_parcel_configurations%ROWTYPE;\n  v_line_kind TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  -- New Parcel construction starts the global lock hierarchy by locking its\n  -- commercial Order Item before the Parcel Instance row exists.\n  SELECT item.commercial_line_kind\n  INTO v_line_kind\n  FROM public.order_items item\n  WHERE item.id = NEW.order_item_id\n  FOR UPDATE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_line_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'configurable_parcel' THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING\n      ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'order_parcel_instances_order_item_kind_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'A Parcel Instance requires an explicit configurable Parcel Order Item.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT * INTO v_configuration\n  FROM public.product_parcel_configurations\n  WHERE id = NEW.parcel_configuration_id\n  FOR SHARE;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND\n    OR v_configuration.family_product_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.family_product_id\n    OR v_configuration.configuration_revision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.configuration_revision\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Parcel instance configuration/family snapshot is inconsistent.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_phase2_inventory_movement_source()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_product_id UUID;\n  v_operation_id UUID;\n  v_receipt_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.supplier_receipt_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    SELECT item.product_id, item.operation_id, item.supplier_receipt_id\n    INTO v_product_id, v_operation_id, v_receipt_id\n    FROM public.supplier_receipt_items item\n    WHERE item.id = NEW.supplier_receipt_item_id;\n    IF NOT FOUND OR NEW.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_product_id\n      OR NEW.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_operation_id\n      OR NEW.reference_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_receipt_id\n      OR NEW.reference_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'supplier_receipt'\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'inventory_movements_supplier_receipt_item_chain_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'Inventory Movement must match its Supplier Receipt component.';\n    END IF;\n  ELSIF NEW.purchase_receipt_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    SELECT item.product_id, item.operation_id, item.purchase_receipt_id\n    INTO v_product_id, v_operation_id, v_receipt_id\n    FROM public.purchase_receipt_items item\n    WHERE item.id = NEW.purchase_receipt_item_id;\n    IF NOT FOUND OR NEW.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_product_id\n      OR NEW.operation_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_operation_id\n      OR NEW.reference_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_receipt_id\n      OR NEW.reference_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'purchase_receipt'\n    THEN\n      RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n        CONSTRAINT = 'inventory_movements_purchase_receipt_item_chain_check',\n        MESSAGE = 'Inventory Movement must match its Purchase Receipt component.';\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_product_parcel_configuration()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_family public.products%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO v_family\n  FROM public.products\n  WHERE id = NEW.family_product_id;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR v_family.flavor_master_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Parcel configuration must reference a family root product.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.composition_mode = 'configurable_mix'\n    AND NOT v_family.is_flavor_master\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Configurable mixed parcels require a flavor family master.';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_family.sale_unit_id IS NULL\n    OR COALESCE(v_family.units_per_sale_unit, 0) <= 0\n  THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Parcel family requires a valid configured sale unit and pack size.';\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_purchase_order_component_family_v2()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_item public.purchase_order_items%ROWTYPE;\n  v_actual_family UUID;\n  v_is_master BOOLEAN;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT * INTO v_item\n  FROM public.purchase_order_items item\n  WHERE item.id = NEW.purchase_order_item_id\n  FOR SHARE;\n  IF NOT FOUND THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23503',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'purchase_order_item_components_item_fkey',\n      MESSAGE = 'Purchase Order Item does not exist.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT COALESCE(product.flavor_master_product_id, product.id), product.is_flavor_master\n  INTO v_actual_family, v_is_master\n  FROM public.products product WHERE product.id = NEW.product_id;\n  IF v_is_master OR (\n    v_item.commercial_line_kind = 'base_unit'\n      AND NEW.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_item.product_id\n  ) OR (\n    v_item.commercial_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel'\n      AND v_actual_family IS DISTINCT FROM v_item.family_product_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'purchase_order_item_components_family_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'Purchase Order component must match its immutable commercial family.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",

        "definition": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_purchase_receipt_item_family_v2()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_line public.purchase_receipt_commercial_lines%ROWTYPE;\n  v_actual_family UUID;\n  v_is_master BOOLEAN;\n  v_po_product_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  IF NEW.commercial_line_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  SELECT * INTO v_line\n  FROM public.purchase_receipt_commercial_lines line\n  WHERE line.id = NEW.commercial_line_id;\n  SELECT COALESCE(product.flavor_master_product_id, product.id), product.is_flavor_master\n  INTO v_actual_family, v_is_master\n  FROM public.products product WHERE product.id = NEW.product_id;\n  SELECT item.product_id INTO v_po_product_id\n  FROM public.purchase_order_items item WHERE item.id = v_line.purchase_order_item_id;\n  IF v_is_master OR (\n    v_line.commercial_line_kind = 'base_unit'\n      AND NEW.product_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_po_product_id\n  ) OR (\n    v_line.commercial_line_kind = 'configurable_parcel'\n      AND v_actual_family IS DISTINCT FROM v_line.family_product_id\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514',\n      CONSTRAINT = 'purchase_receipt_items_commercial_family_check',\n      MESSAGE = 'Purchase Receipt component must match its commercial Family.';\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$function$\n",
